text.body:
{īśvarapratyabhijñānasūtravimarśinī
vyākhyā}
nāmarūpātmakaṃ viśvaṃ yasya līlāyitaṃ vapuḥ | prakāśāya namastasmai savimarśāya śaṃbhave ||
iha viśvānujisṛghṛkṣāparaḥ paramaśiva eva sakalabhūmaṇḍalottare śrīmacchāradādivyakrīḍāsadane śrīkāśmīradeśe śrīnarasiṃhaguptanātha iti prakhyātābhidhāno nikhilarahasyāmnāyasarabhūtaṃ śrītrai'yambaka santāna cūḍāmaṇi śrīmadutpaladevācārya mukhodgītaṃ śrīmadīśvarapratyabhijñākhyaṃ śāstraṃ vyācikhyāsuḥ svavyākhyānasya niṣpratyūha paripūraṇāya tacchāstrasārabhūtāṃ parāṃ devatāṃ samāviśyā nugrāhyajanasamāveśārthaṃ stutiparāmarśa pūrvamabhimukhīkaroti nirāśaṃsādityādinā | yat ahamiti pūrṇānnirāśaṃsāt unmeṣa prasaraṇanimeṣāsthitijuṣaḥ svarūpāt nijakalāṃ purāddhiśākhāmābhā sayati | tadanu tāmeva vibhaṅktumāśāstecā tatparamaśivaśaktyātmanikhilamadvaitaṃ bande ityanvayaḥ | yatkila śrītriṃśikāśāstre (-)
anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulika siddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarī samatāṃ vrajet ||
<2> etadguhyaṃ mahāguptaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdaye sā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kula nāyikā ||
tāṃ mekathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmyaham ||
iti prathamaṃ devī praśna mavatārya (-)
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram | kaulikoyaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomvyavasthitaḥ ||
ityādinā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā ityantena granthena prativacanamarpayatā bhairaveṇa caturdaśayutamityatroddhṛtyaitadanantaramanyāccāra ityādinā
tasyaiva sarvasiddhivibhūtisamudayatvamupavarṇitam ||
evamanuttara bhaṭṭārikātmaka parabhairava yāmala vācakī bhūtaṃ mahā phala pradaṃ hṛdaya bījamasmin śāstrāvatāra etannāyoginī jāta ityādi sarvajñatvamavāpyata ityantena jīvanmukti vibhūtyātmakaparāparasiddhihetubhūtamanuttara bhaṭṭārakaparābhaṭṭārikātmaka bhairava yāmala vācakī bhūtaṃ hṛdayabījamālocitam | tadanta śrīmadīśvarapratyābhijñāśāstra vyākhyānaṃ bha (-------------) ya pādairbhaṅgyantareṇa prakaṭīkṛtam | tadyathā yadityanenānuttaram | nijakalāmiti visargaśaktiḥ | unmeṣa prasaraṇetyādicaturdaśasvaraḥ | nikhilamityanena sadvṛtti rūpam | etacca śāstrakārairadhikāracatuṣṭayerahasya bhāṣayā tadabhihitam | kathaṃ tatra (-------------) nimeṣa lakṣaṇena saṃkocavikāsātmanā jñānakriyālakṣaṇena svabhāvena svaparispanda na sāraeva na tu pariniṣṭhita paricchinna jaḍasvarūpa ghaṭāditulyaḥ | tasya ca saṃkoca vikāsa yogaḥ trikoṇa hṛdaya parispandanādiṣu yathā yathā sphuṭī bhavati (------------) bhairava saṃvidi yathā yathā ca nyūnībhavati tathā tathā tannikṛṣyate yābajjaḍepāṣāṇādau | sa ca saṃkocavikāsalakṣaṇopi sargasvātantryātmā bhagavato'nuttarasya śaktiriti ladhṛvṛttyukta nyāyena jñānakriyādhikārābhyāṃ bindudvandvātmikā visargaśaktirā(----------) rūpeṇātmanā praśamenāhnikena sadvṛtti pramātṛtatva nirūpaṇātmanā dvitīyenāhnikena triśūlaṃ sarvadhātvantarālīnetyādinānuttaramityadhikāracatuṣṭayāntarhṛdā bījasvarūpaṃ spaṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyam |
iha hi etaddhṛdayabījamevāthāryairahamakamahāma(-----)ktam | asya mahāmantrasya | ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām | anuccāryāmahaṃ vāma madhīye hṛdayaṃ prabhoḥ ||
ādyantāntargatānanta vācya vācaka nirbharam || rahasyaṃ mantramudrāṇāṃ prapadye'hamanuttaram ||
maha iti śrīparyanta pañcāśikopakramopasaṃhāraślokoktanītyā ādyamakṣaramanuttaram |
visargo'yamathātyarthaṃ sphuṭobhūt sṛjyavistarāt | etatpṛṣṭātmaśaktīnāmitaretara miśraṇāt ||
bhavatkṣobhāntaraṃ nāsmādvisargādbāhyato bhavet ||
itinītyā ca | akārādihakārāntākṣara vargaḥ pañcadhā sa ceti taṃtra sadbhāvoktanītyā cāntyabhūto hakāro visargaḥ | amityatrabījautriśūlasadvṛttī draṣṭavye | kathaṃ tadvahna | paraṃ śuddhaṃ śāntamabhinnātmakaṃ samaṃ sakalaṃ amṛtaṃ satyaṃ śaktau viśrāmyati bhāsvara rūpāyā mitayata iti vedya iti saṃpādyata iti ca | bhāsvara rūpeṇāmarāmṛṣṭaṃ sadapi tu namaḥ prasūnatvamabhyetīti paramārthasārokta prakāreṇecchā jñānakriyātmakaṃ triśūla meṣaṇī yajñeya kāryātmaka sadvṛttirūpaṃ vedyarāśiṃ svīkṛtya tadetadvedyavedana vedaka viśrānti trayamayaṃ varṇa trayasyarūpamiti śrīlaghuvṛttyukta nītyā svadā mapi vedanātmakatvādviśvavedyā vibhāgavedanātmā binduriti śrīsāmba vyākhyānoktarītyā viśvavedyāvibhāgavedanātmani svoparivartini bindau viśrāmyatītyasya bindo striśūlasadvṛttimayatvam | kiñca hṛdayasya mūlabhāge sadvṛttirūpe vedyāṃśe jāgratsvapna suṣuptyātmakātisphuṭasphuṭā sphuṭa bhedatrayaśāntinisarvathātyanmātra prathamakalā vapuṣi viśrāmyājvṛttāvuttararūpāyāṃ śaktiśivatattvānta krameṇa turīya pada paryantaṃ viśrāntena kramabhinnasamastatatvasvīkaraṇādāsanavyāptiḥ pradarśitā bhavatīti śrīlaghuvṛttidṛṣṭyā sadvṛttitriśūlayorapi vedyarāśi mayatvāt kṣityādiśivāntavedyāvibhāgavedanarūpe bindau viśrāntiḥ |
vedyaṃ svakrama siddhāvittimanupraviśadaṅgaviṣayādyam |
iti śrī virūpākṣapañcāśikoktanītyāyuktai veti hṛdayabījasya mahāmantrāntarbhāvaḥ | vastuvṛttyā(-)
āmūlātaḥ kramājjñeyā kṣāntādṛṣṭirudā hṛtā || iti |
avarṇastho yathā varṇasthitaḥ sarvagataḥ priye || iti | aṣṭatriṃśat paraṃdhāma yatraitadviśvakaṃ sphuret || iti | sārṇena tritayaṃ vyāptaṃ triśūlena turīyakam || iti |
tato visargātmikā ṣoḍaśī bhairavātmikā yāvatsarvottīrṇaturīyaspṛgiṣyata iti | akāro vai sarvā vāgiti śrītantramasat | bhāvataṃ tra vaṭadhānikā mālinī vijaya laghuvṛtti śrutyuktanītyānuttaravisargayoḥ bhairavayāmalayo rakārādikṣakārānta vācaka kṣityādi śivānta vācya samuttīrṇatvānmahāmantradaśottīrṇatvam | tathāpyanayorapi mātṛkāt evāntarbhāvāttanmātṛkāmūlabhūtamahāmantramayatvamapyastyeva | kiṃ bahunā mahāmantra iti vimarśo hi viśvākāreṇa viśva prakāśanena viśvasaṃhāreṇa vākṛtrimāhamiti sphuraṇamityupanyāsanītyā
tau mātṛmā (------) ti meya mayārtha garbhau mātaḥ śive śivapitaḥ śaraṇaṃ śraye vām |
iti śrīśuktāvalayuktanītyā ca tayoḥ parāmṛṣṭarūpayoranuttaraparābhaṭṭārikayoḥ svātmaśivādi kṣityantaviśvakroḍīkārako'hamiti parāmarśaḥ | taduktaṃ śrī tantrāloke -
(-----------------------) sargātmaśivaśaktyadvayātmani | parāmarśonirbharatvādahamityucyate prabhoḥ ||
itītyanenaivāśayenādāvahamiti prayuktaḥ | itīti evaṃ bhūtena mahāmantreṇa pūrṇāt bharitāt | pūrṇatvaṃ nāma śivādikṣityanta viśvanirbharatva mākāṃ kṣaṇīya maparaṃ yena (-------------) nādvitīyasyayuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā | iti śrīmatstotrāvalyuktanītyā nirāśaṃsādunmeṣetyādinānavarata jaḍa brahmavādivilakṣaṇasṛṣṭyādipañcavidha kṛtyakāritvamuktam | tatronmeṣaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ | prasaraṇaṃ sthitinime (--------------------) hau gṛhyete |
cidātmaiva hi devontaḥ sthitamicchāvaśādbahiḥ | yogīva nirūpādānamarthajātaṃ prakāśayet ||
iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā | ataḥ saṃvidaikyena sthita svabhāva rāśerbahirunmajjanarūpatvādunmeṣasya gṛ (----------) ti hetutvāt prasaraṇasya sthititvaṃ bahīrūpatāvilāpanenāntarnimajjanātmaka syānnimeṣasya saṃhāratvaṃ saṃhṛtasya bhāvarāśerantaḥ saṃskārātmanāvasthāpakahetutvāt sthitestirodhānamayatvaṃ tādṛśasya bhāvarāśeści (-------------) taranugrahātmatvaṃ ca | yadivonmeṣetyādi sthitītyantena kevalaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāvabhidhīyete tatonmeṣaprasāraṇetyanenasṛṣṭiḥ nimeṣasthitītyanena saṃhāraḥ sthiti vilayānugrahāṇāṃ viśi (------------) tvāt nādhikāmiti pralayodayābhyāmeva pañcavidhaṃ pārameśvaraṃ kṛtyaṃ saṃgṛhyate | śrīspandanirṇayoktanātyā sthiti tirodhānānugrahāstvanayostvantarbhūtā eva | tatra sṛṣṭayantargatā sthitiḥ | saṃhārāntargatau tirodhānānugrahau | anena
yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau | taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ ||
iti śrīspandakārikārthasaṃgṛhītasvarūpādātmīyāt avināśinorūpyamāṇasya kāryarūpaviśvasya kāraṇabhūtāt śaktirūpāt (-) yo <7> viśvajīvitamayo bhagavān prakāśaḥ(,) iti śrīsuktāvuktanītyā prakāśanādbhāvāt | atha ca(,) nijadharmiṇaṃ svarūpaṃ prakāśayantī prakāśyavargasya iti | iti śrīvirūpākṣapañcāśikoktanītyā svaṃsvātmanaḥ prakāśa rūpaṃ prakāśyasya viśvasya rūpayantīti vā svarūpaṃ tādṛśāt |
sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyācchive(-------) t || iti
śrīvijñānabhairavokta sthityā sarvajñatvādi yuktāt svarūpāt | nijakalāmiti | nijāṃ sahajāṃ
śakti śaktimatoryasmādabhedaḥ sarvadāsthitaḥ | atastaddharmadhārmitvātparāśaktiḥ parātmanaḥ ||
śaktiścaśaktimadrūpādvyatirekaṃ na vāñchati | tādātmya manayornityaṃ vahnidāhikayoriva || iti |
ananyāpekṣitā yasya viśvātmatvaṃ pratiprabho | tāṃ parāṃ pratibhāṃ devīṃ saṃgirante hyanuttarām ||
akulasyāsya devasya kulaprathanaśālinī | kālikī sā parāśakti raviyukto yayā prabhuḥ ||
iti śrīvijñāna bhairava prabodhapañcadaśikā tantrāloka sthityā svāviyuktam | kiñca yasmiṃsthite yadudeti līyate ca tattat pūrvāparabhāga vyāpi | yathā bhūmāvaṅkara iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā viśvapūrvāparakoṭivyāpitvānnityāṃ <8> svātmano (------) bhedanaṃ kṣepo bhedeti tasyā vikalpanam |
jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ saṅkhyānamanyato vyatibhedanāt | gatisvarūpā rohitvaṃ pratibimbavadeva yat ||
nādasvātmaparāmarśa śeṣatā tadvilāpanāt ||
iti pañcavidhamenāṃ kalanāṃ kurvatī parā ||
devī kālī tathā kālakarṣaṇī ceti cocyate ||
iti tantrālokanītyā pañcavidhakṛtyakāriṇīṃ sṛṣṭimayīṃ svātantryaśaktim | pureti antaḥ sthitasya bahiravabibhāsayiṣāyāḥ prathamam | dviśākhāmiti | dviśākhātvaṃ nāma svāntarahamityaikātmyena viśvasyāhamidamidamahamiti śrīsadāśiveśvaro citāntarāyamāṇāṅkurite dantā pratītiḥ | tadvatī | anuttaraṃ svayamekameva sat svāviyuktatvādekāmapi satāṃ svātantryeṇa dvidhārūpāṃ prakāśayati | māsanaṃ nāma ātmānamata evāyamiti vakṣyamāṇanītyā bhāsakasyānuttarabhaṭṭārakasya svātantryāttattadrūpatayā sphuraṇam | tadanviti | dviśākhāmābhāsānantaraṃ tāmeva nijakalāṃ vibhaṅktuṃ mantravijñānā kalapralayā phala sakala pramātṛ tatprameya vargātmanārūpeṇa prakāśayitum | āśāste icchati ca | āśāsanaṃ nāmātiṣṭhāsorevamicchaiva hetutā kartṛtā kriyā | iti vakṣyamāṇa nītyā icchāyāḥ viśvanirmāṇarūpakriyāparyantī bhāvaḥ | ābhāsayati āśāsta ityeka kartṛkatva dyotakena yamuccayārthena ābhāsanasaktivimarśana bījāvasthāpa (---------------)
panatastāni pañcavidhakṛtyāni karotīti śrīpratyabhijñā hṛdayokta nītyā ābhāsanādi śabdavācyeṣu sṛṣṭyādikṛtyasya sarvasya svātmana eva kartṛtvaṃ na tu brahmādivat ekaikasmin pratiniyate kṛtyaviśeṣa ityetat dyotitam | (---------) vibhāgāśāsanayoravyavadhānatvaṃ ca(,) ābhāsayati āśāste ceti cavartamāna prayogeṇa tadidaṃ śakticakramavicchinna prabandhaṃ bhagavato bhairavanāyasyeti laghuvṛttyuktanītyā aviratamābhāsanādikartṛtvaṃ darśitam | taditi sa (------) paramaśivaśaktyātmanikhilamiti | icchādiyuktaṃ paramaśivasvarūpatvaṃ dviśākhāmābhāsanena śaktyātmakaṃ vibhā (---) tadadvaitamiti anantetāvadākāra svīkāre'pyekalakṣaṇāṃ tāṃ svasaṃvidamāviśya vikalpānna (------------) kokta dṛṣṭyā śivāda (------------) tadekaghanasvarūpā | kiñcādvaitamiti
yatra tejāṃsitejāṃsi tamāṃsi ca tamāṃsyalam | tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsyeva (----------) jyotiranuttaram ||
iti śrī laghuvṛttyuktanītyā (-------------------) ram |
śivāścidānandaghanaḥ paramākṣara vigrahaḥ ||
iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā svavācakabhūtarahasyākṣarābhinnatayā arūpaṃ viśvottīrṇaṃ tadantargataviśvabahirvamana grasana śīlatayādvaitaṃ viśvamayam | atra tattvāmityadhyāhāryam | vande iti | vādi abhivādana (-----) (--) kaṣṭatvena parāmarśanīyaḥ |
atha sarvāvasthāsusphuradrupatvādabhivadat abhimukhyena svasvarūpaṃ vimṛśat tatsamarthā caraṇe na nityodya (---) tā prayatnenābhivādaye svarūpa parāmarśaniṣṭhaṃ tatsaṃmukhīkaroti | tatra smṛtirnā(--------------------) tatsaṃmukhīkaraṇamabhivādanamitisaṃkṣepataḥ ślokārthaḥ(,)
evamiṣṭāṃ ciddevatāṃ abhivandya vyācikhyāsitasyaśāstrasya guru paramparayā vatāraṃ darśayan vyākhyāmitthaṃ karomīti pratijānīte (-)
śrītraiyambakasadvaṃśa madhyamuktā mayasthiteḥ | śrīsomānanda nāthasya vijñānapratibimbakam || 2 ||
anuttarānanya sākṣi pumārtho pāya mabhyadhāt | īśvara pratyabhijñākhyaṃ yacchāstraṃ yatsunirmalam || 3 ||
tatpraśiṣyaḥ karomyetāṃ tatsūtra vivṛtiṃ laghum | buddhvābhinavaguptohaṃ śrīmallakṣmaṇaguptataḥ || 4 ||
tatraprathama manvayaḥ (-) śrītraiyambakasadvaṃśamadhyamuktā mayasthiteḥ śrīsomānanda nāthasya vijñānapratibimbakaṃ anuttarānanya sākṣipumarthopāyaṃ īśvara pratyabhijñākhyaṃ śāstraṃ ya abhyadhāt tatpraśiṣyaḥ abhinavagupto'haṃ śrīmallakṣmaṇaguptataḥ buddhvā etāṃ tatsūtravṛttiṃ laghukaromīti | śrītraiyāmbiketi | śriyā jīvācchivatvābhivyakti lakṣaṇayā mokṣalakṣmyā avibhaktasya traiyambakasya sambandhinaḥ sataḥ avirataṃ vartamānasyātha ca sato mayā kāluṣyarahitatvāt śuddhasya |
kailāsādau bhraman devo mūrtyā śrīkaṇṭharūpayā | anugrahāyāvatīrṇaścodayāmāsa bhūtale ||
muniṃ durvāsasaṃ nāma bhagavānūrdhvaretasam | no cchidyeta yathā śāstraṃ rahasyaṃ kuru tādṛśam ||
tataḥ sabhagavān devādādeśaṃ prāpyayatnavān | sasarjamānasaṃ putraṃ tryambakādityanāmakam ||
tasmin saṃkrāmayāmāsa rahasyānisamantataḥ | sopi gatvā guhaṃ samyak tryambakākhyaṃ tataḥ param ||
tannāmnā cintitaṃ tatra sasarja manasā sutam | khamutpapātasaṃbiddhastatputropi tathā tathā ||
siddhastadvatsutotpattyā siddhā eva caturdaśa | yāvatpañcadaśaḥ putraḥ sarvaśāstra viśāradaḥ ||
sa kadācidrāga vaśāt kutaścidbrāhmaṇāt svayam | brāhmaṇī mānayā māsa tato jātastathā vidhaḥ ||
tanayaḥ sa ca kāle na kāśmīreṣvāgato bhraman | nāmnā sa saṅgamādityo varṣādityo'pi tatsutaḥ ||
tasyāpyabhūt sa bhagavān taruṇāditya saṃjñakaḥ | ānanda saṃjñakastasyādudbabhūva tathā vidhaḥ ||
tasmādasmin samudbhūtaḥ somānandākhya īdṛśaḥ | karotisma prakaraṇaṃ śivadṛṣṭyābhidhānakam ||
ityādiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā somānandena śāsane | svakīye tatprasādena śivajñānāmṛtārṇavam ||
avāpyotpalā devo'pi sadbhiḥ saṃpūjitassadā | īśvarapratyabhijñākhya śāsanaikavidhistathā ||
śrīmatstotrāvalī saṃjñā śivāmarśāmṛtākaraḥ | śivāgama rahasyārtha prakāśana divākaraḥ ||
ajāyata tatastasmāt śrīmallakṣmaṇa guptataḥ | adhigamyarahasyārthaṃ sakalaṃ pratyapādayat ||
tatobhinavaguptāya mahāmantreśvarāya saḥ | samasta śivaśāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyātā śivacoditaḥ ||
pratyakṣa tapanaprāpta śāṅkara jñāna bhājanam | samastalokayātrātma śivarūpa prakāśataḥ ||
arakṣat kṣemarājājyastrilakṣagranthakārakaḥ ||
iti prokta (----------) śamadhye sthito muktāmaṇiḥ svaprastuti hetuṃ taṃ vaṃśaṃ viśadayan yathā tiṣṭhati tadvat tryambakādisaṃbandhinaḥ sato virataṃ vartamānasya(,) atha ca sato māyā kāluṣya rahitatvāt śuddhasya santānasya madhye tadantaḥ muktāmayasthiteḥ āmayopalakṣitamāyā rahitasthite (--------) śrī somānanda nāthasyeti prokta lakṣmī sahitasya śrīśivadṛṣṭikāra śrīsomānandanāmno nāthasya | athavā umāparābhaṭṭārikā viyuktasyānandānāṃ sarvajñatva sarvakartṛtvādi siddhīnāṃ nāthasyānuttarabhaṭṭārakasya (-)

saṅketakaraṇe tasya sāmānya lakṣaṇatvena svalakṣaṇatva hāni prasaṃgāt | vastumātrarūpe vā bhrāntyā anyasminnanya saṃjñā kāraṇavat kathañcitkṛtasyāpisaṅketasya vyavahārasādhakatvena niṣprayojanatvāt | tena saṅketakaraṇayogyenānanuyāyinā pramātrananu gatena svasvarūpa mātra niṣṭhena lakṣaṇe na punaḥ saṅketa grahaṇānantara bhāvī vyavahāro na syāt | ato vyavahāropayogisāmānyalakṣaṇameva vikalpasya viṣayaḥ ityanyārtharūpaṃ vikalpajñānamiti siddham |

atheti codyaprāraṃbhe nitya anubhāvaka ātmānasyāt | yadi tarhi anubhavavidhvaṃse tadanurodhinī smṛtiḥ kathaṃ bhavedityatha ityanvayaḥ | nitya iti | pūrvavadanubhāvakaḥ anubhavakartā anubhavatā ātmā ahaṃrūpaḥ anubhaveti | ayaṃghaṭo'yaṃ paṭa ityanubhavasya nāśetadityanubhāvānurodhinī smṛtiḥ anubhūtaviṣayā saṃpramoṣarūpā kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa bhavet syāt | smartarabhāve'rthasya smaryamāṇatvā bhāvāt arthenākiṃcitkareṇa smṛtyupapattiḥ | anubhavenāpinaivasmṛtirghaṭate | naṣṭatvādeva | atona kenāpi prakāreṇaiva smṛtirghaṭeta | smṛtyabhāvesaṅketaśabdasmaraṇādhīnāḥ sarve vikalpā api nasyuḥ | nirvikalpamātreṇa ca vyavahā (--------------------------------) kṣyati | iha dṛṣṭamapi nirvikalpakena yāvannaparāmṛṣṭaṃ vimarśa viśeṣa viśrāntyā tāvat smaryata iti sarvavyavahāra <83> vilopa prasaṃgāt | vyavahārasiddhaye smṛtistāvadaṅgīkartavyā | tadāśrayabhūtonityaḥ anubhavakālo anubhūta (--------------------------------) ścidātmāṅgīkartavya iti dhūmaliṅgenāgnyanumānādivat smṛti liṅgenānumāna muktaṃ bhavati | iti yo dayāsi kimiti sūtrasya saṃkṣepāpārthaḥ | iheti | anubhavakālānantarabhāvinismṛtikāle anubhūtaḥ smartumiṣṭā'rthaḥ vā (--------------------------------) tadhvaṃsatāṃ vā naṣṭenānaṣṭena vā nenārthe na smṛteḥ kiṃ prayojanaṃ arthasmṛti janako na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tameveti | svata eva viṣayābhāvo'nubhūtamarthamevasvātmano viṣayī kartumanubhavamevameva (------------------------------------------------)

avatāritaṃ granthaṃ vyācaṣṭe (-) anubhaveneti | svocita iti | yā dṛśonīla sukhādyanubhava utpannastenaivānu bhavena tādṛśo'nubhūtasya nīlasukhādeḥ smaryamāṇatvena punarutthānabījabhūtaḥ saṃskāro vāsanāpara paryāya utpadyate | saṃskāra jatvāt smṛteḥ anubhavaviṣayeṇa viṣayatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti vaktuṃ saṃskārasyaloka prasiddha sthita sthāpitatvaṃ darśayati saṃskāraśceti | saṃskārasthitasthāpakākhyam | ākṛṣṭeti (-) cireti
ciraṃ kālaṃ veṣṭita tayā sthitasya paścāt prasāryamāṇasya bhūrjakaṭādeśca iti loke prasiddhaṃ yatastena hetunā | atrānubhavaviṣaye'pi saṃskāraḥ tāṃ svasmājjātāṃ smṛti pūrvānubhavakāriṇīṃ karoti pūrvānubhavo'yaṃ viṣayamagrahīt smṛtirapi tameva viṣayaṃ gṛhṇāti yathā tathā karoti | viṣayasyāyāmityanubhava kāle sa iti smṛtikāle pratītiḥ iti | iyāneva viśeṣaḥ sarvāthānubhava(------)stveka eva paṭajñanasya ghaṭajñānasaṃskāra jatvā bhāvāt na jaṭaviṣayatvam | smṛtestu pūrvānubhavasaṃskārajatvāt pūrvānubhavaviṣayeṇa viṣayavattvaṃ saṃbhavatīti viṣamobhavaduktodṛṣṭānta iti bhāvaḥ ātmanāpi (---------------) (---------------) nosmṛtyajanakatvāt smṛtikāryakāraṇaḥ samarthaḥ saṃskāra eveti |
ātmanā na kimapi prayojanamityāha (-) yadyevamiti | evaṃ yaditarhi antargaḍunā syāyinātmanāko'rthaḥ syāt | evamiti | saṃskāraḥ svatonirviṣayaḥ smṛtera(--------------------) dayatititvayocyate | yadi tarhi evañca hantanirākramandamityādi yaduktaṃ bhavatā tadapi parihṛtamityāha (-) sarvamiti | <89> saṃskārā yatta sarvaḥ sarvovyavahāra (----------------------------) (-----------------) sya smṛtihetutvāt smṛtyanyathānupapatti rūpāryāpatteranyathāpyupapattidoṣaduṣṭatvānnātmānumāpakatvamityu ktam |
idānīṃ saṃskārasyāpū(---------------------------------------------) thātmādhastanapṛthivyādyāśrayatvā saṃbhavāt pariśeṣādātmā saṃskārāśrayatvena siddhyatīti śaṅkāmutthāpya taduttaratvenottara ślokabhavatārayati (-) nanukasyeti | ātmānamantareṇa saṃskārāsyaiva smṛti (------------------------------) mityuktam | saṃskāra eva guṇatvāt svāśrayabhūtaṃ guṇinamātmānamanumāpayatītyāśaṃkate (-) nānviti | tasyeti | smṛtikāraṇabhūtasya saṃskārasya guṇatvena rūpādivadāśrayasākāṃkṣatvāt tadāśrayatvenātmānumīyata ityarthaḥ | ta (---------------------------------------------) ṣu tato dharmiṇaḥ ātmanaḥ dharmeṣu jñānādiguṇeṣvabhinneṣu aṣyatirikteṣu vyatirikteṣu svīkṛteṣu satsunityatve nābhimatasya dharmiṇa ātmano'nityāddharmabhūtāt
jñānādeḥ svarūpādaviśeṣato bhedābhāvena nityatvānityatva viśeṣābhāva prasaṅgāt | (jñānādeḥ svarūpādaviśeṣato bhedābhāvena) anityatvaṃ tasyāpyāpatat bhinneṣu vyatirikteṣu tasminnātmasvarūpe viśeṣā bhāvāt | na hi ghaṭasvarūpe paṭena viśeṣobhavati | parasparabhinnatvāt | pa(--------)ghaṭānumānāttāvat bhinnena saṃskāreṇātmānumāṃnastanna bhavati | na cāpi smṛti saṃskārayorāśrayāśrayi bhāvaḥ saṃbandho'stīti vācyam | vastu vyatiriktasya saṃbandhasya tatra tatrāsthite dviṣṭasyānekarūpatvāditi ślokadvayena nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt | nāpi taddvayaṃ nityasya kasyacidraṣṭurityuktanītyā nirvikalpaka savikalpaka darśanāśraya bhūtatvena bhimato draṣṭā yathā <90> kalpitastathā smaraṇāśrayatvenābhimatasmartā kalpitaḥ | evaṃsmaraṇasya saṃskārādeva siddhiḥ |
ihetyāderayaṃ bhāvaḥ (-) saṃskāreṇa svāśraya ātmānumīyata ityatra vivecanīyam | saṃskāre jāyamāne ātmanastajjananāvasthātopi viśeṣo'sti naveti | ādyetasya viśeṣasyātmano vyatirekakoṣyati reko vāghaṭāt paṭānupaṇattivat | ātmano viśeṣotpattyasaṃbhavāt saṃbaṃdhasya durnirūpatvena tasya viśeṣa iti ca vaktumaśakyatvāt | avyatireke ca tasyotpadyamānasya nityatvādanitya viśeṣābhinnātmano'pyanityatvaprasaṅgaḥ | viśeṣo nāstīti dvitīya pakṣe āśrayepaṭādau viśeṣādhāyakasya śau klyādereva guṇatvādviśeṣādhāyakatvasya guṇasyaivābhāvāt | saṃskāreṇātmānumānaṃ na saṃbhavati guṇatvahetorasiddhatvāditi | iha saṃskāreṇātmānumīyata iti pakṣe aṅkure jāyamāne bījasyocchūnatāśeṣavidviśeṣa iti saṃskāra jananāt prāgavasthāto'tiśayaḥ kāścitsa iti tadānīntano viśeṣaḥ | ātmano vyatirikto na bhavatīti | vipakṣa iti | vyatirekapakṣe saṃbandhā bhāvena tadīyatvā saṃbhavāttadīyatvā siddhyarthamavyatirikta iti svīkāre ātmā anityaviśeṣavat svayamapi nityo nasyāt | nitya iti
bhavatpakṣo na siddhyati | anitya viśeṣābhinnasyānityatvameva syāt | asyeti ātmanaḥ | teneti svāśrayabhūta ātmani viśeṣa sādhakena saṃskāreṇātmanaḥ kiṃ bhavati | tasya guṇatvaṃ guṇitvamātmanaśca na smā ate guṇatvahetorasiddhyā nātmānumānaṃ saṃskāre jāyamāne ātmano viśeṣāntaraṃ mā bhūt | sa eva viśeṣo bhavatu | vastvantarāt svāśraya vyāvartako hi viśeṣaḥ | ataśca guṇa eveti śaṅkate (-) atheti | saṃskārasyānityatvāt tasyāsmaviśeṣatva svīkāre viśeṣasya tadīyatva siddhārthamavyatirekasyāṅgīkartavyatvāt | anityasaṃskārābhinnātmano'pyanityatva prasaṅga ityuttaramāha (-) tarhīti |
<91> atha saṃskāraḥ avyatirikto vyatiriktovā adyāvalaṃbanena doṣaḥ na vyatirikta iti | teneti | viśeṣaḥ bhūtena saṃskāreṇāsāvātmā vyatirikto na bhavati | vyatirikta tena bhinnena viśeṣeṇa viśeṣyavatvābhāvād viśeṣāntarapakṣoktavat punarapi jñānarūpe saṃskāre anityatve sati a(---------------------------------------------) viśeṣādvyatirikta ātmāpi anitya ityāyātam | svato jñānavyatiriktonityasaṃskāro nāstityabhiprāyeṇa jñāne saṃskāra ityuktam | vaiśeṣikādyabhimata bhāvātmaka nitya saṃskārasya vyavaccedārthaṃ jaḍarūpaghaṭādigatasthita sā(-----------)jñāna ityuktam |
nanu jñānaṃ nāma guṇāntaraṃ saṃskāraścānyoguṇa iti kathaṃ tasya jñānarūpatvamityatrāha (-) anubhavāditi | anubhavānnirvikalpajñānādviśiṣṭaṃ vikalparūpatvāt parokṣarūpa viṣaya viśeṣāliṅgita (--------------)nakaṃ jānaṃ paramparayā jāyamānaṃ saṃskāra śabda vācyaṃ(,) viṣayasya kṣaikatvena pāramparyāt tadgrāhakatānubhavāderjñānasya ca pāramparyāt tajjñāna janakasya saṃskāra jñānasyāpi pāramparyam | evakāra(--------------------)spaṣṭārtha iti bhāvaḥ |
ātmano viśeṣa bhūtaḥ saṃskāro vyatirikta iti dvitīyapakṣa mavalambate (-) atha saṃskāre vyatiriktatve ātmaviśeṣatva meva saṃskārasya na syādityāha (-) tasyeti | asau saṃskāraḥ tasyātmanaḥ kiṃ bhavi (--------------------)va viśeṣona yyadityarthaḥ | ghaṭaśauklayādivadvyatiriktasya saṃskārasyātmanā
śrayāśrayibhāvasaṃbandhasadbhāvāttadviśeṣaḥ syādityatrāha (-) saṃbaṃdhaśceti | vastu vyatirikto vastuniṣṭhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kaścidastītipakṣonirākari(ṣyate ---) tatrasthite dviṣṭhasyānekarūpatvāditiślokadvayenasaṃskāravat jñānādiguṇairapi nātmānumīyata ityatrāha (-) evaṃ jñāneti | jñānasukhādīnāmātmavyatiriktānāmātmaguṇatvavat saṃskārasyāpi (-) (--------) dityatrāha (-) evaṃ jñāneti | jñānasukhādau jāyamāne ātmanoviśeṣo'stivāna vā | jñānasukhādirātmano vyatirikto'vyatiriktoveti vikalpya nirākaraṇīyam | asaṃpratipannodṛṣṭānta iti bhāvaḥ | eva tātparyāryamu(-------) ukte'rthepadaśaḥ ślokaṃ yojayati (-) tata iti | mūlapadasyātmana ityarthaḥ | abhinneṣu bhinneṣviticākārapraśleṣā praśleṣābhyāṃ vyākhyātaṃ jñānādiṣu saṃskārānteṣu guṇeṣu giṇina ātmano vyatirikteṣva vyatirikteṣu vāṅgīkriyamāṇeṣvityapekṣitaśeṣapūraṇaṃ sarvasaptamī yamiti dyatayati (-) teṣu satsvapīti | abhedāṅgīkāre'nityadharmavadātmano'pyanityatvaprasaṅgena teṣu jñānādi dharmeṣu ātmasvarūpecanityatvānityatvādi viśeṣābhāva prasaṃgāt | dharma dharmibhāvāsaṃbhavena tairguṇairguṇyātmānumīyata iti nirasta eva pakṣaḥ |
(-------------------) ātmānumānaḥ sadbhāvāt ātmavyāpāramantareṇa saṃskārādereva smṛtiḥ | siddhyatītyāha (-) satāvaditi | tāvadasandehe | smṛtijñānasya guṇatvādātmāśrayatvamityapina | abhedapakṣe dharmamayatvādasmattṛtvādibhedapakṣe saṃbandhābhāvādasmṛttṛtvā vikalpaitṛtvādi prācyarūpeti sakala vikalparahita nirvikalpānubhava evātmano nijarūpaṃ tadanapāyāt tadvyatiriktātmanā <93> smṛteḥ prayojanā bhāvāt saṃskārāt smṛteḥ siddhatvāt smartādrasṭeva kalpitaḥ | nanvityādinā ślokadvaena pratyakṣam athānubhava vidhvaṃsa ityādinānumānañca nirākṛtam | tato bhinneṣvityanena bādhakaṃ ca sūcitam | tadeva bādhakamāha dharmayoga iti | jñānādiguṇairātmani viśeṣa ādhīyate cet vikāritvāccarmavadanityo viśeṣo na bhavedākāśādivadasatkalpaḥ |
nanu pūrvamātmanirākaraṇaṃ kṛtam | uttaraśloke jñānasvarūpaṃ nirūpyate | ataśca pūrvāparasaṅgatirnāstītyāśaṃkya pūrvaṃ prastutasyaivātmanaḥ kartari jñātarisvātmanimaheśvara ityuktaṃ jñānakriyāśaktimattvarūpamaiśvaryaṃ nirākartuṃ jñānaśaktisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ prakṛto payogyeveti pūrvoktā dharmamanudyottaraślokatātparyamāha (-) ityamiti | evaṃ pratyakṣānumānarūpasādakapramāṇabhāvenokta prakāreṇātmanā saha samuccayaṃ dyotayati | ātmā yathācitsvarūpaṃ tadvat jñānaṃ ca citsvarūpaṃ ceti tajjñānamanityaṃ kiṃ kimityanityam ātmavannityameva syāt | cidrūpatvāviśeṣādiṣṭamanityatvaṃ na siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ | ātmano vyatirikta manityaṃ jñānamastītivādīpraṣṭavyaḥ | tattvadabhimataṃ jñānaṃ prābhākarādimatavat citsvarūpa (------------------) (-) dimatavat jaḍaṃ vā | ādye jñānasya cidrūpātmavannityatvam | dvitīyapakṣe ghaṭādivat sveṣṭā artha prakāśaktā na syāt | jñānaśaktiścidrūpā jaḍācetivikalpya dūṣaṇaṃ jñānaśaktiparīkṣā jñānasya cidrūpatve'pyanityatvāṅgīkāre ā(---------------------------------) rapyanityatve anyonyā pekṣā bhāve(------------)baṃdhāsaṃ bhavāt ātmano dharmojñānamityuktirnaghaṭa ityarthaḥ |
nanu jñānasya cidrūpatve ātmavannityatvaṃ syādityanityatva <94> prasaṅgaḥ āpādyate vijñānavādi(------------------------------------)prādanena svasyakaśca lābha ityāśaṃkya svamata siddhena naitatprasaṃgāpādanaṃ kiṃtu yaiḥ paraiḥ kāṇādanaiyāyikādibhirātmano vyatirikta (------------------) (--------------------) tadaniṣṭāpādanaṃ tena kriyate | jñānasya cidrūpatve ātmavannityatvaṃ prasajyeteti nityatvaṃ caneṣṭam | ataścidrūpasyāpi tasyānityatvāṅgīkāre ātmano'pyanitva prasaṅge na nityasyātmano jñānaśaktiriti para(--------------------------) sya ye sveṣṭaśca lābhaścāstīti yukta eva |
evaṃ prasaṅgādāpādanamityāha (-) jñānasyāpicidrūpatve ātmavannityatvaṃ syāditi prasaṅgaḥ | tadviparyayastvanityatvaṃ tasmin prasaṅga viparyaye cidrūpatve'pyanityatveneṣṭajñānā(------------------------) nityasyātmano
nityaṃ jñānaṃ śaktirnasyāditi pūrvavādino lābhaḥ |
nanvātmavannityaṃ syāditi prasaṅga āpadyate | āpādite prasaṅgā lābherapyastīti sthite tatra parābhyupagama eva pradarśyate | ātmavādī ātmano nityatvaṃ vakṣya(-------------------)nā nityatvaṃ sādhayituṃ tatpratiyoginyanityatve kālaṃ nimittamāha (-) iheti | loke kalayati svenarūpeṇabhāvamavacchinattīti kālam | idaṃ bhāvaḥ idantā tayābhiniviṣṭasya pramātrā idamiti parāmṛśyamānasya ghaṭādestvayaṃ viśeṣa(-----------------------) nastadānīntana iti taṃ bhāvaṃ viśiṣṭīkurvan tena vartamānādikālaviśeṣeṇa saṃkocāt svānyakālānāveśāpādanenānityaṃ saṃpādayati | anena bhāvānāmanityatvakāraṇaṃ kāla evetyuktaṃ bhavati |
kimetāvatā prakṛte āyātamityata āha (-) ātmana iti | ciditi | <95> ahaṃ prakāśarūpatvāt kuta ātmanoviśeṣyatvaṃ nāstītyatrāha (-) viśeṣaṇeti | nīlamutpalamityādau idaṃ nīlaṃ viśeṣaṇam | idamutpalaṃ viśeṣyam ititābhyāṃ vyatiriktaḥ kaścitpramātādyoyojayati natu ta eva svakīya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ jānītaḥ | ataḥ ātmano viśeṣyatve tadarthaṃ kaścidyojako'pekṣaṇīyaḥ | bhavatu tathetyatrāha (-) na ceti | yojakāntarāpekṣaṇe svaprakāśatvamevanasyāt | anavasthācasyāt | at yojakāntarā bhāvāt viśeṣyatvā bhāve na kālapairccedābhāvādanityatvamātmasiddhamevetyātmavādi siddhāntaḥ |
evaṃ parābhyupagamenātmano nityatvamuktvā taddṛṣṭāntena jñānasyāpi tadāpādayati (-) sa ityamiti |
asmābhiḥ pṛcchyate (-) svaprakāśasyātmano dharmabhūtaṃ jñānamapi svaprakāśamasvaprakāśaṃ veti | ādye doṣamāha jñānamiti | tatrāpi jñāne'pi citsvabhāvatvādidamiti prathanābhāve nityavādinoktā vārtaivanādhikaṃ vaktavyamiti | ātmavadeva jñānasyāpi nityatvaṃ syāt | astu dvayorapi nityatvaṃ ko doṣa ityatrāha (-) na ceti | nityayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvā saṃbhavāttadvyatiriktasya saṃbandhasya bhavanmate'bhāvācca mābhūt saṃbandha ityapi na vaktavyamityāha (-) tat iti | saṃbandhā bhāvāt sambaṃdhārthe ṣaṣṭhī saṃbandhābhāvena ghaṭate | ata
idaṃ mata mava sannaṃ nirastam | dvitīyapakṣamanūdyadoṣamāha (-) atheti | svasvarūpaṃ na prakāśayati cet svavyatiriktasya sutarāṃ na prakāśakaḥ | prakāśatvamitthaṃ bodhasyetyāha (-) svaprakāśeti | svasya bodhasya prakāśarūpasyā vedanaṃ vidadhat parasmin svakīyaṃ prakāśamāveśayan parasyāpiprakāśo bhavati | bhāvāntaravat ghaṭavat <96> jaḍarūpo ghaṭasya prakāśane parāpekṣatayā svayamaśaktaḥ sannanyasya paṭādeḥ sutarāṃ yathā na prakāśakaḥ tadvajjñānaṃ jaḍātmakaṃ cet svaviṣaya prakāśakaṃ na syāt | ataśca sva prakāśatve ātmavannityatva prasaṃgenānyonya saṃbandhā bhāvāt jaḍatve'rtha prakāśakatvābhāvena jñānatvasyaivābhāvāt | ubhayathāpi na jñānamātmanaḥ śaktiḥ | ātmanaḥ svata eva nāstitvāt jñānasya sadbhāve 'pyanyonya saṃbandhā bhāvena taccahktitvābhāvācca tacchaktiyogādātmeśvara iti bhavaduktaṃ yuktamevetyuktaṃ bhavati |
sāṅkhya mata mavalambya jñānasya jaḍatve'pi citpratibiṃbagrahaṇenārtha prakāśakatvaṃ syāditi jaḍapakṣoktadoṣaṃ pariharannāśaṅkata ityuttaraślokārtha tātparyamāha (-) jaḍo'pīti | itthamiti | vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa | asau bodhaḥ buddhirarthasya svarūpaṃ yathādhatte tathātmanaścaitanya pratibimbamapi bibharti | caitanya pratibimbadhāraṇādevāsya jaḍatvādi siddhe(------------------)tā vilakṣaṇaṃ bodharūpatvaṃ buddhau pratibiṃbenopa saṃ(---------------------)tvādarthasya prakāśa iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ sādhayituṃ loka prasiddhaṃ vyavahāramuktvārthasya prakāśo'nyanirapekṣo nisvabhāvo na bhavatītyāha (-) iheti | iha (--------------------------------------) buddhau pratibiṃba rūpeṇopasaṃkrame sati ghaṭaṃ jānāmi mama ghaṭaḥ prakāśata ityādi vyavahārolokaprasiddha upapadyate na tvarthasya(----------------------------)hajaṃ rūpaṃ ghaṭādeḥ prakāśarūpatve cākṣuṣā(------------------------------------) ghaṭādigrāhaka pramātṝn vinā tadanyeṣāmapi tatprakāśaprasaṃgāt | tadanyatpratyaprakāśetān pratyaprakāśatā vāsyāt | prakāśasya(------------) (------------) prakāśāprakāśaviśeṣā saṃbhavāt sarvasya sarvajñatā ajñatāvān syāt | yasya cakṣurādi saṃprayogastaṃ
pratyeva prakāśatā tadanyaṃ pratyaprakāśateti vibhāgo na syāt | <97> ataḥ prakāśaṃ svarūpaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | cidrūpāt pu(--------------) (------) khyaṃ rūpamarthe āgatamityapi nāśaṃ kanīyam | anyasmādāgamityaṅgīkāre'pi arthāyattatvāt prakāśasya pramātṛviśeṣā pekṣayā prakāśā prakāśavibhāgo na syāt | ityeṣa eva doṣaḥ | taditi nijasvarūpatvāṃ bhāvācca pṛ(-----------------------)nyatamasya tattvasya vāyaṃ prakāśākhyo dharmasvarūpamityaṅgīkāryam | anyadharmatve'pyarthasya prakāśaḥ kathamityākāṃkṣāyāṃ yatrayasmiṃstatvaviśeṣe sa iti ghaṭapaṭādiḥ tadutpattihetubhūtaḥ pṛthivyādistadguṇabhūto gandhādiścā (--------------------------------------) ndriyadvārā pratibiṃbena darpaṇatala ivopasaṃkrāmati | tatra tattvāntare tasyārthasya prakāśo bhavatīti nūnaṃ niścitam | tasmiṃstattvaviśeṣe kathamarthasya pratibimbenopasaṃkrama ityatrāha (-) taditi | prakāśarūpasattvapradhānyāt saṃkalpa pratibimbopagrahayogyaṃ tarhisarvadāsarvagrahaprasaṅga ityatrāha (-) tamaseti | aprakāśarūpeṇa tamasā vṛtatvāt sakalapratibimbakatvameva gṛhṇāti | satvaguṇaprādhānyāt sakalopagraha yogyatā | tamoguṇaprādhānyāt na kiñcidgrahaṇaśaktiḥ | rajoguṇayogāt sarvagrahaṇaṃ sarvagrāhakaṃ ca muktvā madhyastha tayā kiñcidgrāhakatā bhavatīti guṇatrayamityarthamayaḥ | tathāpi buddhirarthasya svarūpaṃ dhatta iti svasiddhāntaḥ kathamityatrāha (-) tadeveti |
nanu pratibimbagrahaṇena kathamartha jñānamityatrāha (-) artheti | asyā buddheḥ vṛttirūpā jñānaṃ svātmanighaṭādi pratibimbagrahaṇamevabuddhirātmani ghaṭādimarthaṃ pratibiṃbarūpamupagṛhya tadākāreṇa vartate yadā tadā tad ghaṭādijñānamityucyate | vṛttistadākārapariṇāmaḥ pariṇāme ca buddhirūpahāniḥ syādityatrāha pūrveti | pūrvavyapadeśaḥ kṣīramityādi vyavahāraḥ | dugdhaṃ parimatta <98> ityatramadhuravastu rūpamamlavasturūpaṃ dravarūpaṃ kaṭhina rūpamiti vakṣyamāṇanītyā kāraṇabhūtaṃ dugdhādivyapadeśatiraskāri dadhyādirūpapariṇāmāt
vilakṣaṇaḥ pariṇamati | viśeṣā pūrvarūpa vyapadeśā parityāgena rūpāntara vyapadeśabhāktvam | atra buddheḥ ghaṭādi pratibimbagrahaṇātmaka jñānarūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ kāraṇarūpabuddhirūpa vyapadeśaṃ na tirodhatta ityarthaḥ | evamiti | ukta prakāreṇa kiñcitprakāśāśaṃkasatvaprādhānyāt | tarhi buddhireva prakāśarūpatvādātmā na tato'nyaḥ kaścidātmā nāstītyatrāha (-) iyaṃ ceti | satvādīnāṃ sukhādirūpatayā bhogyatvāt satvādirūpābuddhirapi bhogye jaḍa evāntarbhuteti asya bhogasya jaḍasya buddhitattvasya darpaṇa eva davidrūpatvaṃ jaḍasyāpidarpaṇasye va pratibimbagrāhakatvaṃ buddherbhogyatvāda prakāśatvāccasvaviruddha bhoktṛrūpa prakāśanātmaka svabhāvo na yukta iti svavyatirikto bhoktā kaścidastītyāyātam | sa bhoktā svaprakāśamātrasvabhāvaḥ na svaprakāśarūpatvādvyatirikto yo ya svabhāvatvenānyairūcyate sa sarvo'prakāśarūpo bhogya rūpaśca | bhoktuḥ svabhāvatayā na saṃbhavatīti svabhāvāntaraṃ na kalpanīyameveti bhāvaḥ | sa ceti | buddhausvapratibimbasamarpaṇamantareṇa svayameva prakṛtyādi dharāntaviśvasya prakāśako yadi bhavati tarhi prakāśarūpasya tasya sadā tanatvena prakṛtimahadahaṃkārādi krameṇa prakāśe kāraṇāntarābhāvādyugapadeva viśvasya prakāśa prasaṅge ayaṃ ghaṭo ayaṃ paṭa iti ghaṭāderanyonya prakāśabhedābhāvāt ghaṭādi sādhyodakāharaṇādyartha kriyā(------------------------------)dviśvasyānyonya vyāmiśraṇarūpaṃ sāṃkaryaṃ prasajyeteti bādhaka darśanaṃ pūrvamātmano viśva prakāśakatva bhaṅgīkṛya viśva sāṃkaryalakṣaṇaṃ bādhakaṃ pradarśyedānīmasya tena viśvena saṃbandhā bhāvādviśvaprakāśakatvameva na saṃbhavatīti(-------------)<99> rādīndriya vibhayabhūtāt bimbarūpānnīlāderarthādbuddhigatāt tatpratibimbāt tatpratibiṃbādhārabhūtāt buddhitattvācca vilakṣaṇamarthasya prakāśakaṃ kathaṃ syāt | asaṅgohyayaṃ puruṣa iti śruteḥ | asaṅga svabhāvasya puruṣasyātve(------------------------------)māṇena sādhitamarthamāha (-) tasmāditi | puruṣasya svaprakāśatve naivārtha prakāśakatvaṃ saṃbhavati iti yasmāt tasmāt buddhireva
satva pradhānatayā svacchatvādartha pratibimbamiva prakāśasya pratibimbamapi gṛhṇāti | buddherarthasya caitanyasya ca pratibimba grahaṇamātreṇārthaḥ prakāśata iti lokaprasiddha vyavahārasiddhiḥ kathamityatrāha (-) tata iti | artha caitanyayoḥ ubhayorapi pratibimbagrahaṇāt tato hetorbuddhau pratibimbasya caitanyasya tasyā(-------------------------------)rtha pratibimbasaṃkramadvārā biṃbabhūtanīlādi saṃkramānnīlamidaṃ jānāmi mama nīlaṃ prakāśata iti vyavahāraḥ sidhyati | prakāśa pratibimbasya parigrahasya mahimnā prāpta prakāśā veśe svato jaḍe'pi buddhitattve nīlādināropita (-------------------) bimbataddvāreṇa tatsamarpaka bimbabūta nīlādyartha paryantaṃ prakāśāveśasya saṃkramāt sāṃkhyaḥ sādhitaṃ svamataṃ nigamayati tadevamiti | buddhitatvasyārtha pratibimbavat caitanya pratibimbagrahaṇāt buddherartha prakāśakatvaṃ ya(---) (----------------) devamuktena prakāreṇa jaḍabuddhipariṇāmarūpatayā vyatirekāt svayaṃ jaḍamapi buddhivṛttaṃ jñānaṃ svavyatiriktabuddhigatacitpratibimbayogādviṣayasya prakāśakaṃ bhavatīti |
athāpi jaḍame tasya kathamartha prakāśatā ||
iti vijñānavādyukta doṣaparihāraḥ sāṃkhyamatenāśaṃ kanīyaḥ | asmin sāṃkhyamate'nupapatti samudbhavādaruci sūcaka sūtragato'tha śabda iti vaktumanupapattimāha (-) <100> etadeveti | prakāśātmā pumān baddhātmani buddhitatve ātmasvapratibiṃbamarpayatīti yat etadeva prathamamanucitam | etadaṅgīkṛtya doṣaṃ paścādvakṣyate tadapekṣayā tāvacchabdaprayogaḥ |
anaucityehetumāha (-) sāmāna guṇa iti | atra dṛṣṭāntamāha (-) rūpavatī rūpattvena ghaṭādi bimbasamānaṃ guṇe ghaṭādyapekṣayā ca vimale darpaṇe ghaṭādi svarūpa pratibimbaṃ yathā dṛśyate tadvat ātmasamānaguṇe ātmāpekṣayā ca vimale buddhitatve ātmā prativimbamarpayatīti vaktavyam | taccanāstītyāha (-) ātmeti | ātmanaścitsvarūpatvāt buddheśca jaḍatvāt jaḍājaḍayostamaḥ prakāśavadviruddhasvabhāvatvāt samānaguṇatvābhāvāt buddhestamasā vṛtatvādātmanastadanāvaraṇāt bimbabhūtātmāpekṣayā vaimalyābhāvādya
na buddherātmanaḥ pratibimbanakṣamatvamityanupapadyamānameva | tat sāṃkhyoktaṃ | etadbuddhau caitanyasya pratibimbitatvaṃ bhavatu tāvadityaruciḥ | prauḍhyaitadaṅgīkṛtyāpi dūṣaṇamucyata itīmamartha mathaśabdena sūcayati | anucitamapi proḍhyaṅgīkṛtaṃ cet asmadiṣṭa siddhirityatrāha (-) kiṃ tviti | bhavatu tāvadityākṣepoktiṃ sūcayatyatha śabdaḥ pūrvoktadoṣaḥ parihatumaśakya eveti sūtraśeṣeṇābhidhīyata iti tātparyaṃ darśayati (-) kiṃ tviti | anucitametadaṅgīkṛtyāpi bhavadabhimataṃ yathā na siddhyati tathā viśeṣaṃ vadāma iti kiṃ tu śabdasyārthaḥ | na kevalaṃ kāraṇādibhirevāsmaduktaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ na parihṛtaṃ bhavadabhimatena pratibimbavādenāpi kiñcit pratisamāhitam | evaṃ sā ajaḍā bhavet | jāḍye'rthaprakāśatā na buddhiḥ svacchatvāt caitanya pratibimbamapi pratigṛhṇātītyaṅgīkāre sati tatpratibimbaṃ caitanyaṃ mukhya prakāśarūpaṃ vā | <101> mukhya prakāśarūpaṃ cet mukhya caitanya vatī sā buddhirapi cidātmavacchuddhā cidrūpiṇī bhavet | buddhirjaḍeti tvadabhimataṃ na syāt | ātma pratibiṃbagrahaṇenātmavat svātmano'pi cinmayatvādajaḍā ātmavatsvanityā bhavet | ātmā ca nityona syāt | ubhayorapi nityatve'nyonya saṃbandhā bhāvaḥ | amukhya prakāśarūpaṃ cet taddhetukabuddhe (-------------------) ḍatve prāpte bhāvāntaravannārthaḥ prakāśatetyukta eva doṣaḥ punarapyāpatet | kiṃ cārtha pratibiṃbagrahaṇe artha pratibimbagrahaṇadvārā arthamayī vijñāvādaprasaṃgādapasiddhāntaśca syāt | iti sūtraśeṣārthaḥ | prakāśātmā pumān(------------------)tīti pakṣe buddhau tatpratibimbitaṃ caitanyaṃ mukhyaprakāśarūpaṃ vā na veti vikādye pakṣe svamatiriti siddhiriti vadiṣyan mukhyaprakāśarūpaṃ na bhavatīti dvitīyaprakṣadūṣaṇaṃ jāḍyenārthaḥ prakāśatetyetadevādau vyāka(-----) (---------------------------------) bimbadhāraṇena bimbaṃ prasiddhārtha kriyākāritvādarśanāt caitanya pratibiṃbadhāraṇe na (bimbaṃ prasiddhārtha kriyākāritvādarśanāt caitanyapratibimba) buddherartha prakāśakatvasya (--------------------------------------) caitanya pratibimbamukhyaprakāśarūpaṃ naveti vikalpāvasara iti draṣṭavyam |
buddheścaitanyapratibimbena saṃbandhe'ṅgīkriyamāṇe sati bimbabhūtacaitanyavat buddhigataṃ pratibimbakamapi mukhyaprakāśarūpameva na bhavati |(-----------------------)tarhi yenāmukhyaprakāśarūpeṇa buddhigata caitanyapratibimbenāpi buddherartha prakāśanaṃ pratina kiñcit kṛtaṃ syāt | caitanya pratibimba dhāraṇenāpi buddherartha prakāśaktvaṃ tyayoktam | pratibimbasya ca mukhyaprakāśakatva(---------------------------------)prakāśarūpatvābhāvāt amukhyaprakāśarūpasya caitanyasya dhāraṇena buddherartha prakāśakatvaṃ na syāt | tadeva dṛṣtāntenopapādayati (-) nahīti | tadevārthāntaranyāsena <102> (-) na hīti | pratibimbitasya vahnirūpasyāvastutvāt |(---------------------------)tvaṃ yathā dṛśyate tadvat prakṛtepītyarthaḥ |
ādya pakṣamutthāpya tatra parasyāniṣṭa pratipādakamajaḍetyādi mūlagranthaṃ vyākhyātumāha (-) atha mukheti | buddhestaccaitanya pratibimbaka mukhyaprakāśarūpameveti mataṃ cet tarhitatprati (----------------) (----------------------) dhārabhūtāyā buddhervyatiriktam | na bhavatidarpaṇabimbe yadvannagara grāmādi citramavibhāgi |
bhātivibhāge naiva ca parasparaṃ darpaṇādapi ca ||
ityuktasyityā darpaṇāderatisvacchata svabhāvatayā pratibimbagrahaṇe'pi tasya pratibimbitasya vastunaḥ svādhāradarpaṇādi vyatirekeṇa bhāvamātrameva | na vastuvṛttyā vyatireko'sti yathā tadvaccaitanya pratibimbasya mukhyaprakāśarūpatve svāvyatirikta tadgrāhiṇī buddhirapi mukhya prakāśarūpaiva jāte vati hetoḥ svamate jaḍatvenoṣṭāya buddhermukhyācidrūpatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti bhogyasyā prakāśasya tadvirūddhabhoktṛrūpa prakāśātmaka svabhāva saṃbhavo na yukti yukta iti pūrvamuktanītyā virūddhāviruddhayorjaḍatva cidrūpayorekatra buddhā vadhyāso bhaviṣyatīti yasmādviruddhadharmādhyāsāt doṣādbhirubhiḥ sāṃkhyaistaṣya tasya doṣasya parihārārthaṃ yato viruddha dharmāsyāditi bhogyasya buddhitattvasya bhoktṛtvaṃ prakāśarūpasya tasya prakāśarūpatvaṃ ca virūddhamiti bhogyatvabhoktṛtvayoraprakāśarūpa prakāśarūpatvayoḥ anyonya viruddhayoḥ ekatrādhyāsalakṣaṇo doṣaḥ buddherātmatvāṃgīkāre prasajyeteti tādṛśādviruddha dharmādhyāsāt |
<103> kiñcā nityasya jñānasya cidrūpatvāṅgīkāre ātmavannityatva prasaṅgaḥ | anitye citsvarūpejñāne tadviruddha nityatva dharmādhyāsaḥ nityecitsvarūpa ātmani tadviruddhānityatva dharmādhyāsaḥ | evaṃ viruddha dharmādhyāsāt | kiñca doṣādbhīrubhirbhavadbhistatparihārārthaḥ | evamiti | jaḍāyā api buddheścitpratibimbayogādartha prakāśatvamitye tat kalpitaṃ bhīti vaśādavicāryaiva kathitam | na tu tadyuktiyuktaṃ sabhavadbhiḥ parihartumiṣṭā viruddhadharmādhyāsa eva punaridānīṃ bhavanmukhata evoktatvā | jājvalyamānaṃ pūrvasmādapyati sa eva doṣaḥ punarapyā patitaḥ mukhya prakāśarūpa caitanya pratibimbādhāra mukhena bhavadbhireva buddhermukhyaprakāśatva rūpatvasyaivoktatvāt | jaḍatvaṃ cidrūpatvaṃ ca viruddhaṃ dharmadvayaṃ(,) etasyāṃ buddhau punarapyāpatitameveti bhāvaḥ ||
