smṛtyā vinā pūrvānubhūta vastusaṃbandhī hānādānādi vyavahāraḥ kathaṃ syāt | asya viṣayasyānubhavena hi sukha sādhanatāniścitā | tata iti sukhasādhanamiti ni(--------)nābhila(-----------)tata upādānāt anubhūta viṣayasya punarapyaṃ gīkārāt | tatra smṛteḥ saṃskāra jatve pūrvānubhava saṃskārāt smṛti jñānasyaitā vajjātam | tatsmṛti jñānamanubhavavadviṣayeṇa na janitameva | tathāpyanubhavajñāna viṣayamityetāvat smṛteḥ saṃskārādeva tāvajjātam | anubhava viṣaya viṣaya viṣayitva <112> saṃpādakena saṃskāreṇa smṛteḥ na kimapi jātam | ātmaniṣṭhe svayaṃ prakāśe tasmin smṛti jñāne'nubhūta viṣayasyeva pracyasyānubhavasyā prakāśanāt so'nubhavaḥ smṛtau prakāśate cet sva prakāśo na bhavati | ghaṭavat jñeyī bhavati | anubhavo'nubhāvakādhīnaḥ | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhaviturūpa smartrādhīnā jñānāni pramātrādhīnānītyarthaḥ | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhava saṃskārajanitatvādeva pūrvānubhūtaṃ mapi svaviṣayī kurutāmityāśaṃkyāha (-)
dṛk anubhavātmikā svabhāsaiva svaprakāśaiva na para prakāśyāt para prakāśyācet asyāḥ svaprakāśatvaṃ na ghaṭate | tasmāt svabhāsaiva kiṃ ca svaṣṭāviṣayasyā bhāsikā prakāśikā anyena smṛtijñānena vedyā na bhavati | vedyā cet cakṣuṣaiva cakṣurviṣayasya kṣīrāde rābhrādeḥ phalasya ca rasanā viṣayorasopi gṛhītaḥ syāt | tasmānnānyajñānena vedyā | smṛteḥ saṃskāra jatvaṃ tu anubhava viṣaya viṣayīkaraṇādanubhavatulyatvam | anubhavasya smṛteścaikaviṣayatvāt anubhava sādṛśyamātraṃ bhavati | na tadgatiḥ anubhava gatirna bhavati | bhavajñānaviṣayīkāryaṃ na bhavati | tacchabdena tulyatvāvagatirapi nāsti | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhavena saha mama tulyatvamiti tattulyamapi na jānāti | smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhava tulyeti tasya tulyatvasya pramātradhīnatvāt | kiṃ cedānīṃ taditiyo viṣayabhūto ghaṭaḥ eṣa ghaṭaḥ pūrvānubhava viṣayī kṛta ityetadapi smṛtirnajānāti |
tajjñānasyāpi pramātradhīnatvāt saṃvidātmakāt prakāśāt pṛthagbhūto vaktavyaḥ | vyavahāra daśāyāmiti śeṣaḥ | jaḍasyāpi paramārthataḥ prakāśamānatvāt <113> jaḍādviśiṣṭatvena dṛk svābhāsāt | ābhāso nāma prakāśamānatā | sā prakāśamānatā svaṃ rūpaṃ vyabhicāri yasyā dṛśaḥ | kiñca svasya svāntaḥ sthitasya viṣayasyedamiti bahirābhāsakatvaṃ rūpaṃ yasyā ityapi svābhāsā svayameva prakāśamānatvāt svaviṣayasya ca bhāsakatvācca svābhāsetyarthaḥ | viṣaye jñānādbāhye ityaṃ gī kriyamāṇe satyapitadbāhya viṣaya śarīra saṃkrāntaṃ tajjñānasya svarūpaṃ bhavituṃ nārhati | atra hetumāha (-) svasmādanyatvenābhimata svā(------------) tmaka nijarūpa prakāśanaṃ hi jñānasya bhavyate | tadanubhava jñānamuktaprakāreṇa svābhāsameva bhavatu | tathāpi svapaścādbhāvini smaraṇe bhāsiṣyate | smaraṇe pravartamānasyānubhava jñānasya svābhāsatvahāni(--------------------------------------) ta ityāha anubhavajñānamanyonya smaraṇa jñānena vedyaṃ na bhavati | paratrasmaraṇe anubhavajñānaṃ yadi bhāsate tarhi tadanubhava jñāna prakāśaṃ na bhavati | anubhavātmanaḥ prakāśa rūpasyedame(----------------) (----------------------)prakāśate | anubhavasyasvayaṃ prakāśa samaye anubhava jñānasyādhikaraṇa bhūtā saṃbandha pramāṇāparatreti saptamī kathaṃ saṅgacchatām | tasmin smṛti jñāne ghaṭavadāruhyānubhavasya prakāśanā bhāvāt anyonya vedyāna bhavatī(----------------------)jñānena rasedṛgrasaviṣayaṃ rasanā viṣayarasa jñānaṃ na vedyate cet cakṣuṣaiva hi rasaḥ phalataḥ arthāt sāmarthyāt | kiñca cakṣurviṣayādābhrāderasanā viṣayoraso gṛhītaḥ syāditi indriyaniyamābhāva(-----------------------------)cet | kiṃ tarhi saṃskāreṇa smaraṇa jñānasya kiṃ kṛtaṃ syāt | dṛṣtānte viṣaya iti dyotayati rūpa jñānaṃ cetyādinā | rūpajñānaṃ ca rasajñāna jāt saṃskārājjātaṃ na bhavati | smṛtiranubhavasaṃskārājjātā | tat kathaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kathaṃ(--------------) (-----) nyenavedyeti <114> bhavat saṃbhāvita doṣa prasaṅgāya saṃskāra eva prabhavet | kimuktaṃ bhavati (-) saṃskāra evānubhavaṃ smṛterviṣayī karotītyarthaḥ | naitaditi yadbhavaduktaṃ tanna bhavati | anubhava saṃskāre saṃskṛtāt sama (--------------)t | anubhūta vastu sadṛśa vastu jñānādutthita
smṛti svabodhaḥ | tenānubhava sadṛśo bhavet smṛti bodhaḥ anubhavavadeko na bhavati | uttarottara kālajāyamānottarottara śākhā sanniveśaḥ pūrvapūrvaśākhā sanniveśasaṃskārajātatvāt pūrva pūrva śākhā sanniveśa tulya ivottarottarakālīnaṃ smṛti bodho'pi pūrvakālīnā saṃskārānubhava saṃskārajātatvāt pūrva kālī nānubhava tulyo na bhavati | loke yadbhāva saṃskārāt yobhāvo jātaḥ sabhāvastasya bhāvasya vedaka svabhāvo na bhavati | janaka saṃskārā jjātaḥ sutaḥ | tathā hi (-) tasyātītasya janakasya vedakasya bhāvo na bhavati | bījasaṃskārājjāto'ṅkuraḥ naṣṭa svarūpabīja svabhāvavadekna bhavati yathā tadvadanubhavasaṃskāra jāta smṛti bodho'pi pūrvānubhava vedakona bhavati | smṛteranubhavasadṛśatvasyāvagatirapi katham anubhava jñānaṃ smṛti jñānena svātmanaḥ sādṛśyaṃ na gamayati | smṛti jñānamapyanubhavena saha svātmanaḥ sādṛśya mahamanubhavajñānatulyamiti nāvagamayati | parasparamasaṃvedane'nubhava jñāne smṛti jñāne dvayaniṣṭhasādṛśyādyavasāyāyogāt sādṛśya jñānaṃ pramātṛniṣṭhamva bhavati | mukhaṃ kamalatulyamiti vadubhayo ranubhava smṛtyorvedanaṃ tasya tadvyatiriktasyā nyasya jñānasyābhāvāt | tasmāt saṃskārāt kevalamanubhava samānaviṣayatā mātraṃ siddham | anubhavaḥ viṣayo na bhavati | asya smṛtijñānaviṣayasya ghaṭādeḥ pūrvānubhava viṣayīkṛtatvamapi smṛ(teḥ) siddhaṃ na bhavati | iti niścaya eṣaḥ |
<115> atha smṛtiṃ bhrāntirityāśaṅkate (-) ayaṃ ghaṭa ityanubhavapṛṣṭhapātini smṛti jñāne tasya ghaṭāderanubhavena saha naṣṭatve'pi saghaṭaḥ sa paṭa iti tannaṣṭaṃ ghaṭādiṃ viṣayī kṛtyodīyamāne smṛti jñāne anubhavasyāyamiti satyataḥ prakāśaḥ tadanubhavamukhena tadanubhavaviṣayasya ca satyataḥ ayamiti prakāśaḥ syādyadi tadānubhava samāna viṣayatvādanubhavaviṣayaikaviṣayatvāttamanubhūtamarthaṃ sa iti prakāśayatīti bhavadukte khakāśaḥ | yāvateti prakrāntārtha nirvāhābhāvadyotakamavyayam | tathānetyarthaḥ smṛtervikalpasyā
saṃsparśino hi vikalpā ityuktanītyā vikalpasyārthā saṃsparśitvādvikalpa rūpā smṛtiḥ kevalamaprakāśamevānubhavaṃ tadviṣayaṃ cādhyavasyati | adhyavasāyonāma atasmiṃstadāropaḥ ityādau rajatādirūpā ropavat | tadarthāsaṃsparśitvād bhrānti svabhāvā | tatra smṛtau tayā vinā vyavahāro na ghaṭata iti ko'yaṃ nirbandha ityetaprameyaṃ śa (--------------------------------------) darśayati | smṛteranu bhavasyānubhūtārthasya ca viṣayatvābhāve'pi tayoravasāyataḥ atasmiṃstadbuddhirūpādavasāyāt | bhrāntyā saghaṭa ityanubhūtārthālambanatānaparamārtha ityarthaḥ |
smṛterdṛśamanubhavo na vi (--------------------------------------) yā naviṣayaḥ ubhayorviṣayatvābhāve'pi bhramarūpatayā smṛtyā dhyavasīyate | etāṃ smṛterbhrāntitvāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti | nirākaraṇamevāha ślokaśeṣeṇa | smṛtibhrānteti yadbhavatoktaṃ (-----------) (---------------------------) atrāsāmañjasyekārikayānantarasūtreṇa yuktimāha (-) tāvat prathamaṃ bhrānteti yat smṛtitaiva kathaṃ smṛtervakṣyamāṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhrānteḥ kathaṃ bhavet | kiñcid bhrāntitvenāśaṅkamānāyāḥ smṛteḥ (--------------------------------------) sya vyavasthāpakatvaṃ <116> katham | artha vyavasthābhāvāt | pūrvānubhava saṃskārāpekṣā ca smṛteḥ kimiṣyate |
smṛterlakṣaṇaṃ nirūpayati (-) anubhūta viṣayā saṃpramīṣasmṛtiriti | yogasūtranītyānubhavaprakāśitasya ghaṭa(-------------) (------------------)hāraḥ tathaiva prakāśanaṃ yadetat smṛteḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa ityanubhūtasyārthasya sa tathaivānyūnādhika tayā prakāśanam etadeva smṛte rātmīyaṃ rūpam | anubhūtārthasya tathā prakāśanā bhāve'pi ghaṭetatama(---------------------------------) vat bhrāntau asadrajatādi sadrajatādi grāhakaḥ bhrāntyā kāro vā prakhyāti pakāśate tayā bhrāntyā artho na svīkriyate | asato'rthasyā prakāśanāt satyarūpasya paramārthabhūtasya prakāśanāt tayā bhrāntyā artho na vyavasthāpita eva | vyavasthāpnānāmarthasya prakāśanā bhāve saṃskāra jatve smṛti bhrānteḥ pūrvānubhava saṃskārajatvena kimapi prayojanatvaṃ nāsti | bhrānteḥ saṃskāra jatvābhāvādeva | taddhi saṃskāra jatve smṛteranubhavena sādṛśyaṃ
labdhumavalambyate | yathoktam saṃskārajatvaṃ tattulyamiti | viṣaya prakāśanātmanānubhavena saha sarvathā yamiti vāsa iti veti prakāreṇa viṣayamaspṛśantyāḥ bhrānteḥ kiñcidapi sādṛśyaṃ nāsti | tasmāt saṃskārajatvena bhrānterna kimapi prayojanam |
bhrānterartha prakāśakatvamastītyāśaṅkyate (-) anubhavoyastadviṣayaśca yastadubhayamapi tayā bhrāntyā dhyavasīyata iti yatastataḥ adhyavasāyāt sādṛśyamanubhavena smṛte statsiddhaye sādṛśya siddhaye saṃskāraparigrahaḥ | tasmādartha vyavasthāpakaṃ tata evānubhavasādṛśyaṃ tatsiddhaye saṃskāra parigrahaśceti bhrāntyaiva lokavyavahāraḥ sarvaḥ sampanna ityāśaṃkyottaramāha (-) adhyavasīyata iti | <117> bhavatā kimicyate adhyavasīyata ityanenārthaḥ bhrāntyā prakāśata ityucyate cet tasmānna bhrāntitvaṃ bhavati | adhyavasīyata ityanena prakāśyata ityucyate cet punarapi viṣayo na sphuṭaḥ | pūrvavadbhrānteścārtha sthitiḥ kathamityuktanītyā viṣayo na spaṣṭa eveti saṃbhrānte ranubhava sādṛśyamiti śabdagaḍumātramartho na bhavati |
etadukta prameyaṃ darśyati (-) avasāyasya vikalpaḥ jñānasya bhrāntitve aṅgīkriyamāṇe sati tasmājjaḍādavasāyādviṣaya sthiti vyavasthā na bhavati | smṛti bhrānteranyasya vā bhrānti bodhasya prakāśamāne saṃvedanāṃśe svajñānāṃśe na bhrāntitā artha vaiparītyā bhāvāt dūravartinīṃ śuktiṃ dṛṣṭvā tannairmalyaṃ guṇādidaṃ rajatamiti saṃbhūtasya bhrānti jñānasyedaṃ rajatamiti prakāśamāne svasaṃvedanāṃ śena bhrāntitā vaiparītyā bhāvāt tat bhrāntaṃ cet sarvaṃ rajat jñānaṃ bhrāntaṃ bhavati | tatra bhrānti jñāne adhyavasīyate svākāroyo rajatākāra tasmiṃstadbuddhyā āropyate yo rajatākāraḥ sa ākāraḥ viparīta tayā asvākāra tvenā rajatākāratvenārtha tayā viṣayā kāratvenādhyavasyata iti śuktyākāra eva rajatatvenādhyavasīyata iti tasya rajata jñānasya tatra viṣayāṃśe bhrāntitā na jñānāṃśe bhrāntitā so'rtharūpāṃ śukti rajatādi buddhirūpayāvā dvicandrādibuddhirūpayā vā
smṛtyā na spṛśyata iti tatrārthāṃśe tūṣṇīke nyaprakāśiketi asyāḥ smṛti bhrānti saṃvidaḥ tatra viṣayāṃśe jaḍatvamasyā yātam | śuktiviṣaye jātasya rajatjñānasya svīyeviṣayarūpe rajatāṃśa (--------------) (-----) pāt jaḍatvaṃ ghaṭa jñānasya tu paṭajñāna viṣaye paṭe prakāśakatvā bhāvāt paṭajñāna viṣaya eva jaḍatvaṃ na tu svaviṣaya iti śeṣaḥ | jaḍena jñānena kiñcit kṛtyaṃ nāsti | tatprakāśatvā bhāvāt | tataśca <118> smṛti bhrānteḥ prakāśakatva(---------------------------------) ro'pi lupyeta | tataḥ atha smṛti bhrānti jñānasyā jāḍye'ṅgīkriyamāṇe sati nije svasaṃvedanāṃśe atasmiṃstadbuddhyā śuktā bullikhyamāne sati tataḥ svākāre rajatākāre ca niṣṭhatā tataḥ avaṃ(---------------------------------) (-----)ryasthitirna bhavati | atha śabdaḥ praśne bhrāṃti rūpāyāḥ smṛte khasāya rūpaṃ vikalpātmakaṃ svasaṃvedanāṃ śaṃjñānāṃśam | ata smiṃstadbuddhyollikhyamānaṃ khākāraṃ vā valambyā jaḍatvamaṅgīkriyate kim | evamapi bhrāṃti svarūpa (-----------------------------) (---------) sati nijaṃ svajñānāṃśamullikhyamāna svākāraṃ svaviṣayaṃ cāparamārtha bhūta svaviṣayaḥ ityubhayatraiva pariniṣṭhitaiṣāsmṛti satyarajatarūpasya viṣayasya prakāśakatvā bhāvāttasya nāmāpi grahī tu maśaknuvataḥ smṛtirvikalpa (--------------------------------------) bhavati tasyārthasya vyavahāryatva saṃpādanaṃ sāmarthyam | arthasya hānādānādi vyavahārya saṃpādana sāmarthyaṃ saṃskāre satyapi smṛterna kathaṃ ghaṭate artha prakāśanābhāvāddhetoḥ | tataḥ anantaraṃ satyamityādinā (-------------------) lāni jñānāni paraspara saṃgati hīnānīti | anubhava stāvat smṛterviṣayībhāvāt svaviṣayamapi smṛterviṣayatve nārpaṇābhāvācca smṛtisaṅgati hīnaḥ | evaṃ smṛtivikalpayorapi draṣṭavyam | iti paraspara saṅgati hīnāni | anubhavādīnāma(-----)mityuktaṃ tatprakṛteti | athānubhava ityādinā prakṛte ātmano bhāve smṛtyabhāvāt smṛtyabhāvehānādānādi vyavahārā bhāva iti prakṛte yo jayati |
eva mukta prakāreṇa nyonya bhinnānāmityanubhava jñānādanyadvikalpajñānaṃ tasmādanyat smṛti jñānamityanyonya bhinnānāmaparaspara vedinā miti <119> |
anubhavajñānaṃ smṛti jñānaṃ na jānāti smṛti viṣayañca smṛtijñānaṃ cānubhavamanubhava viṣayaṃ ca na jānāti | tadubhayormadhyavarti vikalpa jñānamapyeva mevetyaparasparavedināṃ jñānānāmanubhavādinā manusandhāna janmeti | ayamityanubhavaḥ | ayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa iti vikalpaḥ | sa ghaṭa iti smṛtiḥ saivānusandhānaṃ tajjanmā janasthitiḥ | hānādānādirvyavahāraḥ | anantaraślokavakṣyamāṇaḥ parameśvaro na cet | kiñca evamiti bhavanmatābhyupagame naśyediti saṃbhāvanāmātraṃ na śyatāmiti bhavadabhīṣṭamātrānna naśyati | prakāśamānatvāt | jñānānāmanusandhāna janmanā janasthitiḥ hānādānādirvyavahāraḥ maheśvaro na cennaśyati samaheśvaro'styeva | tasmāt janasthitirna naśyatītyarthaḥ | janasya lokasya yā kācana sthitiḥ hānādānādirvyavahāraḥ sā sarvā vyavahārarūpā sthitiḥ | ekasya pramāturviṣayā bhāvopapanna smṛtirūpatā prāptirūpaṃ | kiñca anubhava vikalpa smṛti jñānānāmekaviṣayatāmupapannā smartṛrūpa pramātradhīnāyā smṛtitā tatprāptirūpamanusaṃdhānaṃ yattajjanmā tadāyattā anusandhānādhīnā sarvasya pratyakṣādi jñānasya vyavahārasya ca smṛtyāyattatāmeva pratipādayati (-) tathāhītyādinā | sarvovyavahārasmaraṇāyattaḥ prathamaṃ ghaṭaṃ jānāmīti pratyakṣa jñānaṃ paṭadarśanāt pūrvaṃ yo'haṃ ghaṭādi pūrvamanvabhūvaṃ sa evāhamidānīṃ ghaṭamanubhavāmīti anubhavasaṃskārotpanna smaraṇānuprāṇitenāhamiti pūrvaparāsaṃvidaikya rūpānusandhānena vinā ghaṭate tena vinā ghaṭate cet ahaṃ jānāmīti tasya pratyakṣasya pramātari viśvāntyabhāvaḥ prasajyeta | apratyakṣa prasaṅgaśca | pramātāraṃ vinā tasya pratyak'ṃ bhavati(,) tajjñānaṃ sukhamanubhavāmīti sukha pratyakṣātmakajñānaṃ tatsukhavati pramātari <120> viśrāntyā vinā na ghaṭate | sukhavati pramātari viśvāntyabhāvāt sukha pratyakṣatvā bhāva prasaṅgāt | evaṃ sarvatra ghaṭa sukhādivikalpohyevaṃ hānādi sarve vyavahārāḥ smaraṇamayā eveti | jaḍo vā cetano vā yaḥ pratikūlo bhāvaḥ pūrvamanubhūtaḥ sa ana bhimatatvātvāttyājyaḥ | yaḥ punaranukūlatvenānubhūtaḥ
sa abhimatatvādupādeyaḥ | yaḥ pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaścaitraḥ so'smin kārye samarthaḥ enaṃ prerayeti preraṇamapi smaraṇa nibandhanaṃ sarvajana saṃpratipanno'ṅgīkāro'pi evaṃ smaraṇa nibaṃdhanaḥ | ta evaṃ bhūtādanusaṃdhānājjāyamānājanasthitiḥ | kiñcaivamiti śabdasyākṣepa rūpeṇārthāntaramāha ātmeśvara rahita vijñāna vādimatādyaṅgīkāre janasthitirna naśyete | naśyatīti saṃbhāvanā (--------) (-----------) kavakṣyamāṇa maheśvarāyattatvāt natu paramārthato naśyati |
saṃbhāvanāyāṃ hetumāha (-) kuta ityādinā | janasthitirnāśasaṃbhāvanāyām | anyonyabhinnānāmaparasparavedināmiti jñānānāṃ viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetumāha (-) anyonyeti | idamityanubhavajñānaṃ vikalpa smṛtyoranyat | idaṃ nīlameva na pītāmiti vikalpa jñānamapyanubhava smṛtyoranyat | tannīlāmiti smṛti jñānamapyanubhava vikalpayoranyadityanyonyaṃ tāvadbhibhāni jñānāni vikalpadaśāyā meva jñānasya kālasaṃyojana viśleṣādi vyaktitedrānīntanamityuktam | tānyetānī jñānāni krameṇāyamiti ayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa iti sa ghaṭa iti ca svasvaviṣayarakāśamātrarūpāṇi paraviṣaye itaretara jñānaṃ tadviṣaye jātyandha bālamūka kalpāni sva (-------------------------)rekeṇa paraviṣayaṃ draṣṭuṃ vivektuṃ vaktuṃ ca na samarthānītyarthaḥ | na ceti smaraṇajñānaṃ vikalpa jñānasya prakāśakaṃ na bhavati | vikalpa jñānamanubhava jñānasya prakāśakaṃ na bhavati | <121> kiñcānubhava jñānaṃ vikalpa jñānanyo prakāśakaṃ na bhavati | vikalpajñānaṃ smaraṇajñānasya prakāśakaṃ na bhavati ityanyo nyasya prakāśarūpāṇi na bhavanti ukta prakāreṇa | evaṃ jñānānāṃ nija nija svarūpataḥ viṣayataḥ ekābhāva rūpamanusandhānaṃ nāsti | anyonyameka jñānasya viṣayitvam | itarasya viṣayitvaṃ ca nāsti | anubhavasya viṣayatvaṃ vikalpasya viṣayatvam | athavā vikalpasya viṣayatvamanubhavasya viṣayayatvam | evaṃ smṛterapi viṣaya viṣayi bhāvo nāsti | anubhava vikalpa smṛtivyatiritkaṃ turīyaṃ jñānaṃ nibandhanaṃ kāraṇī bhūya eteṣāmanubhavādīnā manusandhātṛpade sthitvā anusandhānādhāyi saṃbhāvyate | tādṛśaṃ turīyamapi
jñānaṃ nāstītidhvaṃseran | sarva vyavahāraḥ dhvaṃsantāmiti bhavadabhīṣṭamātrāttena dhvaṃsante prakāśante yataḥ tataḥ vyavahārāṇāṃ prakāśamānatvāttata etadāpadyate ydvakṣyamāṇam | etadeva vyavahāra prakāśanameva samarthayitu mudyantaṃ yat | adyogaḥ kartavya ityetadāpannaṃ tacca prakāśamānaṃ kartari jñātarītyabhimatamaheśvarātmaka svātmarūpeṇa vinā brahmaṇo'pyaśakya samarthanamiti darśayati (-) antaḥ kṛtānantaviśvarūpaścidvapuḥ jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimāneko maheśvaro na cet janasthitirnaśyediti saṃbhāvyate | so'styeva | tasmānnaśyatītyantaślokena prasaṃgasya viparyayaḥ | antaḥ pūrṇāhantāyāṃ kṛtaṃ tanmayatvamāpāditaṃ śivādikṣityantaṃ deśakālayorapi tatvāntarbhūtatvāttābhyāmaparicchinnaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yena saḥ tādṛgvidhaḥ cidvapuḥ prakāśaikaghanaḥ anubhavāpohana smṛtyātmaka praśastaśakti trayayuktaḥ ekaṃ tāsāṃ śaktināmāśrayabhūtaḥ maheśvaraḥ tacchaktisaṃyojanaviyojana <122> viśramaṇa svāccandya uktaḥ | evaṃ bhūto na cediti pūrvaślokena saṃbandha idaṃ sūtraṃ kathaṃ cidāsādyetyādyukta vakṣyamāṇa smṛti jñānāpohanaikāśraya māheśvarya nirūpaṇa rupāṇāmāhnikānāṃ tadupari kriyādhikāra gamādhikārāgatasūtrāṇāmapi sūtrabhūtaṃ(,) saṃvittāvat prakāśata iti jñānātmikāsaṃvittāvat prakāśata iti kecit | sarvavādibhirapi yaṃ vidaḥ prakāśamānamaṅgīkṛtaṃ taṃ sarvā vivāde na prakāśamānām | apahnuvate ācchādayituṃ na prabhavanti sā saṃvit svātmamātrā saṃvinmātraviśrāntā cet kathamarthasya prakāśikā arthasparśābhāvāt | arthasya prakāśikā cet sa saṃvidrūpaḥ prakāśaḥ arthasya dharma eva syāt | śaktatvāditivat | tataścārtha dharmatvā devārtha prakāśa ityartha prakāśātmikā saṃvittāvatyevārtha eva paryavasa (--------) (-----------------) grāhyamayaṃ grāhaka iti grāhyagrāhaka bhāvaḥ | ataḥ grāhyagrāhakabhāva galana prasaṅgātsaṃvidamartha prakāśātmikāmicchatā | tadvalāditi (-) tatsaṃvitsāmarthyādeva | artho'pi saṃvidrūpāntargata eva |(-------------------------) prakāśātmikā saṃvit | anyaścānyaśca yaiva pūrvaṃ
ghaṭaprakāśātmikā saiva paṭaprakāśiketyevaṃ rūpamaikyaṃ vihāya vijñāna vādi darśanavat ghaṭe nyā paṭe nyā(-----------------)manva bhūtaḥ sa eva smaryata iti anvabhūtasya viṣayasya smaraṇamanupapannaṃ smaraṇānupapatterekaivā sāvityekatvāt sarvovedyarāśistayai kayā saṃvidā kro(-------------------------)nicchatā vijñānavādināṅgīkāryam | evamapīti | sarvevedyarāśirekasaṃvit kroḍīkṛta iti avirataṃ saṃvidunmagnā cedyugapadeva bahiḥ śivādikṣityantaṃ viśvātmanā prakāśeta | nimagnā cedantaḥ yugapadeva kṣitya(-- -------------------------)śata evaṃ svabhāvatvāt paramārthata evameva | tathāpi na tathā prakāśate svātaṃtryāt | ata eva sāsaṃvitsvarūpāntaḥ kroḍī kṛtaṃ yo bhāvarāśi munmajjayitu mīhataḥ <123> tavyatiriktaṃ svātmanaḥ avibhinnākāramartha (-------------------------) tmani parigṛhya kaścit ghaṭamātramarthaṃ paṭamātraṃ vāhaṃ rūpamidantā rūpatayonmagnamābhāsayatītyāpatitam | evamābhāsātmikā saṃvit jñānaśaktiḥ unmagnaghaṭābhāsaṃ bhinnaṃ yat citsvarūpaṃ yat svātmanā bahiṣṭvana prakāśita viṣayonmukhatvena bahirmukhatvāt svayamabahirmukham | tattadvahirmukha navanavānyonyabhinna tattadviṣayacchāyānurāgāt jñānaṃ svayamapi navaṃ navamuktam | evamapinavaṃ navatvena navanavābhāsāḥ ghaṭapaṭādibodhaḥ pratikṣaṇamudaya vyayabhāja iti pratikṣaṇamudayavyayabhāktvameva vyavahāra nirvāha hāniḥ | tattadanubhūtaviṣaya smṛtirūpānusandhānābhāvana hetostena vyavahāra hāni prasaṅgāt gṛhīta pūrve viṣaye ayaṃ ghaṭa para iti bahirmukhe savivedanamabhūt | tasya bahirmukhasya saṃvedna syāntarmukhaṃ pramātrākaṃ cit svarūpatvaṃ taccitsvarūpatvaṃ yat tadanubhavapṛṣṭhapātini kālāntarepyavasthāsnuḥ svātmagataṃ svātma sthitaṃ anubhavakālobhūta ghaṭādiviṣaya bahirmukhatvaṃ tasmin kāle tasmin deśe yo ghaṭo bahirmukho dṛṣṭaḥ taddeśakālaviśiṣṭatadviṣayaḥ saghaṭaḥ sa paṭa iti viśeṣa bahirmukhatvaṃ prakāśayati | tasyāntarmukhasya citsvarūpasyaivā parāmṛṣṭireva smṛti śkatiḥ tadvastu idaṃ nīlamiti navaṃ bhāsayati | tannīlamiti smarati tadvastu anubhavasmṛtyorviṣayarūpaṃ vastu paramārthataḥ prakāśamānatvāt śivādikṣityanta viśvamayyā
saṃvidā tādātmya vṛttīti svayamapi saṃvidviśvamayaṃ pūrvameveti navaṃ nakiñcit ghaṭamātra mābhāsitam | anubhavena prakāśitaṃ smṛtaṃ syāt | idamapyaṃgī kāryaṃ pravāheṇa saṃvit pravāheṇedamapyaṅgīkāryam | evamapi nabhavati anubhava kāle yat ghaṭamātraṃ vastvābhāsyate tat prathamaṃsaṃvido vicchidyate ghaṭagrāhikātmikāyāḥ <124> saṃvido vicchidyate | ghaṭa vyavasthāpikā saṃvit paṭasya vyavasthātmikāyāḥ saṃvido vicchidyate | saṃvedyaṃ ca ghaṭātma saṃvedyaṃ paṭādisaṃvedyāntarādvicchidyate | sarvasyāpyekasaṃvinmayatvāt | paramārthato na vicceda iti vicchedanasya saṃvidāṃ saṃvedyānāñcānyonya vicchedanasyābhāva bhāsanamātraṃ tadvicchedana mābhāsana mābhāsanamātratayā na pāramārthikaṃ nirmīyamāṇasyagrāhyagrāhakātmanaḥ padārthasyāyamevānyonya viccheda iva paramārthaḥ grāhyasya saṃvidaḥ prathamaṃ vicchedaḥ grāhyāntarāt grāhakācca vicchedaḥ | evaṃ saṃvidaśca saṃvidantarāt saṃvedyavargāt saṃvettuśca vicchedaḥ | saṃvettuśca saṃvetrantarāt saṃvidaḥ saṃvedyāntarādviccheda iti | ayameva viccedaḥ paramārthaḥ | yataḥ eṣa vicchedaḥ paricchedanāt pariccheda ucyate tadavabhāsanam | evaṃ bhūtaparicchedāvabhāsanamapohanamaśaktiḥ | ayamitiṃ ayameva sa iti vyavahāraḥ | anena śakti (-------------------------) tat śaktitrayaṃ śaktimatobhagavataḥ eva śaktitvāt | tacca bhagavata eva śakti trayamityanena sūtrakṛtasyaika śabdasyārtho nirvāhitaḥ | yathoktam
śaktiśca śaktimadrūpā dvyatirekaṃ navāñchati | tādātmya manayornitya (------------------------- --------) ||
<śakti> trayasya bhagavadadhīnatvaṃ nāma tathā bhūta iti tacchaktitrayavat anubhavitṛsmartṛ vikalpayitṛsvabhāva caitramaitrādyavabhāsanaṃ samaheśvara eva svecchayā tena tena caitramaitrādi vapuṣā(---------------------) (----) yathoktaṃ sūtrakāreṇaiva ghaṭapadādyartha sthitiḥ <125> arthavyavasthā prāṇapuryaṣṭaka niyantrite jīve nirūddhā tatrāpi nirodhe'pi paramātmani sthitā | etāsāṃ jñānādiśaktīnāṃ ghaṭānubhavaḥ ghaṭasmṛtiḥ pu (-------------------------) rovaicitryavikalpaḥ | aparādhīnasaṃpādanasāmarthyaṃ tat svātantryanirmita brahmaviṣṇurudraiśvarya nirmita sadāśiveśvarāpekṣayā pūrṇamahamityucyate | etadaiśvaryameva
cinmayaḥ | vapuriti kṛtvā śivādikṣityanta iti yadā(------------------) taika rūpajaḍatvena parameśvarasyaiṣā jñānasmṛtyādiyuktatārūpa māheśvarya mupasaṃprāptam | evam bhūtamaheśvarānaṅgīkāre nedaṃ viśvaṃ citraṃ kiñcidbhāseta iti prasaṅgaḥ | viśrāntibhūtamityabhāvādviśvaṃ bhāsate (-------------------------) tadeva māheśvaryamevā vaśyamaṅgīkartavyam | iti prasaṅga viparyayaḥ yadyevaṃ na syāt evaṃ bhūta maheśvaro na syāt janasthitirnaścet iti prāktanena | evamanyonyabhinnāmiti śloke nāti prasaṅgaḥ | na cedityanena ślokena prasaṅga(--------------------) taḥ ||
[iti pratyabhijñāsūtravimarśinī vyākhyāyāṃ tṛtīyamāhnikaṃ samāptam] ||
[atha caturthamāhnikam] ||
jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimānityukta krameṇa jñānaśaktāveva prathamaṃ nirūpaṇīya yogyāyāṃ satyāmapi pūrvameva athānubhavavidhvaṃsa iti sūtreṇa sūcita prasaṅga viparyayasamarthana <126> diśā smṛti śakti nirūpaṇameva prathamamupakramyate | tathāhi (-) pūrvapakṣasvarūpanirūpaṇānantaraṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākartuṃ prathamaṃ satyaṃ kintvityupakrāṃtatvāt padārtharatnanikaramiti | padārtheti | śivādisakalāntāḥ pramātāraḥ | tatprameya bhūtāni sadāśivādikṣityantāni tatvāni tadvikārabhūtvā ghaṭādaya eva viśvasya vyavahāramūlatvenāhlādakāritvāt ratnāni | anubhūta viṣaya saṃpramogha smṛtiriti yogasūtroktanītyā ca ratnāni teṣāṃ nikaramanekasāmānyasamudāyarūpaṃ svalakṣaṇātmakaṃ(,) nijaṃ kiṃsvātmavadavināśinī svīyaṃ hṛdayamevaviśvasaṃkoca vikāsa līlāyogāt kajjaṃ kamalaṃ(,) kuñja pāṭe hṛdayameva śivādikṣityanta viśvāvakāśa pradatvāt kuñjam | yathoktam (-)
labdhvāpyalabhyametat jñānadhanaṃ hṛdguhānte(,) tyādi satyatvā vicchinnatva prabandhenaiva sarvavyavahārajīvitabhūtasya smṛtisūtrāntarmadhye santatyāgra'nantaṃ lambikaṃ kurvantaṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ | evamiti | jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimānityuktaprakāreṇa smṛti jñānapūrvikā smaraṇobhayānugrāhiṇyapohana śaktiriti taṃ navaṃ bhāsayati smarati vā tadvastutaḥ saṃvidā viśvamayyātādātmya vṛttīti viśvamayaṃ pūrṇameveti navaṃ na kiñcidābhāsitaṃ smṛtaṃ vā syāditīdamapi pravāhā patita mūrīkāryam | yat kila tadābhāsyate tat saṃvido
vicchidyate | saṃvicca saṃvidantarāt saṃvedyaṃ ca saṃvedyāntarāt ityādinītyātadubhayānugrāhiṇyapohana śaktiriti prathamamanubhava viṣayabhūta ghaṭapaṭādipadārthodaya krameṇa darśitam | idānīṃ satyaṃ kintu smṛti jñānamityupakramānusāreṇa prathamam | kathaṃ bhavenna nityaḥ syādātmā yadyanubhāvakaḥ | iti sūtraprasaṅgaviparyaya samarthana sadṛśā vivecyā | etasmin pūrvapakṣe yaduktaṃ (-) smṛteḥ saṃskāramātrādeva <127> siddhiriti tadeva dūṣayituṃ satyamityādi jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimānityantaṃ ślokasaptaka mityuktanītyā bhavadukta saṃskāramātrāt smṛtistāvanmopapādyeva bhavatā |
idaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ tathā bhūta iti na cedantaḥ kṛteti sūtrokta bhavadabhyupagata bhagavatprabhāvo'pi enāṃ smṛtiṃ kuryāditi śaṅkāśamayituṃ smṛtitatva nirūpaṇāya ślokāṣṭakenāhnikamārabhyate | tatra prathamena kartarijñātarītyādi ślokokte saṃvidvāda eva smṛtirūpapanneti kathitam | dvitīyena (-)
athā tadviṣayatve'pi smṛtestadavasāyatā |
dṛṣṭālambanatā prānte(,) ityukta nītyā smṛtibhrāntirūpeti vijñānapādimata nirāsāya pūrvānubhavaviṣayīkṛta ghaṭapaṭādika svalakṣaṇa prakāśana sāmarthyamuktam tṛtīyena sa iti smṛteḥ ayamityanubhavena tadviṣayeṇa caikībhāva paryanta āveśa uktaḥ | smṛtiranubhavaṃ tadviṣayaṃ caikībhāvaparyantamāviśati | tata evāyamityanubhūto viṣayaḥ sa iti sata (-------------------------) smṛte ranubhava tadviṣayayorekī bhāvaparyanta āveśaścet anubhūtaghaṭavat | anubhavo'pi viṣayī bhavatītyāśaṃkyānubhavasya svasaṃvidrūpatvena smṛtyā prakāśaṃ nāstīti nirūpitaṃ pañcamenātītānāgatavartamāna (------------) (--------------------------------------) namapi caitramaitrādyanubhavaṃ pṛthagbhāvena na viṣayī karotīti vadatā turīya ślokārtha evopodbalitaḥ | yogī caitramaitrādijñānaṃ viṣayī karotīti cet taccaitramaitrādidehama (-----) (-----------)tvā ghaṭamanubhavāmīti | nanusvasyatirikta caitramevādijñānaṃ viṣayī karotīti vadatā turyaślokārtha evopodbalitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhena saghaṭa <128> iti vat sādṛṅme āsīdityanubhavasya śaṅkyamāna smṛtyā pṛthagviṣayīkaro(---------)
(------------------)saptamena smṛtiryathā pūrvānubhavaṃ viṣayī karoti tadvadanubhavapṛṣṭha pātinī vikalpo'pyubhavaṃ viṣayī karoti | smṛti prasaṃgāt smṛtāvapi kalpepi pūrvānubhavenaikātmya bhāvo darśitaḥ | aṣṭamena smartavyasya(----------------------) caitramaitrādeḥ smartuśca deśakālānavacchinna pūrṇāhaṃ prakāśātmikaikacittatva viśrāntiruktā | smṛti prasaṅgāttatpūrva bhāvinaḥ vakṣyamāṇāhnikarūpyamāṇasya dṛśyasya darśanasya draṣṭuścetyāhnika tātparyārthaḥ |
atha ślokā (-----------------) cyate (-) yaḥ pūrvānubhūtārthopalabdhā iti | pūrvamayamityanubhūtasya ghaṭāderarthasyopalabdhyā upa ātmani labdhā antarmukhaṃ ahaṃ rūpo bodhaḥ | sahīti | antaḥ kṛtānanta viśvarūpayukto maheśvara eva parato'pīti tadanubhavakāla tatparāsmin anantarabhāvismṛti kālo'pi san vartamānaḥ | svariti svamicchājñānakriyātmaka mupakaraṇaṃ svakartavye sṛṣṭyādāvīrayatīti svairī | kiṃ ca svakartavyeṣu svamātmānameverayatīti ca svairī svatantraḥ | evaṃ svatantratvādanubhūtamarthaṃ sa iti vimṛśan smaratītyapadiśyate | apadeśonāma tasya pūrvāparādikālakalāsaṅkoca sahiṣṇumāyā pramātṛbhāvasaṅkoca parigrahaḥ |
pūrvamayamiti | anubhūtārthasyopalabdhāyaḥ antarmukho bodhaḥ(,) adyāpīti | tadanubhavakālātparataḥ smṛtikāle'pyastyeva saṃvinmātra svabhāvasyāhaṃ rūpasya pramātuḥ |
na tadā na sadā na caikadetyapi sā yatra kāladhīrbhavet |
iti śrīmatstotrāvalyuktanītyā kālakṛtaviśeṣāvacchedāyogādanubhūtārthopalabdhetyanenānubhavasya antarartho'pyāpṛthagbhāvenāvasthita <129> ityayatnasiddham | iyattu | cintyamiti | sa iti vimṛśannityuktaṃ tatsa iti vimarśātmaka smṛtyutpattireva cintyā | akālakalita iti | pramātari purāṇetu sarvadā bhāta vigrahe | iti ca vakṣyamāṇanītyā nitye pūrṇāhantātmike para pramātṛrūpe saṃvedane tadantarvartini kṣityādi sadāśivānte sarvatra bhāvajāte sati tasya bhāva jātasya tat saṃvedanavat cinmaya tayā tāvat parāmarśaścettarhi tasyā hamityetāvatā pūrṇena
vimarśena bhāvyam | tadantarvartinastasya bhāvajātasya tasmāt pramātṛrūpāt saṃvedanādi dantayā pṛthagbhāvāvabhāsena parāmarśo bhavati cet tatrāpīti idantayā pṛthagbhāvāvabhāsane'pi dvayī gatiḥ | ahamiti pūrṇarūpeṃśetadbhāva jāta saṃbandhina idaṃ tā yadi viśrāmyati tarhi tasya bhāva jātasyāhantācchāditatvādahamidamidamahamiti śrīsadāśiveśvaradaśayā bhāvyam |
atha tasminna hamityaṃśe idantā viśrāmyaticet tadānīṃ bhāvajātasya māyā pramātra citenedamityevāvabhāsanena bhavitavyam | apūrvateti | navanavarūpeṇa bhāsanādetadidamityavabhāsana manubhavanameva syāt | ahamiti śivadaśāyāṃ(,) ahamida mahamidamiti śrīsadāśiveśvaradaśayoridamiti māyā pramātṛdaśāyāḥ pramātṛ daśāyāmapi smaraṇaṃ nāstītyāśaṃkyāha (-) svamātmīyamicchājñānakriyātmakamupakaraṇaṃ svakartavyeṣu sṛṣṭayādiṣu avaśyamīrayati | avaśyamupakaraṇe karaṇaśīlaśca | kiṃ ca svātmanaṃ svakartavye svayameva prerayatīti svecchayā svabhittau viśvamunmīlayatītyuktanītyā svakartavye brahmādivat prerakāntaraṃ nāpekṣata iti svairīsvatantraḥ (-------------------------) svatantratvāt sasapramātā <130> anubhavaṃ nānantarabhāvini kāle'pi sthitvānubhūtamarthaṃ sa iti vimṛśati | sa iti vimarśanasye damevarūpaṃ tasya kālakalitāhaṃ svarūpa parāmarśanaṃ yattadevanedamityantabhedaparāparśanamapi (-------------------------) nubhūtakāle taddeśakāla pramāntarasācivyenetyanubhavaviṣayasya ghaṭāderya ādhārabhūtaḥ tadviśeṣaṇarūpo deśastadānīṃ tanaḥ kālaśca taddeśavarti caitramaitrādisāhityena (-------------------------) yāḥ saṃvidaḥ pṛthakkṛtaḥ paścāttasyāmeva pūrṇāhantāyāṃ tanmayatvena vilīnīkṛtaḥ saḥ tādṛgeveti pṛthakkṛta rūpa eva san tasya pramātuḥ tadanya viṣayānubhavādi pravṛttatvādanubhūta vastu sadṛśadarśanāt bodhita (-----) (--------------------) kālāma sevācchādyāvasthāpitaḥ tata eva saṃskāraśabdavācyaḥ anubhavitṛviṣaye tiṣṭhati sadṛśa vastu darśanotthitāt tatsaṃskāra prabodhāttasya vastunaḥ kāla vyavadhānarūpaṃ tamācchādakamapahastayati |
tatra (-------------------------) toviṣayaḥ pūrvavadanubhavakāla iva pramātuḥ pṛthakkṛta evābhāti | pramātuḥ pṛthakkṛta evābhāti cet saṃpūrvavaditi anubhavakāla ivedantayāvabhāseta | ityāśaṅkya pariharati (-) maivamiti | saḥ ida (-------------------------) vapratipādayati idanīntanena smaraṇakālāvabhāsena tadanubhavakālāt pṛthakkṛta smartṛśarīraprāṇādi saṃbandhamanavadhūyaivahitasyānubhūtasya prakāśaḥ | tataśceti | idānīntanasmartṛśarīrādi saṃbandhamavalambyeva prakāśanāt tasyānubhūtasya viṣayasyedānīntanasmaraṇa kāla parāmarśo'pi na nimīlatīti | tatparāmarśeti | idānīntanakālaparāmarśabhitti pradhānyena pūrvānubhavakālaparāmarśa iti viruddha pūrvāparakālaparāmarśa svabhāva eva sa iti parāmarśa ucyate | evañca <131> viruddhapūrvāparakāla parāmarśaviśiṣṭamanubhūtaṃ parameśvara eva smarati | tasya parameśvarasyai tadeva smaraṇam evaṃ prakāra iti viruddha pūrvāraparāmarśātmaka kāla kalādisaṃkoca sahiṣṇumāyā pramātṛbhāva parigrahoyat | yathoktam sa eva tena tena vapuṣā jānāti smarati vikalpayati ceti māyā vidyādvayādvayamayamiti pramātṛ pṛthagbhūta deśakāla viśiṣṭa padārtha viṣayatvānmāyā iti saṃvinmaya pramātṛ prakāśalagnatvena prakāśādvidyeti māyā vidyā dvayasaṃmelana rūpaṃ smaraṇaṃ tata eva sakala siddhivitaraṇa caturacintāmaṇi prakhyaṃ iti | tata eveti māyā vidyādvayādvayamayatvāt pramāturbheda prathārūpayā māyayā siddhiṃ pratyākāṃkṣā vidyā tadvitaraṇa caturā iti tādṛgvidha siddhivitaraṇa cintāmaṇi prakhyaṃ smaraṇamityāgamikā manyante |
purvā (va) marśatvamavekṣya bāhya mantarvimarśaika mayatvamāptā | dhyānādi bhāvaṃ smṛtireva labdhvā cintāmaṇistadvibhavaṃ vyanakti ||
iti pūrvānubhūtārthopalabdhetyanena tṛnnanta samāsenānubhavasya pramātṛvat saṃvinmayatvena kālasparśābhāve'pi yatnato'nubhūte tyanenātīta kāla sparśanam | arthetyanenārtha viśrāntatām | upalabdhetyanena dvayorapi pramātṛ viśrāntiṃ
prameyapramātṛniṣṭhābhyāṃ bhedābhedābhyāṃ darśayati (-) pūrvānubhūtārtho palabdheti | vṛttāvanubhavārthayoreka pramātṛ viśrāntyātmakaikārthībhāvāttasya pramātṛbhedā bhedamayatvaṃ <132> kriyā saṃbandhetyādau vakṣyāmaḥ | etat smṛti tatvamevopapādayituṃ śeṣaṃ ślokasaptakam | tatra smṛti viṣaye kaściditi | anātmanīśvaravādināmanyatamā yadi brūyāt iha smṛtiḥ atastiṃ stadā ropaṇa rūpo vikalpaḥ | ata evānena smṛti vikalpanānubhūto'rthaḥ na prakāśyate | yo'rthaḥprakāśarūpobodha iti purvapakṣokta nītyānubhavasyaivārtha prakāśakatvādarthāsaṃsparśinohi vikalpāḥ pūrvaṃ yenānubhavena sa ityanubhavaviṣayo'rthaḥ ayamiti prakāśatāṃ nītaḥ | idānīmiti smṛti kāle kīrtimātramūtirjātaḥ tadānīmeva naṣṭatvātkathāmātraśeṣaḥ so'nubhavasmṛtyā na prakāśyate | dṛk svabhāsaiva nānyena vedyetyukta nītyā jñānasya jñānāntareṇā saṃvedyatvāt tasyedānī masatvācca tatprakāśitasyārthasya prakāśanā bhāvāt tatprakāśitasyārthasyāpi prakāśanābhāvādanubhūtamarthaṃ smarāmīti (-------------------------) thā tādviṣayatve'pi smṛtestadavasāyataḥ dṛṣṭālambanatā bhrāntā ityuktavat punarapi bhrāntimātramityāpatitam | bhrāntimātramiti pūrvamuktaṃ tadeva punarapyāpatitamiti |
evaṃ bruvāṇapratyucyate (-) sa hi pūrvānu (-------------------------) yaḥ smartṛrūpaḥ pramātoktaḥ sa svakāla iti smṛtikāle arthāt sāmarthyāt pūrvābhāsitaṃ pūrvamanubhavena prakāśitaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ deśakāla viśiṣṭaṃ kāñcanatvādyaneka sāmānya samudāyamayaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ sa ityāmṛśan kāñcana (-------------------------) ta ghaṭabhāsamātreṇa | athavākāñcanādyābhāsayuktaṃ yā smṛti śaktyā bhāsayet bhāsayedityanena vidhirūpeṇa niyogena bhāsayatyeveti niyamolakṣyate | ihānubhavapṛṣṭhapatinī smṛtirbhavatābhrāntirūpatayoktepi (------------------) (-------) arthaniścayābhibhāve tasya smṛtivikalpasya mūḍhatārūpasuṣupta mūrchitatā prāpti ranubhūtamarthaṃ na prakāśayatītyarthaḥ | tataḥ smṛti vikalpe anubhūtasyārthasya niścayo yāvadbhavati tāvadarthāditi tatsmṛti sāmarthyāt so'nubhūto'rthaḥ
prakāśata iti ya (-------------------------) aprakāśamāne satyadhyavasāyaḥ andhaprāyaḥ syāt | tasyārtha prakāśakatvāt | tasmādartha prakāśataḥ smṛtivikalpe tadityartha prakāśanaṃ tadānīntanānubhavakālasya tyāgena bhavati | tyāgena cettaditi parāmarśābhāva prasaṅgaḥ anubhavakāla(-----------------------) svīkāreṇa cedidamityavabhāsamāna prasaṅgaḥ | tasmāt smṛtārtha prakāśane anubhūtārtha viśeṣaṇa bhūtaḥ pūrvānubhavakālaḥ tatpūrvānubhūta bhāvasvālakṣaṇyāpekṣakatve nānubhava viṣaye vedyabhāge apekṣaṇīyaḥ | tasya vedyabhāgasya prakāśatmānubhava kālābhiniveśitaye dānīṃ tanasmartṛrūpa pramātṛdehaprāṇādyavabhāsakālaścālambanīyaḥ | smartṛrūpavedakabhāve tasya vedā bhāgasya vimarśośābhiniveśitvena tasmāt smṛtā varthaprakāśe ubhayakālasparśo'pyapekṣanīyaḥ smṛtyanubhavādi jñānaviṣayasya padārthasya ghaṭatva kāñcanatvādyekatamarūpyamanyabhāsa mātrameva svarūpam |
tathaiva sadghaṭadravya kāñcanojjvalatādayaḥ | pratyābhāsaṃ pramāṇasya vyāpārāt (------) iti abhāsa bhedābhinnārtha kāriṇaste padaṃdhvaneḥ ||
iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā tatsvalakṣaṇātmakaghaṭābhāsavartī kāñcanatvādyavabhāsaṃ pratipramāṇavyāpārāttadeveti tadghaṭābhāsa mātrameva(,) viśeṣaṇabhūta kāñcanatvādyābhāsāntara vyāmiśraṇayā dīpa sahasraprabhā saṃmūrcchana iva sphuṭībhavati | tasya ghaṭābhāsasya kāñcanatvādyābhāsāntara vyāmiśraṇayā sphuṭībhāvābhāve'pi <134> tadityanubhava kālābhāsa saṃbhedenaiva tasyānubhūtasyābhāsasya svālakṣaṇyamiti smṛti viṣayatā karoti pramāteti śeṣaḥ | kālaśaktereva bhāva bhedakatvāt iti vakṣyate | sarvatra bhāsabheda ityatroktamevārtha manuvadati | evaṃ tāvadanubhūtasya ghaṭasya mṛtau svalakṣaṇībhāvaḥ iti taditi viṣayabhāvaḥ | prāktanānubhavitṛrūpamātṛdehādi sācivyādyuditānubhavakālābhāsayojanayeti tāvati ghaṭābhāsa mātra eva vā smṛtiḥ kāñcanādyābhāsāntaraiḥ vyābhiśre ghaṭābhāse tadīyā smṛtiratisphuṭā | anubhūtasya viṣayasya mukhādyavayavaparāmarśetyanta sphuṭīkāre'pi
tasya taditi parāmarśātmikā tadānīṃ tanakālātānatruṭyati | anya sā dhāraṇyenā nava bhāsāt tathā vabhāsa iti ekenānubhūtasya viṣayasya tadanyapramātṛ varga sādhāraṇyenenavabhāsāt tathāvabhāsa iti dantayā vabhāse tattathāvidhamavabhāsanaṃ yogino nirmāṇameva na tvanubhūtārtha prakāśanam |
brahmovāceti | brahmādi bhāṣitāvabhāsane āgamādi pramāṇāntarānubhūta brahmādi svarūpa smaraṇa paramparā abhyupāyaḥ | tatrāpya brahmādi bhāsiṭāvabhāsanamapi tadbrahmādi svarūpa samāviṣṭasya sādhakasyānubhavarūpameva bhāsayediti vidhirūpeṇa viniyogena bhāsayatyeveti niyamoakṣyate | svakāla iti | smaraṇa kāle | āmṛśannityanenānubhūtavedyāṃśa sparśī(,) kevalasyeti (-) kāñcanādi viśeṣaṇarahitasyāpitu vedyabhūtasya ghaṭābhāsasya taditi svālakṣaṇyāpatti hetubhūtaḥ kālo darśitaḥ | iyadeveti | anubhūta ghaṭābhāsamātra prakāśanameva smṛtekhyabhicāri vapuḥ pramāturarthitāśayāt anubhūtasya viṣayasya viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭarūpaṃ <135> sphuṭatvaṃ bhavatīti dyotayatyatha śabdaḥ |
tadevāha (-) taditi | sphuṭatvaṃ sa (-------------------------) natvādisarvābhāsa miśreṇa vapuṣā bhāsayet | anubhūtamarthaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtakāñcanādiviśiṣṭaṃ ca sa eva parameśvaraḥ smaratītyuktanītyā parameśvara eva smartṛrūpo bhūtvānubhūtamarthaṃ smṛtiśaktyā bhāsayet | (-------------------------) taṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ smṛtyābhāsayedityuktaṃ smṛtāvevaṃ svalakṣaṇa prakāśane tat svalakṣaṇaṃ tasyāḥ smṛteḥ anubhavādi va bahirbhedenedantayā bhāseta | etadeva tasya svalakṣaṇasya bahiravabhāsanaṃ smṛtau svalakṣaṇa prakāśa (-------------------------) bahiravabhāsanāditi śaṃkāśamanāya nirūpayati (-) na ceti | smṛterviṣayabhūtasya svalakṣaṇasyānubhavādivedamiti bhede sati taditi smaryamāṇasya bhāsanaṃ na yuktam | anubhūyamānameva tadbhavate neti svalakṣaṇasya bahira(-------------)prakāśanebinnakālānāmiti | ayamiti ayameveti | sa iti | bhinnābhinna kālānāmanubhavavikalpa smaraṇa saṃvidāmaikyamasti |
ayamityanubhūtasyārthasyaiva vikalpa smṛtī pratyapi viṣayatvāt | anusandhānaṃ hi nāma pūrvā parayorjñā(---------------------) vedibhyāṃ jñānābhyāmeva sadbhāvaṃ ghaṭeta | ghaṭate tu pūrvā parayorjñānayorahamiti yadaikyaṃ sa eva vediteti sāmānādhikaraṇyena darśitaḥ | eṣa sa iti ācchāditasyaiva pramātṛrūpatvasya sphuṭatvāvabhāsanarūpa (-------------------------) ti anubhavādivedaneṣu saṃyojanaviyojanādi svātantrya kartā |
ayamityanubhūto'rthaḥ yadyanubhavādivat smṛtijñānāt bahiridamiti bhinnatvenāvabhāsate tarhi taditi smaryamāṇasya yadbhāsanaṃ tadeva na syāt | <136> tat smṛtiviṣayaṃ (-------------------------) mānameva bhavet | evaṃ cet smṛtau kathaṃ svalakṣaṇasya prakāśanaṃ pūrvābhāsitamityanena idānīṃ smaraṇakāle(,) tasya svalakṣaṇasya na prakāśanam | api tu pūrvānubhavakāla eva tasya prakāśanamityetaduktaṃ tadeti anubhavakāle | asau svalakṣaṇātmāghaṭaḥ | ayamiti bahiravabhāsa eva | tarhitadā prakāśitasya svalakṣaṇasyedānīṃ smaraṇakāle kiṃ vimarśanamiti brūmaḥ |
nanu bhavadukte naiva vākyena svalakṣaṇa saṃbandhinoḥ prakāśanayorbhinnakālatvamāpatitaṃ kimiti bhinna kālatvāt kiṃ dūṣaṇamāpatitam | ubhayamapīti | prakāśanaṃ ca vimarśanañca | na kiñcitsyāt svabhāvamanvabhāsasyeti vakṣyamāṇanītyobhayasyāpyanyonya jīvitatvāt |
maivam | jñānānyeva prakāśante | bhinnakālāni bhinna viṣayāṇi bhinnākārāṇi cetyuktanītyā yasyānyonya bhinnāni kṣaṇikāni jñānānyeva tatvam | tasya jñāna santāna vādinaḥ | idamityanubhava smaraṇayoḥ prakāśana vimarśanayoḥ | idamiti bhinna kālatvamanubhavādi jñānānusandhāna janmājanasthitiḥ | jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimān maheśvararūpa svātmāṅgīkāre yathā pratisamādheyā tadvadanubhava smaraṇa rūpayoḥ prakāśana vimarśanayoḥ bhinnakālatvamapyapratisamādheyameva | kartari jñātarītyukta nītyā kartṛjñātṛrūpa maheśvarātmaka
svātmāstitvavādinyasmaddarśane tu saṃvidaḥ anubhavādyāḥ | ayamityayameveti | ya iti bhinna kālā api tattadbhinna kālātyāgena svātmanyaikyā bhāsanena tatkālatrayānusyūta svatantraḥ pramātā ahamityātmāroheṇa bhānāditi vakṣyamāṇanītyā yāvatkāla manubhavamanubhūtaṃ cārthaṃ svātmanyāropyāntarmukhatayā tāvati anubhūte viṣayāṃśe vimṛśati tāvadanubhavarūpasya prakāśasya tātkālika bahirbhāvāvabhāsaḥ smaraṇa rūpasya vimarśanasyedānīntavāntarmukhāsthitirbhavatīti etadvimarśanameva tasya pramāturanubhavādi vedanādhikaṃ nettṛtvaṃ(,) anubhavādivedaneṣu tadidamiti smaraṇānubhavasaṃyojane idamiti vikalpasmaraṇa viyojane idamevetyanubhava smaraṇa viyojanenya yathā rucikaraṇaḥ svātantryaṃ veditṛtva kartṛtvayoranyonyā viyogāt etadveditṛtvameva katṛtvamucyate | tadeva pradarśayati (-) ghaṭamanvabhūvamtiti | anubhavaṃ ghaṭañca svātmanyāropya kevalamanubhūtaviṣayaniṣṭhaṃ vimarśanaṃ veti saṃvidātmaikya manusaṃdhānaṃ tadanusandhātu rabhinnamiti darśayituṃ yadaivaikyaṃ sa evavediteti sāmānādhikaraṇyenoktam | eṣa sa iti vismayagarbheṇānubhavasmaraṇarūpeṇānusaṃdhānena māyāśaktyācchāditasya pramātṛtatvasya sphuratvā vabhāsanarūpaṃ pratyabhijñānameva sūcitam | ajaḍa pramātṛsiddhau yadāha granthakāra eva (-)
itthaṃ svasaṃvittimapahnu vānaiḥ yattadvadadbhiḥ kaluṣī kṛtaṃ yat | pramātṛ tattvaṃ sphuṭa yuktibhistān mūkānvidhāya prakaṭīkṛtaṃ tat || ityādi |
nanviti tāvat prakāśasyatātkālika bahirbhāsa iti bhavadukta nītyā yadi prācyo'nubhava eva tadānīmanvayamityanubhūtasya idānīṃ taditi smaryamāṇasya viṣayasya (-----------------) turbahiravabhāsanarūpaḥ prakāśaḥ <138> tarhismaryamāṇasyānubhavena vinā tattayā prakāśanā bhāvāt so'nubhavaḥ anubhūtaviṣayavat idānīṃ smaraṇena viṣayī kriyata iti yaducyatāṃ smartā
draṣṭeva kalpita ityuktanītyā (-----------------) pramāturabhāvāttadviśrāntirūpeṇā laukike neti loke prasiddhena saṃvidāmaikyena ko'rtha iti parakīyaṃ vyāmohaṃ vihantu māha (-) prāgiti | anubhavakāle arthavadityanubhavaviṣayabhūto'rthaḥ yathā tasmā danubhava (----------------------------------) bhedena bhātisma(,) tathānubhavaḥ smaraṇakāle tasmāt smṛtijñānāt pṛthaktvenedaṃ pūrvamanubhavanamiti na bhāti iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ | kiñca smṛti jñāne yathānubhūto'rthaḥ sa iti bhāti tadvadanubhavo'pi sa iti na bhāti | ityapi vaidharmya dṛṣṭānta(--------------------------------) smṛti jñānāt sa ityanubhūto'rthaḥ | prāgiti pūrvavadbahiravabhāsana svabhāvaḥ | na ca yuktaṃ smṛterbhedaḥ ityanantaroktanītyā na bhedenā bhāti | smṛtikāle smaraṇaviṣayasyārthasyānubhavaviṣayavat bahiravabhāsā bhāvāt etaṃ tata eva (-----------------) pūrvo'pyanubhava smṛtau na bhedenābhātīti sādharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tarhi ubhayamiti anubhavaḥ anubhūto viṣayaśca smṛtau | atha kiṃ kena prakāreṇa bhātaḥ āha (-) anvabhūvamiti | asmadartha viśrāntāvevabhātaḥ | ubhayasyāpyahamiti pūrvāpara saṃvidāmekyamiti pūrvaślokena saṃbandhaḥ | kiṃcāhaṃ rūpaḥ pramātā smṛti kāle ubhayamapyātmani viśramayyānvabhūvamiti bhāsate | anvabhūvamiti luṅā būtakālasya dyotitatvāt | prāgītaṃ bhinnakramaḥ | uttama puruṣeṇāsmadarthasya dyotitatvādahamityapi bhinnakramaḥ |
smṛtāvanubhavaḥ pṛthaṅnābhātīpyasminnarthe vaidharmya sādharmyābhyāṃ <139> dṛṣṭāntamāha (-) yathā arthataḥ anubhavakāle anubhavāt pṛthagbhūtaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa iti bhātisma | tadvat smṛtikāle anubhavo'pi | tasmāt smṛti jñānāt pṛthaktvenedamanubhavanamiti na bhāti | kiñca yathā smṛtikāle smaryamāṇorthaḥ | yadvakṣyati (-) smaryate yaddṛgāsīnmesaivam ityādi | tasmāt smṛi jñānāt sa iti pṛthagbhūto na bhāti tadvadanubhavo'pi sa iti viṣayatvena pṛthagbhūto na bhāti | ityubhayathāpi vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ | smṛtikāle'nubhūto'rthaḥ prāgiti pūrvasvabhāvaḥ | tasmāt smṛti jñānādyathā bahirbhūtona bhāti tasya smṛti kāle'nubhavakāla iva bahiravabhāsā bhāvāt | evamiti | arthasya pṛthagbhāvābhāvāddhetoḥ pūrvo'pyanubhavaḥ pṛthagbhūto na bhātīti sādhamya dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
tarhi ubhayamapi smṛtikāle kathaṃ bhāti | āha (-) anvabhūvamiti |
asmadartha viśrāntameva bhāti | anena kimucyata iti cet pūrvāparātmakānubhava vikalpa smaraṇa saṃvidantarmukha svabhāvaḥ ahamityevaṃ svarūpo ya ātmā tatra tayoryadārohaṇaṃ viśramaḥ tena hetunā svaprakāśāyāḥ pūrvānubhava saṃvidrūpatāyā bhāsanāt | tallīnasyeti | tadanu bhava līnasya ghaṭāderapi svaprakāśakatvena bhāsanamuktam | kiñca smartṛrūpaḥ pramātā anubhavamarthaṃ cātmanyāropya bhāsata iti ṇijartho'pyuktaḥ | tadeva spaṣṭīkaroti (-) prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūta iti nyāyāt | saṃkhyākṣipta iti (-) anvabhūvamityeka tva saṃkhyākṣipte | tadvati saṃkhyā vati | katṛbhūte asmadarthe pratyayārthe prakṛtyartharūpo'nubhavaḥ bṛṃhitaḥ poḍitaḥ | tadanubhavadvāreṇānubhūto'rtho'pi tatraiva bṛṃhitaḥ | na tu svātantryeṇeti | anubhavadvāreṇa vinā asāvanubhūto'rthaḥ svayamevā <140> smadarthe viśrānto na bhavati | tadarthamiti | asmadarthe'nubhūtasyārthasyaiva viśrāntyabhāvāt anubhavadvāreṇaiva viśrāntatvāt | anvabhūvamityatrānubhāvyasya karmaṇā svata evasiddhatvāt karma nirdiṣṭam | paṭādiḥ punaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa ityanubhavakāle anvabhūvamiti bhūtārtha rūpamasmadarthaṃ nārohati | hīti | yasmādanubhavasmṛtau pṛthaṅnabhāti | anvabhūvamahamityātmāroheṇā bhāsanāditya parārdhoktā ddhetoḥ | tasmāt saṃvidāmaikyamiti pūrvaślokena saṃbandhaḥ | anvabhūvamiti luṅgā bhūta kālasyadyotitatvāt | prāgiti bhinnakramaḥ | uttama puruṣeṇāsmadarthasya dyotitatvādahamityapi bhinnakramaḥ | ārohaṇamiti ruhirapiṇijartho'pi (-----------------) māheti anubhavasmṛterarthavat pṛthaṅnabhavatīti kenoktam | arthavannabhātīti cet artho'pi anubhavanannabhātītipṛthubudhnodarākārātmanā svabhāvena kiṃ na bhāti | bhātītyetadarthānubhavayoḥ samānam | arthāsyānu (-----------------) pyartha sādṛśyābhāvādanubhavo'rthavatprakāśata ityetaddūṣaṇaṃ na bhavati | smṛtāvubhayamapi prakāśata ityetattāvadaṅgīkartavyam | anubhavaḥ pṛthak na bhātītyetadeva pratipādayati (-) tathāhītyādinā | atītānāgataḥ sa (-----------------) thā sarvavādibhirūpagataṃ yathā
pratyayasya paracittajñānamityādinā yogasūtre paracittamapi viṣayī bhavatītyuktam | tatreti pratyayasya paracittajñānamiti sūtre ghaṭapaṭādikṣaṇika jñānātmanā pariṇataguṇarūpaṃ satvameva cittaśabdenokta (-----------------) na bhavati cet yogi pratyayasya saṃyama viṣayīkāryatvaṃ kimucyateti |
atra saṃyamo nāma viṣayendriya sannikarṣājjāyamānaścetramaitrādi jñānavalambana yogaḥ śakyeta sālambanaṃ ca na śakyeta | tasmādyogi jñānaṃ parakīyamanubhava <141> (-----------------) pūrva bhāinaṃ nijamanubhavamapi viṣayīkriyatāmityāśaṃkya parakīyamanubhavatīti dṛṣṭānta evaṃ bhātītyante sūtreṇāsiddha iti yati | atha vāṅgīkāreṇa dṛṣṭāntasya siddhatve'pi anvabhūvamiti prakṛte'rthe ayaṃ caitraḥ ghaṭamanubhavatītya(-----------------) yapade'pi veti sūtraśeṣeṇa sūcayati |
yogināmapi bhāsante nadṛśo darśanāntare | svasaṃvideka mānāstā bhānti meya pade'pivā || 5 ||
dṛśaḥ caitramaitrādeḥ anubhavādi jñānādiniyogināmapi darśanāntare bhāvanā dyudbhave lokotkṛṣṭajñānaviśeṣe arthavadviṣayatvena na bhāsante | yathoktam (-) na ca jñānamidantayā bhāti | idantā hyajñānatvaṃ na cānyadanya vapuṣā bhātaṃ bhātaṃ bhavet tajjñāne na bhātyeva | paraṃ bhāti ca yatta devāhamityasya vapuriti parajñānamapi svātmaiveti tāścaitrādi dṛśaḥ svasaṃvidekamānā iti svaprakāśaika pramāṇāḥ ahaṃ rūpa svaprakāśāḥ | kiñca caitramaitrādi parakāyānu praveśāt caitramaitrādi pramātṝ na hamiti svātmī kurvato yoginaḥ taccaitramaitrādi svasaṃvideka mānāstā iti svāhantaikarūpā bhānti | api vā bhānti cet ayamanubhavatīti meyapadepatanti na tvanvabhūvamityasma dartharūpe mātṛpade yogināṃ parimita ciatra maitrādi pramātṛ vijñānavilakṣaṇaṃ tata eva tadviṣayī karaṇakṣamaṃ dhyānadhāraṇādyudbhūta malaukaṃ jñānaṃ masti | tatra yogi jñāne dṛśa iti caitra maitrādyupalabdhayaḥ viṣayatvena bhānti | tadena sarvavādyapi saṃvāditvena pratipādayati (-) tathā hītyādinā | saugatānāṃ jñāna santānameva
tattvamiti saugatā ityuktanītyā jñāna santānamātra tatva vādināṃ tāvat jñānaṃ <142> sva prakāśaikarūpaṃ tattādṛśaṃ jñānaṃ jñānāntareṇeti | yogi jñānena vedyaṃ cet tahyananya vedyatayā prakāśanarūpaṃ tasya jñānasya vapuryat tadvapuḥ prakāśitaṃ syāt | tasmāt saugatānāmapi jñānaṃ jñānāntara vedyaṃ na bhavati |
sāṃkhyānāmapi kṣityādi prakṛtyanta jaḍarūpa tatvottīrṇasya ata evā saṃvedya parvaṇaścidrūpasya puruṣasya pratibimbarūpā cchāyaivopalabdhiḥ | puruṣaścāsaṃvedyaparveti saṃvedyakoṭau na bhavati ityupalabdhirūpā tacchāyā kathaṃ vedyā syāt | pratipāṇibhinnabhinnasyātmano nityānumeyatvavādināṃ vaiśeṣikāṇāmātmani kṣīrādau śakyatvādivā bhedena samavāyiparagatamiti caitramaitrādigataṃ jñānaṃ yogiśarīrāntarvartinā manasā kathaṃ gṛhyeta | yoginastaccaitramaitrādi śarīrāntaḥ praveśe tatrasya caitramaitrādi pramātuḥ ahamiti śarīra karaṇādyogi pramātṛrūpe kāhantā bhāsitvācca vairoṣikābhimataḥ ātmane'nyonyaṃ bhedo vigalet | yogināpratyakṣī kṛtatvādātmanaḥ nityānumeyatvaṃ ca vigalet | anubhava jñānasya jñānāntara vedyatve tajjñānasyāpi jñānantaravedyatvaṃ tasyāpi jñānantaravedyatvaṃ mūlakṣati rūpamavasthānam | ādiśabdena smaraṇakāle tasyāsatvaṃ cedyuktaṃ tasmāditi jñānasya jñānāntara vedyatvā bhāvāt yoginaścaitramaitrādi paracittavedanāvasarevātadytaitra maitrādi pramātṛ dehāntargatāhaṃ rūpa prakāśa sahacāri ghaṭasukhādi prakāśata iti | iyānitīti | etāvāneva prakāśaḥ | tatreti | tādṛśe prakāśe prakāśo tadghaṭasukhādīdantayā bhāti | tadgatastu prakāśa iti (-) taccaitramaitrādi dehagataḥ prakāśaḥ yoginaḥ ahamityevaṃ svaprakāśatayā prakāśate | jaḍatve'pi pramātrīkṛte caitramaitrādini(------) (----------- -----------------) <143>śabhāge'pi manyamānaḥ idaṃ parajñānamityabhimanyate yogī | avigalita svaparavibhāgatvāt prāptayogaprakarṣastu sarvaṃ parameśvara padātmatvenapaśyan svaparavibhāgaṃ svakalpitameva paśyatīti caitramaitrādijñānasya yogijñāna (------------------) tā bhavatu | tathāpyanvabhūvamiti prakṛtam | etadyogyanubhavasadṛśaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati tathā hītyādinā yoginaḥ ayaṃ caitraḥ paṭamanubhavatīti caitramaitrādiparaniṣṭah evānubhavaḥ prakāśate | ahamanubhavāmītyātmāreheṇa pra (------------------) bhavasyāhamaṃśaviśrāntiranālīḍhedaṃ
bhāvaiva bhavatīti yasmādanubhavaḥ pṛthaṅgābhāti | tasmādaikya bhinna kālānāṃ saṃvidāṃ veditetyuktaṃ naiva hyanubhavo bhāti smṛtau pūrvo'rthavat pṛthak pṛthaganvabhūvamahamityātmāroheṇa (-----------------) (------------------) śrānti vaśādanubhava smṛtau pṛthaṅgā bhātītyucyate cet tadātarhi smṛtirūpaḥ kaścit parāmarśaviśeṣaḥ so'nubhava āsīditi anubhavamidaṃ tayā parāmṛśannupalabhyate | yadi vā kiṃca mayādayitā vadana kamalaṃ dṛṣṭamiti idantā rūpa dayitā padā (------------------) n anyat parāmarśāntaramupalabhyata ityubhayaparāmarśa viśeṣānu sāreṇāpi anubhavasmṛtau pṛthagbhātīti kiṃ na vyavahriyate iti parābhiprāyaṃ pratikṣipati sā dṛṅna me āsīditi | bhedataḥ pṛthaktvenāyaṃ smaryate so'nubhavo mamāsīditi evaṃ bhūtaṃ smaraṇaṃ yat tanmayā dṛṣṭamiti dṛśyena ghaṭena darśanena tadanubhavena saha māyā dṛṣṭamityasmadartha viśrāntāyāḥ smṛteḥ vyākaraṇaṃ vibhājya spaṣṭīkaraṇaṃ sā dṛṅname āsīdityatrāpyanubhavātmā dṛk asmadartha viśāntaivetyarthaḥ | kiṃ ca sā dṛk me āsīdityevaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamiti ca bhinna kramatvena yojayati | atra sā dṛṅname āsīditi kevalaṃ dṛṅmātra rūpaṃ parāmarśanaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamiti viṣayaviśrāntaṃ darśanaparāmarśanaṃ ceti smaraṇarūpa metadubhayamapi anvabhūvamityucita parāmarśāyāḥ smṛtervyākaraṇam | apiścārthe |
lokasya lokyamāna ghaṭapaṭādi tulyā vyutpannasya sā dṛṅme āsīdityevaṃ bhūtaṃ saṃvedanaṃ na bhavati | sa lokaṃ kāñcidapī dṛśaṃ svātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtānna manyate tathāpi tu evaṃ bhedena yat smaryate kasyacidvivecakaṃ manyasya evaṃ bhūtaṃ smaraṇaṃ yattatsmaraṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇāyāḥ smṛteḥ vyākaraṇaṃ vyaktī karaṇaṃ padasya prakṛti pratyayārtha nirūpaṇamiva kālpanikaṃ vibhajya ākaraṇaṃ paratreti adhikāriṇi pratipādnamātraṃ savivecakaṃ manyo'pyanvabhūvamiti pūrvoktāṃ smṛtermūla pratītiṃ vimṛśati yadi tadāsādṛṅme āsīdityanubhavaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ na vedayate śirovyatirekeṇa rāhorabhāvāt etadrāhoḥ śira ityetat prathanaṃ yathā kālpanikaṃ manyate vivecakaṃ manyate tadvat sādṛṅme āsīdityevaṃ
tadapi anubhavasyedantayā pṛthagbhavanamapi kālpanikaṃ manyate | vivecakaṃ manyaḥ pāramārthī karoti | anyatheti bhedaṃ kālpanikaṃ na manyatecet sa ghaṭa ityatrasmaryamāṇo ghaṭaḥ svaprathane prāktanamanubhavamapekṣate | tadvadanubhavo'pi svaprathane prāktanamanubhavāntara mapekṣaṇīyaṃ syādityanavasthā |
lokasya lokyamāna ghaṭapaṭāditulyasyā vyutpannasya sā
uktamevārthaṃ prakaṭī karoti (-) tadityanena dṛśyadarśanayorapyanubhūtatva sūcakena tacchabdaparāmarśena hi dṛśyasya ghaṭasya darśana rūpasya ca sa ghaṭaḥ so'nubhava iti parāmarśātmikā pūrvānubhava viṣayatāpattirucyate anyathā tacchabda parāmarśābhāve dṛgityeva syāt | tasmādanubhavaṃ cādhatvadanubhavāntareṇāpatita ityāpatitam | tatrāpi dṛṅmayā dṛgantareṇānubhūtamityatrāpi darśanasya darśanāntarānubhūtatve'pi tasya darśanāntarāpekṣayā <145> na tu mūla pratītiṃ vimṛśan ityuktaṃ bhavatā | sā smṛtermūla pratītiḥ kīdṛśīti cet āha (-) mayā dṛṣṭamityevaṃ bhūtāsmadartha viśrāntyātmikā sā mūla pratītiḥ | tatrāpi codayitumāha (-) mayā dṛṣṭa pūrvamityatrāpi bhavatā mūla pratītitvenābhimate'pyarthe tadanubhavātmakaṃ karśanaṃ dṛśyarūpatāvadanaviśrāntamuktaṃ śuklavad dṛśyaviśeṣaṇī bhūtatvāddarśanamapi dṛṣṭamityetat dayitā vadananat svayamapi dṛśyameva bhavati | natvātmārūḍhaṃ darśanasya karmaṇi dayitā vadane niṣṭhotpatterdarśanamapi dṛśya viśrāntatvāt dṛśya sadṛśa (------------------) karmaṇi niṣṭhotpatteriti svavācamapi svamukhotthāṃ vācaṃ paramārthaṃ na jānāti | tasya vāco'rthaṃ paramārthato na jānāti | kartutuḥ kriyayā vyāpyaṃ karmeti etadvadanaṃ na jānāti | tathā ca tadevo papādayati (-) kartṛ sthameva kriyamāha (------------------) darśakai rājñi darśanasya viśrāntatva muktam | na bhṛtyaviśrāntatvaṃ | kartuḥ kriyayā vyāpyaṃ karmetyatra kriyāyāḥ kartṛviśrāntataiva na tu karmaṇi | tena jñānakriye pramātrāyatte | jaiminīyairiti mīmāṃsakairapi tattatkarmaphala prada(------------------) ntra eva phalaṃ dadātīti phala bhāvanātmikā dṛśiḥ saṃvittiḥ | arthāt bhāyayitṛrūpa pramātṛviśrāntaivoktā |

evamiti | sa hi pūrvānumārthetyādinā āhnikena smṛtiśakteḥ svarūpaṃ pratipāditam | adhunātvanubhavamūla smṛtiśaktyupajīvanīyajñānaśaktiparamārtha nirṇayaṃ vitatyaślokaikaviṃśatyā pratipādayati | tatra vartamānavabhāsānam(,) ityādyaślokenānubhava śaktyātmani vastuni pratijñāṃ karoti | evaṃ bhūtājñānaśaktiriti | tataḥ prāgivārtha iti bhinne prakāśa iti ca ślokadvayena tadanubhavaśaktiviṣayāṇāṃ arthānāṃ pūrṇāhantātmakaṃ prakāśa eva svarūpamityāha (-) tatastattadaikasmiteti | na vāsanāprabodho'treti ślokadvayena(,) ahaṃ prathārūpa prakāśa bāhyānāmarthānāṃ sadbhāva vijñānameva <154> vijñeyatvena bhāti | natu vijñāna vyatiriktaṃ bāhyaṃ vijñeyamiti kevala vijñāna vādi vāsanādūṣaṇena bāhyārtha vādinā dṛḍhīkṛta māśaṃkya tataḥ syādetadavabhāseṣviti ṣaṣṭhena tāvaddhānādānādi vyavahārajātaṃ na kiñciduparudhyadarśayati tataścidātmaiva hīti śloke nāhaṃ prakāśāntargate ghaṭapaṭādibāhyārtha vādinā bhyupagataiḥ
pratibimbābhāsaireva hānādānādi vyavahāra jātasya siddhatve cakṣurādīndriya viṣayā amī ghaṭa paṭādayo bhāvā ahaṃ rūpabodhadarpaṇa lagnatvena prakāśamānatvāt pratibimbātmakāḥ etatpratibimbasamarpakāḥ prakāśādbāhyā nityānumeyā bimbarūpā ghaṭādayaḥ ke'pisantīti prakāśa bāhyārthasadbhāvanābhyupagame'pi tāvat proktaṃ a vyavahāra jātaṃ na kiñciduparudhyata iti darśayati atha cidātmaivahītiślokena | svasaṃviddarśane viśvasya saṃvinmayatvameva svarūpamiti darśayan prakāśa bāhyārtha sadbhāve pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ parākaroti | tataḥ anumānamanābhāta pūrva iti | abhāsaḥ punarābhāsāditi śloka dvayena pratyakṣa pramāṇābhāvāt tatpṛṣṭha bhāvinānumāne nāpi bāhyasyārthasyānumeyatāmapi nirasyati |
evaṃ pratyakṣānumāna pramāṇābhāvāt bāhyārthasya sattaiva vāstītyāyātam | tataḥ svāminaścātmasaṃsthasye tyanena svabhāvamavabhāsasya vimarśaṃ viduriti vakṣyamāṇa nītyā iha parameśvaraḥ prakāśātmā prakāśaśca vimarśasvabhāvaḥ iti svarūpa praveśikoktanītyā ca cidātmanaḥ parameśvarasya parāmarśa svabhāvatvāt śivādikṣityantasya parāmṛśyasya tatparāmarśāntargatatvāt parāmṛśyaṃ jagatparāmarśadvāreṇa parāmṛṣṭari anuttara bhaṭṭārake viśrāmyatīti cidātmanyarthānāmavaśyaṃ sadbhāva iti darśayati (-) tataḥ svabhāva mavabhāsadhyeti | ātmāta eva caitanyamiti citiḥ <155> pratyavamarśātmeti sāsphurattāmahāsatteti ca ślokacatuṣṭaye pramātṛrūpasyāhaṃ prakāśasyāhaṃ pratyavamarśa(--------------------------) vakṣyamāṇanītyā pratyavamarśa eva jīvitamityanubhavāgamayukti svarūpanirūpaṇābhirabhidhattetataḥ ātmānamata evāyamiti | svātantryāduktamātmānamiti nā hantādi parāmarśāditi ślokatrayeṇa | jñāna (---------------------) vabhūtaḥ parāmarśa eva svabhittibhūtaṃ prakāśarūpamātmānaṃ svātantrya jāta nīlapītādi jaḍarūpajñeyatvenāvāhanādiṣvidantā rūpatvena pratibhāsamānatve'pi anujjhitaśuddhāhaṃ tādi parāmarśāditi (-----------------) tmaka jñeyatvena ca prathayatīti tasyaiva parāmarśasya
pradhānatve nyāyamāha (-) tataḥ māyāśaktyā vibhoriti ślokena pramātṛpramāṇa prameya rūpasya prapañcasya prakāśaikarūpatve'pi bhedollāsa eva hetu svātantrya śaktimān (------------------) yā māyā śaktyā jñātā jñātrantarād jñeyācca bhinnaḥ jñānaṃ jñānāntarāt jñātuḥ jñeyāntarā jñātṛjñānācca bhinnamityāha tataḥ sākṣātkāra iti | ghaṭo'yamityadhyavaseti ślokadvayena viśuddha(------------------------------) vikalparūpe jñāne savikalparūpe ca vimarśa eva prāṇitamityāha tataḥ kevalaṃ bhinna saṃvedyetyāhnikopasaṃhārātmanā ślokena jñāturjñānasya ca pūrvapakṣe jñānaṃ ca citsvarūpaṃ ca tyādinā śloka dvayena yaddūṣitaṃ bhīnatvaṃ tanmāyāśaktyopapannamiti samarthayati ityāhnikasya tātparyam | ślokārthastu nirūpyate tatra prathamaślokasya | vataraṇikāmāha (-) nanvityādināmanuvikalpānusaṃdhāna saṅkalpotprekṣāṇāmanubhava eva pramāṇabhūtaḥ | tatra teṣāṃ smaraṇavikalpādīnāṃ jīvitabhūte tasminnanubhave prakāśamānā arthā ghaṭapaṭādayaḥ yadimahataḥ prakāśāt bhedenāvabhāsante tattarhi teṣvapi smaraṇa vikalpādiṣvapi prakāśamānasyānubhūtasyārthasya tathaiva bhedenāvabhāsa ucitaḥ | no cedanubhavo bhedenāvabhāsate cet te ṣvapi smaraṇavikalpādiṣvarthāḥ | anyathā na bhedenāvabhāsanta ityarthaḥ | tat tasmāt smaraṇavikalpādīnāṃ kāraṇabhūtaḥ jñānaśaktirūpo'nubhava eva jñānaśaktirūpeṇa nirūpaṇāyaḥ | ityāśayenāha (-) māyā pramātrapekṣayā ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ prakāśate ayaṃ paṭaḥ prakāśata iti bahirātmanā vartamānāvabhāsānāṃ tattadanubhavaviṣayāṇāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ bhāvānāṃ amāyāpramāturbahirātmanā vabhāsanaṃ yattadavabhāsanam | antariti | śuddhacinmaye paramārthapramātari sthitavatāṃ tena sahaikātmya manujjhatāmeva ghaṭate tadavabhāsanam | antaḥ sthitatvamanujjatāmeva pramāṇenopapadyata ityarthaḥ | pramātāramujjitvā bhāvāḥ svayameva bhāsante cet tadidamityavabhāsanamapi na syāt | pramātāraṃ vinā kaṃ pratīdaṃmityavabhāsanam | vartamānatvena sphuṭayatā idamityeva mākāra mavabhāsanaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ yadetadvahirātmaneti kalpitamāyīya
pramātṛ pṛthagbhāvena hetunā bhinnānāṃ tato māyā pramāturvicchinnānāṃ yadetadidamityevāvabhāsanaṃ tadbhāsanaṃ cinmaye mahāprakāśamaye paramārtha pramātari antaḥ sthitavatāṃ tena paramārtha pramātrā sahaikātmyamanujjhatāmeva ghaṭate | ayamatra piṇḍitārthaḥ | tenāntaḥ sthitavatvenānujjhitaparamapramātrātmaka saṃvidabhedasya bhāvasya caitro'haṃ maitro'hamiti vikalpita pramātrapekṣayā idamiti bhedena prakāśanaṃ bhagavato maheśvarasya jñānaśaktirityuktaṃ bhavati | bahiridamityanubhavagocaratvena prakāśamānānāṃ bhāvānāṃ tadidamiti prakāśamānam antaḥ śuddhacinmaye pramātari sthitavatāṃ tadaikyamanujjatāmeva ghaṭate pramāṇenopapadyata ityuktaṃ(,) taditi | tadṛg vidhārthaprakāśakaṃ pramāṇaṃ darśayati (-) ayamityanubhavagocaratvena bahiḥ prakāśamāno'rthaḥ <157> śivādikṣityanta viśvasattāpradaviśvottīrṇa pramātṛrūpa prakāśātmatayā vinā prāgiva tadartha jñānodayāt pūrvamiva svīya jñānodaye'pi aprakāśaḥ syāt | prakāśātmatayā vinā svasattāyā evābhāvāt | tasmāt svīyajñānodaye'pya prakāśaḥ syāt | viśvasattā pradaḥ prakāśah svātmani svasvarūpena bhinnaḥ anyonya rūpo na bhavati | svātmanyeka evetyarthaḥ | kiñca prakāśaḥ arthā(-------------------) (-----------) vati | tasmādarthasya viśvasyātmā svarūpaṃ prakāśatā prakāśa eva viśvātmanā prakāśata ityarthaḥ | yathoktam (-) yatprakāśate tadeka prakāśātmakamiti yathoktam (-) avaiśvātmye jāḍyaṃ prasajati citaḥ spanda vapuṣaḥ

arthonīlādiḥ tasya nīlasya nīlādirūpataiva prakāśatā nīlaśarīrottirṇā aparā nīla vyatirikta apramātrātmikā prakāśa (------------) (------------------) tarhi tasmāttannīlaṃ sarvānnīlānanubhavitṛn pramātṝn prati ahaṃ nīlamiti saṃbhāvanayā yathā bhaṇyate tadbhaṇanaṃ saṃbhāvanāmātrametat | tannīlaṃ paramārthataḥ svātmanyeva nīlasya nīlatāṃ na tu caitra maitrā (----------------------) maitrādiniṣṭhatvānupapatteḥ |
na hi jaṭā danyaḥ paṭaḥ ghaṭaniṣṭho bhavati | nīlaṃ svātmanivā na nīlaṃ pramātṛ dṛṣṭigocaratvā bhāvāt nīlaṃ na cet pītaṃ bhavatvityāśaṃkya nānīlaṃ nīlaṃ svātmanipītamapi na bhavati | pramātṛ prakāśā (------------------------------) at | evaṃ nīlasya nīlatā yathā <158> tathāsya nīlasya prakāśamāna vāpi sarvān pratibhavet | sarvāniti | nīlaṃ na sākṣātkurvataḥ pramātṝn prati nīlaṃ sākṣātkurvantapi vā na syāditi nīlādeḥ pramātṛvarga cakṣurādīndriya gocara (---------------) bhavet | indriyā lokadīpādikṣaṇa vargāt pūrvamaprakāśamānaḥ prakāśarūpo'sau nīlalakṣaṇendriyādilokādikṣaṇā viśiṣṭa eva jāta iti | athaivamapi sa evendriyādikṣaṇaviśiṣṭo nīlakṣaṇaḥ prakāśarūpo jāta ityatra (------------------------------) indriyādi viśiṣṭaḥ sa nīlakṣaṇo'pi sarvān prati vā na kiñcidvā prati prakāśate | indriyādikṣaṇa viśiṣṭasya nīlasya prakāśamānatāpi sarvān prati na kiñcidvā prati prakāśata iti indriyādilokādikṣaṇavargāt prakāśarūpo'sau nīlakṣaṇo viśiṣṭa ityatrāpi pūrvoktaḥ prasaṅgaḥ āpatet | nīlasya prakaṭatā nīlasyaiva dharmaścet sarvān pratiprakaṭatā bhavet | ni kiñcidvā prati sarvathā nīlasya prakāśatā indriyādikṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya nīlasya prakāśatā nīlasya cakṣurindriya sannikarṣāt prakaṭatā iti sarvathā prakāśaḥ artha śarīra viśrāntaścet artho mamābhāsata iti pramāṛlagnatayā prakāśasya mitirdurupakadā |
athendriyādimayaḥ pramāteti cakṣurādīndriyamayaḥ pramātā arthaṃ prati tadānīṃ cakṣurādīndriya sannikarṣa samaye'rtharūpasya prakāśasya kāraṇaṃ bhavet | bījaṃ yathāpūrvamaprakāśamānasyāṅkurasya(,) dṛṣṭānta eva duṣṭa iti darśayati (-) na cetyādinā | aṅkuraḥ bījāpekṣayānaṅkurātmā na bhavati | apitu īśvarecchayā cakṣurādīndriyamayaḥ pramātā tadānīmiti cakṣurāderghaṭādeścānyonya saṃyojana samaye'rtha rūpasya ghaṭarūpasya prakāśasya kāraṇaṃ bhavedityāśaṃkya dṛṣṭānta eva duṣṭa iti darśayati (-) na cetyādinā | aṅkuraḥ bījāpekṣayā anaṅkurātmā na bhavati | apitvīśvarecchayā | yadvakṣyati (-)
<159> jaḍasya tu na sā śaktiḥ sattāyadasataḥ sataḥ | kartṛkarmatvatatvaiva kāryakāraṇatā tataḥ ||
ata evāṅkurepīṣṭo nimittaṃ parameśvaraḥ | tadanyasyāpi bījāderhetuto nopapadyate || ityādi |
tasmāt bījaṃ yathāṅkuramasya kāraṇaṃ na jātaṃ tadvadindriyādimayaḥ pramātāpi jaḍatvā dartharūpasya prakāśasya kāraṇaṃ na bhavati | tataḥ iti prakāśa sparśā darthasya | evaṃ vidhaḥ uktarūpo doṣo bhavati cet yo'rthaḥ prakāśātmā na bhavatu | pragiva(,) ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ iti jñāno dayāt pūrvaṃ yathā pramātuḥ asau ghaṭaḥ aprakāśo jātaḥ tathā jñānodaye'pyaprakāśo bhavati |
nanu jñānaṃ nāmārtha prakāśameva tat tasmādartha prakāśarūpāt jñānasyo dayānudayayorapyarthasya kathaṃ tulyatā syāt | jñānasyodaye'rthasya prakāśaḥ anudaye'prakāśa iti udayānudayayostulyatākathaṃ bhavet | arthaḥ jñānodayāt prakāśo bhavati | jñānasyānudaye'pya prakāśo bhavatītyetat saṃbhavet | yadyupapadyeta upapattireva nāstīti darśayati yāvatetyanena | arthādbhinnaṃ jñānasya cidrūpatvāt arthasya jaḍarūpatvāccārthādchnnaṃ yat jñānaṃ tajjaḍarūpasyārthasya saṃbandhitayā kathaṃ syāt | paṭo yathā svasmādbhinnasya padasya saṃbandhīna bhavati tadvat svasmādbinnasyārthasya jñānamapi saṃbandhi na bhavati (-----------------) | (-----------------------------) rapi pakṣāntaramāha (-) jñānasya svarūpaṃ arthaḥ prakāśata ityevaṃ bhūtaṃ yadi tat tasmādartha <160> jñānayorabheda evāyātaḥ | ghaṭa svarūpameva jñānātmatayoktatvāt jñānasyārthasvabhāvatve'ṅgīkṛte sati jñānasyārtha (--------------------------------) tikiñcidvā pratītyādinā cidrūpasya jñānasya jaḍatvaṃ cāpatet |
athārthaṃ prakāśayatīti jñānasya svarūpaṃ tarhi tasmādarthaṃ prakāśamānaṃ karotītyāpatite arthādbhinnaṃ yajjñānaṃ tadarthasya saṃbandhitayā kathaṃ (---------------) artha prakāśate arthaṃ prakāśayatīti yatha karma prakṛtyartha vyarthayorvivekaḥ mayaiva bhedavidāraṇe granthe kṛta vistara iti tata evānveṣyaḥ | tasmādarthādbhinnaḥ prakāśaḥ arthasya saṃbandhī bhavatīti saṃbhāvanaiva nāsti | tasmāt pra (-------------) rūpaṃ
prakāśatvaṃ prakāśa mānatvaṃ mahāprakāśābhinnatvamiti | evaṃ bhūtaḥ prakāśaḥ ghaṭe'nyaḥ paṭe'nyo yadi pratipadārthaṃ vicchinnaṃ cet kṣaṇika jñānavādimata iva tadanyaścet yo'haṃ ghaṭa manvabhūvaṃ sa eva paṭamanubhavāmīti evaṃ bhūta (--------------------------) prakāśayoḥ svarūpe viśrāntatvādekapramātari viśrāntyabhāvāditi vitatyo papāditaṃ naśyejjana sthitirityatra | tasmādanusaṃdhānasyāyogādeka eva prakāśaḥ prakāśaḥ svātmani na bhinna ityetadapi prameyaṃ darśita (----------------------------) dityanena | arthān prativyatiriktasya jñānasyārtha prakāśakatvaṃ na ghaṭate | tathāpyarthaprakāśakatvamaṅgīkṛtya bādhakāntaramāha (-) bādhakāntaraṃ nāma viṣaya sāṅkaryaṃ tadviṣayasāṅkaryaṃ ghaṭa jñānodaya eva paṭādīnāmudayaḥ sarvasya padārthasya yugapadevodaye cakṣuṣaiva rūpajñānaṃ ghrāṇenaiva gandhajñānamiti maryādā bhāvo bhavet | arthādbhinneprakāśe ata evasvātmanyabhinne ekatve sati vyavasthāpakatvā bhāvāt viṣayasya saṃskāraḥ | kiñcārthādbhinnaṃ ata eva svāsminnabhinnaṃ jñānaṃ punarapyarthena saṃbadhyate cet <161> sarvasyārthasya yugapadevodiyāt sāṅkaryaṃ tajjñānaṃ nīlamātraika prakāśakaṃ cet pītādeḥ prakāśakaṃ na bhavati | kiñca yugapadeva sarvārthodaye parvataśikharasthasya pramāturnagara pramāturnagaragrāma nadīkṣetrādi padārthānubhavāntaraṃ tadanubhūtapadārthasadṛśasandarśane'nubhūtasya padārthasyāśeṣasya yugapadeva smaraṇaprasaṅga iti bhūyāt saṅkaraḥ | tatsāṃkaryādarthaḥ prakāśātmā prakāśa svarūpo bhūtvā prakāśate | arthaḥ prakāścet artha prakāśa rahit | na siddhyati na saṃbhavati tasya sattaiva nāstītyarthaḥ |
yadyarthādanya eva jñānātmā prakāśaḥ | ata evārthābhinnatvādeva arthato bhinnastarhi arthādbhināsya jñānasya svātmanyeva prakāśamātra rūpatvādabheda eva aikyameva | abhedameva pratipādyati (-) tathā hītyādinā | nīlasya prakāśaḥ pītasya prakāśa ityatra jñeyarūpo nīlāṃśaḥ pītāṃśaśca | sa tāvajjñānasya na svarūpaṃ jñānāt jñeyasya bhinnatvāt jñānasya svarūpaṃ cet jñānajñeyayorbheda vādatyāgo bhavet | nīlāṃśaḥ pītāṃśaśca nīla jñānasya pītajñānasya viṣayobhavatviti cet asmābhirapi tadviṣayatvameva vicāryate | vicāraṇā prakāramāha (-) ihetyādinā |
idaṃ nīlaṃ idaṃ pītamiti bhedo jñānabalādabhyupagantavyaḥ | yenaiva prakāśaneti jñānena nīlo nīla ityupagamyate tenaiva jñānena pītaḥ pīta iti kathaṃ saṅgacchatāṃ jñānasya svātmani abhinnatvāt ghaṭapaṭādyarthenābhinnatvānnānātmābhāvāt ghaṭa jñānena na paṭavyavasthā bhavati | tasmānnīlāṃśaḥ nīlajñānasya svarūpaṃ viṣayaśca na bhavati nīlena janitaḥ prakāśo nīlasya prakāśaḥ pītena janitaḥ prakāśaḥ pītasyeti nīlāderjanakatvaṃ prakāśasya janyatvaṃ ca yaducyate tannīla pītayorbhede siddhesyāt <162> jñānasyārthasparśitayā nīlapīta jñānayo nīla pītāsparśa eka samāgrī nāma nīle na saha cakṣuṣaḥ saṅgamaḥ tasya cakṣuṣaḥ nīlagrahaṇa sāmarthyaṃ nīlasya ca śuktirajatavadyathā prakāśaḥ nīlātmanaiva prakāśa iti ityevaṃ rūpaika sāmagrīko jātaḥ | nīlajñānātmā prakāśa ityādi yducyate tadbhavadīyaṃ vākyaṃ nīlapītayorbhede siddhe syāt | cakṣuḥ nīlarūpaṃ viṣayaṃ pītarūpaṃ viṣayaṃ vā spṛṣṭvā idaṃ nīlamidaṃ pītamiti nīlapītayorbhede siddhe bhavati sa eva bhedaḥ vicāryaḥ vicārya iti vicārakoṭau patiraḥ pratyakṣato na dṛśyate jñānasya jñeyāt (----------------) (----------------) cakṣurnīlādikaṃ na spṛśatītyarthaḥ |
punarapi pakṣāntaramāha (-) asau jñānātmā prakāśaḥ darpaṇavannīlapratibimbavannīlākāra ityucyate jñānātmanaḥ prakāśasy tannīlākāratvamukta yuktyā prati bimbabalādbhavati tatpratibimbātma (------) (--------------------------) ba samarpakaḥ sa dvitīyaṃ nīlātmakabimbānapabhāsādayuktameva (+) uktametat jñānasya jñeyādarthādbhinnatvena cakṣurādīndriyaṃ svaṃ svaṃ rūpādikaṃ viṣayaṃ na spṛśati(,) nīlādirarthaḥ jñānātmanaḥ prakāśasya svarūpaṃ na bhavati saṃ (--------------------------------) śasya nīlādinā janyatvaṃ ca na bhavati | jñānātmā prakāśaḥ nīlāderarthasya cakṣurādeścaikasāmagryā paripūrṇayā sāmagryā anyonyasaṃparkarūpayā jātaśca na nīlādyartha pratibiṃbagrahaṇāt darpaṇavat jñānātmā pra(----------------------) ityarthajñānayorbhedapakṣe doṣapañcaka mālakṣyā bhedamevaśaraṇaṃ prāptamāha (-) atha bheda iti | tarhya smān pratikuṭhāra bhūtastava bheda vādastyaktaḥ tathetyarthajñānayorabhedāṅgīkāre'pi kāraṇakāryatā

artha prakāśayorabhedavāde'pi parājito bhūtvā prakāśomābhūt artha evāstvityāha (-)syādetadityādinā | bhedapakṣe'pyabheda pakṣepyarthasya doṣāpādakena prakāśakena kiṃ na kimapi prayojanam | artha evālāsmākamityevaṃ vādinaṃ pratyāha artho'prakāśaścet svayamapi siddho na bhavati | tasyārthasya prakāśaikarūpatvāt | nahi bhittyabhāve citrasya saṃbandhaḥ artho 'prakāśaścet tasya siddhireva na kadācidityeva darśayati (-) svātmani nīlāmityādinā prakāśe na vinā bhūtaṃ svātmani hi svasvarūpe na pramātāraṃ prati |
yadi athavā svātmanyeva pītaṃ nakiñcidveti sattāyā evābhāvānna kaścit syāt | tannīlaṃ doṣāpādakena prakāśenetyuktaṃ tena prakāśenetyuktam | tena prakāśenārthaḥ kiṃ duṣyet | svayamāsti cet dūṣyatvamastitvameva nāsti | ata eveti | arthasyā prakāśatve svata evāsiddhatvāt prakāśasyaivāviśvātmanā prakāśāt grantha <164> kṛtaiva śāstrakāreṇānyatrā jaḍa pramātṛsiddhāvuktam | evamātmanīti amīghaṭa paṭādayoḥ jaḍāḥ | ātmani svarūpe asatkalpāḥ svayamevotpattu masamarthatvādasantaḥ prakāśayaiveti pūrṇahantātmanaḥ prakāśasyaiva saṃbandhinaḥ santi | tasmādviśvasya svātmanaḥ parameśvarasya prakāśa eva svasvarūpaparātmanā viśvātmanā cāstīti | atra piṇḍitārthamāha (-) tat tasmāt ukta rūpāddhetoḥ yadi prakāśaḥ prakāśoyadyāsti tadā'rtho'pyasti | prakāśārthayoḥ bhedo nāsti | athāryaḥ prakāśātmaka eva | tadevopapādayati (-) kathamityādinā ||

ekasya deśa kālā navacchinnasya mahataḥ pūrṇāhantātmanaḥ svecchayā svabhittau viśvamunmīlayati |

evaṃ svapakṣaṃ sthāpayitvā svapratipakṣa vijñāna vādyukta tattadvāsanā prabodhavaicitryagataṃ prakāśavaicitryaṃ tattattīvrayuktibhiryojayituṃ āha (-) vicitraḥ tattadghaṭapaṭādi(dya)anubhavasya vicitratvāttattadanubhava saṃ(---------------) (-----------------) dhaḥ vicitro bhavatīti tādṛgvidhovāsanā prabodhaḥ tattadbodha vaicitryahetutāṃ nayet | tasya vāsanā prabodhasyāpi vaicitrye nibandhanaṃ kiṃ kāraṇabodhaścetasa

niścayaparyavasāyyeva bhavati | kuto niścayaparyavasāyi (--------) miti cet | tatrāha (-) tathāhītyādinā | vijñāna vādinā vāsanāprabodharūpo yo heturuktaḥ saheturbāhyārtha vādinaḥ nopapadyata iti hi yasmāt vijñānavādyuktasya vāsanā prabodhalakṣaṇasya heto rūpapattyabhāvameva (---------------) ti anubhavānantara bhāvi smṛtijanakaḥ anubhavasaṃskāro vāsaneti prasiddham | iha tu bodhasya prathamamevāhaṃ ghaṭaṃ jānāmi paṭaṃ jānāmītyanubhava vaicitrye hetuḥ paryeṣaṇīyo vartate |

atha caitramaitrādernijanijasantānavartīni vicitrāṇi prabodhāntarāṇi vāsanāprabodhakāraṇānīti cet (--------------------------------) sat kathamiti cet svasaṃtānavartinaḥ <169> sukhaduḥkha nīlapītapūrvāparādideśakālabhedasya jñānarūpatve'ntaḥkaraṇaviṣayasukhaduḥādibodhasya bahiṣkaraṇaviṣayanīlapītādibodhasya ca tatsukhaduḥkhanīlapītaviśeṣaṇabhūtapūrvā deśakālasya ca vijñānaikarūpatve vijñānasya prakāśamātra paramārthatayā svarūpabhedā saṃbhave vijñānasyāpi ekabodhātmakatvāt svatantrānuvartinyāpi sukhaduḥādibodhāntarāṇyāpi vāsanā prabodhakāraṇānītyāpatitam | parapramātṛrūpeṣu catrasantānādyanya pramātṛrūpeṣu ata eva maitrasantānādyanyatama pramātṛrūpeṣu atha eva maitrasantānāntara śabdavācyeṣvapi tulyo'yamavailakṣaṇayaprakāraḥ | avai lakṣaṇya prakāro nāmaikarūpabodhānyatvānupapattiḥ | tatrāpi pramātṛrūpeṣu bodhāntareṣvāpi parakīyatvenābhimatānāṃ kṛśasthūlādidehaśvāsapraśvāsādi prāṇasukhaduḥkhādidhīguṇānāṃ saṃvinmātrarūpābhede aṇumātrābhimataṃ paratvaṃ kasyeti na vidmaḥ | aṇumātramapi paratvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | tat kāyādi niṣṭhasya bodhasya paratvamiti cet | sabodhaḥ pratyakṣa pramāṇena yadi na siddhaḥ tarhyasanneva pratyakṣa pramāṇena ghaṭavat prameyatayā siddhaścet jaḍa eva prameyatayā jaḍavat siddho'pi kārya ghaṭādiryathājñāna sadbhāvamātrasvabhāvaḥ tathābodhe'pi jñānasadbhāva mātra svabhāva iti tattajjñāna pratyeyasyāhaṃ pratīti rūpasya bodhasyābhāvāt paratvaṃ kasyeti na vidmaḥ | tasya kāyādiniṣṭhasya bodhasya prakāśaikarūpatve paraṃ pratyasiddhiḥ svaprakāśe caitramaitrādi pramātṛgatapramāṇa vyāpārā saṃbhavāt |

athābhāso'nyenāpi satāghaṭenāvabhāse svapratibimbarūpā svacchāyā dattā pratibimbarūpāṃ tāṃ chāyāṃ vibhradayamavabhāsaḥ ghaṭasya saṃbandhītyucyate | tataśca chāyā dhāraṇamātrādajaḍa ityucyate cet tarhi sphaṭika <188> salilamukurādirapi pratibimbachāyā dhāraṇādajaḍa eva syāt | iti paryaṃtadūṣaṇaprakāraḥ | atha sphaṭikādiḥ tathā bhūtamiti ghaṭa paṭādi pratibimbadhāriṇamātmānaṃ tasmin pratibimbitaṃ ghaṭādiñca parāmṛṣṭumasamartha tvājjaḍa iti bhakto'bhimataṃ cet tarhi śivādikṣityanta viśva pratibimbadhāriṇa ātmanaḥ parāmarśanaṃ pratibimbitasya tasya viśvasya saṃbandhi parāmarśanañcājāḍyasya jīvitaṃ prāṇabhūtaṃ tādṛgvidha viśvāntarbahiṣkaraṇa svātantryarūpaṃ prakāśasya svābhāvikaṃ svabhāvabhūtamahamiti svātmaniviśrāntilakṣaṇaṃ paramarśanamevānanyamukhaprekṣitvam | ananyamukhaprekṣitvaṃ nāma anyatvenābhimatasya viśvasya svātmani kroḍī kṛtatvāt svātmanyevābhimukhī bhūtatvam | svātmanyabhimukhī bhūtatvameva darśayati (-) śivādikṣityanta vācyādikṣmānta vācakātmanā prakāśena prakāśe iti vimarśodaye sati prakāśasya svasaṃvideva svānubhava eva pramātṛpramāṇaprameyātmakaṃ prapañcaṃ cāritārthamityabhimanyate | tasya prapañcasyāhantārūpatayā prakāśanāt svasamvideva kṛtārthamityābhimanyate | yo vikalpamidamarthamaṇḍalaṃ paśyatīśanikhilaṃ bhavadvapuḥ |

iti citi kartṛtātātparyeṇātmājaḍāt caitanya śūnyāt ghaṭādervilakṣaṇaḥ svabhāvmavabhāsasyeti sūtreṇa vimarśa evātmanaścaitanya pradhānamukhyaṃ rūpamityuktaṃ(,) yataḥ ātmanaḥ prayojanarūpaṃ pramāṇabhūtamamumeva vimarśaṃ hetūkṛtya sadā śiveśvarādigata sarvakartṛtvādi dharmāṇāmutpattisthānatvāt dharmāsvabhāvaḥ teṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ viśrānti sthānatvād dravyabhūto'pi caitanyamiti dharmavācinā śabdenāyamātmācetanaḥ idaṃ tvasya caitanyamiti | ityevaṃ rūpāṃ bhedakakṣyāṃ tiraskṛtya śivaḥ śaṅkara iti vat ātmā caitanyamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyamāśritya caitanyamityuditaḥ kathitaḥ āgameṣvitiśeṣaḥ |
tadetaddarśayati (-) bhagavatā śivena śivasūtreṣu caitanyamevātmeti hi paṭhitam | caitanyamiti padaṃ dharmavācakānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ citi dṛśyādi dharmavācakānāṃ padānāmupalakṣaṇam | viśvarūpatāsvīkāre'pi svarūpahānirahitā citi śaktiścetana taddraṣṭṛsvarūpaṃ dṛśerdarśanasya kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ darśanameva draṣṭā dṛśi svarūpaṃ citiśakti pariṇāminī taddṛśeḥ kevalaṃ draṣṭā dṛśi mātra ityādi sūtreṣu dharmaśabdenātmanaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ darśitam guruṇānantena ātmādravyabhūta iti yaduktaṃ tasya dravyatvameva nirūpayati | dravyaṃ hi taducyata ityādinā | yasminnātmarūpe dravye viśrāntaḥ padārthaḥ ghaṭapaṭādiḥ samastobhāti avināśinibodhe | tathā jaḍabhūtānāmityuktanītyā yasminnātmarūpe dravye avināśini <191> bodhesamastaḥ samyagastaḥ nikṣiptaḥ | ata eva viśrāntaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ paṭa ityādirūpeṇa bhāti udakāharaṇa cchādanarūpāyai arthakriyāyai arthyatetadeva dravyamityucyate |

viśvaiśvaryapātratvena pratiṣṭhāpyate | <202> kasmādityāśaṃkya tasyā eva prādhānyaṃ vaktumā (---------------------------------) traikarūpamātmānam | ata eva vimarśaśaktirūpāhetoḥ(,) śivādikṣityanta tatvātmanā jñeyī kuryāt | viśvottīrṇāpi svātantryeṇa svayameva viśvātmanā sphuret | pṛthak sthitīti (-) evaṃ bhūtāt prakāśarūpādātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtāya (---------------------------------) ntasya jñyasyasthitiḥ tādṛkprakāśa pṛthagbhūtasthiti jñeyaṃ naiva bhavati | tu khadhāraṇe | bhavati cedasthātmanā parameśvarasya tatsvavyatirikta jñeyaunmukhyāt jñātraikarūpātmajñeyīkaraṇalakṣaṇātādṛgvidhā vyatirikta jñeyonmukhātantratākhaṇḍyeta tena vyatirikta viṣayeṇainmmukhyenānyādhīnatvarūpaṃ pāratantryamasyaniyate | pāratantryaṃ ca svātantryasya viruddhaṃ svātantryameva cānanya mukhaprekṣitvalakṣaṇamātmanaḥ svarūpamiti tādṛgvidha svātantryābhāvāt vyatiriktonmukha ātmanā ātmaivasyāt | anātmā jaḍaḥ vyatiriktaṃ jñeyaṃ pratighaṭādivannonmukhī bhavatīti atiprasaṅgaḥ | ataḥ prasaṅga viparyayā davyatiriktonmukhaḥ svataḥ sannātmānamevaṃ jñeyikarotīti idamāyātaṃ na kevalaṃ svātantryarahita nīlādirūpe ṇaivātmānaṃ jñeyī karoti | yāvat svātantryāduktaśiveśvara paśupati bhairavādirūpeṇāpi ātmānaṃ jñeyī karotītyāha (-) svātantryāduktamityādinā | ayaṃ prabhumamadvayātmanaḥ saṃvidekarūpasya svātmanaḥ atidurghaṭakāritvalakṣaṇādukta vimarśaśaktirūpāt svātantryādātmānaṃ viśvasṛṣṭyādi kṛtyapañcakalakṣaṇa svātantryāmuktaṃ śivaliṅga śivāgama sthāṇulamaṇḍalādau ayamīśaḥ ayaṃ paśupatirityādi saṅkalpaḥ idantayā bāhyaṃ vyavahārayet | svayaṃ dhyeyā <203> pūjyo pāsyādirūpeṇa sthityā vyavahāreṇa dhyānapūjādinā svātmānaṃ yo jayet | evamātmanaḥ svātantryāmukta nīlādirūpatayā nirmāṇasya svātantryāmukteśvarādirūpatayā nirmāṇasya ca vimarśaśaktihetu rityarthaḥ |
evaṃ sūtrayojanāṃ pradarśya etatsūtra vyākhyānṃ pramṛṣṭamāha (-) sarvāḥ śaktirityādinā | sarvā ityuktarūpāścidānandādikāḥ śaktīḥ aiśvaryātmanā
ityaiśvaryaṃ pañcavidhakṛtya kāritvamiti śrīmatstotrāvalī vyākhyā noktanītyā pañcavidhakṛtya kārilakṣaṇa svātantryātmā kartṛtvaśaktirvimarśamiti tātparyātmasaṃkṣepeṇa bhavduktasya praśnasyottaramuktam | śabdārthastu ayamiti pūrṇāhaṃ prakāśātmā parameśvaraḥ viśvottīrṇaṃ svātmānaṃ jñātraika rūpatvātparama pramātṛrūpatvena jñeyam | anidaṃ prathamamapīdaṃ tayā jñeyī karotīti yat saṃbhāvyate tattadākasmikābhāsa iti kārikoktaprakāreṇa kāraṇāntarānupapatteḥ cidātmaiva hi deva iti ślokoktena dṛḍhena saṃbhāvanānumānena darśitatvāt tatsaṃbhāvanam | ata eveti svabhāvamavabhāsasyeti sūtroktanītyā vimarśaśaktilakṣaṇāt kartṛtvāddhetorbhavati | tadeva saṃbhāvanaṃ yukti yuktatvena pratpādayatiyato hyayamityādinā | prakāśaśca vimarśa svabhāva ityuktanītyā ayaṃ parameśvaraḥ prakāśarūpamātmānaṃ parāmṛśatītiyataḥ kutastasyātmanaḥ śivādikṣityanta viśvanirbaratvāt sa ātmā nīlādirūpeṇa ca kāsti | nānviti | parameśvaraḥ jñātraikarūpamātmānaṃ viśvātmanā jñeyī karotīti eṣā saṃbhāvanaiva kuta ityāśaṃkyātmavyatirekeṇa jñeyasya svarūpaṃ kimapi nāstītyāha (-) ihāsmin saṃviddarśane ātmarūpāt prakāśāt yasyapṛthagbhūtā sthitiḥ tādṛk prakāśāvyatiriktaṃ <204> jñeyaṃ naiva bhavati turevārthe | prakāśavyatiriktaṃ jñeyaṃ naiva bhavati (------------------) (------)vabhāsanāmityādi ślokairyuktayaḥ uktāḥ |
athāṃgīkṛta bādhakātmikāṃ yuktimapyāha yadiprakāśa vyatiriktaṃ jñeyaṃ syāttattarhi jñātṛūpasyātmanaḥ svasaṃvedana siddhaṃ svavyatirikta jñeyaviṣayaṃ yadaunmukhaṃ (------------------------) tannāsyasyāt | tenāvyatirikta jñeyaunmukhyabhāvena hetunā yā tena vyatirikta viṣayeṇaunmukhyenānyādhīnatvarūpaṃ pāratantryamasyānīyate | pāratantryaṃ ca prakāśa svabhāva bhūtasya svātantryasya viruddhamanu(------------------------) lakṣaṇaṃ svātantryamevātmanaḥ svātantryamiti tādṛgvidhasvātantryā bhāvāt vyatirikta jñeyonmukha ātmā anātmaiva syāt | anātmā ca ghaṭādivat jaḍasvavyatiriktaṃ jñeyaṃ pratinonmukhī bhavatīti prasaṅgaḥ |

viśvasyaikaprakāśātmakāhaṃ rūpatve'pi anupapannatve'pi anupapannatvenedaṃ tayābhāsanaṃ māyetyucyate | tataśceti (-) evamuktamānatvādahaṃ rūpāt prakāśāt bhinnamidaṃ tayā bhāsanaṃ ghaṭapaṭādyābhāsa jātaṃ māyetyucyate | taduktam (-)
<210> vastuto'haṃ mayatve'pi yadyatsphuradidantayā | tattanmāyeti tatvajñairuktaṃ kāśmīradeśikaiḥ || iti |
tatra ceti | tasminnavabhāsajāte cittatvasya tadavabhāsajātabheda prathāsampādakaṃ svātantryaṃ māyāśaktiḥ | tayā māyā śaktyā pramāturanyonyataḥ vedyaccabhinnaṃ yat saṃvedya(,) kiñca māyāśaktyā pramāturbheditena vedyācca bhedeti te nānyonyataśca | bheditena karaṇavargeṇa saṃvedyaṃ yannīlapītādikaṃ tadevagocaro viśrānti padaṃ yasyāstādṛśīti bhinnasaṃvedyagocarā satī saiva parāvāgrūpā citiḥ jñānamiti saṅkalpa ityavasāya iti saṃśaya iti smṛtirityādi saṃjñayocyate | jñānasaṅkalpādeḥ svarūpaṃ tatvataḥ kathayati (-) tathāhi tyādinā | sphuṭagrāhiṇācakṣurādīndriyeṇa sphuṭena ca rūpādinā viṣayeṇa ca niyantritayaṃ vittatvaṃ taccākṣuṣādi jñānaṃ manasā asphuṭena viṣayeṇa ca niyantritaṃ saṃvittatvaṃ saṅkalpaḥ | ayaṃ ghaṭa eveti | viṣayatva paryantabhājā buddhyā viṣayeṇa ca niyantritaṃ saṃvittatvamadhyavasāyaḥ | viṣayasyānyonyato bhinnatvaṃ pramāturbhinnatvaṃ bahirantaḥ karaṇebhyo bhinnatvaṃ yadbahirantaḥ karaṇānāṃ ca pramāturbhinnatvamanyonyato bhinnatvaṃ vedyadbhinnatvaṃ ca yattadubhayarūpaṃ bhinnatvaṃ prakāśā bhedānupapannamapi cittatveneti parameśvareṇa svātantryādābhāsyate iti māyā parda māyā pramātṝṇāmidamiti bhede viśrāntiḥ īśvara sadāśivayorivāhamidamidamahamiti bhedasyā bhedena tu viśrāntiriti yataḥ tata iti bhedaviśrānterhetoranyonyabhinnāḥ pramāturbhinnāśca jñānasaṅkalpādayaḥ tasyāḥ pradhvasta pūrṇāhantātmaka svasvabhāvasyākhilamahamityanusaṃdhāturmaheśvarasya śaktaya ityuktāstata eva saṃśayādayaśca bhinnāḥ nīlādayaśca bhāvā <211> vicitrādaya iti sarvamakhaṇḍitam | yathoktam (-)

viṣayasya vimarśamayatvādvastuto vimarśātmatā abhilāpamayatvameva | evaṃ nirvikalpātmikāmavasthāmapi parāmarśa mayīṃ sādhayitvāstaimityādyavasthāmapi parāmarśamayīṃ sādhayitu māha (-) staimityādinā | samādhirūḍhasya pramātuḥ sarvacintā saṃhārarūpāstaimityāvasthā parāmarśamayī na bhavati cettarhi <214> asyā avasthāyā stimitohamāsa iti vimarśarūpā vikalpātmaka pramāturvyāpārānullāsāt staimityāvasthāyāḥ saṃbhava eva śapathamaparamārthaḥ avasthā tṛrūpapramāturvyāpārātmaka vimarśānullāse tatstaimityāvasthā saṃbhavaḥ kenavaktuṃ śakyaḥ | punarapyutthāna samaye tadanubhūtastaimipyāvasthāsmaraṇaṃ ca na syāt | vikalpo na pramāturvyāpāraḥ | apitu rūpādiviṣayādhyavasāyī hyudiyāditi cet tarhyasya samādhirūḍhasya svavyāpārabhūta vikalpātmaka sarvacintā saṃharaṇamayaṃ kimanyat staimityaṃ syāt | tasmāt pramātṛdharma eva vikalpaḥ na tu rūpādi viṣayadharma iti vikalpasya rūpādi dharmatvābhāvāt pratyuta pramātṛdharmatvāt pramātṛdharmātmakaḥ vikalpamayaḥ parāmarśastaimityāvasthā yāmapyastyeva |
