gaccheduccārayedvā punaśca sākṣātkārakṣaṇe'pi vimarśo'stītyetadeva sādhayati tathā hītyādinā | gacchataścaitrasya gantavye deśe <216> tāvat prathama pādavinyāsayogya pradeśa jñānaṃ tatpradeśācikramiṣātatpradeśākramaṇaṃ tat pradeśasyākrāntatā jñānaṃ tasminneva pradeśe sthitasya halāsya deḥ svīkaraṇātmani prayojanāntarānusandhānaṃ nityakṣā ākrāntadeśatyāge cchāgantavya deśāntarānusandhiḥ | tatra cikrimiṣetyādinā gantavya deśa saṃyojanagatadeśaviyojanānusandhānarūpeṇa parāmarśena vinā gacchataḥ abhimata deśāvāptiḥ kathaṃ bhavet | evaṃ tvaritodgrahaṇavācanādāvapi sākṣātkāre tat sākṣatkārasamanantarabhāvi sthūlaṃ vikalpakalpanā dhāvatāna saṃvedyate | tata eva tasya
dhāvanasya tvaritatvamiti tasmin sākṣātkāre svātmani kroḍīkṛtā bhaviṣyanti | haṭo'yaṃ paro'yamiti śabdabhāvanā śabdavistaraḥ yena tena sūkṣmeṇavimarśena bhāvyam | anena sūkṣmavimarśena krīḍīkṛtā śabdabhāvanā ghaṭaḥ paṭa iti prasāraṇena vivartyamānā vistāryamāṇā (ghaṭaḥ śukla ityādi) sthūlavikalpo bhavati | tadeva darśayati (-) yathā idamiti sūkṣmavimarśasya prasāraṇā ghaṭaḥ śukla ityādi | tatra ghaṭa ityasya vimarśasya prasāraṇā pṛthu budhnodarākāra śukla ityasya vimarśasya prasāraṇā ghaṭaḥ sarvaḥ śukla jāti gata śuklatva guṇa samavāyī ityādi dhāviḥ śabdaśaktivaśāt tvarita gatau vartate | tata eveti jaḍādgacchannityuktam |
bhavatvevamiti | nirvikalpā vasthāyāṃ bhavadukta sūkṣmarūpo vimarśaḥ dhāvanādi pravṛtta tattat pramātrahaṃ rūpa prakāśaḥ śarīrāveśī bhavatu | vikalpā vasthā yāṃ punaḥ yatra nīlādi viṣaye sthūlatvenedaṃ nīlamiti vikalpatā sphuṭā | tatra tadviṣaye <217> (---------------) (-------------------) yatvenedaṃ tayā gṛhyate | idaṃ nīlamiti tadvat tayornīledantayorvācaka bhūto nīlamidamiti śabdo'pi śrotreṇa viṣaya tayā gṛhyate | vimarśaśca śabda jīvita ityādi bhavadukta nīlā tādṛgvidha śabda jīvita (----------------------------------) kāśa svarūpāt kathamapṛthagbhūtaḥ syāt | pṛthagbhūta eva bhavitumarhati | nīlamidamityatra nīlaṃ yathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyate tadvannīlamiti śabdasya śrotreṇa viṣayatā gṛhyamāṇatvāttādṛgvidhaśabdanātmā savimarśaḥ a(----------------------------------) pade'pyahaṃ rūpa prakāśā pṛthagbhūto bhavadbhiriṣṭaḥ | tadetadbhavanmataṃ kathaṃ pratipattavyamityāśaṃkyāha (-) ghaṭo'yamityadhyavasā (------------------------) (---------- ----------------------------------) adhyavasātuḥ parameśvarasthādhyavasāyaśaktiṃ nāma rūpātirekiṇīti ghaṭa iti varṇadvayātmaka (----------------------------------) pṛthubudhnodarā kārātmakaṃ netragrāhyaṃ rūpaṃ cātikramya parameśvaraḥ yathāhaṃ tayaiva bhāvi tadvadi yamapi tacchaktitvāt tadabhinnatvenāhantayaiva bhāti nanvidaṃ tayeti sūtrasaṃgatiḥ | ghaṭa iti śrotragrāhyo viṣayarūpasthūlaḥ śabda (----------------------------------) haṃ rūpa prakāśaṃ jīvita svabhāvo vimarśo bhavati iti kenaitaduktaṃ ghaṭa iti sthūlaḥ śabdo'pi ghaṭavatpṛthagbhūtaḥ idantayaiva bhāti | śrotranetrayorvimarśabhūtau tau nāma rūpalakṣaṇau ghaṭo'yamiti śabdārthau so'yamityanusaṃdhāna dṛṣṭayo
bhāvapyekarūpatayā yugapadevaikyena parāmṛśantī yā adhyavasāyā adhyavasāyaśaktiḥ sā parameśvarasya vimarśarūpāśaktiḥ ātmaviditaparameśvara va devāhamityavicchinnatvena bhāti na tu kadācidapīdamiti vicchedena bhāsate | tasyā <218> adhyavasāya śakteridantayā vicchedenāvayesati pariniṣṭhatvāditi ghaṭādiniṣṭhatvāt tasyāścāyaṃ ghaṭa iti pratīyamānasya ghaṭasyevāyaṃ vimarśa iti pratīyamānāyāṃ ghaṭa iti yadiyamadhyavasāyaśaktiriti svātmānaṃ viṣayīkurvatā vimarśāntareṇa bhāvyam | tasmin vimarśe'pi iyamevamaryādetyanavasthaiva syāt | ata iti | anavasthāta eva viṣayībhūtasyanīlasya prakāśanamevasyāt | ahaṃ rūpa vimarśapratiṣṭhālābhā bhāvāt | tasmāditi | idantayā vicchinnatvenāvaghāsābhāvāt sarva eva nīlapītādivimarśaḥ prakāśādavicchinna eva | yathoktam (-) prakāśamānaṃ na pṛtha prakāśāt ityādi |
eka saṃvidivibhāti bhedadhīḥ nīlapītasukhaduḥkharūpiṇī | nimnanābhiriyamunnatastanī bhāti citraphalake same yathā || iti |
(atra puṭatraya parimito grantha pātaḥ )
<219> nanviti | sarvasyaiva nīlapītādi jñānasya sa eva vimarśaḥ prakāśādavicchinna ityukta nītyā ahamityeva pratiṣṭhā sthāne ahamiti svarūpe viśrāntau idaṃ nīlamidaṃ pītamiti nīlapītādi vedyabhūmisparśo nāsti | atratamidaṃ nīlamiti hi deśakālayogaḥ nīlapītādi vedyabhūmau dṛśyate | nanvahaṃ rūpe ve dakāṃśasya deśakāla yogābhāve tadviśrāntānāṃ jñānānāṃ midamiti idaṃ nīlamevetitannīlamiti tadidaṃ nīlamityanubhūyamānavikalpasmaryamāṇānusaṃdhīyamāna tattadviṣayāpekṣayā ca na kramatvaṃ lakṣyate | tat sarvakramatvamakramāhaṃ rūpaviśrāntānāṃ jñānānāṃ kathaṃ bhavet | kramābhāve paramārthataḥ pūrṇāhantātmakatvameva bhavet | tataśceti | ekarūpatvāt jñanasmṛtyādiśaktibhistadvān śaktimān paramaeśvara iti | yaduktaṃ parameśvara śaktimān jñānasmṛtyādikāḥ stasya śaktayaḥ tāsāṃ śaktīnāṃ viśvaṃ śakya rūpaṃ
viṣaya iti tat kathaṃ virvahetyāśaṅkāṃ śamayan etadāhnikoktaṃ sarvaṃ prameya mupasaṃharati | akrama svarūpaviśrāntau kramābhāva ityetat satyameveti pratipādayitu māha (-) kevalaṃ tasyaiva parameśvarasya svātantryātmanā māyāśaktyā tasmāt parameśvarāt jñānasmṛtyādi śakteścānyonyataśca bhinnāni yāni nīlapītāni saṃvedyāni tat saṃbandhinau | atratyāmidānīntanamiti tat saṃvedya vargaviśeṣaṇabhūtau deśakālau anurudhyākramatve'pi icchāyā mātreṇāvalambya jñānasmṛtyavasāyādiśaktibṛndaṃ prathamamanubhavaśaktistadanantaraṃ vikalpaśaktiḥ tataḥ smṛtiśaktiḥ anantaraṃ smṛtyanubhavao bhayātmakānusandhānaśaktiriti taṃ taṃ kālaṃ taṃ taṃ viṣayaṃ cānurudhya saṃkramaṃ prati (-------------------------) (---------) ta iti sūtra saṅgatiḥ |
<220> satyamiti jñānānāmahamiti pratiṣṭhāne vedya bhūmisparśo nāstītyuktaṃ paramārtham | evamiti | uktaprakāreṇa saṃvittatva kramameva | kiṃ tu kevalemāyāśakti vaśāduktaprakāreṇa | yāni bhinnatvena (----------) (------------------------) ni teṣāṃ pṛthubudhnodarākārādimūrtibhedena kṛtaḥ ghaṭasya paṭo dūravartī kuḍyamadūravarti paṭaḥ vitataeśa vyāpī ghaṭaḥ avitata deśavyāpīti dūrādūravaitatyā vaitatyādirūpo deśoyah tiṣṭhatyādikriyābhedakā (----------------------------------) reṇaiva viśīrṇa iti kriyābhedakṛtaḥ ciraśīghrakramādirūpaḥ kālaśca yaḥ tau tattat saṃvedyaviśeṣaṇabhūtau deśa kālāvanurudhya tattatsaṃvedyāharaṇonmukha tayā cchāyāmātreṇāvalaṃmbyajñāna smṛtyadhyavasāyāḥ sāṃ(----------------------------------) rūpaviśrāntatvāt niraṃśānāmakramaṇāmapi tattadbhāsamāna deśakālātmakāṃśakṛtaḥ samramatvāvabhāsaḥ parasparāpekṣayā tattadviṣayarūpasvāṃśāpekṣayā ca bhavati |
yadyapi vijñāneṣvanubhavādiṣu atītaṃ vartamānānāgata (----------) (------------------------) na deśakramaḥ | tathāpi vimūḍhasya parvatasaṃvedanaṃ tatparvatasya vitatatvādvitatamiva bhāti | badarasaṃvedanaṃ tu tadvadarasya sūkṣmatvāt sūkṣmamiva ca bhātīti deśakramo'pidarśitaḥ | teneti | sa kramābhāsatvena vedyagatadeśakāla (----) (------------------------------) bhāsāt jñānādīnāmapi sakramatvapāramārthikaṃ na bhavati | ābhāsamānasya vastunaḥ paramārthatvāt
kṛtetyasya jñānādayaḥ asya bhagavataḥ śaktaya ityuktaṃ yuktameva |
<221> māyāśaktyāirbhāritiślokena jñānānāmanyonyaṃ svarūpa vaicitryaṃ darśitam | anena ślokena tattajjñānaviṣaya nīlapītādi saṃbandhibhyāṃ deśakālābhyāṃ vaicitryamiti viśeṣaḥ ||
[iti śrīpratyabhijñāsūtravimarśinīvyākhyāyāṃ pañcamamāhnikaṃ samāptam] ||
[atha ṣaṣṭhamāhnikam] ||
evaṃ na cedantaḥ kṛtetyādi sūtrokte smṛtiśakti jñānaśaktī ekaikenāhnikena suspaṣṭaṃ nirūpya tadubhayānugrahakāriṇīmapohanaśaktimekenāhnikena nirūpayituṃ tadāhnika prameyarūpaṃ parameśvaraṃ stutidvāreṇa samāviśati (-) svātmabhedaghanānityādinā | svātmābhedaghanān cidānandaghanasvātmābhedarūpān śivādikṣityantān bhāvān | tadabhedana ṭaṃkataḥ tadabhedaghanatva cchedātmanā māyārūpayā svecchayā svātantrya śaktyā parameśvarāt pramātṛvargebhyaścānyonyato vicchinnaṃ ayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa na caitra iti parimitān kurvan citrarūpakṛdayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ paṭaḥ idaṃ ghaṭa jñānaṃ idaṃ paṭa jñānaṃ ayaṃ caitraḥ ayaṃmaitraḥ ityanyonyabhinnaprameyapramāṇapramātrātmaka nānātvarūpakṛt avirataṃ tatparoyaḥ taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ ||
atheti | smṛtyanubhavaśaktinirūpaṇānantaraṃ tadubhayā nu grāhiṇī apohanaśaktirahaṃ pratyavamarśa ityādi ślokaikādaśakena nirṇīyate tasyā apohanaśakte rubhayānu grāhiṇītvaṃ nāmānubhavasmṛtiśaktyorviṣayabhūtasya ghaṭapaṭāderviśvamayyā saṃvidātādātmyāt tattatsaṃvidviśvamayatve'pi tatsaṃvinmayatvaṃ vyapohya tattaddeśakālaviśiṣṭaikaikaṃ <222> ghaṭādimātratāpādanaṃ tatreti | tasminnāhnike prathamenāhaṃ pratyavamarśa iti ślokenānuttarabhaṭṭārakātmaprakāśa prāṇabhūte ahamiti pratyavamarśe vakṣyamāṇarūpo vikalpaḥ viśeṣaḥ(,) tadaṃśaḥ taekadeśaḥ vatu svayaṃ śuddhaḥ pratyavamarśe svavyatiriktāpohyābhāvāt tatsaṃbandhyapohana vyāpārāsaṃbhava iti tṛtīyena maheśvarātmaka svātmāstitvavādini svadarśane tadapohanopapattiḥ iti tato dvayena dehādiṣuvartamānasya
śuddhasyāhaṃ pratyavamarśasyāhaṃ caitra eva namaitraḥ aghaṃ ghaṭaḥ itīyaṃ svarūpasthāpanānyarūpāpohanātmaka vikalpa rūpateti | tata ekena yo'haṃ sthūlo'bhavaṃ sohamidānīṃ kṛśaḥ yo'haṃ pūrvaṃ prabalaḥ so'hamidānīṃ durbalaḥ yo'haṃ pūrvaṃ sukhī so'hamidānīṃ duḥkhī | yaḥ pūrvamalpanidraḥ so'hamidānīṃ dīrghanidraḥ | evaṃ yo'haṃ bālaḥ so'haṃ yuvā sa evāhaṃ vṛddhaḥ | bālya kāle yo me ghaṭo'bhūt sa evāhaṃ ghaṭa iti dehādi pramātṛ ghaṭādi prameyagatasyānusandhānasyāpyuktānyāpohanātmakalpaketi | tata ekenaikadehādi pramātṛgata vikalpānusandhānādirūpamevaparameśvarasya sraṣṭṛtvamucyate | parameśvarasya sraṣṭṛtvaṃ nāma tattadvikalpayitṛ anusandhātṛ rūpacaitramaitrādi pramātṛvargasya tattadvikalpānusaṃdhāna viṣaya ghaṭapaṭādi prameya vargasya ca saṃyojana viyojanādirūpaprakāśamiti tata ekenaṃ cidātmaiva hi devo'ntaḥ ityādiślokena prakṛte cidātmani parameśvare śivādikṣityaṃ tasya viśvasya sattā sadbhāvaḥ tasminnevāstitvaṃ pūrvastutamupasaṃhriyate nigamanena <123> niścīyata iti | tata ekena cidātmani vartamāna (----------------------------------) mātrapekṣayā bahiḥ prakāśamānasyārthāva māsasyānubhavasmaraṇādau ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ sa ghaṭaḥ ghaṭobhaviṣyatīti sphuṭasphuṭāsphutasphuṭarūpaṃ vaicitryamucyata iti | tata ekena pūrvānubhavānapekṣiṇī manorājyādi svatantra vikalpeso'rthaḥ naisargikaḥ sahajaḥ smaraṇaviṣayārthā vabhāsavat pūrvānubhūto na bhavatīti | tata ekena sphuṭāsphuṭa vaicitrya prasaṃgā gata svatantyra vikalpa nirmāṇoktiḥ tatpratyabhijñāmupapādayāmaḥ | (----------------------------------) yāmīśvarasvātmapratyabhijñāyāmupayujyata iti sarvasya jīvita iti śeṣaḥ ityāhnikasya tātparyam ||
atha krameṇa vyākhyātuṃ prathamaślokasya śaṅkāmavatārayati svabhāvamavabhāsasyeti | sūtravimarśaḥ avabhāsasya svabhāvabhūta ityuktaṃ savimarśaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa ityabhilāpātmanā śabdena yojita eva | tacchabdayojanākṛtaṃ vikalparūpatvaṃ śuddhe avikalparūpe paramaśive'pi prāptaṃ śabdanātmāvimarśastasya svabhāvabhūta ityuktatvāt tatparamaśive etadvikalpa rūpatvaṃ neṣṭam | anyonyāpohanātmaka
mayātmani saṃsārapade tasya vikalparūpasyopapatterityāśaṃkya paramaśivaprāṇabhūtaḥ ahaṃ pratyavamarśo vikalparūpo bhavatītyāha (-) prakāśasyānuttarabhaṭṭāraka bodhasyādimāntagṛhīta varṇarāśyātmikā hamiti yā svataḥ pratha ityukta nītyā vagvapurapi vikalpo na bhavati | sa vikalpaḥ dnayākṣepīti ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ eva na paṭa iti vyavasthā panīyāpohanīyātmaka bhāva dvayākṣepī viniścayobhavati yataḥ tataḥ ahamiti pratyayavimarśaḥ evaṃ bhūtavikalpātmako na bhavatītyarthaḥ | iti saṅgatiḥ |
<224> atha vyākhyā prakāśasya māyādikalaṅkarahitatvādviśuddha saṃvidrūpasya ata eva sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamityādirūpadehādi saṃsparśairakaluṣitasyānuttarabhaṭṭārakātman bodhasyātmā jīvitabhūtaḥ vahnerdāhikāśaktivatsārasvabhāvaṃ vyāptatvānnityatvāt pūrṇatvācca deśakālākārākṣaka vicchedaśūnyā antaḥ śironirdeśavadomityabhyupagamakalpaḥ svāntaḥ śivādikṣityanta viśvakroḍīkārāt | ata eva bahiḥ svavyatiriktābhāvādanyamukhaprekṣitvarūpasvātantryātmaka viśrāntirūpo'hamiti pratyavamarśoyaḥ asau vikalpo na bhavati | ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ityādi śabda jīvitasya vicchinnavimarśasyevāhaṃ pratyavamarśasyāpi vikalpatvāśaṃkāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ darśayati (-) vāgvapurityanena viśeṣaṇena bhavatā yā vikalpatvāśaṃkāhetu bhūtā vātrivicāryate | eṣā parāvāk tādṛśīna bhavatītyāha (-) atra vāgityanena | netragrāhya ghaṭādi viṣayavat śrotragrāhyāt ata eva viṣaya rūpāt ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ paṭa ityādi śabdādanya eva | antariti pūrṇāhantātmatayāvabhāsamāna saṃvidrūpāveśī śabdanātmā ahamevākhilamityantaḥ parāmarśanātmābhilāpa uktaḥ | kiñcayaḥ prapaṃcaḥ māyā pramāturbahīrūpeṇa bhāti bhāsate taṃ | śivādi kṣityantaṃ svasmin viśramayyaso'yamiti anusandhānātmikāhaṃtārūpatvena vaktivimṛśatiti vāk ahaṃ pratyavamarśaḥ vāgvapuriti bhavatāṅgīkṛtaścet kasmānnavikalpaḥ(,) āha (-) asya pratyavamarśasya vikalpa lakṣaṇaṃ nāsti | vikalpa svarūpameva nirūpayati (-) dūrasthitaṃ yat kiñcidvastu dṛṣṭvā tadvarṇau jvalyā dayaṃ vahnirvā guñjāphalaṃ veti vividhā kalpanā
vikalpa eva vividhatvena śaṅkitasya vahnyātmano vastunaḥ ayaṃ vahnirevāthana guñjāphalamiti | kḷpūcchedana iti dhātugatyānyasya guñjāphalarūpasya cchedanaṃ <125> vikalpaḥ(,) vikalpe taditi vahnirūpatvaṃ niścitavyam | acceti | avahnirūpaguṃjāphalaṃ vyapohitaṃ ca bhavati | ayaṃ vahnireva na guñjāphalamityahaṃ pratyavamarśaḥ svavyatiriktāpohanīyābhāvādvikalpo na bhavati | saḥ vikalpaḥ dvayākṣepīviniścaya iti yaduktaṃ tadevānuvadati (-) tathā cetyanena | anyonya bhinnayorghaṭapaṭayoriva dvayoravabhāsaḥ syāt saṃbhavati śivādikṣityanta viśvapūrṇasyāhaṃ prakāśasya punariveti tattulyayoginaḥ pratiyogino'nyasyāprakāśasya | vabhāsanamevasyāt | saṃ (----------------------------------) yataḥ pratiyoginaḥ saṃbhavo'sticet so'pi prakāśātmaka eva hīti yataḥ tasmādahaṃ pratyavamarśasya vikalpa rūpatvaṃ nāsti | iti sūtra saṅgatiḥ ||
ghaṭe hi dūravartini dṛṣṭe svāsikāyogyabhimata tad ghaṭasa(-----------) (-----------------------) kramaṇaśīlaḥ saṃvartitaḥ ghaṭaḥ adṛśyamāno'pi tasya ghaṭasya dūravartitvena sphuṭāvamarśanā bhāvāt ghaṭo vā paṭoveti saṃśayādhiyā pūrvānubhūta paṭānubhava saṃskārātmaka vijñānopanītaḥ saṃbhāvyate |(----------------------------------) bhāvyamānatvāt tasmin saḥ paṭāropaḥ sāvakāśī bhavati | paścāttasmin ghaṭe sphuṭatayā dṛṣṭe sati ayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa iti paṭasyā satyarūpāropaniṣedha lakṣaṇaḥ apohana vyāpāra iti tadapohana vyāpārānuprāṇita (----------------------------------) sya niścayasya | atra liṅsaṃbhāvanāyām |
evaṃ rūpāvikalpatā prakāśasya nāstītyāha (-) yastvayaṃ para śivāhaṃ rūpaḥ prakāśo nāma ghaṭasthāne paṭa eva tasya sthāne tadahantā prakāśātmāyaḥ yaṃ bhāvyate saḥ prakāśamāna (---------------) satvānnasaṃbhavati | tulya kakṣyavastunaḥ sa eva saṃbhāvanaṃ paṭasya prakāśamānatvena prakāśamānaghaṭatulya kakṣyatvāt <226> ghaṭa sthāne saṃbhāvanaṃ bhavatu | aprakāśasya tvasatvenaiva prakāśatulya kakṣyatvābhāvāt prakāśa sthāne saṃbhāvanaiva na bhavati |
evaṃ svarūpa tastulya kakṣyatvaṃ nāstītyuktvā arthakriyāto'pi tulyakakṣayatvānnāstītyāha (-) prakāśena yadviśva prakāśanādi karaṇīyaṃ
tadaprakāśasya kadācidapi na dṛṣṭam | yaḥ svayamaprakāśaḥ saḥ kimanyat prakāśayituṃ samarthaḥ | tasyā prakāśasya prakāśasthāne saṃbhāvanāropaṇādāvaṅgīkriyamāṇe tvaprakāśatvamapi ghaṭeta so'pi prakāśaika rūpa eva bhavati |
etadeva nigamayati (-) ata ityādinā | antaḥ svarūpeṇārthiyātattulya kakṣyatvā bhāvāt prakāśasyeva prakāśa tulyasyānyasyeveti svayamaprakāśa svarūpasya bhedina iti svayamapi prakāśa kriyamāṇārtha kriyā kāritvāttulyakakṣyasya | kiñca bhedina iti | uktarūpā pohanātmaka bhedana vyāpāra sahiṣṇoḥ kasyacidavabhāsanameva nāsti | tadabhāve tādṛśasya vastunaḥ asatyekasyāpohanam | avabhāsaṃbhave nāsti | tadabhāve tādṛśasya vastunaḥ asatyeka syāpohanam | avabhāsa saṃbhave tasyā prakāśasyāpi prakāśarūpatvamevā evaṃ prakāśasyeva nānyasyetyarthasyānyamapyarthaṃ darśayati (-)prakāśasyeveti prakāśatulyasyānyasya prakāśādvitīyasya prakāśasya bhedinaḥ prathamaprakāśatulyakakṣyasyāvabhāsanamapi nāstītyāha (-) mahāprakāśasya viśvapūrṇatvādviśvavyāpakatvādviśvatoditatvācca svarūpato deśataḥ kālātaścaivamākāraḥ etaddeśasyaḥ etatkālavartītyādibhedo nāsti | yena bhedena dvitīyaḥ prakāśaḥ etasmāt prathamaprakāśādapohye tarhīti | uktādevahetoḥ | dvayābhāvāditi dvitīya vastuno 'bhāvāt apohyavastu saṃbhave vikalpa rūpatvābhāvāt cinmātre cidekarūpe paramātmaniparamaśive svātmani ahamityetatpūrṇa pratyavamarśa eva nanu vikalpaḥ |
<127> nanviti | ghaṭe dṛṣṭe tatsthāna eva svavijñānajanakasaṃskārātmakakāraṇopanītaḥ paṭādi svabhāvo'pi saṃbhāvyate | tata eva saniṣedhyata iti yaduktaṃ tatkathaṃ pariniṣṭhitarūpe'nyapaṭādivivikte ghaṭamātra rūpe sati kathaṃ syāt | kiñcaitad ghaṭadarśanamupajīvatā ghaṭa eveti vikalpenādṛśyamānasya paṭasya niṣedhaḥ kartumaśakyameva na ghaṭadarśana samaye aghaṭarūpasya paṭasyarūpaṃ cakṣurviṣayaṃ tāvaddūretiṣṭhatu tadānīṃ kenacit śrotraviṣayaṃ tannāmāpina gṛhītaṃ ghaṭe hi dṛṣṭe paṭānubhavasya saṃskāro'pi kathaṃ kāraṃ prabudhyatām | vimatametat | satyaṃ(,) jñānasantānameva tattvamiti saugatāḥ ityukta nītyā nairātmya vādī śākya evaṃ paryanuyojyaḥ natu nayam |
asmatpakṣe tadatatpratibhā bhājāmapaṭa pratibhāmaghaṭa pratibhāṃ ca bhajatāmatraiva taditya ghaṭa vyapohanāttanniścayamiti ghaṭaniścayanameva ghaṭa ityayaṃ vikalpa ityukta iti yataḥ ataḥ śakyā eva paryanuyojyaḥ nata vayam |

tasminneva ghaṭe nāyaṃ ghaṭo rajata iti rajatasaṃvidviśleṣaṇa (---------------------------------) ubhayorapi dṛśyamānatvāt tasmin ghaṭe rajatasya viyojanaṃ saṃhāraḥ tasya dṛśyamānatvāt | <228> ādiśabdāt ghaṭakāñcanayoḥ sthitiḥ kiñcasaṃyojanamekāsmin ghaṭe so'yamityanubhavasmaraṇayoraikyarūpa (---------------------------------) miti puraḥ sthite vastuni vartamānāya nirvikalpakarāṃvidamayaṃ vikalpānusaṃdhānasaṃvidbhoviśleṣaṇam | anusandhāna saṃvido'pyamiti anubhavasaṃvidaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa eveti vikalpa saṃvidaḥ sa iti smaraṇa saṃvidaśca viśleṣaṇam | evaṃ bhūta saṃyojanaviyojanādyā(----------------) (-----------------) t kartā darśitaḥ | na cedantaḥ kṛtetyādau tasya pramāturantarvaḥ śivādikṣityanto'rthāvabhāsaścinmātraśarīraḥ ahamityaikyena pratibhāsamānatvāttatsāmānādhikaraṇya vṛttirapi darpaṇagatanagaranyāyeneti | tathādarpaṇāntargataṃ nagaraṃ darpaṇo'yaṃ nagara midamiti bhedena bhāti darpaṇāntargatvācca darpaṇādabhedena ca bhāti | tadvacca pratibhātītyuktaṃ grāhyagrāhakatā bhinnāvityatra | evamiti | darpaṇagatanyāyena pramāturantarviśvasyāstitvāt | pratibhāṃ ghaṭa pratibhām | atadityaghaṭapratibhāṃ ca pramāta | bhājate sevata eva | samudrāntargatānadī pūrvameva yathā samudrāntargata sarvanadīmayī samudrībhavati tadvadavikalpadaśāyāṃ ghaṭaḥ tatpramātrātmaka citsvabhāvaḥ san cidvadeva taccidantargata viśvaśarīra pūrṇaḥ | teneti | viśvamayena ghaṭenodakāharaṇādi vyavahāro na kriyate | tattaditi | udāharaṇādi vyavahārābhāvādbhedaprathāhetuṃ māyā vyāpāra ullāsa yadviśva pūrṇamapitaṃ ghaṭātmakaṃ bhāvaṃ khaṇḍayati anyapramātṛpaṭādivyapohanena parimitī karoti | tena khaṇḍanena taṃ ghaṭaṃ pratyātmanaḥ pramātuḥ paṭādeścāyaṃ ghaṭa
<229> eva na pramātā na paṭādiriti tattatpramātṛ paṭādyapohananarūpaṃ niṣedhanaṃ kriyate | tadapohanaprāṇo hi ghaṭa eva na paṭa iti niścayaḥ | evārthasya saṃbhāvyamānā paravastu niṣadharūpatvāt | eva iti niścayātmā vikalpa eva tatkṣaṇaṃ vikalpāt parīta iti pramātṛvargādanyaprameyavargācca viśleṣarūpādvicchadanāt pariccheda ityucyate | dvitīyataḥ evaṃ tasmāt dvayākṣepī viniścaya ityuktaṃ yuktameva | ahaṃ pratyavamarśo na vikalpaḥ | vikalpa vastu dvayākṣepī viniścaya iti prathamaślokokte vastu dvaye anantaraślokadvayena hetū krameṇoktau tatra | prakāśasyaiva nānyasya bhedinastvavabhāsanam | ityardhaṃ(,)
ahaṃ pratyavamarśoyaḥ prakāśātmāpivāgvapuḥ | nāsau vikalpa ityāsmin vastunihetutvenoktam | bhinnayoravabhāsohi(,) tadatatpratibhābhājaḥ(,) iti sārdhaślokaḥ |
sa hyukto dvayākṣepī viniścaya ityukte vastuni hetutvenoktaḥ(,) ityasmin ślokatraye'haṃ pratyavamarśātmaka mahāvākyārtho darśitaḥ nairātmya vādibhiḥ | eka pratyavamarśākhye tāna jñāna ekatra | sthitaḥ pravaktā taddhetūn bhāvān visṛjati svayam | ityasmin śloke pravakteti svayamiti ca vadadbhiḥ śākyairapyayaṃ vikalpaḥ pramātṛ vyāpārabhāvoktaḥ satu pramātā etaiḥ pramātṛśūnyakevala vijñāna vādibhiḥ kathaṃ samarthyate ityāstāṃtāvadetat |
nanviti | yathā ghaṭa iti vimarśe tatpratiyoginoghaṭarūpasya niṣedhena vikalpatā jātā evamahamityapi pratyavamarśe tatpratiyogino'nahaṃrūpasyāpohanīyasya ghaṭāderapohe vikalparūatā kathaṃ na syādityāśaṅya śuddhe'haṃ pratyavamarśe apohanīyā bhāvāt <230> yā na bhavati śuddhe eva sā bhavatītyāha (-) cittatvamiti | pūrṇāhantā tmakaṃ cittatvaṃ bhedaprathārūpayā māyayā hittvā antarvicitra (---------------------) tamapya parāmarśena pradhānī kṛtyānya smāddehāderghaṭādeścabhinne dehe buddhau prāṇenabhasīvakalpite śūnye ahaṃ sthūla eva na kṛśaḥ na ghaṭaḥ(,) ahaṃ sukhyena na duḥkhī(----) (--------) durbalaḥ naghaṭaḥ ahaṃ sarvarūparahitaḥ evaṃ na dehādirnaghaṭādaya ityanya dehādi ghaṭādi vyapohanāt pramātṛtvenātmatvena yo vimarśaḥ sa vikalpa eva | kasmāt parasyā nyasya dehāderghaṭāde (---------------------------------) nyonyaparihārāt
viruddhasya ca samāropaṇa lakṣaṇo'vabhāso yastadavabhāsaniṣedhena tasyāhaṃ vimarśasya jātatvāt iti sūtrasaṅgatiḥ | athavyākhyā | ahamityavamarśaḥ (śivādi kṣityanta) śuddhaśca māyīyaśceti dvidhā(,) tayoḥ (---------------------------------) ddhaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ śivādikṣityanta viśvābhinna iti | antaḥ antaḥ kroḍī kṛta śivādikṣityanta viśvesaṃvinmātre bodhe rūpe śivabhaṭṭārikātmani bhavati |
athavā (-) kṣityādi śuddhavidyānta viśvacchāyācchurite svacchātmani śrīsadāśivabhaṭṭārakarūpe saṃvinmātre bhavati | aśuddhastvahaṃ rūpaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ idamiti vedyarūpe śarīrābhāve bhavati | tara śuddho'haṃ pratyavamarśe'pohanīya vyatiriktaḥ prayogī na saṃbhavati | ghaṭāderapi prakāśa sāratvena pratiyogitvābhāvādapohyābhāve vikalpa rūpatvaṃ na bhavati | aśuddhastvahaṃ pratyavamarśo vedyarūpe śarīrādau bhavan tat evānyadeha ghaṭādivyavacchedena ca bhavan vikalpa eveti śloka dvayasya vākyārthaḥ | padārthastu vyākriyate | pūrṇāhaṃ prakāśamātra rūāścittatvaṃ hitvā <231> antardehādi ghaṭādi bhittibhūtatvena sadapyapradhānī kṛyāparāmṛśya devādirūpo'hameva madvyatiriktenīlādau prameye pramātetyabhimānenāhaṃ sthūla ityādi vimarśo'yaṃ savikalpa eva na tu śuddham | avikalpam | ata eva pūrṇaṃ pratyavamarśamātram | atreti | tasya vimarśasya vikalpatve hetu māha (-) tasya devadatto'hamiti | vimarśasya parasvavyatiriktaścaitra maitrādirūpo dehādirghaṭādiścayaḥ pratiyogī prakāśamānatvātulya kakṣyaḥ | kiñca(,) anyonya parihāreṇa viruddhaśca tasyaivaṃ bhūtasya pratiyoginoyaḥ smāropaṇalakṣaṇo'vabhāsastatsamāropaṇa lakṣaṇavibhāsa viṣedhānuprāṇitaḥ ahamityavamarśo jātaḥ ahaṃ sthūla eva na kṛśo na ghaṭādiriti śuddhāhaṃ pratyavamarśasyāpradhānīkaraṇameva dehāderghaṭādeścānyonyaṃ bheda hetuḥ tasya śuddho'haṃ pratyavamarśasyāvahastena tu parameśvarasya viśvamaya viśvottīrṇasvātmapracchādano rūpābhedāprakāśanātmakaṃ pratibhrāntirūpaṃ pratisvātantryarūpā māyāśaktiḥhetuḥ | kiñca atyaktavedyabhāvasyānyonyabhinno dehādāvupapatti śūnyatayāhamiti pramātṛtvabhimāno yaḥ vimarśa stadeva cidrūpasyāpahastanam |
atha dehādau vartamānamahaṃ vimarśaṃ pratyekaṃ pṛthak pṛthageva nirūpayitumāha (-) deha evātmeti | dehābhimāna bhūmikāyāṃ sthitāścārvākāḥ caitanyaviśiṣṭaḥ kāyaḥ puruṣa iti kāyamātmatvenāhuḥ | strībālamūrkhāṇāṃ kāya evātmetyabhimānāt | tato'pīti | cārvākebhyo'pi vivekavantaḥ(,) pākajo nāma śuklaśoṇitātmakodhātuḥ tasmādutpattiḥ tataḥ pariṇāmaḥ tato jarā tatomaraṇam | ityādimatvāt śarīraṃ manvānāḥ <232> prāṇaśaktyutkrāntau śarīrasya kīṭāviṣṭatva durgandhatvādi vikāraśataṃ paśyataḥ bubhukṣāpi pāsā saṃbandhayogyaṃ prāṇamevātmānaṃ kvacicchrutyanta vidomanyante | tata iti | śrutyanta vidbhyo'pi adhika viveka bhājaḥ prāṇasyāpi kṣaṇikatvenānityāt tasya prāṇasya so'haṃ so'haṃ so'yamityanu sandhāna yogyatāmapaśyantaḥ jñānasukhaduḥkhecchādveṣa prayatnadharmādharma saṃskārātmakanavaguṇāśrayabhūtāṃ buddhimevakāṇāda prabhṛtayaḥ ātma (---------------------------------) māhuḥ |
apare śūnyabrahmavādi sāṃkhya prabhṛtayaḥ tasyāśca buddheryonidaśāyāmiyamiti vedyābhāvāt | aparatvamaśroṣṭhatvaṃ manyamānāḥ asaṃvedyapūrvarūpaṃ dehādighaṭādi vedyarāśi vinirmuktam | ata eva śūnyatvānnabhaḥ sthalaṃ a(---------------------------------) bhūtaṃ mahābhūtākāśasvabhāvaṃ yanna kiñcidrūpaṃ śūnyaṃ tadeva pramātṛtatvamāhuḥ | tasmin śūnye idamiti vedyesati avedyarūpaṃ śūjyāntaraṃ kalpanīyam | tasmiñchūnyāntare vedye avedyaṃ śūnyāntaraṃ kalpanīya (---------------------------------) do bhavati | tāvadvedyarūpaṃ śūnyaṃ kalpanīyamityarthaḥ | evaṃ śūnyakalpanāyāmanavasthā ca na bhavati | paramārtha prakāśabaleneti ghaṭadeha pra (---------------------------------) pratyavamarśātmaka prakāśabalena prakāśo yataḥ na tu dehādi vaśāt sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamityādyabhimānamātrarūpo dehādiḥ pramātā śūnyaṃ nāma svoparivartinaḥ pūrṇāhaṃ prakāśātmanaścitatattvasya ca svādho (---------) (------) kācaḥ ghaṭaviviktaṃ bhūtalaṃ yathā ghaṭābhāvaḥ tatsaṅkocopari vedyāṃśacchuritaṃ cittatvameva buddhiprāṇadehādi jāyate | amīdehādibhūmikā viśeṣā uttarottaramiti dehamatikramya prāṇe prāṇamati kramya <233> pu (-----------) matikramya śūnye śūnyamatikramya cittatve cārohatāṃ yogināṃ jāgratsvapna suṣuptaturya tayā piṇḍapadarūpa rūpātītayā cāgameṣu
bhaṇyante | uktamapahastanamāgamādhikāre vyākhyāsyate | kalodbalitametaccetyanena | smādevā śuddho'hamityavamarśo vikalpa eveti sthitaḥ |
dvividha iti | ahaṃ pratyavamarśaḥ prakāśātmā ityuktaḥ prakāśa prāṇabhūto'haṃ pratyavamarśaḥ dehabuddhāvityādi ślokadvayokto devādyahaṃ pratyavamarśaśca pratyekamanubhavarūpeṇānusandhānātmanā ca dvidhā | tatra prathamaḥ pratyavamarśaḥ śivātmani śiva svarūpe ahamityanubhavātmā sadāśivesvarātmanisvarūpe ahamidamidamahamityanusandhānātmā iti tasya dvaividhyam | dvitīyastu dehādau ahaṃ sthūla ityanubhavātmā yohaṃ sthūlo'bhūvaṃ so'hamidānīṃ kṛśaḥ | yo'haṃ bālo'bhūvaṃ so'haṃ yuvā sa evāhaṃ sthavirobhaviṣyāmīti sthaulyakārśyādidaśā svanusaṃdhānātmā iti tasyāpi dvaividhyam | tatroktarūpānusandhānātmatayobhayātmaniśuddhe'haṃ pratyavamarśe vikalpa rūpatvamapratiṣṭhitamevetyuktaṃ ahaṃ pratyavamarśa ityatra sūtre | anubhavarūpe'śuddhe ahaṃ pratyavamarśe vikalpatvamupapāditaṃ dehe buddhāvityatrā śuddhetvanusandhānātmakāhaṃ pratyavamarśeyo'haṃ bālo'bhūvaṃ sa eva sthavirovartate ityetāvantaṃ kālamabhedasya prasphuraṇattasya kaścidavikalpatvaṃ śaṅkate tasya vyāmohaṃ vyapohitum | anusandhānātmā aśuddhāhaṃ pratyavamarśo'pi vikalpa eveti pratipādayati kādācitkāvabhāso | atratyamidānīntanamevaṃ rūpamiti yataḥ deśakālākārābhāse pūrvokte dehādau saṃskārāttattadbālyādyavasthānubhava kṛta <234> saṃskāra prayāja smṛtivaśāt yo'haṃ bālo'bhūvaṃ so'haṃ yuvā yo'haṃ yuvā ādigrahaṇāt sa eva sthavirobhavitāsmīti pūrva pūrvābhāsa uttarottarābhāse anusandhānātmikā sahayā yojanā sā vikalpanā | vikalpa eva kathamiti cet tatrāpi yojanāyāṃ tasya dehādeḥ yo'haṃ bālo'bhūvaṃ so'haṃ yuvā na caitraḥ na ghaṭa iti anyā bhāsanātmaka bhinnāvabhāsitvāt | iti sūtra saṅgatiḥ |
atha vyākhyā (-) kādācitka iti | yasyaṃ dehāderavabhāsaḥ kādācitkaḥ niyata deśa kālākāraḥ tasmin dehādau pūrvābhāsādiyojaneti pūrvarūpabālābhāsenottareṇa yuvā | ādigrahaṇāt tasya hyuttareṇa bhāvinā sthavirābhāsena
ca saha yojanā | sā sarvākalpanā vikalpa eva | sā vikalpātmikā yojanā śuddho'haṃ pratyavamarśo na bhavati | atra bhinnāvabhāsinītyetaddehāderviśeṣaṇaṃ tasya vikalpatāyāṃ hetutvāśayena sa dehādiḥ anyonya bhinnāvabhāsa iti yataḥ tadānīmapīti tasyāṃ vikalpa rūpāyāṃ manusandhāna daśāyāṃ matyavicchinnaṃ ka (---------------)tasya dehāderviśvataḥ pūrṇatvam | ata evāvacchedahīnatvaṃ paśyannahamidaṃ sarvamityanu sandhānaṃ vidadhyāt | tadiyamevānusaṃdhānātmā sā daśā sadāśivabhuḥ pūrṇatve nāpohyatvā bhāvāt kena vikalpā spadatvena bhaṇyeta yāvateti (------------) tyarthaḥ | dehādiṣvanusandhiravacchinna evānyonya bhinnedehādau kathamanusandhirityāśaṃkyāha (-) saṃskārāditi | prāktana bālāvasthānubhava kṛta vāsanā prabodha jāta smaraṇa balādeva so'haṃ (------------) ṇe yo'haṃ prabalo'bhūvaṃ so'haṃ durbala iti balābalavaśādanusandhiḥ | buddhau yo'haṃ pūrvamalpabodhaḥ sa evāhamidānīṃ saṃpūrṇabodhaḥ(,) śūnye yo'haṃ pūrvamalpanidraḥ sa evā <235> hamidānīmalpa (---------------------------------) ṇādyanu sandhirapi vikalpa eva | yo ghaṭaḥ pūrvaṃ bālyādavasthāyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa evedānīṃ sthavi rāva sthāyāṃ api dṛśyata iti ghaṭā dyanusandhāne'pi vikalpatvaṃ mantavyam | na kevalaṃ dehādyanusandhānabhūmiṣu so'hamityabhedaprathāyāḥ sphuraṇādabhedātmikā vidyāśaktiracitadyuti va dudīcyata iti tāsāmanusandhāna bhuvāṃ pūrṇa svarūpapariśīlanādi kalpanāyāṃ guravaḥ upāyatvamabhyupagaman | dehadīnamiti | paramārtha prakāśabalena sarvasya yataḥ prakāśaḥ natu dehādi vaśāt ityuktanītyā dehādīnāmapi prakāśyatvena jaḍatvāt pūrva pūrva pramātṛ vedyatāna bhavati | yena vedyatvena pramāturaprakāśe deharūpe pramātari adṛśyamāne ghaṭādi prameyaṃ nā bhāti | na deha pramātāpi tatpūrva prāṇapramātaryadṛśyamāne nā bhāti so'pi tatpūrvarūpa buddhipramātarya dṛśyamāne nā bhāti | so'pi tatpūrvarūpa pramātṛ prakāśe nā bhāti so'pi kalpanīya tatpūrvarūpa śūnyāntararūpa pramātra bhāvenā bhāti | anavasthā yā na kiñcidapi prakāśeta | tasmāddehāderghaṭādeśca tattatpūrvapūrva pramātṛvedyatā nāstītyarthaḥ | api tu pūrṇāhaṃ bhāvātmā prakāśa eva ghaṭādi dehādi rūpasya viśvasya prakāśa iti nirūpayan tena tena
pramātraikyaṃ sṛjyate(,) anyena pramātraikyaṃ saṃhriyate ghaṭādimātresthitiḥ kriyate | pūrṇā svarūpa nimīlanāttirobhāva ādhīyate | tāvatyā bhāsena pūrṇatva vitaraṇāt | ata eva pratikṣaṇaṃ pramātṛsaṃyojana viyojana vaicitryeṇa parameśvaro viśvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārādi na prapañcayatītyukta yuktyā sadaiva sṛṣṭayādiśaktyaviyogo'pi bhagavata ukto bhavatīti darśayati |
prabhureva parameśvara eva | vyavahāre māyāpade heyatvenābhimate <236> dehādimayyāviśan cidātmaiva hītyukta nītyā antaḥsaṃvinmaye svarūpe bhāstamata evāhamityevaṃ rūpaṃ dehādiṃ ghaṭādiṃ cārthau māyāśaktirūpa yecchayā bahiridamiti bhāsayet | ataḥ dehe buddhādvityādyukta mupapannam | anyathoktarūpānavasthaiva syāt | api śabda eva śabdaśca bhinnakramau | hetau liṅ ityekonvayaḥ |
anyamapyāha (-) dehe buddhāvityādi yaduktaṃ taditi | tasmāddhetoḥ | evaṃ krayavikraya prekṣāvyākhyānādi vyavahāre'pi pūrvameva svasṛṣṭaṃ caitramaitrādi dehādiṃ tattatkrayyavikraya prekṣyāvyākhye yādyarthe tattatkretṛvikretrāderabhyupagamarūpeṇaikyenāviśan bhāntaṃ tamevāntaḥ anujjhitāntaḥ prakāśamevārthaughaṃ bahiricchayā bhāsayet | atyaparo'rthaḥ | anena bhāsanena vyavahāre'pibhagavataḥ pañca kṛtyakāritvamuktam | iti sūtra saṅgatiḥ ||
atha vyākhyā | samanantarameva dehe buddhāvityādinā dehaṃ buddhiprāṇaśūnyatva pramātṛtvaṃ tadghaṭādeḥ prameyatvaṃ taddarśitaṃ yattadevamiti vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇopapadyate kathamidamiti prathamāne māyāpade viśvottīrṇaḥ pūrṇāhaṃ prakāśaparamārthaḥ parameśvara eva sthūla kṛśādirūpatayā heyatvenābhimataṃ dehādimapi bheda prathā hetu bhūtamāyāśaktirūpayecchayā āviśan pūrṇamapi nijaṃ svarūpaṃ sthūlo'haṃ prabalo'hamityādirupadehaprāṇādiprādhānyena pradarśayan cidātmaiva hītyuktanītyā svāntaḥ saṃvinmātre pūrṇāhantātmani svarūpe bhāntaḥ svāminaścātmasaṃsthasyetyukta nītyā avirataṃ tatraiva bhāsamānam | ata evāhamityevaṃ rūpamarthaughaṃ(,) ukta rūpayā svāviṣṭa tattaccaitramaitrādi pramāturbahiridamiti bhāsayatīti yata etadupapadyate
tatpra (--------------) ka evopapadyate | tathā cedanavasthaiva bhavatītyeko'rthaḥ |
anyamapyarthamāha (-) dehe buddhāvityādi yaduktaṃ taditi | tasmāddhetoḥ vakṣyamāṇarūpaṃ prameyamevaṃ jātam | kiṃ taditi cet uktarūpaḥ prabhuḥ samartho (-----------------------) rānu bhūyata iti vakṣyamāṇa nītyā samalavimalātmaka krayavikrayaprekṣā vyākhyānādirūpe parasparaṃ vyavahāra samaye pūrvameva sva sṛṣṭān caitramaitrādisaṃbaṃdhino dehādīn tāvatīti svasṛṣṭe krayya (-----------------) (------) nyonyamabhyupagamarūpeṇaikye nāviśan antaḥ sthita vatāmeva ghaṭate bahirātmanā | ityuktanītyāntarbhāvameva santatamevārthaughaṃ kretṛtattadvikretrāderidamiti bahiranyonyābhyupagamarūpaikābhāsa yo (----) (-------------------) tītyetat jāta miti phalitamarthamāha (-) tatra tatra krayavikrayādyarthe tena tena pramātrā kretrā dinābhyupagamarūpaikyaṃ sṛjyate | anabhyupagamatā pramātrā sahaikyaṃ saṃ vriyate tasya tasya pramātuḥ parameśvareṇodakāharaṇādirūpāmartha kriyāmavalambya ghaṭādimātṛrūpe sthitiḥ kriyate | prakāśamānatvāt | śivātmakatve'pi tacchivātmaka pūrvasvarūpa nimīlanāttirobhāva ādhīyate | tāvatighaṭādyābhāse ayaṃ ghaṭa eveti sarvaṃ saṃpratipannaikyāvabhāsanātmaka pūrṇatvavitaraṇādanugrahaḥ kriyate | ādāveva śivādikṣityantatatva ṣaṭtriṃśattatvena nirmāṇātmakamahāsṛṣṭiṣu kṣityādiśivaparyanta tattvasaṃhārātmaka mahāpralayeṣu tādṛgvidha sṛṣṭisaṃhāramadhyabhūtamahāsthitiṣu mahātirodhānamahānugrahau uktarūpa saṃhārāṃtargatau <238> mantavyau | tasya svanigrahātmaka prakopa sañjāta svasvarūpatirodhāne gururūpeṇa bhūtvā svātmanaivānugraha yogyān pratikriyamāṇeṣu dīkṣājñānādyanugrahe ṣveva na kevalaṃ bhagavataḥ kṛtyapañcaka yogaḥ madhyakoṭirūpe vyavahāre'pi yaduktaṃ sadā sṛṣṭivinodāyetyādi śrīmatstotrāvalyām
namaḥ śivāya satataṃ pañcakṛtyavidhāyine | cidānanda ghana svātma paramārthāvabhāsine ||
iti pratyabhijñā hṛdaye | pratikṣaṇaviśrānta iti śrībhaṭṭanārāyaṇena | prākāmyamātmani yadā prakaṭīkaroṣi vyaktīḥ pratikṣaṇamaneka vidhā dadhānaḥ |
tenaiva so'pi bhagavān bhajate'rthavattāḥ prāyovidagdhacaritaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅganādaḥ ||
ityavadhūta viracita pratyakṣa stave ca ||
iheti | antaḥ sthitavatāmityuktanītyāntaḥ saṃvinmaye pūrṇāhantātmani prakāśe śivādikṣityanto'rthāvabhāsaḥ sthita eva | tasminnarthāvabhāse tattadākasmikābhāso bāhyaṃ cedanumāpayedityuktasya tadarthāvabhāsātmaka pratisamarpakasya nityānumeyasya bimbarūpasya kāraṇāntarasya cintayā kimiti tatkāraṇāntara bāhyenānupapattinetyanena nirasya tatprameya mantaḥ sthitameveti cidātmaivahītyatra prakṛtam | tatsiddhayeti | prameyasyāntaḥ sthitatvasiddhaye | svāntaḥ sthitenaiṣaṇīyena vimṛśyena prameyena vinā svāminaḥ icchārūpaḥ parāmarśo nasyādityupapattisktā | tatprasaṅgāditi | <239> tadicchārūpa parāmarśa prasaṅgāt | svasvabhāvamavabhāsasyetyādinā ahaṃ pratyavamarśoyaḥ prakāśātmaiva vāyuḥ nāsau vikalpa ityantena jñānasaṃkalpādhyavasāyādeḥ tasya pratyavamarśasyaiva svarūpamupapāditam | sahyukto dvayāpekṣī viniścaya ityādinā | sāpi bhinnāvabhāsinī tyantena | vikalpāvikalparūpasyānusaṃdhāsya ca svarūpamupapāditamiti śiṣyāṇāṃ prameyāntara vyavahitāṃ dhiyaṃ samādhātumantaḥ sthitamiti | prakṛtaṃ prameyamupapādayan viśvamantaḥ shtitamevetiniścinoti | dehe buddhāvityuktanītyā parameśvara eva dehādimāviśya tattatpramātṛrūpeṇa sthita iti yataḥ evamiti ato hetoḥ smṛtāvapohana parāyaṇe vikalpe'nubhavātmani jñāne'pi smarthamāṇo vikalpyamāno'nubhūyamānaścārthāvabhāsaḥ | ataḥ pūrṇāhantātmani prakāśe sthitaḥ viśrānta eveti niścitam | nanudehādāviti sūtra saṅgatiḥ | viśvamaya viśvottīrṇa prakāśātmā parameśvara eva sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamityādirūpadehādi pramātṛtābhimāna daśāyāmapi prabhurdehādimāviśānnityuktanītyā vastuḥ pramātetiyataḥ evamityato hetoḥ jñānasmṛtyapohanaśaktimāni (----) (-------------------) maheśvarasya śaktibhūte smaraṇe apoha jīvite'pite vikalpe anubhava jñāne ca sa ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ ghaṭa eva ayaṃ paṭa iti pratibhāsamāno'rthāvabhāsaḥ tadvaditi maheśvare prakāśe viśrānta eveti ityetadvi (-----------------------) arthāvabhāsaḥ
prakāśa viśrāntaḥ ityasminnarthe na kaścidapi saṃśayaḥ | yadyahaṃ sthūlo'haṃ kṛśa ityādirūpo dehādireva paramārtha pramātā syāt tattarhiśarīra prāṇādeḥ ghaṭādirantaḥ sthita mityetat <240> siddhaṃ bhavati | (-----------------------) danupapannamevātasya dehāderapi ghaṭādivajjaḍatvāt nāhaṃ ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ caitra eveti ghaṭādiparihāreṇa dehādeḥ sthitatvāt | tasmād grāhyagrāhakabhinnau ityukta nītyā paramārtha prakāśastu sarvaṃ sahaḥ paṭādidehādya (-------------) iti tasmin paramārtha prakāśe antarviśvaṃ sthitamityanayā sasiddhametat | yathoktam -
bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svātmaniviśrāntito mahānandam | icchā saṃvitkaraṇairnirbharitamananta śaktiparipūrṇam ||
sarvavikalpavihīnaṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ vyayodaya vihīnam | yatparatatvaṃ tasminvibhāti ṣaṭtriṃśadātmajagat ||
iti śrīparamārthasāre |
nanviti | prakāśāntaḥ sthitasyābhāsavargasya bahirābhāsanaṃ tattadviṣaya rūpatayā sarvatra smaraṇa vikalpānubhaveṣu astīti cet āsya bhāsa vargasya smaraṇau pratibhāsabhedaḥ kathaṃ bhavet | asāvābhāsabheda smaraṇādau saṃvedye dṛśyata eva sphuṭāsphuṭarūpayoḥ sphuraṇādityāśaṃkya svātaṃtryataḥ tatsphuṭāsphuṭarūpā bhāsabhedo'stītyāha(-)taṃ tviti śabdaḥ tasyāntaḥ sthitasyāvabhāsasya bahiḥ prakāśe'nubhavādau sphuṭāsphutarūpa viśeṣadyotakaḥ | tadevāha (-) sa iti | pūrvaprastutaḥ prakāśāntaḥ sthito'rthāvabhāsaḥ bahirābhāsanātmani jñāne'nubhave naisargakaḥ nisargasiddhaḥ smaraṇādiṣu tu pūrvānubhavasaṃskārajo bhūtvā sthitaḥ smaraṇa vikalpādīnāmanubhavajīvitamityuktanītyā teṣāṃ svasvaviṣaya prakāśane'nubhavamukhaprekṣitvam | anubhavasya tvanya <241> jñānamukhaprekṣitvaṃ nāstīti sūtra saṅgatiḥ ||
anantarābhāsamānaṃ vastu idaṃ nīlamiti vyavadhānena bahirābhāsayato'nubhavajñānasya svānta stannīlādirūpa bhāvā vabhāsaḥ sanaisargikaḥ svatassiddhaḥ | nisargonisṛṣṭiḥ tasmādāyāta iti naisargikaḥ | svātantryeṇa siddha ityarthaḥ | smaraṇādestu sadāntarā bhāsaḥ anubhava jñānakṛtasaṃskāra balādeva bhavati tadvat
anubhavajñānasya viṣaya prakāśane'nyajñānamukha prekṣitvaṃ nāsti | ataḥ smaraṇe utprekṣaṇe pratyakṣa pṛṣṭha bhāvini vikalpe saṃ ghaṭa iti taṃ ghaṭa mevaṃ manye ayaṃ ghaṭa eveti ca taiḥ smaraṇādibhiḥ bāhyatayā bhāsayitavyo yoghaṭādyābhāsaḥ asau smaraṇādeḥ svātmīyona bhavati | apitu pūrvānubhava saṃskārādevāyātaḥ | tatreti | smaraṇādau ābhāsamānasyārthasya saṃskārajatve sthite tajjanakaḥ saṃskāronāmānubhavasya kālāntare'pyanuvartamānatā rūpo naisargika svabhāvaḥ | evaṃ saṃsārarūpeṇa kālāntare'pyanuvartamāno'sāvanubhavaḥ svaviṣayībhūtanīlādyābhāsa saṃbhinneyataḥ tato'nubhūtārtha prakāśakatvādanubhava tādātmyāpannaṃ smaraṇādyapi viṣayībhūtanīlādyābhāsa saṃbhinnaṃ nirbhāsate | tata eveti | anubhava viṣayībhūtanīlādyābhāsa saṃbhedena nirbhāsamānatvāt sanīlādyā bhāsaḥ smaraṇakālāsaṃbhavī tadanubhavātmaka pūrvakālakalita eveti smaraṇādeḥ svātmano nirviṣayatvam | anubhava gṛhīta grāhitvaṃ codghoṣyate | śāstreṣviti śeṣaḥ | etadeveti | svātmano nirviṣayatvāt gṛhīta grāhitvameva smaraṇādau pratibhāsamānasyārthasyāsphuṭatvamiti anubhavasmaraṇādau sphuṭāsphuṭarūpābhāsabhedaḥ siddhaḥ | antarābhāsamānasya vastunaḥ avyavadhānatvam <242> anubhavenedaṃ bahirābhāsanaṃ sphuṭatā smaraṇādau anubhava vyavadhānena pratibhāsamānasyārthasya tatsmaraṇa kāla jātatvābhāvādasphuṭatā |
nanviti | ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ayaṃ rasaḥ ayaṃ gandhaḥ ayaṃ sparśaḥ ayaṃ śabda ityādi cakṣurādi(viṣaya) bahirindriyajādanubhavajñānāt smaraṇādikaṃ vikalpa jñānamanubhava vyavadhānenānubhavadvāreṇa svasvaviṣayasya bahisvabhāsana rūpa prāptamityāśaṅkya svatantyra vikalpastathā na bhavatīti pravibhāgamāha (-) sa iti | pūrvaprastuto'rthāvabhāsaḥ anubhavānapekṣaṃ svairacāriṇīti svayameva svapreraṇayodīyamāne svatantravikalpo naisargika eva | svataḥ siddha evāsti | atra hetumāha (-) cara iti | svacchadhīdarpaṇātmanyantaḥ karaṇe anubhūtasya | yathā bhimateti | yathā bhimatasya sveṣṭasya saṃsthānasya saṃniveśasya bhāsanāt prakāśanāt | iti sūtrasaṅgatiḥ |
yo vikalpaḥ pratyakṣa vyāpāramiti anubhava saṃskāra (-----------------) tayā manorājyasaṅkalpādirvikalpaḥ sa svairaṃ īraṇa preraṇa iti dhātugatyā
svayameva svātmanaḥ preraṇenā nugrahādi preraṇa nairapekṣyeṇa svātantryeṇa ca rati udeti vyayati ceti svaira cāriṇītyu(-----------------------) mātṛbhūmeravatīrya buddhiviṣayatve idamiti yo bahiravabhāsaḥ sa naisargika eva | naisargikatvamvopa pādayati (-) tathā hītyādinā | adṛṣṭapūrvamapiśvetaviṣāṇaśatakalitaṃ karayugalayuktam | antaścaitramaitrā (-----------------------) sthitaṃ svasṛṣṭaṃ dantinaṃ svacchadhīdarpaṇātmikāyāmantaḥ karaṇabhūmau savikalpaḥ bahirimamiti tadānīmevāvabhāsayati | <243> tasmāt svatantra vikalpaḥ smaraṇādivānubhava mukhaprekṣī na bhavati | svāntaḥ sthitaṃ dantinaṃ bahirābhāsayatītyanenāpi dantarūpārthāvabhāsasyātrāpyantaḥ sthita tvamevoktam | anyathā tasya buddhiḥ darpaṇe bahiravabhāsamānameva na bhavati | evaṃ bhūtasya vastuno nirmāṇāvabhāsanābhyāṃ jñānākriyāśakti sarvasya svataḥ siddhe ityuktaṃ parameśvara dharmabhūtajñānakriyāśaktimatvāt sarveṣāmapi ekeśvararūpatā siddhaiveti sthitam || imamevārthamuttaraślokenadarśayati (-) asmāditi ||
evaṃ smṛtau vikalpe vāpyapohanaparāyaṇe | jñāne vāpyantarābhāsa sthita eveti niścita(m) ||
ityantarābhāsa saṃbhavasamarthana prasaṅgāgatān | asmāditi (-) tathābhimatasaṃsthādityuktarūpāt | svatantravikalpaṃ viṣayabhūtā vabhāsabheda vicārādasminnīśvara pratyabhijñā śāstre | caitrametrādeḥ pramātuḥ ahamahamiti prakāśamāne svātmani īśvaro'pi jānāti karoti ahamapi jānāmi karomi īśvaradharmabhūtasya jñānakriyālakṣaṇasya svabhāvasyamayyapi dṛśyamānatvāt sa evāha mitīśvara pratyabhijñārūpamukhyatvena tatpratyabhijñāmupapādayāmīti śaktyāviṣkaraṇeneyaṃ pratyabhijño padarśyata iti prathamevābhihitaṃ prayojanaṃ yat tatpratyabhijñānātmakaṃ prayojanamanyasyārthasyāsiddhau yadanuṣaṃ geṇa siddhyati | sasyādādhāra siddhānto jagatkarturyatheśitā(,) ityuktanītyā evaṃ bhūtābhāsabheda vicārātmakadhikaraṇa siddhāntanītyā janasyāyāsasiddhamiti darśayati | yathābhimatasaṃsthānetyatra svatantra vikalpe 'bhīṣṭasya vastunaḥ yannirmāṇarūpamullekhanamavabhāsanarūpaṃ prakāśanañca darśitam | atehetoḥ jīvataḥ sarvasya <244> jñānakriye eva sphuṭe eva siddhe iti sūtra saṃgatiḥ |
yathā bhīṣṭasya bahiścakṣurādi viṣayatvenāsatvādidamityanubhūtasyāpi
vastunaḥ buddhigocaresamyagullekhanaṃ nirmāṇabhavabhāsanaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca svatantravikalpasya | kintu naisargiko jñāna iti ślokokte prameya prasaṃgāddarśitam | ata eveti | evaṃ bhūta samullekhā vabhāsanāddhetoḥ idamapi siddhyati | tatkimiti cet yatkiñcitkīṭovā brahmā vā jīvan jīvanakriyāviṣṭaḥ tasya sarvasya kīṭabrahmāderviśvāvabhāsanarūpā jñānaśaktirviśvollekhanarūpā kriyāśaktiśca naisargikī ityetat siddham | tataścaitramaitrādestasyāṃ svatantravikalpabhūmau svavyatirikteśvaropakalpita pūrvasṛṣṭayupajīvana saṃbhāvanāpi nāstīti | janāmikaromīti kriyāsvātantrya lakṣaṇamaiśvaryaṃ sphuṭaṃ pratyabhijñeneyaṃ jīvata ityekavacanena sakalādeḥ śivāntasya jīvajātasya paramārthata ekeśvararūpatāṃ sūcayatīti śivam ||
[iti pratyabhijñāsūtravimarśinī vyākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamāhnikaṃ samāptam] ||
[atha saptamamāhnikam] ||
anantāḥ deśakālāparicchinnāḥ smṛtyādyāḥ śaktaya eva tattatsvaviṣaya bhūta viśvaprakāśatvādratnāni teṣāṃ yasya viśvaprakāśasya ekasyādvitīyasyā śrayasya asituṃ yogyasya bhājanasya saṃśrayāt tatraiva samyagavasthānāt sa iti aya <245> mityayameveti vicitrāyāścandrikāyāstattadviṣayāmṛtāsvāda radatvā dānandinyāstattatpadārtha saṃbandhina ullāsasya udasya saṃsiddhiḥ samyak siddhiḥ lābho bhavati | evaṃ bhūtaṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ | evaṃ smṛtyādiśaktīnāṃ svarūpamiyate yekamekaike nāhnikena vitatyadarśitam | atra smṛtyādiśaktimadhye sāhi pūrvānubhūtārthasiddhi (-----------------) | (-) (-----------------) ditaiṣa sa iti avasyatari darśanamiti grāhya grāhakābhinnāviti | cidātmaiva hi deva iti tadevaṃ vyavahāra ityādinā pramāturapi yat citsvarūpamunmīlitaṃ tattāsāṃ śaktitvaṃ tat pratisamarthayituṃ śaktiśca śaktima (-----------------------) iti śaktimatāvināśakti svarūpaṃ svatantraṃ bhavituṃ nārhatīti tāsāṃ śaktitva samarthanārthaṃ śaktimataḥ pramātuḥ svarūpamapyunmīlanīyameva | tāsāṃ smṛtyādi śaktīnāṃ ya eke āśrayaṃ vibhāgarūpaṃ viśrāntisthānam | sa caitāsāṃ ca jñāna (--------------) prakāro vaicitryavikalpa iti tatsāmarthyaṃ
svātantryamaparādhīnaṃ pūrvaṃ mahadaiśvaryaṃ tannirmita brahmaviṣṇurudrādyaiśvaryāpekṣayocyata ityuktanītyā tāsāṃ tattadghaṭapaṭādi viṣayeṣu pramātṛṣvapi so'yamiti sa ekaḥ ayamevetyekaṃ vaṃ rūpa saṃyojana viyojanasthityādi svātaṃtryayogāt maheśvaraḥ natvahamiti parāmarśābhāvāddāhaka pācakādi śaktyāśrayamātra jaḍarūpavahā(hnyā)divat kevalaṃ tadāśrayamātram | apitu tatsaṃyojana viyojanādiṣvapi svatantra ityetacchakti trayāśrayabhūtasya pramāturevaṃ bhūtaṃ māheśvaryamekatvaṃ cetyubhayamupakṣiptaṃ na cedantaḥ kṛtetyatrasūtre | adhunātaddvayamapi nirṇetavyam | tatreti (-)tayormadhye | prathamamekāśrayaṃ nirṇetuṃ yā caiṣā pratibhetyādi caturdaśabhiḥ <246> ślokairāhnikaṃ prastūyate | tatra prathamaślokena sa eka āśraya svarūpa upakṣipyate | evamevaṃ bhūta ekāśraya iti tato dvayena vakṣyamāṇaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādi hetuḥ sarvovyavahāra ekasminnāśraye sati yujyate ityanvayātmātasminna satina yujyata iti vyatirekātmā ca yuktirucyate | tataḥ hānādānādivyavahāra svarūpaṃ vistīrṇamapi kāryakāraṇabhāvataḥ smarataḥ satyāsatyapravibhāgataśca bhavatīti saṃkṣipya pratyekamekaikena ślokena | punaśca satyāsatya pravibhāgameva ślokasaptakena vitatyapratpādyate | tataḥ ślokenāhnikoktaḥ sarvo'rtho nigamyata iti āhnikārya saṃkṣepaḥ |
athāsyāhnikasya pūrvāhnikena saṅgatiṃ darśayan prathamaślokaṃ vyākhyātuṃ śaṅkāmavatārayati (-)jīvaḥ sarvasya jñānakriye siddhe iti yaduktaṃ tat kathaṃ jñāna vikalpādi vyatiriktaḥ ko'sāvanyo jīvanātmāyasyate jñānakriye saṃbandhinyau syātām | tatobhinneṣu dharmeṣvityādinā guṇaguṇībhāvenātmasadbhāvavādinaḥ kāraṇādīnapi pratyātmādūṣitaḥ | jñānasantānavādimatamāśaṃkya nacedantaḥ kṛtetyuktasya darśana diśā tamekāśrayaṃ svarūpata upakṣipati | tadāśrayasyaiva prakāśaṃ svarūpaṃ prakāśayati sā caiṣetyādi | tattatpadārthakramarūṣiteti | padārthānāmatratyāmidānīntanamidameva tadanantaramidametatpūrvamidamiti | etadyugaṃ yugapadeva pratibhātam | iti tena tena deśātmanā kālātmanā pūrvāparādyātmanā yaugapadyātmanā
ca krameṇa rūṣitā paramārthato deśakālakramābhāvāt parameśvaravadakramāpi |
evaṃ kramaviśiṣṭa tattadviṣayagrahaṇaunmukhyāt rūṣitā pratibimbakaṃ patayā uparakteti kevalaṃ bhinna saṃvedyetyatroktā(,) eṣeti sarvasya svaprakāśa siddhā <247> ayaṃ ghaṭa ityarthaṃ prati ahaṃ ghaṭamanubhavāmīti cānubhavitāraṃ pratisa ghaṭa ityarthaṃ praticāhaṃ ghaṭaṃ smarāmīti smartāraṃ pratyayaṃ ghaṭa eva na paṭa iti vikalpa viṣayaṃ ghaṭaṃ pratyahaṃ vikalpayāmīti vikalpayitāraṃ prati ca bāhyānuvādi prathā saivānanta cidrūpa iti deśakālāparicchinna vyāptinityaparipūrṇa saṃvidrūpaḥ ukta rūpo maheśvaraḥ pramātā pramāsu saṃyojanaviyojanādau svatantra iti sūtra saṃgatiḥ ||
pratibhāti ghaṭa ityatra tatpratimānaṃ ghaṭopaśliṣṭameva yadyapi bhāti tathāpi tatpratibhānaṃ na ghaṭasya svakaṃ vapuḥ | api tu pramātṛtva saṃvideva | tat pratibhārūpeṇa ca kāsti māṃ prati prabhātīti tadghaṭa pratimāyā mātṛlagnatvāt | tathā ca vedaḥ (-) tameveti | viśvottīrṇaṃ parameśvaraṃ bhāntamaviratamābhāsamānaṃ sarvamiti śivādikṣityantaṃ vi (-----------------------) tītyasyaiva vyākhyā tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhātītye tat | bhāntamiti śatrā tasya parameśvarasyaviratasphuraṇatvaṃ dyotitam | anubhāvanātmanā karmapravacanīyena parameśvara svātantryokalpitanirmāṇakriyājanita (------) (-----------------)palakṣaṇātmā saṃbandho dyotitaḥ | parameśvarasya vedyavedakātmano viśvasya prakāśasya prakāśarūpaḥ saṃbandhodyotitaḥ | tasyāḥ pratibhāyāḥ parameśvarābhinnatvādakramatve'pi paramārthataḥ kevala (--------------------) (---)kramāvabhāsaḥ samarthitaḥ | jñānasmṛtyavasāyādi sakramaṃ pratibhāsate | ityatra tattat padārthakramarūṣiteti tattat pūrvāparātmaka kramayaugapadyādi ciraśīghravitatvāvitatvādi vicitrarūpoyaḥ padārthānāṃ mūrti vaicitryatayā (-----------------------) īśvarasvātantryarūpābhyāṃ deśakālavartibhyāmupakalpitaḥ kramaḥ | atratyamidānītaṃnamityādi <248> deśakālaparipāṭī tena krameṇa rūṣitā pratibimbakalpatayopasktā kevalaṃ bhinnaṃ savedyetyādinā yā pratibhoktā(,) eṣeti sa (-----------------------)api purata eva sphuraṇāt sva prakāśāsiddhā paramārthataḥ ahamityantaṃ mukha svarūpa viśrāṃntatvena
tadahaṃ prakāśamātra paramārthatayā deśakāla kalita bhedābhāvādakramaḥ sā pratibheti prokta lakṣaṇo maheśvaraḥ śaktiśca śaktimato bhedāt anantacidrūpa iti yasyāścito deśakālākārairanta iti paricchedaṃ nāsti | ityanantā sā cit parā bhaṭṭārikārūpā saṃvidrūpaṃ yasya satādṛgvidhaḥ | ata eveti | anantacidrūpatvādbahirbhūtaghaṭapaṭādi viṣayagrahaṇonmukhatvāt svayamapi bahirmukha prakāśātmaka tattadghaṭādi vijñānasvabhāvasya idametādṛgiti ca vakṣyati |
evaṃ yadvaśādvyavatiṣṭhate | vastu pramāṇaṃ tatso'pi svābhāsobhinavodayaḥ(,) iti vakṣyamāṇanītyā idamiti sāmānyena etādṛgiti viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭatvena ca prameyavyavasthāpakasya pramāṇa vargasya prāṇabhūtaṃ sontastathā vimarśoti vakṣyamaṇanītyāntaḥ karaṇe pratyābhāsamiti ghaṭapaṭādyābhāsa tadviśeṣaṇaviśeṣya rūpeṇa saṃyojanam | rājato jaṭa iti | rajata saṃvidaḥ kāñcana saṃvido'piyojanaṃ kāñcana saṃvidolohita saṃvidaśca | ekasyāṃ ghaṭasaṃvidiśramāṇaṃ ityāghaneka prakāra saṃyojanādisvātantrya pūrṇāhaṃ pratyavamarśoya ityuktanītyā śuddhāhaṃ pratyavamarśamayaḥ sa pūrvokto maheśvaraḥ pramātābhaṇyate |
etat piṇḍitārthamāha (-) ata ityādinā | ata iti | evaṃ prameya pramāṇa pramāpramātṛ svarūpatattvakathanāt prathamamayaṃ ghaṭa iti ghaṭātmaka prameyonmukhaṃ bahiḥ pramāṇātmā prakāśoyaḥ anta iti antaḥ karaṇe svīkṛtapūrvarūpaḥ iti svīkṛta tad <249> ghaṭātmaka prameya tadvyavasthāpana pramāṇātmaka pūrvarūpavimarśarūpaḥ pramātmako yo vikalpaḥ ahamityetaṃ svarūpaṃ tadubhayaviśrānti sthānamiti ahamiti prakāśasya svarūpabhiyaṃ pūrṇamiti prameyapramāṇapramāsaūhai pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanmayamevetyarthaḥ | atraiveti | ekāśraya rūpe pramātari sati uktarūpapratibhādvāreṇa mṛdghaṭādīnāṃ bījāṃkurādīnāmagni dhūmatvādīnāṃ ca kāryakāraṇabhāvātmakānyonyānvayarūpā viśrāntirghaṭa ityevarūpamanvayaṃ tāvadāha (-) tattaditi | anyonyabhinnānubhavādisaṃvittidvārairanubhavitṛvikalpayitṛrūpe tadanubhavādyāśrayabhūte eka pramātari uktarūpakāryakāraṇātmasubhāveṣu pratiṣṭhatsumāṃ pratighaṭādiḥ
pratibhātītyādi mukhyaviśrāntiṃ bhajatsu | jñātīnāṃ bhāvo jñāteyaṃ tat eva bhāveṣu idaṃ kāraṇamidaṃ kāryamidaṃ viśeṣaṇamidaṃ viśeṣyamiti pramātṛ vikalpavyāpāra kṛtānyonyānvayarūpa saṃbandha upapadyate | prāṇe na ghaṭate | kiñca jñātīnāmanyonyayogakṣemodvahanātmakaṃ karma ca jñāteyaṃ tadapi bhāvānāmekapramātṛ samanvayābhiprāyeṇa darśitamiti sūtrasaṃgatiḥ |
ghaṭapaṭādi viṣaya vyavasthitaḥ tattadghaṭapaṭādijñānaniṣṭhā iti sarvavādibhirucyate tadviṣaya vyavasthānaṃ pramātṛviśrānti vyatiriktānyonya bhinnānubhavādi saṃvinmātraviśrāntyā na sidhyati | apitu taditi tāstā vibhinnā anyonyabhinnā niścayarūpāṃ adhyavasāyātmikā pramātmānamantarmukhavimarśarūpāyāḥ saṃvittayā tāḥ saṃvida eva | mukhānidvārāṇi | upāyāḥ mārgāḥ taissaṃvidrūpaiḥ samudrābhimukhanadī srotaḥ sthānīyaiḥ yadyamī bahirantaḥ karaṇaviṣayā (----------) hyamānā etasmin deśakālānavacchinne pramātṛrūpe ahamiti <250> mahāsaṃvitsamudre pratitiṣṭhanta uktarūpeṇābhimukhyena viśrāntiṃ bhajaṃte | tata iti | tarhi eṣupramātṛviśrānteṣu bhāveṣu paraspara samanvaya (-----------------------) jñāteyaṃ tadupapattyā ghaṭate | taditi tacchabda pravṛtta jñātiśābdapravṛtti nimittaṃ parasparaṃ jānatāṃ jñātīnāṃ bhāvo bodharūpaṃ jñāteyaṃ(,) kiñca jñātīnāṃ anyonya yogakṣemodvahanātmakaṃ karma ca jñātīyam | tacceti | karmarūpa jñāteyaṃ ca(-----------------------) viśrānti rūpa samanvayābhiprāyeṇa darśitam | kathamiti cet tat karmarūpaṃ jñāteyaṃ viṣayeṣu bījādeḥ pūrvamasadrūpāṅkurāsaṃpādana ityaṅkurādiṃ pratibījāde yogakṣemodvaham | aṅkurodervinā bījādeḥ kāraṇatvābhāvāt bījādiṃ pratyaṅkurāderapi tatkāraṇatvāpādanātmaka yogakṣemodvahana mastyeva | evaṃ ghaṭakāṃcanodarapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpātmakānyonya yogakṣemodvahanaṃ draṣṭavyam |
jaḍānāṃ pramātṛviśrāntyā vinā na kadācit svataḥ samanvaya iti eva manyonya bhinnānā mityatra darśitam | yathoktam
evamātmanyasatkalpāḥ prakāśa sthaiva santyamī | jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti svātmanaḥ sva parātmabhiḥ || iti |
ghaṭaḥ paṭaṃ na jānāti paṭe'pi na ghaṭaṃ tathā | caitrāyattaṃ tayorjñānaṃ caitre taddvārataḥ sthitiḥ || iti |
uktamevārthaṃ vyatirekamukhenāpi sthāpayitu māha deśakālā krama juṣāmiti | atratyamidānīṃ tanamityādi rūpeṇa deśakālakrama matyajatāmarthānāṃ ghaṭapaṭādīnām | kiñca tattadarthagrahaṇonmukhānāṃ bahirmukhānāṃ jñānānāṃ tadartha saṃbandhināṃ vikalpānāñca pratyekaṃ svasamāhitānāṃ svasvarūpamātraviśrāntānāmeka <151> pramātṛ viśrāntyā vinā saṃmelanarūpaḥ kaḥ samanvayaḥ nija rūpamātra viśrāntatvānna kaścidityarthaḥ | asaviti | uktarūpaḥ samanvayaḥ sakṛdābhāsa iti sakṛdābhāsena svātmano deśakālākārābhāvādavicchinna prakāśena mātrā | kiñca tatra tatra viṣaye atratyabhidānīṃ tanamevakāramiti deśakālamiśrīkaraṇātmanā eka pramātṛkṛtena yojanābhāse na sādhyaḥ | anyatheti | evaṃ bhūta sakṛdābhāsābhāve anvayona bhavatītyarthaḥ |
atra dṛṣṭāntamāha (-) samudraṃ prāpyamadhye pṛthak pṛthak prakṣīṇeṣṣthasrotasssu taduhyamānāstṛṇolapādayaḥ svataḥ samanvayaṃ yāntīti deśakālākārātmā bhedaḥ bhāvānāmanekakārītyāśayena sakṛcchabdaḥ taddeśādibheda kṛtānekatvaniṣedha tātparyeṇa prayukta eka pramātṛūpasya sakṛdābhāsasya deśādi kṛtamanekatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | tatra pramātari agnidhūmādīnāṃ kaḥ samanvaya ityāśaṃkya kāraṇatvaṃ na jānāti bījasyāṃkuraṃ prati | aṅkur'pi na jānāti (na)bīja kāryatvamātmanaḥ | eka pramātradhīnā tatkāryakāraṇatā tayoḥ ||
eva meka pramātṛsthā sarvā saṃbandha santatiḥ ||
ityuktanītyā samanvaya rūpaṃ bahutara deśakālapuruṣa vyāpakaṃ saṃbaṃdhātmakaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ darśayati |
pratyakṣe tasmiṃstasmin dhūmā'nyoḥ svabhāvātmani viṣaya rūpe aṃśe tasmiṃ stasmin svātmano jñānarūpe aṃśe ca(,) pātināṃ patatāṃ(,) pataṅgatāviti dhātu gatyātayoḥ svasadbhāvā sadbhāvarūpaṃ svaviṣayātmakaṃ maṃśamavagamayatāṃ svasmin svasmin jñānāṃśe viśrāmyatāṃ agniṃ pratyanvayarūpaṃ pratyakṣamekaṃ
<252> vyatirekarūpo'nupalambha eka iti pañca vidhānāṃ pratyakṣanupalaṃbhānāṃ dhūmāgnī prati ayaṃ dhūmaḥ kārya magniḥ kāraṇamiti kāryakāraṇatā rūpa saṃbaṃdhasiddhiṃ prati yā hetutā sā eka pramātṛ jā prathamamagnipratyakṣakālo dhūmo'pi pratyakṣī bhavati cet kiṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ kāryamiti jñātumaśakyatvāttadānīṃ dhūmasyānupalambho'ṅgīkāryaḥ | tata iti | anupalambhādanantaram | agnereva dhūmotpattiriti kāryatā siddhyarthaṃ dhūmaṃ pratyakṣeṇa paśyati ityanvaya krame jñānamagniṃ tu yadinopalabhate dhūmo'pi nopannaṃ bhata iti vyatirekarūpeṇānupalāṃbhadvayamiti pratyakṣanupalambhapañcakāt dhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ siddhatīti yaduktaṃ loke taduktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet | na bhavatyevetyāha (-) agni pratyakṣeṇa dhūmena kiñcidvyūḍhaṃ ghaṭa pratyakṣeṇe va paṭe | tadeva darśayati (-) tasyāgni pratyakṣasya dhūmadbhinnejñānarūpe aṃśe viśrāntatvāt sva smāt parasya (---------------) mānava gāhanāt sva vyatirikta dhūmajñāna svarūpānavagāhanācceti hetu catuṣkādagni pratyakṣeṇa dhūmātmakaṃ viṣayaṃ prati tajjñānaṃ kiñcidudvyūḍhabhinnāṃśapā(-----------------------) ttadbhinna rūpa viṣayāṃśa jñāna vācī pati tattatsvīya jñānāṃśaviśrāṃtavācī iti patiḥ | patiśca tantreṇa guptabhāṣayā prayuktaḥ | evaṃ dhūmānupalaṃbhādau catuṣṭaye vācyam | tadyathā (-) prathamaṃ dhūmānupalambhaḥ(,) agnivadbhāvena kiñcidudbūḍhadhūmabhāve lakṣaṇe agnerbhinne aṃśetasyāvagamahetutvāt svasvabhāvarūpe jñānāṃśe viśrāntatvāt aparaviṣayeti agnijñānaviṣayā agnyanavagāhanāt svavyatiriktāgni jñāsvarūpānāveśanācca dhūmapratyakṣeṇāgnisadbhāvena kiñcidudvyūdhaṃ dhūmalakṣaṇe <253> agnisadbhāvāt bhinneṃśe tasyāvagamahetutvāt svasvabhāvarūpe jñānāṃśe tasyāvagamahetutvāt agni jñānaviṣayāgni sadbhāvānavagāhanāt svavyatiriktāgni sadbhāvajñānānāveśāccāgnyanupalambha jñānena dhūmābhāvena kiñcidudvyūḍham | anyathā bhāvalakṣaṇe dhūmādbhinneṃśe tasyā vagamahetutvāddhūmānupalaṃbhajñāna viṣaya dhūmā bhāvā nava gāhanāt svavyatirikta dhūmānupalambhātmaka jñāna svarūpānāveśācceti dhūmānupalambhajñānenānāgnya bhāvena kiñcidudvyūḍhaṃ dhūmānupalambha lakṣaṇe
agnyabhāvādbhinnāṃśe viśrāntatvādagnyanupalaṃbha jñānaviṣayāgnyabhāvānavagāhanādagnyupalaṃbhātmaka jñānāntara svarūpānāveśācceti catuṣṭayami vyākhyātam | tataśceti | tajjñānapañcaka mātra dhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇa bhāvāsiddheḥ agnidhūmābhāvau dhūmāgnyabhāvau dhūmābhāva ityetāni tajjñānapañcakaviṣaya bhūtāni pañcavastūni pṛthak pramātṛvedyānīti prathamamagnisadbhāva ekasya vedya bhūtaḥ tadānīṃ dhūma sadbhāve ekasya paścāddhūma sadbhāvo'pyekasya viṣaya iti | evaṃ tattatpratyakṣādi jñānaiḥ pṛthak pṛthagekaika pramātṛsaṃvedyā niyamābhavanti | tadidānīṃ tāni jñānāni yathā tayordhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ na gamayanti tathā bhavatpakṣe jñāna santānameva tattvameva saugatānyukta nītyā jñānasantānamātraika pramātṛ vedyāni pramātṛvedyānyapi dhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ na gamayanti (tayā bhavatpakṣe jñānasantānameva) kathamiti cet (-) agniṃ pratyakṣīkurvatah pramātuḥ kṣaṇikatvena dhūmānupalaṃbhādi jñānakāle'vidyamānatvāt pramātu stāvat kṣaṇikatvāt dhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvagamakatvaṃ na bhavatu | vikalpa eva tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ gamayatīti cet | agni pratyakṣa pṛṣṭhapātīvikalp'pi <254> tadagni pratyakṣānubhūtāgnyatiriktaṃ dhūme sadbhāvādikaṃ jñāpayaṃścedapramāṇameva tasya pratyakṣa vyāpārabhūtasya pratyakṣa viṣaya eva viṣayo yasmāt |
evaṃ paramataṃ nirasya svamata eva kāryakāraṇa bhāvasyotpattirityāha (-) yadā tu pratyakṣānupalambhātmaka jñāna srotaḥ pañcakena tānyāgni sadbhāvādi pañcavastūni deśakālākāra kālī tatvādvyāpta nityaparipūrṇe'hamityeka smin saṃvitsamudre pramātrā viśrāntī kṛtāni bhavanti tadā ekībhūtānyonya vyāmiśrāṇi | tata eva pramātrā svatantratayā kāryakāraṇabhāvātmanānyonya sāpekṣāṇi bhāvyante | natu ghaṭapaṭādivat anyonya sāpekṣatvābhāvena ghaṭa paṭayoreka pramātṛ viśrāntatve'pyanyonya sāpekṣatvaṃ nāsti | tayoḥ kāryakāraṇatābhāvābhāsa evaikā bhāsa iti pramātrā eka saṃvitsamudra viśrāntīkṛtaḥ | ata evānyo nya sāpekṣa ekābhāsaḥ teṣāmagni sadbhāvādīnāmekīkaraṇā bhāsa eva kārya kāraṇabhāvā
bhāsa iti kārya kāraṇabhāvasyaika pramātṛ janyatvānnakiñcidavadyaṃ na kācidapi hāniḥ | pratyakṣānupalāṃ bhātmanā jñānapañcakena yat svasvaviṣaya prakāśanaṃ kṛtaṃ dhūmā (---------------) ṇakṛtaṃ dhūmaprakāśana magnidhūmānupalaṃbhajñāna kṛtamagnidhūmā bhāva prakāśanam | ityetat sarvaṃ smaraṇabalādanyonya sā pekṣatvenaikīkariṣyate | tena dhūmāgnyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi sidhyati | kimeka pramātā ityā(-------) (--------) vikalpavat pratyakṣa vikalpayoḥ pṛṣṭhapātitvādvikalpo'pyanubhavātiriktaṃ jñāpayanna pramāṇamevetyanantaraślokoktanītyā sarvasyāyaṃ vikalpo'nubhavamūla ityuktanītyā vikalpātmikānubhūtātirikte'rthena <255> vyāpriyate | ahamityeva (---------------) rasaṃvidantarmukhasvabhāva iti prokta nītyā anubhavādi pūrvāparasaṃvidātmaka vijñānavādi samanvayarūpānubhavitṛvikalpayitṛsmartṛrūpaika pramātṛsadbhāvasādhakaṃ na bhavati | smṛtau caiva svasaṃvittiriti smṛtāviti smṛtau svātmani saṃbhave smṛtyutpattau smartrātmaka pramātṛ rūpā sva saṃvittiḥ svamavināśinī saṃvit yaiva smṛti sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ saiva pūrvānubhavotpattāvapi sādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nā parimiti mātrātmaka saṃvittivyatirekeṇānyat pratyakṣānumānādikaṃ pramāṇaṃ pūrvānubhava sadbhāve sādhakaṃ na bhavati |
iheti | loke smṛteḥ svātmanaḥ svata eva viṣayābhāvādanubhūta eva viṣayaḥ prakāśate | tatrānubhūta viṣaye prakāśane sā smṛtistasya viṣayasyāyamiti nūtana prakāśo na bhavati | apitvasya smṛtau prakāśamānasyārthasya prācya evānubhavaḥ prakāśakaḥ smṛtidvāreṇa prakāśayitrībhavati | sa cārtha prakāśako'nubhavaḥ svayaṃ jñānarūpeṇa jñeyatvā bhāvāt smṛtirūpeṇa jñānāntareṇānubhūtaviṣayavat svasaṃvedyo na bhavati | saṃvedyaścet svaprakāśo na bhavati | tasmānnasaṃvedya eva | sa ca prakāśo'nubhavasmṛtikāle'saṃścet asattvādeva kathaṃ prakāśatām | smṛtikāle sattve'pi sa iti smṛti prakāśo'yamityanubhavaprakāśe ityanyonya bhinnaṃ jñānayugalaṃ yugapadeva bhavatīti ayamityanubhavaprakāśa vyatiriktā sa iti
prakāśātmikā na kācit smṛtiḥ saṃbhavet | tasmāditi | pramātṛ vyatirekeṇa smṛtyanubhavayoḥ svata evotpattyabhāvāt | evamiti (-) vakṣyamāṇam | etaditi (-) tayorutpatti svarūpamupapadyate | smṛtīti | smṛtyutpattihetubhūtaṃ pramātṛrūpaṃ yaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ tadevānubhavasyātyutpattihetubhūtaṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ tat svasaṃvedanaṃ smaraṇakāle smartṛrūpa manubhavakāle'nu bhavitṛrūpamiti <256> tādṛgvidhasvasaṃvedana vyatirikta pratyakṣādipramāṇam | tatra pūrvānubhavena kramate spanditumapi na śaknoti | anubhava kālādārabhya smṛtikālāvadhi avicchinnamahamiti yat svasaṃvedanaṃ tat svamavināśi saṃvedanameva pramātṛtattvamiti siddham | anyatra smartā anyatretītyetannopapadyata ityanayā cchāyayā smṛtyā pramātṛsiddhiḥ pūrvamuktā athānubhavavidhvaṃsa ityatra | sa hi pūrvānubhūtārtha ityādau ca | idānīṃ tu smṛtyanubhavayorekameva svasaṃvedanaṃ kāraṇamiti kāraṇabhūta svasaṃvedanaikī bhāvātmanā prakārāntareṇa pramātṛ siddhiriti viśeṣaḥ ||
nanviti | vikalp'pyanubhavātiriktaṃ jñāpayanna pramāṇamevetyuktam | tatkathamanubhūta vyatirikte'pyarthe vikalpāḥ pramāṇaṃ santu | teṣāmapramāṇyaṃ hi bādhaka jñānabalādeva bhavati | bādhakajñānābhāve tada pramāṇyaṃ kathaṃ syāditi so'pyayaṃ jñānānāṃ bādhya bādhaka bhāva idaṃ śuktijñānaṃ satyapūrvaṃ rajata jñānamasatyamiti satyāsatyaprabhājanayā viśveṣāṃ vyavahārāṇāṃ jīvita bhūtaḥ ekena śuktirajatādijñānānāṃ viśrāntibhūtena pramātṛtvena vinānaghaṭa ta ityeka ślokenoktvā ślokasaptakena jñānānāmeka pramātṛ viśrāntiṃ vināsvata eva bādhyabādhaka bhāvo na bhavatīti tameva vitatyadarśayati (-) bādhyabādhaketi | svātma niṣṭhāvirodhināṃ sva iti svīye viṣaye ātmanisvāsmin jñārūpeṃśe ca niṣṭhatvādavirodhināṃ jñānānāmidaṃ śuktijñānaṃ bādhakamidaṃ rajata jñānaṃ bādhyamiti bādhyabādhaka bhāvo'pyeka pramātṛ pariniṣṭhiteḥ ekasmin pramātariparitaḥ (---------------) niṣṭhitatvādviśrāntatvāt udiyāt saṃbhavet | iheti (-) jagati <257> jñānasya jñānāntareṇa bādhā bhavet | tasya jñānasya viṣayatvena | prāmāṇyamityetadbādhasvabhāve satyaviṣayatvena prāmāṇyam | avaśyasamarthyo yo (---------------) sāpi eka pramātṛ viśrāntyā vinā kathaṃ syādityapi śabdasyārthaḥ |
prathamaṃ tāvat śukti jñānaviṣayabhūtayā śuktyā rajatajñānaviṣayasya rajatasya na kācidbādhā kriyamāṇā dṛśyate | jaḍatve spaṃdituṃ śakyatvāt rajatajñānaviṣaya (---------------) yā śuktyā tāvādbādhāmābhūt | śuktijñānena rajatajñānaṃ bādhyata ityāśaṅkya tadapi na yukta mityāśaṅkya tadapi yuktamityāha (-) svātmaniṣṭhāvirodhināmiti | svasminniti svīpeviṣaye ātmani nije jñānāṃśarūpe dvayoḥ śukti rajatajñānayorviśrāntayorghaṭapaṭa jñānayorivānyonyaṃ virodhasyā bhāvāt |
atha svātmaniṣṭhāvirodhināmiti parasparaparihārarūpā (--------------) (-) prakārā svātmaniṣṭhaiva tayorjñānayorvirodhaḥ | tarhīti | svātmaniṣṭhaivavirodhaścet sarveṣāṃ satyatvenābhimatānāṃ ghaṭapaṭādijñānānāmapīyamevānyonyaparihārarūpasaraṇirastīti bādhyabādhakabhāvasyedaṃ bādhakamidaṃ bādhyamiti pariniṣṭhaiveyattārūpā vyavasthaiva na labhyeteti sutarāṃ vighaṭate | satyetarapravibhāgaḥ svātmaniṣṭhāvirodhināmityatra nayartho'pi tantreṇaikoktyā draṣṭavyaḥ |
uktamarthaṃ nigamayitumāha (-) yadirajata jñānamanyajñānabādhārahitaṃ svayameva naśyati tadānīṃ jñānāntareṇa śukti jñānenāsya rajatajñānasyakā bādhā śukti jñānena tasya viṣayamapyapahartumaśakyamityāha (-) rajata jñānakāle'saṃbhavatā tena <258> śukti jñāne tasya rajatarūpa viṣayāpahāraṃ kartuṃ na śakyaḥ tatkāle tasyotpatterabhāvāt śukti jñānena rajata jñānasya tadviṣayasya ca bādhāmābhūt | rajatamiti rajatābhāve jñānena bhūtapūrvaṃ rajatajñānaṃ tadviṣayaśca bādhyatāmityāha nedaṃ rajatamiti ca jñānaṃ nijaṃ rajatābhāvaṃ viṣayīkurvat bhūta pūrvasya rajatajñānasya viṣayaṃ nāpaharet | tasyāpi tatkāle'saṃbhavāt |
vipakṣe bādhāmāha (-) athāpīti | evaṃ bādhābhāve'pi jñānaṃ jñānāntareṇa nāśyata iti pakṣaśceta tarhi sarveṣāṃ satyatvenābhimatānāṃ ghaṭapaṭādijñānānāmapīyameveti anyonyabādhaiva saraṇiriti kriñcideveti (-) kāni cidbādhyāni kānicidbādhakānīti kathaṃsyāt |
evaṃ parokṣe jñānānāmeva bādhyabādhaka bhāvā bhāvatvaṃ pradarśyasvapakṣa
eva tadbādhyabādhaka bhāva mupapannamityāha (-) yadā tu bhūtapūrvaṃ rajatajñānaṃ tadanantaraṃ śukti jñānaṃ caikatra pramātṛrūpe svasaṃvedane viśrāmyataḥ tadetadbādhya bādhakabhāvatvamupapadyata iti pratipādayati (-) tathā hīti | eka pramātṛtatve visrāmyatāmapi jñānānāmekaprakārā na bhavati sā viśrāntirvicitrarūpaivasaṃvedyate | tadvicitrarūpatvameva darśayati (-) nīlamityutpalamiti ca jñānadvayaṃ tayornīlotpalayorviśeṣaṇaparasparoparāgābhāsena pramātariviśrāmyati(,) ghaṭa iti paṭa iti jñāneparasparānāśleṣeṇa viśrāmyatāmanyonyasaṃbandhādiyaṃ śuktikārajatamiti ca rajata jñānāntarābhā vijñānadvayaṃ bhūtapūrvasya rajatamiti jñānasyonmūlanaṃ sā bhitticitranyāyena kṣīyeti tadrajatajñānaviṣayarajata vimarśātmaka pramātṛrūpa vyāpārānuvartanasya vidhvaṃsaṃ kurvat pramātari pratiṣṭhāṃ bhajate |
evaṃ dhūmāgnyādirūpayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādau idaṃ kāryamidaṃ kāraṇamiti tatkārya (---------------) tmaka prameyā saṃbhavi pramātrāsvatantreṇa nirmitaṃ tat evāsya pramāṇe svatantra dāyi viśrānti vaicitryaṃ vācyam | evamukta prakāreṇa ekatra pramātari idaṃ rajatamiti pūrvajñānasya parivarjaneneyaṃ śuktiriti vartamānasya jñānasya yato niścitāsthitḥ tat itiḥ eka pramātṛviśrāntyāsthiterniścitatvāt jñānānāṃ bādhyabādhaka bhāva upapannaḥ nīlādīn yathā sṛjati tathā tatsaṃbandhino bādhyabādhaka bhāva vyavahārānapi sa eva parameśvara svātantryādābhāsayatīti te'pi satyā eva |
atra bādhyabādhaka bhāvātmani vyavahāre ekapramātrāvinā paścādbhāviśukti jñānamevabhūtapūrvarajata jñānāntarasyā pramāṇatvavedakamiti vivikta bhūtalamita (---------------) dṛṣṭāntapurassaraṃ parakīyaṃ matamāśaṃkate uparitanaiḥ ślokairdūṣayiṣyāmīti | ghaṭavivikta bhūtalajñānaṃ yathā ghaṭābhāvapratīti sādhakaṃ tathā paścādbāvi bhūtapūrvarūpya jñānā pramāṇatva vedanamiti ca (---------) (------) pramātṛviśrāntyā iti sūtrasaṅgatiḥ |
iti śuktikājñānamapyanapekṣaṃ svayameva saṃbhavat svātmanaḥ svasvarūpeṇābhinnaṃ pramāṇatvaṃ budhyate tatparicchinattīti nyāyāt taditi śuktikārūpaṃ vedyaṃ paricchinattīti nyāyādviṣaya (---------------) to (-) (--------------) ta jñānasyavyavaccheda iti | tadayuktam | śukti jñānasya śuktisaṃvedanā bhinna pramāṇatvavedanaṃ yattadeva bhūtapūrvasya rajata jñānasyāpramāṇatvavedanamucyate | ghaṭātmaka stvanantarajñānameva | ghaṭa rūpa stvanantarābhāva jñānamityeta (--------) pūrva (------) viviktabhūbhāgajñānaneva ghaṭābhāvajñānamiti prasiddhametat śukti jñānakṛtaṃ rajata jñānaṃ pratyapramāṇatā saṃvedanameva rajata jñānasya bādhakamucyate tajjñānayorbādhyabādhakatvam | evamuktaprakāramiti cet asmābhiriti jñānasantānameva sautrā ityukta nītyā jñānamevātmeti vādibhirucyate | jñānānāṃ kiṃ pramātraikyeneti | atreti bādhyabādhakabhāva prasaṅgāt abhāva vyavahāra siddhau svarūpamupapādayiṣyan viviktabhūtalajñānamityuktaṃ dṛṣṭāntameva prathamaṃ dūṣayati viviktabhūtalajñānaṃ ghaṭābhāvamitiryathā iti | naivamiti yo dṛṣṭānta uktaḥ sa evaṃ na kathamiti cet (-) ucyate śuddhasthala jñānāditi | ghaṭaviviktabhūbhāga jñānāttasya bhūtalasyāghaṭātmatā paṭarūpatā siddhyet | bhūtale na ghaṭa ityetā tāvadeva siddhyati | atra bhūtale upalabdhiyogyasya cākṣuṣa pratyakṣeṇa darśanārdasya ghaṭasyātmanaḥ ghaṭasvarūpasyā bhāvo'pi na sidhyatyeva | ekapramātrā vinā śuktikājñānameva rajata jñānatvavedanaṃ bhavatītyetad dārṣṭāntikaṃ pratiyodṛṣṭānta uktaḥ sa eva na kuta iti cet | ucyate | kadācid ghaṭo na paṭa iti vat bhūtalaṃ na ghaṭa iti tādātmyenā bhāvo vyavahartavyaḥ kadācidiha bhūtale ghaṭo neti vyatirekeṇā bhāvo vyavahartavyaḥ | atreti abhāva dvaya śuddha bhūtala jñānādādyaḥ bhūtalaṃ na ghaṭa iti tādātmyarūpeṇābhāva vyavahāraḥ sidhyati | yatra niṣedhyasya ghaṭādi vastunaḥ cakṣurjñānaviṣayī kārya pṛthubudhnodarākārādino payogi sa tādātmyābhāva vyavahāraḥ | yasyapiśā ca
bhūtādeḥ svabhāvabalāt sṛṣṭibalāt darśanayogyā prāptirnāsti tasyāpi svata eva tādātmyenābhāvo vyavahartavyaḥ bhūtalaṃ na piśācādīti | athavā bhūtale yasya śabdāde statkṛtā ghaṭā bhāvamitiryatheti yodṛṣṭānta uktaḥ sa eva na yuktaḥ | śabdādi grāhakaika śrotratvagādīndriyajñāna saṃsargiśabdādivastvantara <261> sannidhānābhāvenāniścayaḥ | tasyāpi śabdādestādātmyenā bhāvo vyavahāryaḥ(,) bhūtalaṃ na śabdādiriti yatrabhūtale niṣedhyasya vastunaḥ dṛśyatvarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇamavaśyamupayogi tatreha bhūtale na ghaṭaḥ na śabdaityādinā vyatirekeṇā bhāvo vyavahartavye naiṣatādātmya vyavahāro'bhyupāyona bhavati cet atiprasaṅgāditi brūmaḥ |
ati prasaṅgo nāma paṭevidyamāne'pi bhūtalasya ghaṭaviviktatvameva | bhāvānāmanyonya vyamiśraṇābhāvāt | kiñca ghaṭe'vidyamāne'pi bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti vaktumaśakyam | tadetaditi | ati prasaṅgatvamevadarśayati (-) śaśvāditi | vidyamāne'pi ghaṭe bhūtalaṃ ghaṭaviviktameva bhāvānāmiti bhūtala ghaṭādīnāṃ svātmaniṣṭhiteḥ nijanija svarūpa niṣṭhitatvādanyonya vyāmiśraṇā bhāvāt taditi vidyamāne'pi ghaṭe bhūtalasya viviktatvāt jñānamiti ghaṭa viviktabhūbhāgajñānaṃ jātviti kasyāñcidghaṭā saṃnidhānarūpāyāṃ daśāyāmeva | bhinnasyeti | bhūtalādbhinnasya ghaṭasyā bhāvāt | sādhanamiti abhāvaṃ sādhayatīti katham | paṭasannidhāne'pi bhūtala(---------------) nahibhāvāmiśrībhavanti | bhūtalaghaṭayoranyonyaṃ vyāmiśraṇā bhāvāt | tataśceti | tasmāt | tadāpīti | ghaṭasya vidyamānatve'pi viviktabhūtala jñānamastīti satyapi ghaṭe atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti vyatirekeṇa (---------------) tatajjñānamiti (-) ghaṭavivikta bhūtalajñānam | jātviti kasyāṃcidghaṭā sannidhāna rūpāyāṃ daśāyāmeva bhūtalādbhinnasya ghaṭasyābhāvaṃ sādhayatīti kena prakāreṇa bhavet | ghaṭāsannidhāna daśāyāmapi atrabhūtale (---------------) syādityā <262> patitamiti mantavyam | bhūtale ghaṭasya sannidhāne'pi bhūtalaghaṭayoranyonyaṃ vyāmiśraṇā bhāvāt atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti vaktuṃ yuktam | ghaṭā saṃnidhāne tu
ghaṭasyādarśanādiha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyetadapina (---------------) tamityarthaḥ |
nanu vyatiriktaiti bhūtale ghaṭe vidyamāne bhūtalaṃ viviktamityuktam | tathā pīhabhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti vyatirikta vastvabhāvaniṣṭho vyavahāraḥ kasyāṃcidghaṭā sannidhānarūpāyāmavasthāyāṃ dṛśyate sarvairavinītayenānubhūtam | tatrakāgatirityāśaṃkya cirantanairakṣapādaprabhṛtibhirapi dṛṣṭamabhāva vyavahāra siddhiṃ prakāraṃ darśayati (-) kiṃtvityādi | atreti | ghaṭavivikte bhūtale cakṣuṣmata stāvat cakṣurgrāhya ādityāloka cayo'sti | andhasyāndha tamasa sthitasya ca tvagindriya viṣayaḥ ghaṭocita kaṭina sparśa viviktaḥ mṛduḥ uṣṇādikasparśo'sti vā śabda sūcita śrotrādīndriyagrāhyaḥ śabdādirapyasti | tasyāloka ca yasya sparśādeścāyamālokaḥ ayaṃ sparśa ityādinā nyaghaṭādivivikte svena rūpeṇa jñānaṃ yat tajjñānamaghaṭātmatāmiti iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti bhūtala vyatiriktaghaṭābhāvaṃ sādhayatyeva | tatra bhūtale tattadindirya viṣayaikaikavastu sadbhāvamavalambyānyasya ghaṭābhāvasyābhāvograhītuṃ śakya ityarthaḥ |
ghaṭā bhāva eva ghaṭādibhāvāntarasyā bhāvā iti vyavahartavyaḥ ityayaṃ pratīkaḥ panthāḥ pratītisiddhaḥ sarvavādibhiraparityājyaḥ | tatreti | evaṃ vidhepaci bhāvasya ghaṭāderbhāvāntareṇa bhūtalena saha ca ādhāryādhāra bhāvarūpa saṃbandhaḥ sa eva bhāva tadabhāvayoriti bhāvasya bhūtalasya tadabhāvaghaṭābhāvarūpasya śivādeścobhayorapyādhāryādhārabhāvaḥ | tataśceti | eva mādhāryādhārabhāvavedite <263> ghaṭādi vyatirikte bhūtale śilādikaṃ vā tasya darśane āloka puñjādikaṃ vā yaccākṣuṣe jñāne bhāti tadeva śilādikaṃ bhūtale ghaṭā bhāva iti kriyā parāmarśā bhāvena vā bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyabhāva kriyāparāmarśa sadbhāvena vā vyavahriyate | yatra bhūtale netranimīlane santamasādau sati cakṣurvyāpāro nāsti tatrāpi cakṣurvyāpāra gocare bhūtale ghaṭo cita kaṭhina sparśa vinābhūtaṃ mṛdūṣṇādisparśaṃ gṛhṇan taṃ sparśameva ghaṭābhāva iti vyavaharati | sarvagasyeti | sarvadeśakālagatasya vāyusparśasya tatra bhūtale'vaśyaṃ bhāvāditi ślokasya piṇḍitārthaḥ | padārthastu
vyākriyate | kiṃ tviti śabdaḥ svamate | pakṣepaviśeṣadyotakaḥ | kintvitye tat svamato pakṣepāyeti svasiddhānta sthāpanāya svapratibhāṃ prativaktīkṛtya tayā saha sūtrakarasya kiṃ punaratra nyāyyamiti praśnarūpaḥ parāmarśaḥ ityevaviśeṣadyotakasya kiṃtvityasya padasyārthaḥ | tatreti | evaṃ bhūte praśnaparāmarśe svayamevāha (-) tatreti | ghaṭaviviktebhūtale cakṣuṣmataḥ svacakṣurgrāhyālokacayastāvadastīti jñeyaḥ andhasyāndhatamasasthitasya coṣṇādi sparśo nāsti | tasyālokasparśādeḥsvena rūpeṇeti tadeka grāhakeṇa ayamālokaḥ ayaṃ sparśa ityādirūpaṃ jñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ kartṛbhūtvā tasyālokādeḥ aghaṭarūpatāṃ ghaṭābhāva rūpatām | tatra bhūtale sādhayatīti śilādi jñānameva śilāderghaṭādyabhāvarūpatāṃ sādhayatītyarthaḥ | sādhayituṃ śakyo bhavati |
evaṃ śilādyālokādyabhāva eva ghaṭādibhāva ityuktvā śabdarasāderabhāvo'pi tadanyaśabdarasāderbhāva eveti vaktumāha (-) ucchvāsa niśvāsātmaka bahiḥ spandaḥ parispanda vyatiriktāntara prāṇaparispandajanita svīya sūkṣmaśabdākarṇanāt <264> śrotrādi sāmagrī sākalyamiti śrotrendriyasya śabdagrahaṇasāmagrī sākalyamastīti saṃbhāvayamānastamevāntaraṃ śabdaṃ śrāvaṇarūpaikajñāna saṃsargiṇaṃ gṛhṇan tadanyaṃ bāhyaṃ śabdaṃ niṣedhayati | tatrāntara eva śabdo'stina bāhya iti tadāntarasūkṣmaśabdābhāvamadhi (---------------) sūkṣmāntaṃ nādopahita śrotrasūkṣmatamaḥ śabda evāsti sūkṣmaḥ śabdo nāstītyabhavaṃ vedayate | evaṃ rasāntarā bhāvāt tattadbāhya śabdādyabhāva grahaṇasamaye tadānīmeva svakīya śabdādeva śrotrādīndiryajñānaṃ bhavati (---------------) nijanijarūpavyatirikta vastvantarā sparśināpi svakīyaṃ daṃtodakarasamanubhavan dantodakarasa evāsti nānya iti vedayate | evaṃ rasāntarābhāvamapi svakīyaṃ trijpuṭitabhāvaṃ jighrat svakīya tripuṭikāgandha evāsti nānya iti vedayate | evaṃ svakīya kāyīya sparśaṃ sa eva dadhat sparśāntaraṃ nāstīti vedayate | ekaiḥ śrautādi jñānasaṃsargayogyaśabdādivastvantaropalaṃbhena (---------------) śabdādyupalabdhikāraṇasya
p 205> śrautādikaraṇavargasya taditaraśabdādyabhāva niścayonāstītyekānta eṣaḥ | tasmādekaika śabdādikaṃ gṛhītvā śabdādivastvantarasyābhāvo vaktuṃ śakya ityarthaḥ |
anantara pravṛttena śabdādiviṣayānubhavenāstītikalpitasya śrotrādikaraṇa vargasya tadaiva dhvaṃsanāśaṃ sanādanyaśabdādyabhāva grahaṇa sā kalya niścayo'styeva | tattadvācyaśabdādyabhāvagrahaṇasamaye svakīye'syaśabdāṃśe svakīyaśrotrādīndriyarūpaika bhūḥ kimiti cet etatpariharati (-)neti | tattacchabdādyabhāvopalipsurhiprayatnena tattacchabdādi grahaṇa hetubhūtaṃ tattacchrotrādīndriyādhiṣṭhānaṃ vyāpārayanneva lakṣyate |
<265> nanviti | na kevalaṃ śrotrādīndriya viṣayasya śabdādereva vyatirekeṇa niṣedhaṃ vyavahāraḥ prāptaḥ | yāvadadṛśyasyāpi piśācādervyatirekeṇāpi niṣedhavyavahāraḥ prāpnoti | kathamiti cet | sa bhūtalagata āloka puñjo yathā ghaṭādanyastadvat piśācāderapyanya iti tamāloka puñjaṃ gṛhītvātra bhūtale piśāco nāstīti vaktuṃ yuktamityāśaṃkyāha (-) piśācaḥ syādityādi | anālokaḥ ālokādanyo'pi piśācaḥ indriyagocaratvādadṛśyo bhūtvā bhūtalāntare bhātīti syāt(,) saṃbhāvyate tadvadālokasyāntare so'stīti saṃbhāvyata eva sapiśācaḥ adṛśyo bhūtvā bhūtalasyāntarvartamānatvādatra piśāco nāstīti yathā aniṣedhyaḥ tathā lokābhyantare piśācasyāstitvāt tatrāpyaniṣedhyaḥ | evaṃ sarvatheti | bhūtalaṃ na ghaṭa ityādi tādātmya bhāva vyavahāraḥ sarvatra yathā svataḥ siddhastadvat piśācāderapīti bhavaduktanītyā ālokapuṃjo yadyapi piśācādvyatiriktastathā yadyapi apiśācātmā āloko nāstītitādātmyarūpabhāvaḥ sidhyati | atra tathāpi atrālokamadhye piśāco nāstītyetadaśakya madhyavasitum | ghaṭo hyālokapūramadhye piśāca vadadṛśyo na saṃbhāvyaḥ | kathamiti cet ghaṭe vidyamāne tatra ghaṭādhiṣṭhite bhūtale tadbhūtala gatālokapūrāpasarpaṇāt | ataśceti | ālokapūramadhye ghaṭasyāsaṃbhāvyatvāt | atrālokapūramadhye ghaṭonāstīti
siddhyatīdaṃyaḥ piśācastu bhūtalamadhya ālokamadhye'pi vā bhavan ghaṭavattāmālokapūra nibiḍitā na pratihanti satādṛgvidhasvabhāva iti yataḥ tataśceti tanniviḍitā pratihananā bhāvādālokamadhye tasya piśācasyā saṃbhāvanādatra piśāco nāstīti kathaṃ vyatirekeṇa niṣedha vyavahāraḥ | evaṃ cakṣurindriyaviṣayabhūta dugdhādigata rūpamadhye rasanendriya viṣayasya rasādeḥ saṃbhāvanādrūperasagandhādirnāstīti <266> vyatirekeṇa niṣedhaḥ kartumaśakyaḥ |
evaṃ tātparyamuktvā padaśovyākhyāti(-) yadyapītyādi | tadvadālokasyāpyabhyantareso'stīti saṃbhāvyata ityetadantaṃ sūtrayojanāmeva vyākhyātam | tataśceti | ālokābhyantare'pi piśācasya saṃbhāvanādālokaḥ piśācādanyaḥ ityanena tādātmyarūpeṇa yathā niṣiddhaḥ piśācaḥ tathāpi sarvaprakāreṇeti atrapiśāconāstīti rekeṇāpi na niṣiddha iti piśācādyabhāvaniviḍa vāsanā vyavahārāḥ tatra bhūtale kathaṃ pravartantām | iti ślokārthaḥ |
evaṃ bādhya bādhakabhāva vyavahāra prasaṃgāt kiṃ tvālokacaya ityādinā bādhyabādhaka ityādinā āloka caya ityantena prasaṅgāgatā bhāvavyavahāraparamārthaṃ pradarśya naivaṃ śuddhasthala jñānādityardhena prakṛte premeye tādātmyabhāvaṃ yojayati (-) evamiti | yathā ālokādi jñānaṃ ghaṭābhāva jñānarūpaṃ evaṃ śuktimati śukti jñānaṃ rūpyajñānābhāvarūpaṃ bhavet | na tu bhūta pūrvāyā rajata jñapteraprāmāṇyavedikā syāt | yathā āloka eva ghaṭā bhāvarūpa ityāloke gṛhīte tenālokena prāgghaṭasya vidyamāna daśāyāṃ na tena ghaṭajñānena gṛhītasya ghaṭasya kiṃcidāyātam | tadvādhāyāṃ prasaṅge'pi nāyātaḥ | evamiti | tathā śuktikā jñānaṃ rūpya jñānaṃ na bhavatīti yat (----------------------) na ghaṭa jñānaṃ svātmanā svayameva svaviṣayabhūtaghaṭajñāna prāmāṇya saṃvittadānīmeva vartamānaḥ paṭajñānābhāvaḥ paṭajñānābhāva prāmāṇyaṃ saṃvit iyaveti ghaṭajñānena paṭābhāvajñānena ca pūrvaṃ pra(----------------------) bhavati | ayaṃ ghaṭa iti ayaṃ ghaṭajñānacintā ayaṃ paṭonāstīti paṭajñānābhavaciṃtā
<267> cetyeṣā sarvā ghaṭajñāna svarūpa cintā | anayā pūrvapravṛttasya paṭa jñānasya kiṃ jātaṃ na kimapītyarthaḥ | evaṃ śuktiriyamiti na rajatamiti (-----------) krameṇāhaṃ śuktau pramāṇam | ahaṃ rajatābhāve pramāṇamityevaṃ svātmanā svayameva prakāśatāṃ tāvateti | tajjñāna dvayamātreṇa bhūta pūrvasya rajata jñānasya na kiñcidapi bādhanaṃ pravṛttamiti tatprāktana rajatajñāna viṣayī kṛtaṃ rajataṃ kathaṃ satyaṃ syāt | jñātrāvinā jñānānāmeva bādhyabādhaka vyavahāro na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
evaṃ śuktijñānena rajata jñānasya pratyakṣatobādhanaṃ bhavatītyuktvā dvayorapi jñānayoreka pramātṛ viśrāntyā vinānumānato'pi paścādbādhā na bhavatītyetat samarthayitumāha (-) nanviti | idamiti vartamānedantāśukti kameka pramātṛviśrāṃtyāvinā parāmarśena tatpūrvānubhūtaṃ vedyaṃ parāmṛśyate |
yatredaṃ rajatamiti rajata jñānamabhūt tatraiva viṣaye idānīṃ na rajatamiti śuktiriti ca jñānadvayaṃ pramāṇabhūtaṃ jātam | taditi tayo statraiva viṣaye pramāṇabhūtatvāt | ataḥ jñānadvitayāt prācyaṃ rajata jñānamapramāṇamityanumīyate | rajata viṣayāvagāhi rajatajñānaṃ śuktiviṣayāvagāhiśuktijñānaṃ caikatraviṣaye bhavatītyetanna saṃbhavatyeva | taditi ekasminviṣaye jñānadvayā bhāvāt ānubhaviko bādha vyavahāraḥ śukti jñānena rajata jñānasya bhaviṣyatītyāśaṃkyāha (-) na kevalaṃ svasaṃvedanāt pratyakṣata eva śuktijñāne rajatajñānasya bādhā na sidhyati | yāvadanumānato'pi na sidhyati | śuktijñānakāle prācyasya rūpyabodhasya dharmiṇo siddhe tasmin rūpyajñāne dharmiṇyaprāmāṇyaṃ sādhyodharmaḥ śukti natvād vā <268> na rajatamiti jñānatvād vā niṣayagataṃ tajjñānaviṣayīkāryatvāt vā hetū kriyeta yatra yatra rajata jñānaṃ tatra tatrā prāmāṇyamityanumānato'pi na bādhā svasaṃvedana siddheti iyaṃ śuktirnarajatamityavyavadhānena tadānīmeva pratyakṣataḥ siddhā eka pramātṛjā cetyuktā tayoḥ śukti rajata jñānayoreka pramātṛviśrāntau idaṃ śuktijñānaṃ pramāṇabhūtaṃ bhūta pūrvaṃ rajatajñānaṃ pramāṇamityevaṃ rūpā bādhā na siddhyati |
prāco rūpyabodhodharmī aprāmāṇyaṃ bhavitumarhati | tasya dharmiṇa idānīṃ śuktikā jñānatvānnarajatamiti jñānatvādvā tadubhaya jñāna viṣayavatvādvāhetutrayaṃ yatra yatra viṣaye śuktikājñānādi tatra tatrā prāmāṇyamityapi śabdāddhetorvāpteścā siddheranumānato'pi bādhā svasaṃvedanasiddheti iyaṃ śuktirnarajatamityavyavadhānena tadānīmeva pratyakṣataḥsiddhā sā bādhā eka pramātṛjā yukteti eka pramātṛjā cetyuktvā tayoḥ śukti rajata jñānayoreka pramātṛviśrānteḥ idaṃ śuktijñānaṃ pramāṇabhūtaṃ bhūtapūrvaṃ rajatajñānaṃ pramāṇamityevaṃ rūpā bādhā sidhyati | apiranumāne hetu vyāptyośca neyaḥ |
iheti | loke dharmiṇi sati smaryamāṇa vyāptikena siddhena hetunā tasmin dharmiṇi sādhyadharmā saṃbaṃdha vyavacchedo'numāna vyāpāraḥ | iha bhavadukte anumāne tasya dharmiṇaḥ sādhyama prāmāṇyātmakaṃ dharmaṃ pratidharmaṃ pratitā sādhako hetuḥ śuktijñānādi | tatkāle śuktikā jñānakāle(,) prāpyasya rūpyabodhasya dharmiṇo bhāvāt tasya rūpyabodhasya dharmiṇa idānīntanāḥ śuktijñānādayo dharmāḥ rupyabodhātmakapakṣā dharmāddhetoḥ sādhyasiddhirna bhavati | smaryamāṇaṃ tadrūpajñānaṃ dharmisyāt ityapyasat | tatrāpi hetorapakṣatvena sādhyā siddheḥ | idānīṃ śuktiḥ rajatajñānasya <269> viṣayo na bhavatītyetat siddhameva na sādhyam | rajata jñānakāle tasya rajatajñānasya śukti viṣayo bhavatīti sādhyate tadā tatpūrvarajata svasaṃvedane śuktijñānena sādhyaviṣayatā yatra viṣaye idānīmanyajñānaṃ tatra pūrvamanyajñānaṃ na bhavatītīyaṃ vyāptiḥ kena gṛhītā | pramāturanaṅgīkārāt pramātā mābhūt uktavyāptiranumānāntareṇa gṛhīteti cet tasyāpyanumānāntarāpekṣayā navasthā | etenaika pramātrā vinā vyāptergṛhītumaśakyatvena hetu (---------) (-------------) kathaṃ jñānadvayaṃ syādityetat pratyuktam | tayoḥ śuktirajata jñānayorekaviṣayatāṃ ko jānīyāt | ubhayakālānubhūtamātrabhavāt | tarhi śukti rajatajñāne jñānāṃśurūpe svātmani śuktirajatarūpe svaviṣayeca viśrāmyatītya (----------------------)iti pramātrā vinā kevalaṃ śuktijñānaṃ na
rajatajñānasyānumānato'pi na bādhā | tatreti (-) nedaṃ rajatamiyaṃ śuktiriti bādhā pratītau anumāna yogyaṃ vyāptigrahaṇādi vyavadhānaṃ na saṃcetyate nedaṃ rajatamiyaṃ śuktiriti pratyakṣeṇaiva (---) (-------------------)saṃvedana siddhatayā jhaṭitibhāsamānādeva bādhāmābhūdityetadapyaśakyaṃ vaktum |
evaṃ bādhyabādhaka bhāvasya parapakṣe jñānasantānameva tatvamiti saugatā ityukta nītyā jñānasantānamātrātmavādi saugatapakṣe evamanupapattiṃ pradarśyaika pramātṛ (----------------------) va iti vākyena pratijñātaṃ svapakṣaṃ nigamayati sā bādhā ekasmāt pramāturyadi jāyeta tadānīmeva yuktedaṃ śuktijñānaṃ satyaṃ idaṃ rajatajñānamasatyaṃ iti pramātaiva nīlādivatkila tānapi bādhyabādhaka rūpān vyavahārān nirmātīti vyākhyātam | evaṃ sthite (----------------------) ka bhāva eka pramātrā yatta <270> ityevaṃ sthite sati etadbādhyabādhakabhāva vyavahārasiddhaye anyathānupapattiḥ satya jñānenā satyajñānasya bādhānaṅgīkāre bādhyabādhaka bhāva vyavahārānupapattirityucyate tacyatāṃ kāmam | adhunaika pramātraṅgīkāre sarvaṃ bādhyabādhaka bhāvasatyatvā satyatvādi sidhyati |
