svacchaṃ viśvapratibimbana kṣamaṃ bhavati | tatra śivādikṣityanta viśvātmaka bhedarūpatā viśvabhedagrahaṇe sva svarūpāparityāgenā bhedarūpatā copapadyate | sarva pramātṝṇāmanubhavādeva hi svacchasya tattad ghaṭapaṭādi bimbapratibimbanakṣamasyā darśādeḥ svāntaḥ pratibimbita parvata mataṅgajādi rūpa sahasrasaṃbhinnamapi vapurakhaṇḍita svasvabhāvamupalabhyate | śuktiṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā varṇasāmyenedaṃ rajatamitibhrāntyā pratīyamānaṃ rajata makṣi rogādayaṃ dvicandra iti <431> pratīyamānodvicandraśca yathā śuktikaika candrasvarūpatirodhānena vartate yathā darpaṇe pratīyamānaṃ parvatādi darpaṇasvarūpatirodhānānnavartate darpaṇasyaiva hi yathā vabhāsa iti parvatamataṅgajādi saṃbhinne avabhāse'pi darpaṇavadaprakāśa pradatvāddarpaṇataiva sutarāmunmīlati | ayaṃ darpaṇaḥ nirmalaḥ parvatādi sarvapadārthapratibimabanakṣamaḥ ye ye pratibimbanakṣamāḥ sphaṭikasalilādayaḥ tebhyaḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ śuddhaḥ saṃskāreṇa śodhita ityālokayatāṃ pramātṝṇāmabhimānāt bāhyodūragataḥ parvataḥ parvataḥ svayamāgatya tatradarpaṇe na hisaṃkrāmati | tathā cedasya parvatasya svadeśatyāgaprasaṅgaḥ | asau parvataḥ asya darpaṇamadhaḥ kṛtya tata upari na bhāti | tadānīṃ darpaṇānavabhāsa prasaṃgāt | na ca madhya iti | asau parvataḥ darpaṇamanupraviśya tadgarbhe na bhavati | nibiḍakaṭhinasya taṭaśikharatartvādi pratighasahitasya tatrānupraveśaṃ saṃbhāvanā bhāvāt | na ca paścāditi parvata āgatyādarśasyādhobhāgena bhāti | tatrādarśanāddūrataḥ svasthāna eva bhāsanāccabāhyaḥ parvataḥ darpaṇena saṃkrāmati kevalaṃ cākṣuṣāmayūravā darpaṇapatanotpalitāḥ tataḥ pratyāvṛttyā bahiḥ sthitaṃ parvatameva gṛhṇātītyapi na bhavati | biṃbapratibiṃbayorapīti | bahiḥ sthitasya bimbarūpasya parvatasya darpaṇāntargatasya pratibimbarūpasya parvatasya ca parvata pārśvasthāpitānya darpaṇāntāvalokanāt | tasmāddarpaṇasya nirmalatā māhātmyametat | tasmāddarpaṇasya parvatamataṅgajādyanantāvabhāsagrahaṇe'pi bādhārahitamekatvaṃ dūre ca giri | śikharopavartinaḥ pramāturekatrāhamiti bodhe nagara grāmādi gata sarva padārtha saha sva mavabhāsata iti |
cidrūpasyaiva viśvāvabhāsanakartṛtvamupapannam | svayamabhinnasyaikasyaiva <432> śivādikṣityanta bhedāveśasahiṣṇutvena tannirmātṛtārūpa kriyāśaktyāveśasadbhāvāt | uktametat (-)
eṣa cānanta śaktitvā devamābhāsayatyamun | bhāvānicchā vaśādeṣā kriyā nirmātṛtāsya sā || iti |
nanviti etāvatīti | cinmātreṇarūpeṇāhamiti svātantryātmakavimarśaśūnyaṃ brahmarūpaṃ vijñānameva imāmiti | śivādikṣityantāṃ viśvarūpatāvaicitrīṃ parigṛhṇātu na nu ca(,) nanu ca tadviśvarūpatā parigrahe īśvara eva sarvatrakartā ahaṃ ca sa eveti proktā yā jñāna kriyā lakṣaṇa mīśitāyāḥ ityuktanītyā jñānakriyā svātantrya lakṣaṇāyā īśvaratāyāḥ kalpanena kimityāśaṃkyāha (-) brahmaṇaḥ prakāśamānarūpe cidekatve vāstave'pyābhāsa bhinnayo riti | svena svena karmarūpeṇa jaḍātmanākartṛrūpeṇa cidātmanā bhāsena bhinnayoḥ kriyamāṇakartṛrūpayoḥ sthāvarajaṃgamayoḥ saṃbandhinīti kriyāvicikīrṣālakṣaṇaika parāmarśaṃ vineti (-) cikīrṣārūpeṇa svābhinaścātmasaṃsthasya bhāvajātasya bhāsanam || ityuktanītyā svāntaḥ sthitaśivādikṣityantabhāvavargabedaparāmarśena vinānasyāt |
yadivā proktenābhāsena bhinnau yau jaḍacetanau tayoḥ saṃbaṃdhinī yā cikīrṣā ityamāṇeṣitṛtā rūpā tāccitṛtā rūpā tāccikīrṣā svabhāvaḥ parāmarśaṃ vinākriyā na syāt | kiñcota proktenābhāsa bhinnayoścetana jaḍayoḥ saṃbandhīkrameṇāhamidamitiyaḥ parāmarśaḥ ekapramātariviśrāntirūpaḥ cikīrṣā taṃ parāmarśaṃ <433> vinā kriyā na syāt | athavā proktena bhāsena bhinnayorjaḍacetanayoḥ saṃbandhinam |
yadahaṃ bhāvaḥ puṃsāmidamaha mava bhāsamātmasāt kurute | ityuktanītyā ahamityeka parāmarśaṃ vinā cikīrṣā lakṣaṇa kathaṃ kriyā syāt | evaṃ cikīrṣāṃ parāmarśaṃ vāpekṣyābhāsabhinnayoriti ṣaṣṭhī ābhāsabhinnayoriti nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ | vimarśo hi nāma viśvā kāreṇa viśvaprakāśanena viśvasaṃhāreṇa vā akṛtrimāhamiti sphuraṇam | ityuktavimarśaśūnya
prakāśa mātra rūpasya brahmaṇaḥ svātmanyekatvaṃ vāstavaṃ yadi pṛthvyādi rūpo'yaṃ bhedaḥ avidyopaplavādityucyate tadā sā vavidyopaplavaḥ tasya saṃbandhīti na saṅgacchate | vidyaikarūpasya brahmaṇaḥ kathamavidyārūpatā saṃbhavet | brahma vyatirekeṇa jīvajaḍādivastuto nāsti | yasyāvidyā bhavet | anirvācye yamavidyeti cediti iyamevaṃ vidheti vaktumaśakyā cet tarhikasyānirvācyeti na vidmaḥ | brahmavyatirekeṇa kasya cidapya bhāvādavidyeti kāci svarūpeṇabhāti | athāpyanirvācyeti kimetadbhātyaviyuktyā nopapadyata iti cet saṃvedanatiraskāriṇī kā khaluyuktirnāmeti prakāśamānāyā avidyāyāḥ prakāśamānatvatiraskāriṇī kākhaluyuktirnāmabhāsamānasyāvidyāsvarūpasya paścādanupapattiśca kānyābhaviṣyati |
pakṣāntaramāha (-) avikalpakebodhe | oṃ tatsaditinirdeśo brahmaṇāstrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ ityuktanītyā sadrūpaṃ brahmābhinnaṃ cakāsthi | vikalpabalāttvayaṃ <344> viśvātmako bheda iti cet tadānīmayaṃ vikalpavyāpāraḥ kasya saṃbandhī bhavati | avikalparūpasya brahmaṇaḥ vikalpa vyāpāro bhavati ceda vidyāyogo bhavati | brahmavyatirekeṇa vikalpa vyāpāravān na kaścijjīvādirasti | avikalpakaṃ brahmasatyaṃ vikalpaṃ tu viśvaṃmasatyamiti kutovibhāgaḥ | ubhayorapi bhāsamānatvasyāviśeṣāt | bhāsamāno'pi viśvātmako'yaṃ brahmarūpeṇānena bādhata iti cet | abhedo'pyayaṃ bhedābhāsanena tasya bādhāt loke yasya ca bhāsamānatvādevaṃ nānyata iti tatkārī bhedo'pi bhāsamāna iti mūlabhūtābhāsamānā avidyākathamavadhīryāḥ | ayamabhedaḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ sādhayitu maśakyaḥ | kevala bhāgamaika pramāṇa iti cet āgamo'pi pramātṛ pramāṇa prameya vibhāgātmaka viśva nirūpaṇa hetu bhūtatvāt bhedātmaka eva vastu bhuta iti na kiñcidetat | tasmād brahmaṇo vāstavaṃ cidekatvamabhyupagamyāpi tasya
viśvakartṛtva lakṣaṇā na bhinna kṣityādi viśvarūpa samāveśātmikā kriyā nopapadyate | vimarśo hi nāma viśvākāreṇetyukta parāmarśalakṣaṇaṃ tasya svātantryaṃ yadi bhavati tadopapadyate | sarvamiti | sarvakartṛtva lakṣaṇa kriyā tatkāryaṃ ca viśvamapi bhavatītyarthaḥ | parāmarśo'hi viśvacikīrṣā icchā |
icchāyāṃ tava yasyaitat phalaṃ loka trayātmakam | tasya tenādhikāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ ||
iti śrī bhaṭṭanārāyaṇokta nītyā tasyāṃ parāmarśa rūpāyāmicchāyā mevanirmātavyaṃ śivādikṣityantaṃ viśvamantarabhedakalpanenāsta ityuktam | svāminaścātmasaṃsthasyetyatra | <435> tena prakāśamānatvāt svātmarūpamevaviśvaṃ tattadarthakriyākāritvāt satyarūpaṃ prakāśamānātmatā paramārthamatruṭitāhaṃ rūpa prakāśābheda prakāśamevasat prakāśaparamārthe naivedamiti bhedena prakāśayatimaheśvara iti tat evāti durghaṭakāritva lakṣaṇaṃ svātantryalakṣaṇamaiśvaryamityucyate | ābhāsabhinnayoriti ṣaṣṭhī kriyāpekṣā saṃbandhasāmānye vartate | paścādyathocitaṃ vibhajyate | svenābhāsena cidābhāsādbhinnaḥ jaḍābhāso ghaṭādiḥ karmarūpaḥ | tasmādbhinnāsścidābhāsaḥ kartṛradha iti tayoḥ saṃbandhinīkriyā ekasya ghaṭādeḥ kriyamāṇatvam | aparasya cidābhāsasya karṭtvamapi brahmaṇo nabhavet | icchārūpeṇa nirmātavya śivādikṣityanta bhavavargā bhedaparāmarśena vināsvayamekā cāsau kriyākathamanyonya bhinnayoḥ kriyamāṇa kartṛrūpayorjaḍacetanayoḥ kathaṃ svabhāvabhūtābhavet | āha (-) ekasya kriyamāṇatvamaparasya kartṛtvamiti kāryakāraṇatā prastāvāt kartṛkarmaṇī kārake ukte |
kriyā vimarśa viṣayaḥ kārakāṇāṃ samanvayaḥ |
ityuktanītyā kārakāntarāṇyapitu ekakartṛtvarūpa kriyānupraveśinī paramārthataḥ | anyathā karaṇādau kāraka vrāte kriyāto bhinnesātaiḥ kathamabhinnā yadivoktarūpeṇā bhāsena yau bhinnau jaḍacetanau tayoryācikīrṣā
ekasya ghaṭāderivyamāṇatā aparasyaiṣitṛtā tatsva bhāvamekatva parāmarśaṃ vinā kathaṃ kriyā syāditi |
yadi vā bhāsabhinnayoścetana jaḍayo rahamidamitiyaḥ parāmarśaḥ pūrṇāhantātmani pramātari viśrāntarūpaścikīrṣātmātaṃ vinā brahmaṇaḥ kathaṃ kriyā syāt | <436> proktābhāsabhinnayorjaḍacetanayo rahamityekatva parāmarśaṃ vinā taccikīrṣā lakṣaṇā kathaṃ kriyāsyāditi vā | evaṃ kriyāṃ cikīrṣāṃ proktaṃ dvividhaṃ parāmarśaṃ vāpekṣya ṣaṣṭhī ebhinityasāpekṣatvāccābhāsabhinnayoriti samāsaḥ |
etadāhnikoktaṃ prameyamupasaṃharati (-) itthaṃtayā ghaṭapaṭādyābhāsa jagadātmanā | tiṣṭhāso revabhicchaiva hetutā kartṛtā kriyā ||
jaḍasya tu na sā śaktiḥ ityādinā jaḍapradhāna paramāṇvādeviśvaṃ pratikāraṇatā na yuktā | jaḍavilakṣaṇasya cinmātrarūpasyetthaṃ bādhātmakatve'pi yeṣāṃ nottama kartṛteti vakṣyamāṇa nītyottama kartṛtā rahita svātaṃtrya rahitasya ata evānīśvarasya brahmaṇo'pi jagatkāraṇatā nokteti cetyuktaṃ yata ityamiti | anena prakāreṇa tathā tena tena janmasthityādi vikāsasahastreṇa yukta tattadghaṭapaṭādyābhāsa jagadātmanā tiṣṭhāsostattadrūpatayā sthātumicchoḥ parameśvarasya | evamiti | tiṣṭhā sā rūpe cchaiva śivādikṣityantaṃ viśvaṃ pratihetutā kartṛtā nirmātṛtārūpā kriyā | ityamiti | jaḍasya tu na sā śaktirityuktanītyāyato jaḍasya pradhāna paramāṇvāderviśvakartṛtārūpā na kāraṇatā vāstave'pi cidekatva ityukta nītyā | anīśvarasyeti | viśvasṛṣṭyādipañcakṛtyakāri svātantrya rahitasya cetanasya cinmātrarūpasya brahmaṇo'pi na kāraṇatā ityanena hetu prakāreṇedaṃ jātaṃ tat kimiti cet yadvastu yaḥ pramātā yathā cikīrṣuḥ tasyaiva sā cikīrṣā | eva mekākriyāsaiṣā sakramāntarbahiḥ sthitiḥ | ityuktanītyā <437> āntarāt saṃvidrūpāt bahiṣparyantatāṃ prāptā kriyetyabhidhīyate | saiva cikīrṣā kartṛtā taccikīrṣā rūpameva viśvaṃ pratihetutvaṃ cikīrṣāvyatirekeṇa kartṛtvādināsti | tena loke ghaṭāstiṣṭhatītyasyāyamarthaḥ ghaṭātmanātiṣṭhāsuḥ
svātantryāttadghaṭāvasthāna mabhyupa gacchan na tu tad ghaṭādi svarūpamasahamānaḥ śuddhaśaivādyabhimato yo maheśvara prakāśaḥ sa ghaṭādi rūpeṇa tiṣṭhatīti bhavati | ghaṭapaṭādyābhāsa rūpaṃ yat kila jagat tadātmanāyat tatheti tena tena tattajjagadgāta janma sthityādi bhāva vikāra tadbhedakriyāsahasrarūpeṇa casthā tu micchuḥ svatantra stasya tasya saṃbandhinī yā | evamiti | vicitrarūpecchā saivakriyeti saṃbandhaḥ | etadevecchāśaktiścottarottara mucchūnatayā kriyāśaktiparyantī bhavati | darśayiṣyāma iti pūrvamuktam | teneti | jaḍasya pradhānādestadvilakṣaṇasya cetanarūpasya brahmaṇo'pi kartṛtvābhāvānmaheśvara eva bhagavān viśvasya kartetiśivam |
[iti śrī pratyabhijñā sūtra vimarśinīvyākhyāyāṃ dvādaśamāhnikaṃ samāptam] ||
|| [kriyādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ] ||
[atha trayo daśamāhnikam] ||
<438> ahamahamityādi vimarśa nadī pravāhaḥ | kiñca tattatpramātṛgataghaṭapaṭādi jñānarūpo vimarśa nadī pravāhaḥ | kiñca garuḍa evāhamityādi bhāvanārūpeṇa tattadgāruḍādi rūpa tādātmyātmā yo vimarśa nadī pravāhaḥ | kiñcāyaṃ sadā śiva evaṃ rūpaḥ ayaṃ mantramaheśvaraḥ evaṃ rūpaḥ ayamantra evaṃ rūpaḥ(,) ayaṃ vijñānakālaḥ evaṃ rūpaḥ ayaṃ sakalaḥ evaṃ rūpaḥ ayaṃ tatprameyavargaḥ evaṃ rūpa iti śivādi sakalānta pramātṛ tatprameya pratipādana rūpaḥ paramaśivamukhoktaḥ śabda rūpoyaḥ āgamasindhuḥ eṣa sarvaḥ yaṃ bhairavaproktaṃ pūrṇāhantātmakam | abdhiḥ kevalaṃ ratnaughasāraḥ | ayaṃ paramāgamābdhiścintā ratnaughasāraḥ | tatrāpi śāmbhava svarūpa cintāratnaughasāraḥ | evaṃ bhūtaṃ paramāgamābdhiṃ prāpya tasminneva viśrāmya pūrṇatvamabhyeti | samudraprāptanadasaṃgha prāyeṇa pūrṇī bhavati kṛtārthatāṃ ca paramāgamābdhyaikātmyaṃ cābhyeti | evaṃ bhūtaṃ paramāgamābdhiṃ naumi | ṇamaḥ prahvatve iti nītyā parimita dehādi pramātṛtāṃ
nimajya tanmayī bhavāmīti yāvat |
śrīmatsadāśiva pṛthivī paryanta prasaratprakṛṣṭa śrīmadvikāsavatprāraṃbhaṃ vasudhāntikaṃ yasya śivasyāntastatvānāṃ cakraṃ bhātitaṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ ||
jñānakriyādhikāradvayena jñātṛtva kartṛvameva pramāturīśvara pratyabhijñā <439> hetutvena darśita miti nirṇītam | itthaṃ tathā ghaṭapaṭetyatra | anantarameva kriyādhikārānte śivādi kṣityanta viśvapadārthāvabhāsā lakṣaṇetyuktam | viśvapadārthāḥ ke iti praśnaḥ | tatraviśva padārthāvabhāsana lakṣaṇetyuktau pramātṛprameya lakṣaṇājaḍacetanāḥ padārthāḥ ābhāsā eva | te padārthāḥ kriyatā rūpeṇa saṃgṛhyante māyā pramātuḥ pratyakṣeṇa hi sarvatra kramate | māyā pramāturanumānamapi na sarvatra kramate | anumānasya pratyakṣa pṛṣṭhapātitvāt | yadyadvastvasti tatra tatra vastuni liṅga vyāptigrahaṇa saṃbhavo na hīti | aparicchinnaḥ iyattā rahitaḥ prakāśātmaka maheśvara vimarśaparamārtha āgama stutiṃ na paśyet | tadanusāreṇāgamānu sāreṇa | śivādikṣityanta viśvaprameyī karaṇena pratilabdhatachivādikṣityanta padārtha nirṇayaṃ nirupayitu māgamādhikāraṃ tṛtīyamārabhate | tatrāgamādhikāre ślokaikādaśakenaivamantarbahirityādi nā sthūla sūkṣmabhedata ityantenā gamasiddhaṃ śivādi dharaṇyantaṃ pratyekaikā bhāsa rūpātmakaṃ pṛthivītvaikaikābhāsarūpatātmakanyāyadarśane sāmānyamiti yadviśvasya vyavahṛtaṃ yasya sāmānyātmanastatvagrāmasya prṭhivyādi śivāntatatvagrāmasyaikatrasamudāyīkaraṇe nānekakāñcanatvādi sāmānya samudita ghaṭādisvalakṣaṇāvabhāsanātmakaṃ vyūhaviśeṣapūrvakaḥ samasto'yaṃ śarīrabhuvanādirvibhavatvasya tatvagrāmasya tatvagrāmaṃ parameśvarāgamasiddhaṃ(,) yuktyā tatvataḥ anugataṃ tatvagrāmaṃ darśayatītyāhnika tātparyaṃ jñānakriyādhikārayorāgamādhikāreṇa saṅgatiṃ yojayan pūrvapakṣanirāsaṃ copasaṃharan śivatatvasvarūpamevadarśayitumāha (-) <440> ślokaikādaśa kasyāpyekārthatvāt pratyekaṃ ślokārtho na nirūpitaḥ |
evamiti | paradarśanoktaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvo na yukta iti yata stato hetoḥ evamevā kriyā saiṣetyukta nītyā antara kramā bahiḥ sakramā pūrvāparakramātmaka
kāla kramānugā kriyā pramāturjñātureva yataḥ <343> tat tasmāt tasya jñātṛtvāt jñāturanyonyāviyukte jñānakriyeśivatatvaṃ jaḍarūpaḥ pratiṣṭhaḥ jaḍarūpa pradhāna paramāṇvādi prasiddhaḥ bauddhādiparadarśanoktaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kathaṃ cinnopapanna iti |
evamiti | yataḥ antarakramatvena bahiḥ sakramarūpatvena prakāśaparamārthenāpi atathā rūpeṇāntarbahīrūpātmanā prakāśena vapuṣā svarūpeṇa ca vartamānaḥ kāla krama mākṣipan kriyetyabhidhīyate | sāntarviparivartinaḥ | ubhayendriyavedyatvaṃ tasya kasyāpi lipsayā(,) ityukta nītyā parameśvarasya kāraṇatā viśvasya tatkāryateti kārya kāraṇa bhāva eva kriyetyabhidhīyate | jñānaśaktipuṣastasya pramātureva sā kriyādharmaḥ | tasya kartṛtvāt tasyaiva svarūpa bhūtaḥ taditi tasmāt kartṛjñātṛrūpasya pramāturanyonyāviyukte jñānakriye vimarśa eva devasyetyukta nītyā jñānaṃ vimarśānusaṃbhavati | anyonyā viyuktatvāt jñānakriyayoranyonyāviyuktajñānakriyārūpaṃ kriyādvāreṇa sadāśivādikṣityanta tatvarāśitasṛṣṭisaṃhāraśatasahasrāntaḥ karaṇa sahiṣṇu anābhāsamānamiti | idantayā vabhāsamānatvābhāve'pi upadeśāvasare hi sarvātmanā tāvadasya parameśvaratā <441> prameyatāsya parihartuṃ śakyetyuktanītyā gururūpaṃ dhyānāvasare upadeśyarūpatayā dhyeyarūpatayā cābhāsamānaṃ vastutaḥ śivatatvamityuktaṃ bhavati tatraivaṃ bhūta śivatatvaviyukte jñānakriye eva śivatatvānantarabhāviśaktitatvam |
evaṃ bhūtamiti | anyonyanyūnādhika jñānakriyāśaktyaviyuktaṃ vakṣyamāṇa sadāśivādikṣityantaviśvābhinnaścet śivatatvaṃ tataḥ śivatvāvyatiriktaṃ kimanyattatvaṃ syāt | ekasmiṃścidrūpe śivatatve viśrāntau sadāśivādi kṣityantānāṃ tatvānāṃ pūrvāparātmakaḥ kathaṃ kramo bhavet | śivatatvasya deśakālāyogāt | tadvat śivatatva viśrāntasya sadāśivādikṣityantasya tatvasya tadabhinnatvāt | tadabhinnatvena tasyāpi deśakālā yogāt kathaṃ pūrvāparātmakaḥ tatva kramo bhavet | evamevaitat | tathāpi śivatatva svātantryāt kramo bhavatītyāha (-)
kintu bhavaduktaṃ satyameva | tathāpi viśeṣo'stīti darśayati (-) kiṃtvityanena | āntara daśāyā jñānaśaktirūpāyā āntara daśāyāḥ kriyāśaktiṃ pratyudrekāt kiṃcidvikāsādāditaḥ śivaśaktitatvādanantaramāditaḥ sadāśivākhyaṃ tatvaṃ sāda iti śrī sadā śivākhyaṃ tatvamucyate | sādākhyaṃ sadākhyāyāṃ bhavaṃ yataḥ prabhṛtisaditi sadrūpasya viśvasya prakhyā prakāśaḥ ahamidamityādi prakāśaḥ tatsādākhyaṃ tatvaṃ tādṛk prakhyā hetu bhūtatvāt sādākhyaṃ tatvam |
kiñca sādākhyāyāḥ sadāśivatatva rūpāyāḥ vācyatvāt tatvamapi sādākhyaṃ sadāśivākhyaṃ(,) antaḥ sthitasya viśvasya bahirbhāvahetutvāt bahirbhāva mayyāḥ kriyāśakterudreke jñānaśaktito'pi kriyāśakte rudrekāt parataḥ <442> sadāśiva tatvādanantaraṃ parameśvaramīśvaraśabda vācyam | īśvaratatvaṃ tu sadāśivatatvāt īśvaratatvasya vastutaḥ apṛthagbhāve'pi pṛthagbhāvarūpaṃ viśeṣyaṃ dyotayati | śivatatve sadāśivādikṣityantasya viśvasyāhamityeva pratīti śivatatve viśvasyedantā prasaṅgo'pi nāsti | śaktitatvaṃ tacchivatatvāviyuktajñānakriyāśaktirūpatvānna pṛthaggaṇita sadāśivatatve ahamityekādhikaraṇasaṃbaṃdhinyā ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyā ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyātmanā pratītyā ahamidamita ahantācchādite'hantārūpatayāṅkurāyamāṇasya viśvasya pratītiḥ sadāśivatatve viśvasaṃbandhinyā idantāyā ahamidamitthaṃ kurāyamāṇatvam | īśvaratatve idamahamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyarūpayā pratītyā idamityaṃkuritasya viśvāsyāhantācchādita sphuṭedantārūpā pratītiḥ |
deśakālāparicchinnatvāt śivatatvamekameva | tathāpyekatve'pitadīyaṃ śivatatvaṃ svātantryameva | svātmani nijerūpe sadāśivādikṣityantaṃ svarūpabhedaṃ pratibimbarūpeṇa darśayati (-) śiva tatvasya viśvātmanā vaicitryameva deśa kāla kramaḥ tattatvavargasya pūrvāpararūpaḥ kāla kramamūrtivaicitryato deśa kramamābhāsayatītyukta nītyā asaudeśaḥ mūrtivaicitryamayaḥ asaukālaḥ kriyāvaicitryamayaḥ sadāśivatatvamanyat īśvara tatvaṃ sadāśivatatvādanyat ityādirūpeṇa mūrtivaicitryameva deśakramaḥ śivatatvādanantaraṃ sadāśivatatvaṃ tadanantaramīśvara tatvamityādi
pūrvāparātmakaḥ kriyā vaicitryamayaḥ kālaḥ | tataśca svātmani pratibiṃbakalpa tayā svarūpa bhedadarśanādāntarī śivatatvāntaraṅgabhūtā ahamiti jñānarūpā <443> yā daśā tasyā jñāna daśāyā udrekā bhāsane kriyāśaktitaḥ jñānaśakterādhikyasphuraṇe sat ityevaṃ rūpāyāṃ sādākhyāyāṃ bhavaṃ sādākhyaṃ yata statvāt prabhṛtiviśvasya saditi prakhyā | kiñca sāda iti sadāśiva paryāyaḥ tasyāssādākhyāyāḥ vācakātmanaḥ śivatatvarūpāyā vācyaṃ tatvaṃ viśvasṛṣṭikrameṇādau gaṇayitu mucitam upadeśādā vapi śivatatvameva sadāśiva tatvatayā prathama mupadeśya dhyeyādirūpeṇa prathamaṃ parāmraṣṭumucitaṃ tat sādākhyaṃ tatva mupadeśyā vasare viśvasṛṣṭi krame ca śivatatva meva prathamaṃ sadāśivatatva rūpatayā sphurati | anantaramīśvara tatvādi rūpatayā tatsādākhyaṃ tatvaṃ kriyāśaktimayasya viśvabahirbhāvasya jñānaśaktitaḥ udrekāducchūnatāpatteḥ | pārameśvaraṃ parameśvara śabda vācyam | īśvara tatvaṃ nāma tadīśvara tatvaṃ sādākhyasya tatvasya paścāducitābhāsanam | etaditi vakṣyamāṇaṃ paramārthata uktaṃ bhavati sadāśivasya bhāvaḥ sādākhyaṃ tatvam | īśvarasya bhāva aiśvaram tatvam | śivatatve'dhiṣṭhātṛtā adhiṣṭheyarūpasya pramātṛ vargasya saṃbhavo nāsti | sadāśive tatve adhiṣṭhātā śrīsadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ mantra maheśvaraḥ pramātṛvargaḥ adhiṣṭheya rūpaṃ tadubhayādhiṣṭhitaṃ sadāśivākhyaṃ tatvamiti bhedatrayamastī | īśvara tatve śrīmadīśvara bhaṭṭārakam adhiṣṭhātā mantreśvara rūpasaṃjñaḥ adhiṣṭheya rūpaṃ pramātṛvargaḥ tadadhiṣṭhitamīśvara tattvākhyaṃ tattvaṃ bhinnānāṃ mantramaheśvara rūpāṇām bhinnānāṃ pramātṛvargāṇāṃ svasvavargīkaraṇa nimittaṃ pṛthivī rūpatvaṃ svayamekamevasat tadvargā vibhaktaṃ bhāti | nadī nada sāgarādīnāṃ vargāṇāṃ svābrūpavargī karaṇanimittamabrūpatvaṃ api svayamevasat nadī nada sāgarādi sva vargavibhaktaṃ bhāti |
<444> evaṃ dṛṣṭāntamuktvā dārṣṭāntika meva darśayati(-) tataścetyādinā | aha mityahantārūpeṇedantā rūpa viśva pratibimbanakṣamatvāt śuddham | dehādikāluṣya rahitaḥ
kevalaṃ caitanya rūpaḥ pramātṛvargomantramaheśvarākhyoyaḥ asya mantramaheśvara vargasya viśvasyādisṛṣṭau asmākaṃ sakalākhyānāṃ pramātṝṇāmantaḥkaraṇavedyaḥ śrīsadāśivabhaṭṭārakādhiṣṣthātavyastu dhyānamalātmaprāyamasphuṭaprāyaṃ svādhovarti īśvara tatvādikṣiti tatvāntaṃ bhāva cakramunmīlita mātra citrakalpam | aspaṣṭā vayavā kāraika mātra vikalpaṃ pratibhāsamānaṃ bhāvacakraṃ yaḥ saṃhāre'pidhvaṃsonmukha tayā tathā bhūtameva pratibimbaprāyatayā tatpramātṛvargasvātmamukurāntargatatvādahamidamiti pratibimbaprāyatayā cakāsti | tasya mantramaheśvarākhyasya caitanya vargasya sadāśivatatva vartinaḥ tādṛśi pratibimba prāyatayā cakāsti | saditi | bhavarāśau tathā prathanamahamidamiti prathanaṃ nāma yaccidviśeṣatvaṃ bodhaviśeṣatvaṃ tatsādākhyaṃ tatvaṃ śrīmadīśvarabhaṭṭārakādhiṣṭhitasyeśvara tatva vartinaḥ mantreśvarākhyasya caitanyātmanaḥ pramātṛ vargasya śuddhavidyādi kṣityantaṃ bhāva cakraṃ tasya pramātṛvargasyedamaha mitī dantāyāḥ prādhānyāt sphuṭībhūtam | amaditi pūrvoktasakalākhyapramātṛvarga bahiṣkaraṇa saraṇi prāpta ghaṭapaṭādi bhāva vargapratimabhāvacakraṃ ca kāsti | viśvamidamahamiti pratītyā idantāyā ahantāviśrāntatvāt pratibiṃbarūpatayā bhāti | tasya vargasya tādṛśi tathā pratibhāsamāne bhāvarāśau tatheti idamahamiti prathanamīśvaratatvam | tatra tatvasyaiva sadāśiveśvarasaṃjñāyā sadāśivatatvamīśvaratatvaṃ coktam | na tu sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakau proktau | mantramaheśvarādipramātṛvargasya dhyeyopāsyādirūpatayā sthitau tadadhiṣṭhātṛbhūtau śrīmatsadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakau <445> brahmaviṣṇurudratulyau pṛthagevamantavyau | tatva tadadhiṣṭhātronīmasārūpyāt sadāśivetīśvara iti ca nāma sārūpyānnabhramitavyam | sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakāvatroktāviti na bhramitavyam | brahmaviṣṇurudrādhiṣṭhātṛvat tatvāt pṛthagevamantavyaṃ tayo rapyadhiṣṭhātṛrūpatvāt | tayoḥ sadāśiveśvara tatvayoḥ pṛthagevamantavyam | sadāśivaśabdeneśvaraśabdena sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakau uktau | tadvat brahmaviṣṇurudrā iti kiṃ noktā ityāhuḥ eko yathā tathā na bhramitavyam | tasmādbrahmaviṣṇurudrā atra yathā noktāḥ tathā sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakā vapi noktau | kevalaṃ tatva svarūpamevoktam |
(######)teṣāṃ rūpamuparivakṣyate | tatra sadāśiveśvarākhya tatvadvaye nāmadheyāntaramapyatra darśayati (-) īśvarākhyasya tatvasya viśvasya bahirunmeṣaḥ tasya tatvasyonmeṣa iti saṃjñā | sa unmeṣaḥ viśvabahirbhāvahetuḥ | sadāśivākhyaṃ tatvaṃ viśvasyāntarūpatod recanarūpo nimeṣaḥ nimeṣa iti saṃjñā | tasya
yasyonmeṣa nimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau ||
ityatreśvaratatvamevoktam | unmeṣaṇaṃ nāma viśvasya bahiḥsphuṭatvam | antaḥ saṃvidātmanā sthitasyedantā rūpeṇabāhyatvamunmeṣaṇam | yataḥ unmeṣāt viśvasyodayo bhavati | unmeṣa īśvara tatvam | nimeṣaṃ nāma viśvasyāsphuṭatvāpādanam | ahaṃ rūpatāyā ādhikyaṃ nimeṣaḥ sadāśivatatvaṃ yato nimeṣādidaṃ rūpasya jagataḥ ahamityahaṃtā yā nimajjanaṃ pralayaḥ | sadāśiveśvarākhyaṃ tatvaṃ parameśvarasya śuddhaspandaḥ acalasyeti idantā rūpabodhātmanā spande'pi pūrṇāhantātmakaṃ svasvarūpamatyajataḥ <446> aprarūḍhedantātmaka rūpāpattilakṣaṇastasya tatvadvayasya paryantataḥ ahamidamidamahamityahantā yāmeva paryanto viśrāntatvāt śuddhaspandaḥ śuddhaḥ māyā kāluṣya rahitaḥ spadi kiñciccalana iti dhātugatyā kiñciccalattātmatayā sphuradrūpatvāt yaduktam (-) spandanaṃ ca kiñciccalanam | eṣai va kiñcidrūpatā | yadacalamapi viśvātmanā ābhāsata iti prakāśa svarūpaṃ hi manāgapi nāti ricyate atiricyata ivetyābhāsa bhedayuktamiva ca bhātīti pūrvameva sā sphurattetyatroktam | sadāśivādikṣityantaḥ tatvagrāmo ya etāḥ parameśvarasya śaktayaḥ | yathoktam (-)
śaktiśca śaktimāṃśceti padārthadvayamucyate | śaktayo'sya jagatsarvaṃ śaktimāṃstu maheśvaraḥ || iti |
etāsāṃ madhye kācicchaktiranya bahutaraśaktiranya śaktikroḍīkāraṃ kurvatī parameśvarasyāntaraṅgatvādanyābhiḥ śaktibhirūpāsyā(,) yathā ghaṭasya ghaṭatvātmikāśaktiḥ ghaṭanikaṭabhūtā tadghaṭaviśeṣaṇībhūtāpi anyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ yathopāsyā tadvat kācicchaktiranya bahutaraśaktikroḍīkāraṃ kurvatī svarūpamātraniṣṭhā parameśvarasya dūravartinī ghaṭasaṃbandhinī satyātmikāśaktistadghaṭagatakaṭhinatvonnatatvadṛḍhatvādyanapekṣiṇī | atra paṭādisattāsamānyarūpeṇa vartamānatvād dūravartinī | <ṭ p. 348> atra sadāśiveśvarāditatvātmikāḥ śaktayaḥ parameśvaranikaṭavartinyaḥ svādhaḥ parvatavartitā śuddhavidyādikṣityantatatvaśaktikroḍīkāraṃ kurvaṃtyaḥ ahamidamidamahamiti prathamānatvāt parameśvara nikaṭavartinyo bhavanti | māyādikāḥ śaktayo bhedena prathamānatvāt svasvarūpamātraniṣṭhādūravartinyo bhavanti | idamidamiti <447> prathamānatvāt |
evaṃ nimeṣonmeṣaśaktī eva sadāśiveśvarau viśvāntaḥ kāra bahiṣkārahetubhūte nimeṣonmeṣaśaktī eva sadāśiveśvaratatve | tayostatvayoradhiṣṭhātṛdevate api | tathā sadāśiveśvaranāmadheye adhiṣṭheyastatvadvayavartīmantramaheśvaramantreśvarākhyaḥ pramātṛvargo'pi tathā nāmadheyaḥ |
atheśvarasatvādanantaraṃ tadadhiṣṭhātṛ devatādvayagataṃ tayoradhiṣṭheyarūpayoḥ tatvavartino'dhiṣṭheya rūpasya mantramaheśvaramantreśvarākhyasya pramātṛvargasyādhiṣṭhātṛbhūta sadāśiveśvaradevatākāraṇabhūtamindriyabhūtaṃ vidyātatvaṃ ghaṭo'yamityādi pratītau cakṣurādīndriyavargo yathā kāraṇabhūtaḥ tadvadahamidamidamahamiti pratītā vadhiṣṭhātṛdevatayorindriya bhūtaṃ śuddhavidyātatvamāha (-) sadvidyā śuddhavidyā ca(,) ahamidamidamahaṃ dhiyośca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ cakāra | pūrvokteśvaratatvāpekṣayā īśvaratatvamevaṃ rūpamiti ubhayorapyeka madhikaraṇaṃ tasyabhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sā śuddhavidyāmāyāpramāturahamidaṃdhiyo'dhikaraṇaṃ pratyekaṃ pṛthak pṛthak adhikaraṇadvayam | tatrāhaṃ dhiyaḥ adhikaraṇadehādiḥ idaṃ dhiyastu ghaṭādiḥ tatpṛthagadhikaraṇagrāhiṇī pratītiraśuddhavidyā ahaṃ dehādirevedaṃ ghaṭādiriti pṛthak pṛthageva |
ahamidaṃ dhiyoḥ pratyekaṃ pṛthak pṛthak svarūpaṃ darśayati (-) cidrūpasya prakāśasya parameśvarasyātmamātre idantā sparśābhāvena cinmātreviśramaṇam | idantābhāvādanyonmukhasvātmalakṣaṇaḥ idantānunmukhavodharūpasvātmaprakāśaviśrāntilakṣaṇo vimarśo yaḥ so'hamityucyate | ananyonmukhovimarśo yaḥ svavyatirikta <448> viśvonmukhaḥ yaḥ sa idamityucyate | sa cedaṃ rūpo vimarśo'pi svabhittibhūte ananyonmukhe ahantārūpe svaprakāśamātre paramārthataḥ punarviśrāmyatīti | yathoktam (-)
<ṭ p. 349> idamityasya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthā | ityādi |
tatrādyo'haṃ vimarśe śivatatvam | dvitīye idaṃ vimarśe vidyeśvaratā | teṣāṃ mantrapramātṝṇāmahamiti pratītiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakartetyādirūpe cinmayesvātmani idamiti pratītistādṛgvidha svātmavyatirikte viśvasmin vedyarāśau śaiva naiyāyikānāmapyevameva | yadvakṣyati (-) yathā dvatīnāmīśvara iti śiva bhaṭṭārakānantabhaṭṭārakayorantarāle ahamidamitīdamahamiti ca dhiyorekādhikaraṇatvānnyūnā | ahamidamidamonyūnādhikyarahita samadhṛta tulyanyāyena yo vimarśaḥ ahamiti idamahamiti yo vimarśaḥ sa krameṇa sadāśivanāthe īśvarabhaṭṭārake ca bhavati | ubhayatrāpi vartamānasyedaṃ bhāvasya dhyāmalādhyāmalatā kṛto viśeṣaḥ asphuṭatvasphuṭatvakṛto viśeṣo'sti | prastute ete dve ahamidaṃ dhiyau tayormāyā pramātari pṛthagadhikaraṇatvam |
pṛthagadhikaraṇatvameva darśayati (-) ahamitidhīrdehādirūpe grāhake idamiti dhīḥ svavyatirikte ghaṭādau vartate | tannirāsena pṛthagadhikaraṇanirāsenaikasminnevādhikaraṇe ubhayorapyahaṃ dhiyoḥ saṃbandharūpaḥ prathanaṃ satīśuddhavidyā māyā pramātṛgatā bhinnādhikaraṇaprathanamayī yā aśuddhavidyā sā anyā śuddhavidyā vyatiriktā | tatra sadāśivatatve ahamityasya cinmātrarūpamadhikaraṇaṃ yat tatra cinmātrarūpe'dhikaraṇe idamaṃśamaṃkurayati | tasyedamaṃśasyā sphuṭatvāt sadāśivatā | sā <449> kīdṛśīti cet ahamidamidamahamiti pratītau idamityavamarśātmake sphuṭībhūte'dhikaraṇe yadāhamiti vimarśastadupari niṣicyate tadedamahamitīśvaratā iti tayostatvayorvibhāgaḥ | sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakayoḥ kāraṇabhūteyaṃ vidyā tasmāddhetoḥ śuddhavidyetyata āha (-) prameya bhūmimupeyuṣāmata evedaṃ bhāvopapannānāṃ bhāvānāṃ māyādikṣityantānāṃ bhāvānāṃ bodhasāratvāt | tathā vastvavalokanāt citparamārthāvalokanāt śuddhavidyā |
avalokanaṃ nāma prathanaṃ tadeva prathanaṃ vedanaṃ vedanameva vidyā yathā vastutatvaṃ paramārtharūpam | kiñca vastvanusāritvaṃ ca vidyayā avyabhicāreṇa bhāvasvarūpānusāritvaṃ ca vastvanusāratvāvalokanatvaṃ ca tasyāḥ vidyāyāḥ śuddherapi parītatā aśuddhavidyā vastuna idaṃ bhāvenāgrahaṇaṃ cakṣurādīṃdriyaviṣayabhūta <ṭ p. 350> prameya daśāmupagatavatāmaṅgīkṛta vatām | ata eva prameyadaśā prāptatvāt idamityevaṃ bhūtena svocitena parāmarśenopapannānāṃ parāmṛśyamānānāṃ prakāśātmāhantārūpabodha eva sārarūpaṃ vastu prakāśascāhamiti ananyonmukhaḥ idantonmukha prakāśarahitatvādahamityevaṃ rūpa iti eṣāṃ bhāvānāmahamiti pāramārthikaṃ rūpaṃ yat tatrapāramārthike rūpe viśrāntatvādahamidamityasya prathanasya śuddhavedanarūpatvamidamahamiti prathanasya ca śuddhavidyārūpatvam |
adhiṣṭhātṛbhūtāt sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakāddevatā dvayāt sadāśiveśvara tatvasvarūpaṃ prameyatvādvibhaktamiti etat pūrvaṃ sadāśivabhaṭṭārakeśvarabhaṭṭāraka ityuktamapīdānīmāgamabhāsayā prakārāntareṇa darśayati (-) bhāvānāmanātmatvenāhantārūpeṇabhāsanā <450> bhāvādaparatvamapūrṇatvamanyāpekṣatvamidamiti pratibhāsanam | ahaṃ rūpeṇācchādanātparatāpūrṇatā ananyāpekṣatvamahamiti pratibhāsamānam | atra sadāśiveśvarātmanitatvadvaye bhāvānāṃ sā parāpara dṛśā(,) seti āgamoktā ahantedantāmiśraṇātmikā parāparadaśā | bhāvānāṃ paratvaṃ paratvaṃ pūrṇatvamanyāpekṣābhāvaḥ ahamiti | aparatvamapūrṇatvamanyāpekṣatva midamiti | ahamiti śivadaśā | idamiti mantravijñānākalapralayākalasakala daśā | atra sadāśeveśvara tatvadvaye krameṇāsphuṭasphuṭarūpāṇāṃ bhāvānāmahamidamidamātmakobhayāṃśa sparśāt parāparatvamiti ślokatātparyamuktvā sadāśiveśvarātmanastatvadvayasya tadvartino mantramaheśvaramantreśvarākhyasya pramātṛvargasya tadadhiṣṭhātṛbhūtayoḥ sadāśiveśvara bhaṭṭārakayostatkāraṇabhūtā yāśśuddhavidyāyāśca svarūpaṃ pratyekaṃ vibhāgena pratipādayati (-) vedya bhāganiṣṭhā daśā tatvasvarūpā tadvedyātmaka tatvasvarūpā vabhāsayitṛtvaṃ mantramaheśvaratvādi mantramaheśvarādiśuddha pramātṛ saṃvedyamāyādikṣityantavastusādhāraṇā śuddhapramātṛ niṣṭhā yā jñānadaśā sā śuddhavidyā | tasya pramātṛvargasya kāraṇabhūtasya cakṣurāderyathā tatvaṃ tathā sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakayo mantramaheśvaramantreśvarākhya pramātṛvargasya cakāraṇabhūte'pi tat svarūpatvaṃ tatpramātṛ vargādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ sadāśiveśvarabhaṭṭārakarūpatā janapadavartino janasya rājā yayādhiṣṭhātā tadvat |
ekeṣāmiti | āgamikānāṃ mate ahamidamidamahamityatredaṃ bhāgā <ṭ p. 351> cchādako yo bhāgastatprathā ahaṃ prathā pradhānaśuddhavidyā |
anye āgamikāmanyante (-) ahantācchādanīyaṃ ya idaṃ bhāgastasyedaṃ <451> bhāgasyācchādanaṃ tat pradhānā idaṃ bhāgapradhānā śuddhavidyācchādanīyedantā prathā pradhānā śuddhavidyā na cet na idamaṃśaḥ kena bhāsyatāṃ kevalamahamaṃśapradhānādimaṃśo na bhāsata ityarthaḥ | tasmādidamaṃśapradhānā śuddhavidyā | tatra māyottīrṇe śuddhavidyādi śivāntatatve māyā vyā | abhāvāt | māyāyāḥ sadbhāve śuddhavidyāditatve'pi prarohaṇaprasaṅgādidantāvabhāsa pradhānayā māyā māyāyāḥ prarohaṇaprasaṃgāt | ata evāchādanīyedaṃ bhāgapradhānatvādiyaṃ śuddhavidyāprarohāsahiṣṇuṃ sthūlarūpatayā prarohāsahiṣṇumidantāṃ bhāsayati yatastataḥ śuddhābhāsanācca vidyeti ananyā śuddhavidyāyā bhāsamānāyā idantāyāḥ parohāsahiṣṇutvāt śuddhatvaṃ(,) tadbhāsanatvāttāṛgvidhedantāvabhāsanatvādvidyātvam | śuddhavidyāyā aprarūḍha māyākalpatvadiyaṃ śuddhavidyā mahāmāyeyaṃ kimiti cet māyātīrṇe'pi pade idantāṃśabhāsakatvādraurava sārādyāgamānāmupadeṣṭṛbhirmahāmāyeti śuddhavidyaivopadiṣṭā | etat pūrvamevoktaṃ prathamāhnika prathamaśloke maheśvarasyeti padavyākhyāne | ūtīrṇā api mahāmāyā gatāḥ śuddhā śuddhāmantratadīśatanmaheśātmana iti |
sarvakartuḥ sarvajñasyāpi pramāturbhāveṣu bhedadhīryā idantāpattiḥ yā māyāśaktyaiva vedyāṃśe bhedaparāmarśanāt māyāśaktyātulyā | na kevalaṃ māyaiva cinmātrarūpe vedakāṃśe viparyāsābhāvāt sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamityādirūpeṇa viparyā sā bhāvāt | na ca māyā evaṃ bhūtā śuddhavidyetyanye āgamikā manyante | vidyeśvarā <452> anantādayomantrapramātāraḥ yathābhedadhiyameva śuddhavidyāṃmanyante | tadvat śūnyādi rūpe śūnyadhīprāṇadeharūpe māyāpramātari anullasite pramātari cinmātra eva kartarisati prakāśamānatvena cidekarūpeṣu bhāveṣu apthacidrūpa tayā acidrūpamityabhimānena bheda prakāśalakṣaṇaṃ pārameśvaraṃ svātantryaṃ yat sā śuddhavidyā māyā śaktyaiva māyāśaktyā tulyā | kathamiti cet | vedyabhāge bhedaprakāśanāt kevalaṃ <ṭ p. 352> māyaiva na bhavati | grāhakasyātmanaścinmātratā bhāge sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'hamityādi viparyā sā bhāvāt yena prakāreṇānantādyā vartante tadvat | te hi vidyeśvarāḥ | śuddhe āṇavādikalaṅkarahite cinmātre bodhamātre gṛhītāhaṃ bhāvā svatastubhinnaṃ vedyaṃ paśyati | māyā pramātā tu bhinno ghaṭādiriti dehādau gṛhītāhaṃ vastuko bhinnaṃ vedyaṃ paśyatīti viśeṣaḥ | śaiva naiyāyikānāmīśvaraḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakartāpi san svābhinnaṃ viśvaṃ paśyami tadvat vidyeśvarāḥ | tasmāddvaitānāmīśvarasyeśvatvaṃ vidyesvaramātre paryavasitam | evaṃ śiva sadāśivādivat pūrṇacaitanyā bhāvāduktaprakāreṇa grāhake aṃśataścaitanyarūpe ātmani nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ ahamiti pratītyabhāvāt grāhakamātre ahantā pratibhāsanādaṃśataścaitanya rūpatvāt paramārtharūpagrāhyasya viśvasya cinmayenāhantā rūpatve'pi viparyāsanaśaktiridantāvabhāsanaśaktirvidyeśvarāṇāṃ śuddhavidyā | parameśvarasyedaṃ bhāvasyāprarūḍha bhedāvabhāsanamaṃkuritamātrabhedāvabhāsanaṃ sadāśiveśvaratā śivaśaktitatvavibhāgātmanastatvottīrṇasya bhagavataḥ <453> paramaśivasyāhamidamidamahamityatredamaṃśasyodbhede'pi tasyedamaṃśasyāhantā chāditatvena sphuraṇāt | tatra prarūḍhabhedāvabhāsanameva sadāśiveśvaratā | tatra bhedāvabhāsanasyā śuddhavidyātatvasyā sphuṭatve paramaśivasyecchāśaktirvyā priyate | idaṃ bhāgasyā prarūḍhabhedāvabhāsanasyeśvaratatvātmani sphuṭatve paramaśivasya sphuṭatve jñānaśaktirvyāpriyate | ahamahamevedamidameveti sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvena svavyatirikte prarūḍhe tu bhede grāhya viparyāse'pi ahantānādi tatve'pi sthāṃśake ātmanyahamiti cinmātratāyāṃ satyāṃ vidyeśvareṣu paramaśivakriyāśaktiryvāpriyate | grāhakasyātmanā dehādergrāhyasya ca ghaṭāderūbhayorapi cinmātratābhāvā didantā prarūḍhau tu paramaśivasya māyāśaktirvyāpriyate(,) sā māyāśaktiḥ paśupramātṛṣu vyāpriyate | uktarūpagrāhya grāhakayorubhayorapyuktarūpaviparyā sa saṃskāre nivṛtte'pi paramaśivātmaka svasvarūpaparamārthaprathanaṃ yattatra vastu paramārthaprathane sadguru kāṭākṣanugṛhīte apaśupramātṛṣu yogī jñāni prabhṛtiṣuparamaśivasya <ṭ p. 353> śuddhavidyāśaktirvyāpriyate | apravartitapūrvottara ityatroktasya tadetadvidyā śaktivyāpāratvaṃ paśubhāve'pi |
tasyeti | pūrvoktasya nityatvavibhutva svatantratva rūpasyaiśvarya svabhāvasya gurukaṭākṣeṇa prakāśikā yā sā paramaśivasyānugrahātmikā vidyāśaktiḥ | paśubhāve grāhakagrāhyo maya viparyāsaikalakṣaṇe pāśanīyakāt svatantraparamārthataḥ yaṃ vidaikye'pi sarvasya dṛśyasya draṣṭurdarśanasya ca bhede dṛśyamanyaddraṣṭā cānyaḥ jñānaṃ cānyat ityanyonya bhede jāte satyapi sā paramaśivasyānugrahātmikā <454> tvamīśvaraḥ jñānakriyā yā śaktiyuktatvāt yo hi jñānakriyā svātantryayuktaḥ sa īśvaraḥ | yathā siddhāntapurāṇaprasiddhāḥ jñānakriyāśaktiyuktatvāt īśvarastayā catvaṃ tasmāt jñānakriyāśaktiyuktatvāt īśvara eveti īśvaratva pūrṇatva vibhutva nityatvādikāyuktī śadṛśya tadyuktyāśvastahṛdayāḥ kṛtinaḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ pūrṇā bhavanti sā anugrahātmikā pārameśvarīśaktiḥ vidyāśaktiḥ vyavahārapravartanātmakayuktibalena yadaiśvaryamātmani nityatvādyaiśvaryamuktaṃ tadaiśvaryaprakāśikā parameśvaraśaktiryadvaśāt yaduktavaśāt | keciditi (-) gurukaṭākṣānugṛhītā apaścimajanmānastāḥ nityatvādi pratipādikā yuktīrādṛśya tadyuktyāśvastahṛdayāḥ kṛtinaḥ kṛtakṛtyāḥ pūrṇā bhavanti | sānugrahātmikā pārameśvarīśaktiḥ vidyāśaktiḥ | yathoktaṃ pūrvameva | eṣa cānugrahalakṣaṇāḥ antyaḥ pañcamaḥ pārameśvaraḥ kṛtyaviśeṣaḥ parapuruṣārthaprāpakaḥ tannibandhanatvāt paramārthamokṣasyeti | ayameveti | vidyāśaktinirūpaṇātmakaṣaḍartha iti śrītrikasārādyāgamādi dṛṣṭaḥ uktaḥ pakṣaḥ sūtrakārasya hṛdayamāvarjayati | asmin sūtre'nya iti pakṣāntaravādinaṃ pratyanyagukteḥ ||
śuddhavidyātatvādanantaraṃ māyātatvamityārohakrameṇa tannirūpaṇaṃ kriyate | tannirūpaṇamevāha (-) māyākhyā śaktiḥ punastasyaiśvaryasvabhāvasya tirodhānakarī tasya nityatvādyaiśvaryasvabhāvā vidyāśaktiḥ prakāśayati māyāśaktistirodhatte iti māyāvidyayorviśeṣaḥ | sarvasya pramātuḥ parameśvarātmaka svātmāṅgabhūteṣu pṛthivyādikāraṇabhūteṣu bhāveṣu tatkāryabūteṣu ghaṭapaṭādiṣu cāmī pṛthivyādayo <ṭ p. 354> <455> madanyā ghaṭādayaśca tadvat ahamapi caitrādyanyo na maitra eveti pramātṛ vargasyānyonyato ghaṭapaṭādeśca | evaṃ ghaṭādipṛthivyādeḥ parasparaṃ pramātṛvargasya ca bhedaprathākarī māyāśaktiḥ supto'haṃ mūrchito'hamiti śūnye sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyahamiti buddahu kṣudhito'haṃ pipāsito'hamiti prāṇe jaḍatvādacidrūpe prarūḍha iti ahaṃ devādireveti tasminneva prarūḍhaṃ pramātṛtābhimānaṃ dadyatī cinmayā napi bhāvān prameyā bhedenedaṃ rūpeṇābhāsayantī sarvathaivānātmani ahamityātmatābhimānena dehādāvādātmatābhimānena prakāśamānatvādātmarūpatve'pi ghaṭādau svarūpa paramārtharūpaṃ tirodhatte āvṛṇute sā māyāśaktiḥ yat tirodhānaṃ sṛṣṭyādi kṛtyapañcakamadhye āgameṣu bhavyate | etat tirodhānaṃ yaṃ hārāntarabhāvitvāt kādācit kaṃ vilayarūpaṃ va caturthaṃ kṛtyaṃ namantavyam | dīkṣitasyāpi gurumantrādinindanaprāyaṃ vilayarūpaṃ kṛtyaṃ ca na bhavati | yathoktam (-)
kaścit tvīśecchayā samyaganāśvasto'pi cetasaḥ | nindanneva bhajeccaryāt satirohitaṃ ucyate ||
nindyamāna mahāmantra vidyācāryādikopajaḥ | pāpmā taṃ pātayed ghore yātanādhāmni sarvadā ||
etat tirodhānaṃ svābhāvikaṃ svarūpā varaṇameva pārameśvarasyāvaraṇarūpaṃ prakāśamānasyāpyācchādanaṃ māyākāryaṃ tirodhānaṃ vistārayati | grāhakagrāhyayorubhayorapi prakāśamānatvāt citparamārthatve'pi ahaṃ devādireva(,) ayaṃ madvyatirikto ghaṭādireveti <456> saṃvinmaye'pi svātmani sthūlo'hamityādidehā ghahantāropaṇaṃ ghaṭādau ca prakāśamānatvāt svātmabhūte'pi tat svātmabhinnedantā ropaṇamityubhaya viparyā sātmani ekarase'vicchinnaprakāśe bhede bhāte satyanātmani ākāśakalpe śūnyasuṣupte viśvapralaye netyabhāva samādhau ākāśakalpamānātmarūpaṃ śūnyamahamityātmatvena bhāsate | vā śabdena madhye prāṇa ākṣipyate | ūcchvasana niśvasanā vasthā yā mahamucchvasimi niśvasimīti vāyukalpaḥ prāṇaḥ ahamityātmatvanekṣate(,) sthāvarajaṅgamajighatsāyāṃ <ṭ p. 355> kopaprajvalanādau vā tejaḥ samupabṛṃhitaḥ prāṇaḥ ahamityātmatvena vīkṣate | antarahaṃ vedmi sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyahamiti cintādyavasthā susvacchodakakalpā vedyapratibimbanavatī buddhirahamityabhiniviśyate | kṛśo'haṃ sthūlohamityādi daśāsu pṛthivī prāyaṃ śarīrākhyamevāhamityātmatvenābhiniviśyate | vā grahaṇena punarapi sutadhanadārādi ṣvapyasaṃkhyātaṃ antābhiniveśasyānatvaṃ sūcyata iti śūnyaprāyabuddhiśarīreṣu mātṛtvena | bhigateṣu sutadhana dārādireva vedyeṣu mamāyaṃ sutaḥ mamāmīdārāḥ mamedaṃ dhanamiti iti sutadhanadārādi vedyeṣu ca itye teṣu sarveṣu ahantā yā īkṣite ṣvātmatvenekṣiteṣu māyāśaktirvijṛmbhata ityanena parameśvarasya svātantrya rūpā yā māyāśakteriti duṣkaravastu saṃpādanā pratihata sāmarthyaṃ darśitam | ghaṭādi dehādyacirakālaprakāśarūpe suṣupte viśvasyaudayāt cirakālaprakāśarūpe suṣupte viśvasyaudayāt cirakālaprakāśarūpe mahāsuṣuptarūpe pralaye vedyaṃ viśvaṃ na tat śūnyabhāvanāniṣṭha ahamapi na ityabhāva <457> samādhāvanantaramucchvāsaniśvāsāvasthāyām ahamucchvasimīti niśvasimīti vāyukalpaḥ prāṇamātramevāhamityātmatve na vīkṣyate |
kiñca kṣudhātiśayena sthāvarajaṃgamajighatsāyām | athavā kopaprajvalanādau | te vaiśvānarātmakatejaḥ samupabṛṃhitaḥ saṃhārodyataḥ prāṇa evātmatve na vīkṣyate | vedyapratibimbanatvāt svacchodakāśaya kalpā ghaṭādiṃ bhāvarāśiṃ mantarevāhaṃ vedmi ata evāhaṃ mukhī ahaṃ duḥkhīti tallābhālābhacintādyavasthāsu tad ghaṭapaṭādivedya pratibimbanatvāt svacchodaka kalpā buddhirevāham ityabhiniviśyate | kṛśo'haṃ sthūlohamityādi daśāsu śūnyādi buddhiparyanta pramātṛbhittibhūtaṃ śarīramevāhamityātmatayā bhāti | yathoktam (-)
śūnyadhīprāṇa itye tat sṛjyate kṣīyate (--------------) | stharyamasya paraṃ dehāpekṣayā na tu vastutaḥ ||
iti tantrapaṭadhānikāyāṃ śūnyādi sarvaṃ prakāśamānatvāt svata eva pūrvamasatvāt <ṭ p. 256> saṃvideva tat tad rūpeṇa bhāsamānatvāt cinmātrasārameva paramārthato'hantārūpameva svasaṃviditi viśvaṃ māyaiva tāvadacidrūpā yā avabhāsitamacidrūpatayā vabhāsitameva idantayā vabhāsitameva sat śūnyādi aprakāśedantā bhāvamapi śūnyādimāyayā ahamityevaṃ rūpāyāḥ saṃvidrūpatayā bhiniveśasthānaṃ saṃpāditam | ityevaṃ bhūtaduṣkaravastu saṃpādanā pratighātarūpā parameśvarasya māyā śaktiritye tat sāmarthyaṃ vijṛṃbhate | sūtragatena vā śabdena pramātṛ saṃbandhināṃ vedyarūpāṇāṃ sutadhanadārādīnāmapyasaṃkhyā tamahantābhiniveśaviṣayatvaṃ sūcitam |
śūnyādiḥ acidrūpatvādanātmā yadiyaḥ sukhīyastṛṣitaḥ yaḥ <458> sarvarūparahitaḥ so'hamitīdantaivāntarhitāhaṃ bhāvā saṃsāriṇāṃ parisphuratītivakṣyamāṇanītyā cidrūpatvā bhāvāt | ata eva ghaṭādivadidantārūpeṇa pratīyamānatvācchūnyādiryaghanātmā tattarhi ātmatvenāhantārūpeṇābhiniviśyamānāścidrūpa eveti śūnyādirmāyā pramātā kiñcit kartṛtvādi dharmānapahāya sarvajñatvasarvakartṛvādi viśuddhaiśvaryadharmaiva syāyat | ityāśaṃkyāha (-) svavyatirekabhāji prameye ata eva idantārūpe pramātā ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ ahametadyatiriktaḥ caitrādeśca vyatiriktaḥ iti ghaṭādi pratimāṃ vikurvāṇaḥ śūnyādiḥ pramātā yaḥ ghaṭādivat svayamapi meyaḥ san mātākālādi pañcakaveṣṭitaṃ tatvasya meyatvaṃ nāmakālādi pañcakaveṣṭitatvam | yo'haṃ kṛśo'bhavaṃ sasthūlo varte sthūlakaro bhaviṣyamiti dehādau tatsvāmini sahacāriṇi prameye'pi tasminnevakāle ghaṭo'pyabhavat idānīṃ ghaṭo vartate ghaṭo bhaviṣyatīti dehādau ghaṭādau ca kālena veṣṭitaḥ kiñcijjñatvarūpayā vidyayā kiñcitkartṛtvarūpayā kalayā(,) atra viṣaye rakta iti rāgeṇa tatrāpyatraiva raktaḥ nānyatreti nītyā ca nityatvasarvajñatva sarvakartṛtva pūrṇatva vyāpakatva viruddhena veṣṭitaḥ kaḥ otaḥ protaḥ sarvajñatā viśuddhaiśvaryadharmaṃ maivasyāt ityāśaṃkā dūrato nirastā |
uktāmāśaṃkāmākṣepeṇānusarati (-) anahaṃ rūpatve'pyahamityābhiniviśyamāno'pi śūnyādiḥ svātmano meyatāṃ jahyādyadi tadānīṃ <ṭ p. 357> syādaiśvaryadharmayogaḥ | sthūlo'hamityādi meyatāṃ jahyādyadi pramātumeyaṃ nīlādyapi māturvyatiriktatayā hanta tayaiva bhāse tavānaveti prakrāntavastunirvāhā bhāvadyotakamavyayam | <459> ayaṃ śūnyādiḥ pramātā ahamityābhiniviśyamāno'pi meyatāṃ na jahātītyarthaḥ |
tadeva pratipādayati (-) śūnyādiḥ pramātā śūnye buddhāvityatra kathitaḥ svātmanaḥ vyatiriktatvenābhimate nīlādau prameye yāvadeva ghaṭādivat svayamapi bhedabhūta eva san mātāmeyaṃ hi idamīdṛgiti paricchedyamānatvād eva parimitaḥ | tādṛśaḥ idamīdṛgityevaṃ rūpādanya smānmeyādupapannam vyatirekam ubhayorapyanyonyabhinnatvāt | evaṃ pramātā ca caitra pramātāpi metrādeḥ pramātuḥ ghaṭādeścopapanna vyatirekaḥ | ata eva ghaṭavan meyāścidrūpaḥ prameya vargātpramātuścopapannavyatirekaṃ na bhavati pūrṇatvācchūnyāderahaṃ bhāvasya paricchinnatvaṃ yat parimitatvameva kālādipañcakaṃ prathamaṃ kālaveṣṭita tvameva darśayati (-) tayāhīti | kālaḥ pūrvāparātmakamakramamāsūtrayan pramātari yo'haṃ kṛśo'bhavaṃ sthūlovarte sthūlataro bhaviṣyāmīti iti pūvā parātmakaṃ kālakramamāsūtrayan pramātarivijṛṃbhamāṇastadanusāreṇa tatsaṃbandhini prameye'pi prasarati |
tatprasaraṇakramamevāha (-) yo'haṃ sthūlo bhavāmītyādinā | tena svātmani svabiṣaye ca vijṛṃbhamāṇe na kālaprasareṇāyaṃ pramātā ātmānaṃ tadviṣayaṃ caivaṃ parāmṛśati | yo 'haṃ kṛśo'bhavaṃ sasthūlovarte sthūlataro bhaviṣyāmi iti saṃvinmayamātmānaṃ jaḍātmakadeharūpamakramamapi kramavantamiva parāmṛśan tad dehacāriṇi prameye'pi ghaṭo'bhavat bhavati bhaviṣyatīti bhūtādirūpaṃ prameyaṃ prakāśayati pramātā kālaḥ nityamevasantaḥ pramātāramanityaṃ karotītyarthaḥ |
<460> atha vidyā vyāpāramāha (-) śūnyāderjaḍasya caitramaitrādeḥ pramātuḥ kiñcijjñatvonmīnarūpā vidyā asya pramātṛ buddhidarpaṇasaṃkrāntaṃ nīlasukhādi bhāvarāśiṃ vyanakti | idaṃ nīlamidaṃ sukhamiti bahirantaḥ karaṇavedyaṃ <ṭ p. 358> nīlasukhādimātrameva bhāvaṃ vyanaktīti sarvajñamapi pramātāraṃ kiñcijjñameva karoti tadā kiñcit kartṛtopodbalanamayī kalāghaṭapaṭādi kāryamudbhāvayati iti sarvakartāramapi pramātāraṃ kiñcit kartārameva karotīti kiṃcijjñānāmi kiṃcit karomītyatra jñānakriyāviṣayasya jñeyasya kāryasya ca vastunaḥ kiñcit tve tulye'pi kasmādidameva kiñcidrūpaṃ vastutayorjñānakriyayorviṣayabhūtamiti | atra kiñcidrūpe jñānakriye kārye cārthe abhiṣvaṅgarūpaḥ āsaktirūpadehādi pramātari ghaṭādi prameye ṣvādareṇa tadviṣayādareṇātiśayā dhānāropaṇamaya iva tasyotkarṣa viśeṣādhānamaya iva prathamaṃ dehādau vyāvṛtyaṃ paśyād viṣaye rāgovyāpriyate | tadgoratvaṃ buddhidharmabhūtaḥ rāgo na bhavati | buddhigato rāgasthūla eva etad rāgatvavanniyatā vṛddhasya puruṣasya pūrvaṃ yauvanasamaye jātaḥ buddhigato rāgaḥ pramadāyāṃ na bhavet | rāgatatvaṃ tu sarvadā styeva | dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryātmani buddhidharmāṣṭake rāgatatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dharmameva karomi adharmameva karomīti dharmādharmādyaṣṭakābhiṣvaṅgarūporāgo dṛṣṭa eveti rāgatatvaṃ pūrṇarūpaṃ pramātāramapūrṇameva karoti | atraiva vastunikasmādabhiṣvaṅgaḥ nānyatre tyasamabhiṣvaṅgarūpo'rtho niyatyā niyamita iti niyatyā sarvatrapūrṇatvābhāvādekasminnevārthe niyata iti niyati vyāptaṃ pramātāramavyāptaṃ karoti ekatraiva saṃkucitaṃ karoti | evaṃ kālādibhirveṣṭitaḥ māyayāpahṛtanityatvādyaiśvarya sarvasvaḥ san paścādaiśvaryaṃ sarvamapahṛtya paścāt prativitīrṇaḥ tat sarvajñatvād yaiśvarya sarvasvamadhyagata kiñcijjñatvādibhāgamātraḥ | evṃ bhūtaḥ samanantaravakṣyamāṇamitaḥ pramātābhāti |
tadeva pratipādayati (-) kālaṃ pratīdānīmiti | kālenedānīṃ tanavidyayā idaṃ kiñcijjānānaḥ kalayā idaṃ kiñcit kurvāṇaḥ parāgeṇātraraktaḥ niyatyātraivaraktaḥ nānyatreti parāmṛśati yaḥ so'hamiti | ayaṃ pramātā kālādipañcaka veṣṭitobhāti | eṣāṃ kālādīnāmanyatrarakto'pi niyatyānyat kāryata iti eṣāṃ kālādīnāṃ bhinnaviṣayatvamapi bhavati | anenāsya dehādeḥ svātantryāt parameśvarasyaiva svātantryaṃ ca darśitam | ete ca kālādaya uktakrameṇedānīntano'haṃ kiñcijjñohaṃ <ṭ p. 359> kiñcit kartāhaṃ atrarakto'haṃ tatrāpyatraiva rakto'hamityuktakrameṇapramātṛlagnataiva bhātīti tasya māyā pramātṛśaktisvarūpastadvyabhicāriṇaḥ pramātṛbhinnā eva ete sarvapramātṝṇāmekaprakārā na bhavati prati pramātṛbhinnā eva ete sarvapramātṝṇāmeka prakārā na bhavati | pratipramātṛbhinnā api naṭamallaprekṣādau kālādayaḥ sarvapramātṝṇāmekī bhaveyuḥ | kalādīnāmīśvarecchā vyatiriktaṃ sahajajīvitaṃ nāstīti svāminaścātmsaṃsthasyetyādau asakṛduktam | eṣa pramātā māyāndha ityatra vakṣyate ca (-)
svavyatirikte meye mātā pramāteti pūrvaśloke yaduktaṃ tatrokte tat prameyaṃ pramātṛ vyatiriktaṃ prameyaṃ darśayati |
trayoviṃśatiprakāraṃ pṛthivyādi śabdānta sthūlasūkṣmātmakaṃ kāryarūpaṃ <462> bahirindriyātmakaṃ karaṇarūpaṃ prameyaṃ yat tasya kāryakāraṇarūpasya kāryakāraṇairavibhaktaṃ svayamekaṃ eṣāṃ mūlakāraṇaṃ pradhānaṃ ca yat tatsarvaṃ meyam |
kāryakāraṇarūpaṃ trayoviṃśati prakāraṃ yat sarvakāryasya kāraṇasya ca sukhaduḥkhamohamayatvāt tairavibhāgarūpaṃ prakṛtitatvaṃ yat tatsarvaṃ meyamiti saṃbandhaḥ | māyottīrṇānāṃ yogināṃ mantrapramātṝṇāṃ tadīśvarātmamatreśvarāṇāṃ mantramaheśvarāṇāṃ ca mātṝṇāṃ pṛthivyādibhūtapañcakasya gandhādi tanmātrā pañcakasyopasthādi vāgāntasya karmendriya pañcakasya ghrāṇādi śrotrāntajñānendriyapañcakasya mana ādi buddhyantāntaḥkaraṇatrayasyāsya sarvasya viṣayīkāreṇa vaśīkaraṇayogitvāt sarvameva prameyaṃ māyāpramātṝṇāmapi pratyakṣatvā bhāve'pi anumānadiśā āgamadiśā ca pṛthivyādi prameyamevetī yat prameyaṃ pṛthivyādi prakṛtyantatatvaṃ prameyaṃ pūrvaślokoktāḥ kālavidyā kālārāganiyatayastu api tatvāntargatatvānmāyāpramātṛ vyatiriktaprameyanirūpaṇād asminnavasare kālādayaḥ prameyā api na prameyatvena gaṇitāḥ vastutaḥ atratyaḥ māyādikṣityanta tatva madhyavartī pramātā prameya eva | sa tu māyā pramātā prameya bhūto'pi svavyatiriktaṃ prameyaṃ pratiparameśvarasya māyātmikāyāḥ svātantryaśaktyā pramātrī kriyamāṇa prameyatve satyapyācchādita prameyatāka ihocyate | atra pṛthivyādi buddhyantatatvatrayoviṃśati madhye kiṃ <ṭ p. 360> kāryaṃ kiṃ ca kāraṇamityante vā si praśnamāśaṅkyāha | atra trayoviṃśatau bāhyakaraṇāvalī antaḥ <463> karaṇāvalī trayodaśavidyā sthūlasūkṣmatvabhedataḥ kāryavargaśca daśadhā māyā pramātuḥ prathamaṃ karaṇarūpayogaprayojanamiti ādau karaṇānāṃ kathanam | tāni trayodaśa | tatra karaṇe ṣvavarohakrameṇādau pṛthivyādi śabdāntādhyavasāya sāmānyamātrarūpā buddhiḥ adhyavasāya sādhanaṃ buddhiriti muktanītyā svayaṃ pramātṛviṣayādhyavasāya sādhanarūpatvādyādyasmin yasmin viṣaye pramāturyoyo'dhyavasāyo'sti tat tadadhyavasāya sāmānyamātrarūpā trayoviṃśattatvātmikā buddhiḥ | anena buddhervyāpakātmakā tatvatā darśitā | ahaṃkāro mamedaṃ na mamedamityabhimānasādhanamityukta nītyābhimānasādhanatvāt yasya yasya pramātuḥ yatra yatra grāhye viṣaye ahaṃ grāhakaḥ mamedaṃ pṛthivyādi grāhyaṃ na mamedammiti māyīyo yo'bhimāno'sti tat tadabhimāna sāmānyamātrarūpo'haṃkāraḥ manaḥ saṅkalpavikalpasādhanamityuktanītyā pṛthivyādiśabdāntaṃ saṅkalpaṃ sarveṣu kāryeṣu evaṃ karomi evaṃ na karomīti sarvakāryakartranusthūta sāmānyātmakasaṃkalpakāraṇaṃ manaḥ ityetattrayaṃ pramātuḥ antaḥkaraṇaṃ pṛthivyādi śabdāntaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaṃ viṣayamantaḥ karomītyantaḥkaraṇaṃ śabdādi pṛthivyantavastvadhyavasāyarūpāyāṃ jñānātmani buddhau upayogonīndriyāṇi jñānendriyāṇi pañcaśabdādhyavasāyarūpe jñāne upayogi śrotrendriyaṃ sparśādhyavasāyarūpe jñāne upayogisparśendriyamityādi yatra yatra śabdādhyavasāya jñānamasti tatra tatra śrotramupayogīti śrotrendriyasya vyāpakātmakaṃ tatvamityādi krameṇa sarveṣāmindiryāṇāṃ vyāpakarūpaṃ tattvamavagantavyam | yathoktam (-) śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmanāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ krameṇa grahaṇasādhanāni <464> śrotratvak cakṣurjihvāghrāṇānipañcajñānendriyāṇi vacanādāna gamanavisargānandātmani karmāṇyupayogīni pāṭavādighrāṇāntānti | karmāṇyupayogitvameva karmendriyāṇāṃ pratipādayati (-) tathā hītyādinā | tyāgaṃ grahaṇaṃ(,) tyāgagrahaṇayordvayamiti bahirindriyaviṣayaṃ yat karma teṣu tyāge grahaṇe ubhaye ca krameṇa pāyuḥ pāṇiḥ pāda iti karaṇāni vyāpriyante | pādendriyasyaikasya deśatyāgaḥ ityubhayamapyasti | etat tyāgahaṇadvayamantaḥ prāṇapramātari yenendriyeṇa kriyate <ṭ p. 361> <464> tadvagindriyaṃ mūlādhārāt prabhṛti jihvā paryantaprasāraṇātmani prasaramekamekaṃ sthānaṃ tyaktvā anyamanyaṃ sthānaṃ gṛhṇātīti tyāgagrahaṇātmakaṃ karmadvayamasti | tyāga grahaṇātmakavyāpārakṣobhapraśāntyā ānandātmakaviśrānti kriyopayogyupasyendriyaṃ jñānendriyavargāt karmendriya vargasya viśeṣaḥ tāmasāhaṅkāraviśeṣātmakāni karmendriyāṇi sarvadehavyāpakāni vyapakatvācchinnāgrahastaḥ bāhubhyāmādadānaḥ haste naivādatte | cchinnapādaḥ jānubhyāmeva gacchati | kevalamasphuṭapūrṇādānādi vyavahāralābhasthānatvāt pañcāṅgulīrūpamadhiṣṭhānamucyate | ityevaṃ buddhyādyupasthāntāni karaṇāni trayodaśa śrotrādīnikaraṇāni gotva ghaṭatvādivat śivādisakalāntapramātṛ gata śrotrādiṣvanusyūtatvāt sāmānyarūpāṇi tatvānyeva | eṣāṃ śrotrādīnāṃ paramapramātāraṃ pratikāryatvepyasādhāraṇe na kāryatvena vyapadeśaḥ eteṣāmeva kāraṇatvena vyapadeśaḥ(,) natvanyasya kartṛvargasya kāryavargasya ca kāraṇatvam | atrārohakrame gandhādiṃ vihāya pṛthivyāderūpādānaṃ gandhādivargasya pṛthivyādyantarbhūtatvāt sthūlāni kāryāṇi pṛthivyādīni pañcaiṣāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ sūkṣmaṃ rūpaṃ krameṇa gandho raso rūpasparśaśabda iti | <465> śabdaikagaṇamākāśam | śabdaikaguṇavyāpitvādākāśaṃ tvamambike |
śabdasparśātmakaṃ tattvaṃ tadguṇaṃ vyūhakṛt pare ||
vāyuḥ prāṇādirūpeṇa sthitastvatprakṛtirmataḥ | yaḥ śabdasparśarūpāṇāṃ saṃsthānaṃ tadguṇasya yat ||
tejo vikārastvadrūpa pare pākādi kāryakṛt || yaḥ śive śabdasaṃsparśarūpaiḥ sākaṃ rasātmanā ||
tanmātreṇodbhavantyāpastāstvatsaṃgrahayonayaḥ | śabdādibhiścaturbhiryā gandhena ca vibhāvyate ||
tatkāryā ca bhavet pṛthvī pṛthvī sā tvaṃ nigadyase ||
ityekaikaguṇaiveti | iha tatvamātragaṇanāyāmanupayogāt pṛthivyaptejovāyurnabha iti vibhaktaṃ pṛthivyādisthūlaṃ gandhādyavibhāgasyānumāpakaṃ jñāpakaṃ prathamaṃ sthūlapañcakaṃ darśitam | tatra tattvagaṇanāyāṃ pṛthivyādayaḥ śabdāntāḥ <ṭ p. 362> miśrī | bhūya ghaṭapaṭādi svalakṣaṇībhūtāḥ vāgādibhiḥ karmendriyaiḥ prasarpitāḥ gṛhītāḥ śrotrādijñānendriyairālocitāḥ manasā saṃkalpitāḥ ahaṅkāreṇa mamedamityābhimatā buddhyāniścitāḥ aśuddhavidyayā vivecitāḥ kalādibhiścaturbhirabhirañjitāḥ pṛthivyādyābhāsaḥ ityevaṃ krameṇa pramātariviśrāmyatīti tātparyam | sarvāṇi tatvāni pramātari viśrāmyantītyarthaḥ | etacca tat pradhāneṣu tattvagaṇanā pradhāneṣu tattattattva tattatpramātṛnirūpaṇapradhāneṣu śrītantrālokatrikasārādiṣu nirṇītamiti iha tattvamātragaṇanāyāmanupayogaṃ na vistāritam ||
<466> [iti śrīpratyabhijñāsūtravimarśinī vyākhyāyāṃ trayodaśamāhnikam] ||
[atha caturdaśamāhnikam ]
āgamādhikāre prathamāhnikena śivādikṣityantatattvātmaka prameya nirūpaṇaṃ kṛtam | anena dvitīyenāhnikena māyādikṣityanta pramātrādiśivādi pramātṛsaptakanirūpaṇaṃ tatpramātṛtānyonya tāratamyapratipādanātmakamāṇavādi malatrayanirūpaṇaṃ tanmeya trayanirūpaṇaṃ tanmalatrayodbhavatirobhāvabhedāt saṃsāriṇāṃ bandhamokṣanirūpaṇaṃ prāṇāpāna vyānodāna samānātmaka jāgratsvapna suṣuptaturya turyātītāvasthā pañcakanirūpaṇaṃ ca kriyate |
akhaṇḍita iti | sarvajña sarvakartṛ satatodita sarvavyāpakatvātmaka cidānandaghanasvabhāva khaṇḍane'pi sakala pralayākala vijñānākala mantramantreśvaramantramaheśvarātmikāṃ vicitrāmanyonyaṃ bhinnāṃ mātṛkalpanāṃ suhṛnmaṇḍalacakre svasminnavināśini sahaje hṛnmaṇḍale sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāranigrahānugrahātmaka kṛtyapañcakaparivartanakāritvāc cakrarūpe śrīparāśaktyātmanihṛdaye yaḥ prathayet paramārthataḥ svātmābhinnamapi darpaṇabiṃbagata nagaragrāmādivadanyonyataḥ svātmanaśca bhinnaṃ prakāśayet taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ ||
evaṃ śivādikṣityanta tatvarāśau nirṇīte sati tattattatvāntarbhāve noktamapi <ṭ p. 363> pramātṛtatvaṃ vitatya pradhānatayā pṛthageva nirgetuṃ kevalaṃ pramātṛ tatvameva vitatya tat pramātṛtatva svarūpaṃ vistareṇa pradarśya tatraitanmātṛtetyādibhiḥ <467> vyāno viśvātmakaḥ para ityantairviṃśatyā ślokairāhṇikaṃ prastūyate | asmin pratyabhijñā śāstrapramāturadhikāriṇaḥ sadgurukaṭākṣapavitri tasya svarūpa pratyabhijñānamupadiśyate | tathā hītyanena pramātṛtatvaheyopādeyatā vibhāganirūpaṇadvāreṇa tadubhayaṃ pramātṛtatvaṃ matsvarūpaṃ tasmādahamīśvara evetī śvarātmaka svarūpapratyabhijñānamasmin śāstra upadiśyate | sa upadeśyaḥ pramātā heyamupādeyañca śāstropadeśadvāreṇa heyamupādeyatvaṃ pramātṛtatvaṃ svaṃ svabhāvaṃ vidvān ubhayasyāpi svarūpatayā vedanaṃ paramopādeyarūpaṃ śivasya bhāvaṃ svātmānamabhedenāviśan jīvannevamukto bhavatīti śivalakṣaṇābhijñānabhūtaṃ jñānakriyāśaktiyuktatvāt śivasvabhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ yaḥ purāṇāgamādi prasiddha īśvaraḥ sa evāhamityabhedenāviśan jīvannevamukto bhavatīti ślokena māyā pramātṛvargasya saṃhārasṛṣṭi sthityavasthā trayādhikāri brahmaviṣṇurudrasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ tato'pi dvayena heyopādeya pramātṛtattvaṃ māyāntarvartī pramātṛtatvoheyaḥ māyottīrṇapramātṛtatvavartī pramātṛvarga upādeya iti baddha(ndha)rūpa pramātṛvargoheyaḥ gurukaṭākṣānmukta upādeyaḥ | heyopādeyatvopayogi āṇavādimalasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ malakṛtaṃ ca pramātṛbhedaṃ dvayena parameśvarātmaka svarūpasamāveśasvarūpaślokapañcakena suṣuptasvapna jāgratturīya turīyātītātmikāvasthā trayeṇa tāsāmavasthānaṃ heyopādeya nirūpaṇaṃ jāgradādi trayaṃ turyaturyatītātmakaṃ dvayamupādeyamiti nirūpayatyācāryaḥ tatreti |
evamāgamasiddhe yuktyanugate ca tatvasvarūpe nirūpite sati etanmātṛteti kālādikapañcakaveṣṭitopasaṃhṛta prameya jāta mātṛtāmātrasya <468> sthitau saṃhāradaśāyāṃ rudraḥ taddaśāsaṃpādanenopasaṃhṛta prameyadaśā saṃpādanena svopāsakalokasya taddaśādānena taddaśāddhyānāveśasampannasya svopāsakalokasya <ṭ p. 364> svāmimukhyasaṃpādanena ca bhajamāno bhagavān rudro'dhidaivatam idamiti bhinnaprameya prasārātmani sṛṣṭyavasthāyāṃ brahmādidaivatatvena sthitaḥ prasṛte bhinnaprameye tat santānapravahaṇalakṣaṇaprasārātmani sthityavasthāyāṃ viṣṇuradhidaivatatvena sthitaḥ | tatra bhagavato rudrasyāhamiti pramātṛdaśāyuktatvāt prāṇāpānadina niśāsūryendvādidvandvavinirmuktatvāt brahmaviṣṇvostṛtīyanayanonmīlanatvaṃ nāsti | evamantarbahirvṛttirityādinā sthūlasūkṣmatvabhedata ityantenāgamakāṃḍa prathamāhnikena śivādikṣityante tatvavarge nirūpite sati kālādiveṣṭitaṃ māyāpramātṛtārūpaṃ yat tat pramātṛ rūpameva saṃhārākhyāyāṃ yasyāṃ prameyadaśāyāmupasaṃhṛte dantārūpaprameyajātam | ata eva pramātṛtā mātratvena sthitaṃ bhavati | tathāsvāṃ daśāyāṃ tasya pramāturadhiṣṭhātṛ devatā tvaṃ tasya pramātustad daśā saṃpādanena svopāsakalokasyopasaṃhṛtaprameya(-) jātamātṛtā mātrātmakasaṃhāradaśādānena ca |
kiñca tat saṃsāradaśādhyānasamāpannasyābhimukhya saṃpādanena cādhiṣṭhā tṛdevatā tvaṃ bhajamāna īśvara eva rudro bhagavān parameśvara eva bhagavān rudro bhūtvā sthitaḥ yo rudraḥ māyā pade'pi prāṇāpānamaya dharmādharma sūryendudinaniśādi dvandvavinirmuktāhaṃ tātmaka brahmanāḍīmayo dānātmaka vahnimayamadhye jyotīrūpaḥ <469> pramātṛsvarūpasparśādunmīlita tṛtīyanetrā madhyamajyotirbrahmanāḍī tasya māyā pramātuḥ svātmano bhinnasyedantārūpasya prameyasya prasare sṛṣṭyādi daśāyām adhiṣṭhātṛ devatā tvaṃ bhajana tasya pramāturā saṃhāraṃ prasṛtabhinnaprameya saṃtānapravahaṇalakṣaṇe prasare sthityavasthāyām adhiṣṭhātṛ devatā tvaṃ bhajanviṣṇustayorbrahmaviṣṇavorapi svorapi svopāsakalokasya taddaśāsṛṣṭisthiti daśādānaṃ tat sṛṣṭidaśā dhyānāveśasamānasya svopāsakalokasya svābhimukhya saṃpādanañcāsti | ata evedantā rūpaprameyasṛṣṭisthitīrūpasya meya saṃpādane prādhānyāt ata evāhamiti pramātṛ daśā veśa śūnyatvāt tayorna tṛtīyanayanonmīlanaṃ prasara iti pramātpatti sthityoḥ paryāyaḥ |
<ṭ p. 365> pūrvasūtreṇa yat pramātṛsvarūpamuktaṃ tasya pramātṛsvarūpasya māyāṃ dhatve sati saṃsārī pramātā patiriti kathyate | tasyaiśvaryasya bhāvasyetyuktanītyā vidyābhijñāpitaiśvarye pramātari sati mukta iti vyapadeśaḥ | viśvasya svāṅgatvābhimānane ahamevāhamidamiti sadāśiveśvaradaśāyāṃ sampannāyāṃ tasya māyāpramātuḥ patirityāgamasiddhā saṃjñā | tirādhānakarī māyābhidhā punaḥ ityuktanītyā māyāśaktyā viśvasya svātmano bhedenābhimanane kleśakarmādi kaluṣaḥ paśurityāgamikā saṃjñā iti saṃsārīti muktaya iti patiriti paśuriti cāgamikāsaṃjñā bhedañca nirūpayati (-) eṣa iti | kālādi veṣṭitaḥ māyāndhaḥ ata eva karmabaṃdhanaḥ karmāṇi bandhakatvenābhimanyamānaḥ | eṣa iti kālādiveṣṭitaḥ śūnyādi pramātā saṃsārītyucyate | proktarūpa vidyābhijñāpitanityatvādyaiśvaryaḥ ata eva cidghanaḥ cidekarūpaḥ <470> mukta ityucyate | eva muktaṃ bhāveṣu svāṅgarūpeṣu pramātā kṣityādi bhāveṣu svāṅgatvena pramananaṃ kurvan patiriti kathyate | māyāvaśāt svātmano bhediṣu teṣu bhāveṣu pāśarūpaistaistairbhāvaiḥ pāśitatvāt | ata eva kleśakarmādi kaluṣa iti kathyate āgameṣu parameśvareṇeti śeṣaḥ | tirodhānakāriṇyā mayayā andhovimohitaḥ tiraskṛta svātmeśvarabhāvaḥ ata eva mohitaḥ kālādiveṣṭitaḥ śūnyādiḥ pramātā saṃsarati yoneryonyantaraṃ bhajatīti saṃsārī dehasyāpi saṃsaraṇamastītyāha (-) deho'pityādinā |
<471> na kevala va (------------) bu (-----------------------------) vanavārdhakeṣu tadbāhyādi svarūpasādṛśyamanuvartayan bālyādiṣu saṃsaratī va dehī | yathoktam (-)
dehino'sminyathā dehe kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā | tathā dehāntaraprāptirdhārastatra na muhyati ||
dehasyaikasminneva janmani bālyayauvanādiṣu saṃsaraṇam | anyonya rūpagrahaṇāt | buddhiprāṇādestu jantāntare'pi saṃsaraṇam | yathoktam (-) mano hi jātyantarasaṅgatijñamiti | api śabdena tattatkṣaṇika (-----------------) duḥkhamohāviṣṭatvāt ekasminnapi janmani saṃsaraṇamasti | tasyaiśvarya svabhāvasyetyuktanītyā maheśvarātmakasvasvarūpaprakāśanakāriṇyā vidyayā yasya pramāturaiśvaryaṃ pratyābhijñāpadaṃ prāpitaṃ <ṭ p. 365> pūrṇatvādyaiśvaryaṃ yasya pūrṇatvādyaiśvaryasya pratyabhijñāpanaprāṇanāt śarīrādyapi śarīraprāṇabuddhiśūnyāni tadvyatiriktaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi viśvamapi saṃvedanameva | ekasaṃvinmayamevābhimanyamānaḥ ata eva cidaikaghanā pūrṇāhantātmakabodhaikaghanā ata evānye dantātmakā cidrūpavyāmiśraṇā śūnyā cideva yasya svarūpaṃ saṃbhede sthite'pi dehapātānantaraṃ janmabandhavirahāt mukta iti vyapadeśayogyaḥ dehe patite tu yathā sthita śivaikarūpaḥ iti kaḥ pramātā saṃsaraṇahetu bhūtād dehādestasya pramātuśca śivaika ghanatvāt kaḥ kuto muktaḥ | yathoktam (-) namaḥ saṃsārarupāyeti | gurukaṭākṣapātāt pūrvapaśvavasthā rūpayā gatyā amukta caitramaitrādi pramātrantarāpekṣayā ca muktaḥ <472> śiva iti vyapadeśaṃ yo'yaṃ muktaḥ saḥ kṣityādi bhāvān saśarīratve nābhimanyamānaḥ kṣitirahamahaṃ pātho vaiśvānaro'hamahaṃ marudviyadahamiti nītyā kṣityādi bhāvān svaśarīratve nābhimandamānaḥ pramimīte pramananaṃ kareti mananamavagamanaṃ karoti | ata eva kṣityādibhāvānāṃ svāmī īśa īśvaraḥ patiśabdasyaiko'rthaḥ | ātmānamata evāyamityuktanītyā teṣāmaprakāśarūpasyātma paramārthasamarpaṇācca pālaka iti bhāvānāṃ patirupadiṣṭaḥ śāstre tattadrūpatayā svayameva prakāśanāt pālakorakṣakaḥ patirityupadiṣṭaḥ śāstre parameśvareṇa māyāto bhediṣu mātāsan māyāśaktyā svātmanaścānyonyaḥ kṛtabhedān | ata eva svātmano vyatiriktān yadābhimīte māyāśakti kṛtabhedaistaireva meyaiḥ pāśīta iti paśuraktaḥ | mamedaṃ kalatraṃ mamedaṃ kṣetraṃ mamāyaṃ putra ityādi baddhatvāt pāśita iti paśuruktaḥ (------------) ma (--------------) raṇeti śeṣaḥ | tathā hi tyanena teṣāṃ meyānāṃ pāśatvamevadarśayati | ādyasya pramāturvedyarāśivaśādeva | vidyā svasvarūpā pratyabhijñām | asmitā tesvahaṅkāraḥ | rāgasteṣvabhiṣvaṃgaḥ dveṣastadviparītaḥ | abhiniveśa āveśa iti kleśāḥ saṃbhavanti | asya pramātuvedyarāśi vaśāt svarganarakaphalarūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti | ādiśabdenāśārūpā hṛdayasthā vāsanā teṣāṃ hṛdayasthitaḥ saṃskāraḥ kleśānāṃ phalātmaka bhogarūpo vipākaḥ ityavidyāsmitādirūpeṇa kāluṣyamanantaprakāraṃ kāluṣyaṃ māyāśaktyāvilatvaṃ yataḥ kāluṣyāt pāśitatvena paśuruktaḥ |
<ṭ p. 367> <473> yadetaduktaṃ paśurūpaṃ tat paśurūpamevāṇa va māyīya karmātmakaṃ malamityāgameṣu parameśvareṇoktamityāha (-) citsvarūpatve satyapi pūrṇāhantātmaka svātaṃtryahāniḥ dehāhaṃ bhāvātmaka svātantryetyāpi bodhaśūnyatā ityāṇavaṃ malaṃ dvidhā | tatrahetuḥ jñātṛkartṛntātmakacittatva svarūpa hānito hetoḥ | tatra bodhasya svātaṃtrya hānirvijñānākāleṣu sakalapralayākaleṣu svātantryasyāpyabodhateti vibhāgaḥ | atraivaṃ dviprakāre āṇavamāyīye sthite sati bhinna vedyaprathā anyonya bhinnānāṃ svātmano bhinnānāṃ vedyānāṃ prathaiva māyākhyaṃ malam | etan māyāmalaṃ sthūlatva sūkṣmatva tāratamyena sakalapralayākala vijñānākala mantramātṛṣvanusyūtaṃ janmabhogadaṃ kārmaṃ jātyāyurbhogadaṃ karmetyuktanītyā pramātuḥ punaḥ punarjananaṃ bhogañca dadāti | puṇyā puṇyakartari pramātaribodharahite sati kārmamalam | etat trayaṃ māyāśaktyaiva bhavati | asya malatrayasya māyāśaktireva nimittaṃ kārmamalaṃ sakalapramātṛṣu teṣāṃ kārmamalepya (---------------) kṣā (----) (----) ṇanītyā pralayāt punarutthānarūpaḥ saṃskārarūpeṇāsti kārmamalaṃ paramaśivaṃ pratimantramaheśvaramaṃtreśvara mantravijñānākala pralayākala sakalākhye pramātṛsaptake āṇavamalatāratamye na krameṇa sūkṣmasthūlātmanā tāratamye nāsti |
cittatvasya pūrṇā hantātmanaḥ prabodharūpaṃ jñātṛkartṛtā rūpaṃ sarvajño'haṃ sarvakartāhamityevaṃ bhūtasya svarūpasya sthitatve'pi ti (-----------) māyayā parityāga āṇavaṃ malaṃ yena male nāsau pramātā saṃkucito jātaḥ parimito jātaḥ | atrāṇoḥ pūrṇāhantātmanaḥ svarūpasya nimīlanaṃ saṃkocaṃ tat svarūpa nimīlanaṃ cidātmani kevalaṃ bodharūpe sthite sati kartṛtva rūpasya svātantryātmanaḥ svarūpasyāntarasya nimīlanaṃ kartṛ lakṣaṇe svarūpe sthite sati pūrṇāhantātmakaṃ bodhalakṣaṇasya svarūpāntarasya nimīlanaṃ vetyubhayaprakāraṃ svarūpāparihāraṃ rūpam āṇavaṃ malaṃ dviprakāramadhye ekamevātraiveti āṇave male sati bodhahānitaḥ svātantrya hānitaśca dviprakāre svarūpasaṃkoce sati svātmano bhinnasya vedyasya prathanaṃ yadbhinnavedya prathā vaśāddharmādharmarūpaṃ kārmamalaṃ yataḥ kārmamalājjanma ca bhogaśca bhavati | sa ca bhoga etā vantaṃ kālamevamiti niyatā vadhika iti jātyāyurbhogadaṃ <ṭ p. 368> karmetyuktaṃ bhavati | eṣāmāṇavādi malānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak svāśrayasyātmabhūtaḥ pramātṛrūpaṃ sphuṭīkartuṃ svātantryāhānirbodhasyetyāṇavamalā prathamabhāmasya prathamaṃ sthānāvaśeṣamāha (-) śuddhacidātmakatve'pi yeṣāṃ vijñānakevalānāṃ pramātṝṇāmuttamakartṛtā nāsti te parameśvareṇa svātmanaḥ parameśvarādanyonyaṃ ca bhinnā nirmitāḥ svātmano'nyonyaṃ ca binnatvena nirmāṇaheturuttamakartṛ tyāgaḥ | tasmāt |
tasmād yeṣāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ bodhaikamātrameva paramārthaḥ viśvasyāhamiti svātma viśrāntirūpānandalakṣaṇaṃ svātantryaṃ nāsti | prapañce satyapinedamiti parameśvarasvātantrya kalpitādatadabhimānād viśvakartāhamiti paraṃ svātantryaṃ nāsti | te parameśvareṇa sarvajñaṃ sarvakartṛrūpā pūrṇāhantātmanaḥ svātmanaḥ sakāśāt vyatiriktī kṛtāḥ bhinnī kṛtāḥ | eteṣāmetad vyatiriktanirmāṇa hetuḥ śivādikṣityanta <475> viśvakartṛtātmakottama svātantryā bhāvāt parameśvarasya bodharūpatvaṃ pūrṇāhaṃtātmakottama svātantrya viyuktasya mityasya ślokasyābhiprāya śeṣaḥ | kartṛtātyayāddhetoḥ parameśvarāt te bhinnā bhavantu vijñānākālānāṃ kathamanyonyaṃ bhedaḥ kevalaṃ bādharūpasya vyāpitva dharmakṛta deśā bhedasya nityatva dharmakṛtasya kālā bhedasya cānyonyaṃ samānatvāt |
evamanyonya bhedābhāve nirmitāsta iti kathaṃ bahuvacanamityāśaṅkāṃ vyapohati (-) bodhanityatvasya vyāpitvānāmekatve'pi lakṣaṇaṃ tvanyonya bhinnau tadvijñānākālavargātmanā parameśvarecchā viśeṣeṇānyonyabhinnatā te ca śāstre parameśvareṇa vijñānakevalā uktā kartṛtāśūnyaṃ kevalaṃ vijñānamevarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ te(,) tattvavarge śivādikṣityantatattvātmanā śivādi sakalāntapramātrātmanā ca bhavitumicchustattadrūpeṇa bhavati prakāśate | natvanyaḥ kaścit parameśvara vyatiriktaḥ pramātṛvargo vā kaścinnāstīti | iha yadyat kiñcana sphurati tat tad vakṣyamāṇeśvarasvātmaprathā mātra mityādi vākyavyākhyānārambhe ātmānamata evāya mityādau cāsakṛduktam |
yā cidullasati viśvasattayā sā śivo'hamiti viśvasattayā | ākalasya sakṛdevamucyate deśikairasakṛdevamucyate ||
<ṭ p. 369> tataśca sakṛduktatvāt ahaṃ deśakālāsaṃkucitatvād vyāpakanityabodhasvabhāvo'pi bhede nānyonya bhinnavijñānā kalānātmanā nirbhāse bhātumīśe ityevaṃ bhūteśvarecchā viśeṣeṇa teṣāṃ śarīrādi śūnyānta jaḍapramātṛ padottīrṇānāṃ bodhatvādi <476> dharmajātasyaikye'pi teṣāmanyonyaṃ bhedaḥ | te ca śāstre vijñānakevalā uktāḥ | tatra vijñānakevalaḥ malaikayukta ityādi granthe uktaḥ | vijñānakevalaśabdasyārthaḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ | svātantryahānibodhasye tyāṇavamalādi bhāgasya |
vijñānā kalatā muktvā svātantryasyāpyabodhatā |
ityamumaṃśaṃ viṣayapradarśanena spaṣṭayati (-) vijñāne nā kalāḥ kalātatvopalakṣita karaṇakāryarahitāḥ sakalapramātṛvat | tasmān mahāsauṣuptarūpāt | pralata utthāne karaṇakāryasahitā bhavanti | māyātatvāntarvartitvāt teṣāṃ punarutthāna lakṣaṇakāraṇakāryabījabhūtaḥ saṃskārātmakārmamalo'pyasti madhiyo malaṃ vikalpitaḥ saṃskārātmaka bhinnavedyaviṣaye keṣāṃ cit prāṇasuṣupte bhedaprathāmayomayīyomalo'sti | apavedyaviṣaye śūnyasuṣupte nāstīti māyīya malovyavasthita viṣayaḥ | yadvakṣyati (-) savedyamapavedyañca māyāmalayutāyutam || iti |
teṣāmāṇava vastu uktakrameṇa svata evāsti | etadapi śabdena sūcitam |
jaḍatvādabodharūpe śūnye eva yadi vā abodharūpe prāṇabodharūpe buddhau vā yeṣāṃ śūnyādāvahamiti camatkāra yogāt kartṛtvaṃ te pralaye nā kalāḥ kṛtāḥ kalātatvopalakṣita karaṇakāryarahitā ityarthaḥ | pūrṇā hantātmakabodharahitā | tasmiñchūnyādau ahaṃ śūnya iti kartāraśca mahāsuṣuptyā vyavahite tathāvasthitāḥ pralayādanantaraṃ kāryakāraṇasaṃbaṃdhā eva bhavanti yatastataḥ pralayāvadhihite tathā bhūtāsteṣāṃ kevalamuktarūpa āṇava evamalaḥ <477> vāsanā saṃskārarūpaḥ bhaviṣyatkāryakāraṇa vāsanāsaṃskārarūpatvāt kāryakāraṇodaya hetu dharmā dharmātmā ahaṃ puṇyabhāk ahamapuṇyabhāgiti dharmā dharmātmā kārmamalo'pyasti | yadyevamiti | kārmamalo'pyasti yadi tat karmahetu bhūtā māyāmalātmikā bhinnavedyaprathāpyeṣāṃ syāt | satyamityanena bhāgenānu vadati saṃvedye prānisuṣuptapade saṃskārātmakavedyasahite prāṇasuṣupte'sti <ṭ p. 370> apavedye gāḍhasuṣupte na bhavati | bhinna vedya prathāntena sa vedyāpavedya sauṣuptapadayorbhinnavedyaprathāyāḥ satvā satvāt vyavasthita viṣayatvena māyīyomala eṣāṃ vikalpitaḥ | tathā hītyanena māyā malasya sadbhāvā sadbhāvau prakaṭīkaroti | śūnyasyādi apavedyabhāge viśrāntā gāḍhanidrayā jaḍī kṛtāḥ apavedye suṣuptipadabhājaḥ kecit pralayā kalāḥ | anye tu pralayā kalāḥ buddhiprāṇayoḥ sthitāḥ sukhaduḥkhaśeṣarahita sāmānyātmakā bhinnasaṃvedya yoginaḥ saṃvedya sauṣuptapadalīnāḥ sthūlasya dehātmanaḥ kāryasyendriyātmanaḥ karaṇasya yogarūpatvaṃ sarveṣāṃ tulyam |
svātantryahānirbodhasyetyāṇavamalasya prathamāṃśo vijñānākalaniṣṭhaḥ svātantryāpyabodhatetyayaṃ caramāṃśaḥ pralayākalaniṣṭhaḥ | āṇavamalaprasaṃgāt pralayākalasyāpi kārmamalaviṣayatvaṃ darśitam | māyāmalasya ca pralayākaleṣu pākṣikatvamuktam | evaṃ vijñānākalasyāṇava māyāmalaustaḥ | pralayākalasyoktakrameṇamalatrayamastīti bhedamuktvedānīṃ punarāṇava kārmamaladvayā bhāve'pi <478> vidyeśvareṣu mantrapramātṛṣu māyākhyasya malasya śuddho viṣayo'stīti darśayati (-)bodhānāṃ sarvajñānāmapi bodhakartṛtvajuṣāmahaṃ puṇyakarmā ahaṃ pāpakarmeti kārmamalakṣitau sati bhinnavedya yujāṃ teṣāṃ māyāmalamastite vidyeśvarāḥ |
ye pramātāraścinmātramevātmatvena paśyantaḥ māyāpramātṛ vajjaḍarūpaṃ dehādyātmatayā paśyanti tasminneva cinmātre ahamiti camatkārollāsātkartāraḥ ata eva sarvajñāḥ sarvakartāraḥ cinmātrasyaivātmatayā darśanāt | tatraiva kartṛtvāt sarvajñāḥ sarvakartāraśca te vidyeśvarāḥ | evaṃ bhūtatve'pi teṣāṃ viśeṣaṃ darśayati (-) kiṃ tvityanena bhuvanabhāvādikaṃ viśvaṃ vedanaviṣayatvāt jñānaviṣayatvaṃ vedyatayā kriyā viṣayatvāt kāryatayā ca bhāti | māyābhūmau sraṣṭṛrūpāṇāṃ kuvindakumbhakārādīnāṃ tat sṛṣṭaṃ vedyaṃ kāryaṃ ca viśvaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi yathā svasmāt svātmano bhinnaṃ bhāti | taccedvidyeśvarāṇāṃ vibhinnameva sadbhātīti tadbhinnavedyaprathārūpamāyākhya malayogo'sti |
malatrayasyāpi yau gapadyena sahaiva yo viṣayastaṃ darśayitumāha (-)
<ṭ p. 371> bhavināṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ devādīnāṃ sthāvarāntānāṃ vidyādhara devayakṣarākṣasagaṃdharvakinnarāpiśācaguhyakāṇḍaja(-) svedaja jarāyujaudbhijjasarīsṛpasyā varāntānāṃ caturdaśadhā śāstre parigaṇitānāṃ trividhaṃ malamasti | teṣu satsvapi kārmamalaṃ teṣāṃ devādīnāṃ mukhyatayā saṃsaraṇe saṃsāre kāraṇam | āṇava māyāmalau tu kārmeṇa <479> vinā saṃsaraṇe kāraṇaṃ na bhavataḥ | iha pramātṛvarge vidyeśvaravijñānākalavargayormāyāntā dhvatikrameṇānnannabhavo'sti | mantreśvaramantamaheśvaravargayostadadhiṣṭhātrorīśvarabhaṭṭāraka sadāśiva bhaṭṭārakayordūrato nāsti pralayākalāstu viśvasaṃhārāt punastad viśvodayāntamavidyamānabhāvā māyātatvāntarvartino ye devāḥ sthāvarāntāsteṣāṃ trayo'pimalo yugapadeva santi te sarve saṃsāriṇa ityuktam | tatra malatrayamadhye katamomalassaṃsaraṇameṣāṃ sampādayatītyāśaṃkya kārmamalasyaiva saṃsaraṇasaṃpādanamāha (-) tatrāpi teṣvāpi satsvityarthaḥ | teṣu sat svapi kārmamalaṃ pradhānatvenāgatya saṃsaraṇe kāraṇam | yathoktam (-) kārmamalataśśarīrāṇi viṣayāḥ saṃbhavanti | teṣāṃ tanuḥ karaṇaviṣayasaṃbaṃdha eva tadānīm | idānīñca vartamānaḥ paścātpaścādbhaviṣyaṃścetyanavarata prabandhena vartamānaḥ saṃsaraṇamucyate | āṇava māyāmalau tu saṃsāre kāraṇameva | āṇavamāyīyau kārmeṇa vināvijñānakevaleṣu kārmamalarahitatvād dehādi vicitrabhāvā bhinirvartanaśaktiśūnyau iti mukhyaṃ kārmameva malaṃ mukhyaṃ saṃsārakāraṇamiti tatra tatra śāstre bhaṇyate | ata evaṃ bhaṇyamānatvāt karmanāśe vṛtte saṃsārasopānapadabaṃdyā bhāvodatta ityāśayena sāṃkhyapurāṇabhāratādi śāstreṣu karmabandhābhimānaparihāṇireva bhaṇyate | ekaikarūpaistribhirdehaistrirūpairdvibhedaiḥ ekarūpatribhedeneti śivādi sakalāntāḥ saptapramātāra uttiṣṭhanti | krameṇa tāratamya padavīṃ prāptaistribhirāṇavarūpaiḥ kairbhedaiḥ śivamantramaheśvara mantreśvarā uttiṣṭhanti | āṇavamāyīyarūpeṇa bhedadvayenāṇavakārmarūpeṇaikena bhedena mantreśvaravijñānākalapralayākalā <480> yathā kramamuttiṣṭhanti | tatrāṇavamāyīya bhedadvayena mantreśvaravijñānā kalā uttiṣṭhanti | <ṭ p. 372> āṇava kārmātmanā dvibhedena pralayā kalā uttiṣṭhanti | āṇava māyīya kārmātmanā ekena bhedena sakalā uttiṣṭhanti | iti malatrayasya tribhirekaikabhedaistribhirdvibhedenaikena tribhedena śivādisakalāntāḥ saptapramātāraḥ krameṇottiṣṭhanti | tatra malatraye sthūlasūkṣmatāratasmya bhedena pradhānatā pradhānatā bhedena vikalpabhedena samuccaya bhede nādiśabdena nyūnādhikya bhedena cānantaprakāratvamastyeṣāṃ malānām |
tatra śivamantramaheśvaramantreśvareṣu āṇavaṃ malaṃ tāratamyena mukhyam | tatra vidyeśvareṣu yā malasya mukhyatvaṃ vijñānākaleṣvāṇa va māyīyayoḥ krameṇamukhyatvaṃ pralayākale ṣvāṇava kārmamalayormukhyatvaṃ sakaleṣu malatrayasyaiva mukhyatvam | tatrāpi saṃsārahetoḥ kārmamalasyaiva mukhyatvam | etan malamukhyam | etadamukhyaṃ taccetacca mukhyamityavāntarabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | atra ca malatrayasya vikāsatirobhedāt saṃsāriṇāṃ baṃdhamokṣātmakaṃ prakāradvayaṃ darśayati |
kalāśaktyātmanā tattve nopadbalitaṃ malenanyakkṛtaṃ sarvarūparahito'haṃ tṛṣito'haṃ pipāsito'haṃ sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyahaṃ kṛśo'haṃ shtūlo'hamityatra cidrūpaṃ śūnyadehāntaraṃ pradhānīkṛtyasvaṃ pradhānatvena sthitam | tatra hetu māha (-) mitaṃ idantāpannaṃ kiñca dehādiśūnyānta pramātṛbhāganimagnatvācca prameyaṃ yadā punaḥ kartṛtāyāścidātmano bodhasya mukhyatvaṃ śūnyādāvetajjñātṛ kartṛtvayorapradhānatvena sthite sati tajjñānaṃ parameśvarātmaka svasvarūpasamāveśalakṣaṇam |
<481> etacceti | bhavināṃ tridaśādīnāṃ caitanyaṃ yad dehādāvātmano bodhabhāgasya nimajjitatvāt kartṛtāmayaṃ cidrūpasya tatvamiti svātantryamityarthaḥ | parameśvaraśaktyātmanā kalākhyena kiñcitkartṛtārūpeṇa tattvena upodvalitamanuprāṇitaṃ malena nyak kṛtaṃ sadudbodhitaṃ śūnyādi dehānta māyā pramātṛ saṃbandhi yat tatvaṃ svātantryaṃ śūnyādipradhānīkṛtya svayamapradhānatvena sthitaṃ tadidantāṃ prāptam | kiñca dehādiśūnyānta prameyabhāganimagnatvācca prameyaṃ yogaura iti dehasya sukhīti buddheḥ yastṛṣita iti prāṇasya yaḥ <ṭ p. 373> sarvarūparahita iti śūnyasya gauroyaḥ sohamiti gaurādirūpā idantai vāṃ tarhitāhaṃ bhāvā bhūtvā saṃsāriṇyaṃ parisphurati seyaṃ saṃsārāvasthā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptarūpā yaḥ khalvahamiti bhāti sa (----) pūrṇaḥ svatantro vibhurnityaḥ sapūrṇasvatantra ityuktagurupadeśayuktibhiḥ | nityo'haṃ paripūrṇohaṃ svatantro'hamahaṃ vibhuḥ |
ityevaṃ vimṛśannāse satyena vacasā guruḥ ||
iti nītyā svātantryātmakatva nityatvādi dharmaparāmarśātmani cidrūpe vidadhatā te naiva paripūrṇe nāhaṃ bhāvena śūnyādiṃ prameyaṃ saṃvit svarūpe nimajjyaivāsya te yadā tadā turyātītāvasthā | yadā tu parāmṛṣṭastadā(thā) bhūtavaibhavanityatvaiśvaryādi saṃbhede naivāhaṃ bhāvena śūnyādi dehāntaṃ saptadhātūṃśca siddhasya mantrasiddhena raso yathā tāmrādi svarṇī bhavati tadvacchūnyādi dehadhātvantaṃ siddharasena na <482> vidhyate | sā turyadaśā tadā tasyāṃ turyadaśāyāṃ tadapi śūnyādi prameyatāmujjhatīva saṃvinmayī bhāvāt turyāvasthā turyātītāvasthā ceti dvayapi jīvanmuktyavasthā samāveśa ityuktā | śāstre saṃvicchāstre tatra tatrāgame'hantā rūpasamyagāveśanameva hi pradhānāveśasiddhaye upadeśāntarāṇi samāveśopāya viśeṣākārāṇyapekṣaṇīyāni | yathā gītaṃ bhagavatā (-) māyipūrṇāhantātmani svarūpe manaḥ dehāderapyupalakṣaṇam | māyimana āveśya nimajjya (-) mayyāveśyamano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate | śraddhayā parayopetāste me yuktatamā matāḥ || iti nityayuktā avirataṃ svasvarūpasamāveśodyuktāḥ te mahāyogino matāḥ ||
athāveśāyituñcittaṃ na śaknomi mayi sthiram | abhyāsayogena tato mabhicchāptuṃ dhanañjayaḥ ||
iti ca dehaprāṇabuddhiśūnyādi prahvībhāvo'nuprāṇitāḥ parameśvarastuti prāṇāḥ pūjā dhyānasamādhiprabhṛtayaḥ sameveśapallavā aṃśā iti prasiddhāḥ | samāveśābhyāse'samarthaḥ san matkarmaparamo bhāvaḥ(,)
madarthamayi karmāṇi kurvan siddhimavāpsyasi | iti dehapāte <ṭ p. 374> parameśvaraikarasa iti kaḥ kutra kathaṃ samāviśet | svavyatirekeṇānyasyā bhāvāt svayameva parameśvaratvāt | tadetaduktaṃ prameyamatyāha | kartṛtāyāḥ pūrṇāhantātmikāyāḥ kartṛtāyā mukhyatvaṃ yat kartṛtāyā avinābhāvaḥ śūnyo darguṇabhāvaḥ acidrūpe śūnyādau guṇī bhūte svātantryasyāpyabodhatetyuktasya mala vyāpārasyā bodhatetyuktasyāṇava malavyāpārasyāpahastanāt bodhātmakaścito <483> parodhabhogo yaḥ āṇavamalenanyak kṛto'bhūt tasyāpi bodhalakṣaṇasya bhāgasyādhunāpi kartṛtonmajjanakāle''cchādakasyāṇava malanyagbhāvād bodhasyonmagnatvena mukhyatvaṃ bhavati | kartṛtāyā mukhyatvaṃ yadunmagnatvaṃ kartṛtva bodhayorunmagnameva jñānam | asya samāveśalakṣaṇasya jñānasyā jñānātmaka malapratipakṣatvāt tadetat kartṛtva bodhayo svasvarūpasamāveśātmakaṃ mukhyatvam | yena samāveśena dehe sthito'pi pramātāpatiriti tamukta iti śāstreṣūktaḥ | patidaśāyāṃ pramātusturyatadatītarūpā ca daśā evamukta prakāreṇa bhavatu | pramātuḥ paśudaśāyāṃ suṣupta svapnajāgrad daśā āgameṣu kathamuktamityāśaṃkyaślokatreṇasuṣupta svarūpameva prathamamācaṣṭe |
buddhiprāṇadehaghaṭādyabhāvātmani śūnyo'hamityahantā kartṛtā yāḥ pade āspade asphuṭa ārūpe asphuṭe cidrūpabuddhiprāṇadehasaṃskāramātriṇe śūnye jñeyānāṃ śūnyatā bhavati | sā jñeyaśūnyatā akṣāṇāṃ cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ saṃskāramātrarūpā antarmukhīvṛttiḥ prāṇādiprerikā prāṇāpānasamānodāna vyānātmani vāyucakraprerikā sā jñeya śūnyā jīvanākhyā matā jīvatīti jīvanākhyā sā śaktiḥ |
athavā prāṇasauṣupte puryaṣṭakātmikā ahantā jīvanākhyā bhavati | tāvanmātra sthitau śūnyatāmātra sthitau proktaṃ pralayopamaṃ prāṇasauṣuptaṃ māyāmalayuktatvāt <484> saṃskāravedyasahitaṃ māyāmalayuktatvād eva vedyaṃ sauṣuptaṃ tāvan mātra sthitau śūnyamātra sthitau proktam |
iha cittattvaṃ svasvarūpamācchādayan jñeyarūpeṇa buddhyādinā jñeyarūpo dehāntena <ṭ p. 375> ghaṭādinā cā bhāsate | cittatvasyaivamadvitīyaṃ svātantryavijṛmbhitam | atra svātantrya vijṛṃbhite vāstavaṃ vasturūpaḥ kramo vā bhedo vā nāsti | tatrāpi kramabhedayorabhāve'pi cittatvasya svātantryāt kramaśca bhedaścābhāsate | paramārthato deśakālakramābhāvādabhede'pi bhedaśca kramaścābhāsate | iti sthite yaccittatvasya svarūpācchādanabhāgaḥ sa śūnyabhāgaḥ uttarottara buddhiprāṇadeharūpeṇa bhāgāntareṇā saṃkīrṇā yadā viśrāmyati tatraiva śūnyabhāge ahantārūpakartṛtāyāḥ padaṃ parāmarśaḥ buddhiprāṇādīnāsphuṭatvādī ṣadrūpātmanā vedyapadavīmāptena ata eva śuddhasaṃskāreṇa parāmarśaḥ ahantāyāḥ katṛtārūpaḥ parāmarśo yokto bhavati yadā tadā saiva śūnyā va sthānetyabhāvāmarśaśeṣā | anīpsitaṃ niṣedhya buddhyādiṣu suspaṣṭasaṃbhedāpi buddhirnāsti deho nāsti ghaṭādirnāsti iti niṣedharūpaḥ suspaṣṭaparāmarśasaṃbhedaḥ apekṣito'pi niyataḥ bhāvi niṣedhya yogāt akiñcano'hamityevaṃ bhūtaparāmarśavat mama kiñcidapi nāstīti svīkṛtasāmānyākāra niṣedhyā ata eva sāmānyākāraniṣedhyarūpatvāt saṃskāraśeṣīkṛta jñeyarūpā śūnyāvasthetyucyate | tathā vidyasaṃskāraśeṣīkṛta buddhyāderdehāntasya saṃskāraśeṣīkṛtasya nīlāderabhāvarūpe śūnya ityucyate | yasmāt tatra śūnye jñeyānāṃ śūnyatā abhāvarūpatā saṃskāra śeṣatā saṃskāra viśeṣa taiva sarvatrābhāvaḥ satāṃ vastūnāṃ sarvātmanā na vināsaḥ tatra śūnyapramātari saṃyuktā avinābhūtā prāṇādyātmake vāyucakre preraṇātmikāśaktistatraiva samacetā sā śaktiḥ vidyākalātatvayorvikāsabhūmau krameṇa vidyāyāḥ prapañcabhūtaḥ buddhindriyavargaḥ kalāyāḥ prapañcabhūtaḥ karmendriyavarga iti krameṇabuddhīndriyavargeṇa vargau yau tayo buddhindriya karmendriyayostayorāntarīvṛttiḥ tayorbuddhīndriyayostayorāntarīvṛttistayorbuddhīndriyavargayoḥ śabdasparśādeḥ parāmarśarūpāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhānām abhivyaktirūpasya sthānasyābhihananādi rūpā bāhyā vṛttiḥ sāmānyakaraṇavṛttiḥ prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañcaprāṇādyāḥ pañcavāyavaḥ karaṇānāṃ sāmānyā yā sādhāraṇīvṛttiḥ <ṭ p. 376> śūnye indriyacakropodbalikā jīvanamiti śūnya eva jīvaḥ saṃsaratīti yaḥ rūpādi vā | athavendriya śaktīnāmāntarī sādhāraṇaprāṇanātmikā prāṇaśabdavācyā prāṇādimārutaviśeṣapreraṇāmayī vṛttiryā tadā saivaśaktirahamityatiśayyamānā prāṇapramāturjīvanaṃ yadā tadā prāṇa eva jīvaḥ saṃsārītyarthaḥ | śūnyapramātā prāṇapramātā ca pūryaṣṭakaśabdavācyaḥ prāṇādipañcakaṃ pratyekamekaṃ buddhīndriyavarga ekaḥ niścayātmikā ca dhīryataḥ śūnyarūpāt prāṇarūpācca pramāturvyajyata iti svamate pūryaṣṭakam |
matāntaramapyāha (-) tanmātrapañcakaṃ ca mano'haṅkārabuddhayaḥ ityanye | tanmātrodayarūpeṇa mano'haṃ buddhivartinā puryaṣṭakena saṃruddha iti |
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ svaṃ mano buddhireva ca | <485> ahaṅkāra itī yaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā || ityanye |
śūnyātmakaṃ prāṇātmakaṃ pūryaṣṭakaṃ yat tāvativedya sparśā bhāvāt śuddhe ubhayātmake śūnyapramātuḥ prāṇapramātuḥ viśrāntistasyāṃ viśrāntau satyāṃ viśeṣeṇa suṣuptā yā ahantā yā bodhātmakaṃ bhāvarūpaṃ suṣuptā yāḥ bhāvaḥ sauṣuptamiti suṣuptā yā ahantā yā (bodhātmakaṃ bhāvarūpaṃ) karma ca sauṣuptaṃ tadbhāvakarmakarmātmakaṃ sauṣuptaṃ jāgratsvapnayorapi malena pramātā suptaḥ kiñcitkartṛrūpayā kalayā asupta iva sauṣupte tannimajjane suṣuptasya bhāvaḥ karma ca sauṣuptamiti | tatra ca śūnyasauṣupte prāṇasparśakṛtasya sukhaduḥkhāderastitvāt māyākhyaṃ malamasti | atastatsauṣuptaṃ savedyamapavedya savedyasuṣuptavat pralayo'pimantavyaḥ | pralayaḥ dehādipradhvaṃsānudayābhyāṃ kṛtaścirakālaśca dehādervidyamānatve'pi dehādyanādaraṇe kṛtaṃ sauṣuptamacirakālaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ | tatra sauṣuptaśramakṛtaṃ suṣuptaṃ nidrādhātudoṣa kṛtaṃ sauṣuptamūrcchādravya kṛtaṃ sauṣuptaṃ madonmadādi svātantrya kṛtaṃ sauṣuptaṃ samādhiryogaḥ ityavāntarabhedāḥ ||
kecittu (-) samādhirūpaṃ sauṣuptaṃ savedyam | anyāni sauṣuptānyapavedyānīti kecidāhuḥ | idaṃ sukhaṃ idaṃ duḥkhaṃ ayaṃ dehaḥ ayaṃ prāṇa iyaṃ buddhiriti sphuṭādvedyasthānādvinirmuktāyāḥ <ṭ p. 377> suṣuptāvasthāyāḥ śūnye buddhyādyabhāvādyā ityādi ślokatrayoktanītyā <487> suṣuptāvasthāyāḥ svarūpamastu | idānīṃ nīlamityādi sphuṭavedyābhāsayoginyoḥ svapnajāgraddaśayoranyonyaṃ ko bheda ityāśaṅkyaślokadvayena bhedamāha (-) antaḥkaraṇātmani mano mātre mārge'pi svapne ahaṃ cakṣuṣā kāntārūpaṃ dṛṣṭvān śravaṇena śabdaṃ śrutavān ityādi rūpeṇa bhrāntyā sphuṭa prakāśā bhāvānāṃ āntarī asthirā asādhāraṇī pārameśvarī sṛṣṭiḥ paśoḥ pramātuḥ svapnāvasthāmatā | āgameṣu parameśvareṇoktā paramārthataścakṣurādi sarvākṣaviṣayatvena yā sṛṣṭiḥ pramātuḥ bāhyarūpā sthirā sarvapramātṝṇāṃ sādhāraṇī sā sṛṣṭirjāgarāvasthā | cakṣurādindriyādhiṣṭhānāni dṛḍhaniyatāvāsabhūtāni cakṣurgolakāśravaṇaśaṣkulī ityādīni nidrāyamāṇasya nimīlitāni lakṣyante | adhiṣṭhāna nabhūta cakṣurgolakādiṣu nimīliteṣu satsubāhyendriyavyāpāro na dṛṣṭaḥ kaścidapi śeṣaḥ | tena dṛṣṭatvā bhāvāt cakṣurādīndriya vyāpārānapekṣe kevalaṃ manormāgre cakṣurādīndriya viṣaya sparśādayo bhāvāḥ akṣādīndriyagrahaṇasamucite na spaṣṭena vapuṣā bhāsamānayogyāḥ santaḥ svapne parameśvareṇa sṛjyate | natvaṇunā svapnāvasthā vatā na | aṇunā sṛjyate cet anirdiṣṭasyavastuno darśanaṃ na bhavati | tasmādaṇunā na sṛjyate | iṣṭasya vastuno darśane'pi svātmanādhiṣṭhita deśaṃ tatra vartamānaṃ kālaṃ tatra vartamānamākāraṃ vihāyānyadeśakālādiyogena darśanāt svayaṃ tat svapnāvasthā vatā na sṛjyata iti śeṣaḥ | ata eva pārameśvarāduktarūpāt sargādeva manomātrasthitatvādeveyaṃ rūpasparśādīnāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ pramātrantaradhāriṇī na bhavati | svapnadraṣṭureva saṃbandhinī tādṛśyāṃ <488> satyāmasādhāraṇyāṃ sṛṣṭau rūpasparśādīnāṃ cakṣurādīndriya viṣayatvaṃ svavyatiriktacaitramaitrādi pramātrantara sādhāraṇyaṃ cakāsti | tad dvayamapi yāvad bhavati tāvat tathaiva bhānaparyantaṃ tathaiva bhāsanaparyantaṃ yadyapi paramārthameva tathā māpamānatvāt tathāpi paramārthamapi uttarakālaṃ prabuddhasya cakṣurādīndriyaviṣayatvaṃ svavyatirikta caitramaitrādi pramātrantara sādhāraṇyaṃ <ṭ p. 378> cakāstītyuttarakālaparāmarśena tad dvayarūpaṃ nirmūlya mānatvenāvabhātīti bhrāntaṃ svapataḥ pramātustasmin svapne svātmanā saha caitramaitrapramātrantarāṇi cakṣurādi bāhyendriyāṇi ca bhānti | tāni prabodhakālabhāvibhiḥ pramātrantaraiścakṣurādibhiś(-) cābhinnānīti | tatra svapne niścayaḥ prabodhakāle tathā na | etaiḥ pramātrantarai cakṣurādibhiścābhinnāni na iti tadabheda niścayānuvṛttirapohyata eva
